jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: "We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time." AI Platform Engineer As an AI Platform Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the foundational components of an enterprise AI platform, enabling secure, scalable, and responsible development and deployment of advanced AI and agentic solutions. You will work across the full AI platform stack, from data ingestion and vector databases to retrieval systems, orchestration frameworks, agent platforms, and developer\-facing APIs, enabling teams to rapidly deliver innovative AI\-powered business capabilities. You will collaborate with security, FinOps, platform engineering, data engineering, and application teams to deliver enterprise\-grade AI capabilities that are secure, observable, and cost efficient. Your work will span cloud\-native AI services, agentic architectures, orchestration frameworks, and responsible AI guardrails. You will play a critical role in designing and implementing solutions based on Model Context Protocol (MCP), enterprise AI Gateway patterns, and modern agent platforms including Amazon Bedrock and AWS AgentCore. You will help establish the enterprise standards for model access, agent execution, governance, observability, and cost optimization while enabling a multi\-model AI ecosystem through AI Gateway technologies such as Kong AI Gateway and similar enterprise platforms. You can build and maintain AI platform services: * Design, build, and operate enterprise AI platform capabilities supporting Generative AI, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic workloads. * Develop scalable data ingestion pipelines, knowledge ingestion workflows, and AI data services. * Integrate vector databases, embeddings, knowledge graphs, and enterprise knowledge repositories with appropriate governance controls. * Design and implement retrieval frameworks supporting enterprise search, semantic search, and RAG patterns. * Build and operate AI services using Amazon Bedrock, including foundation model integrations, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, and inference capabilities. * Design and support agentic architectures utilizing AWS AgentCore and other enterprise agent platforms. * Implement model serving infrastructure for real\-time and batch inference workloads. * Enable secure agentic workflows through Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool orchestration frameworks, and agent\-to\-agent communication patterns. * Design and implement AI Gateway capabilities using technologies such as Kong AI Gateway to provide centralized authentication, routing, governance, observability, rate limiting, and policy enforcement for AI workloads. * Develop APIs, SDKs, reusable platform services, and self\-service capabilities that accelerate AI adoption across engineering teams. You ensure observability and responsible AI: * Monitor model performance, application behavior, agent execution, and service reliability. * Implement logging, tracing, alerting, rollback, and operational recovery mechanisms. * Monitor AI usage patterns, token consumption, latency, throughput, and AI Gateway telemetry. * Implement observability solutions that provide visibility into prompts, responses, model behavior, agent interactions, and platform health. * Apply explainability, fairness, governance, and compliance guardrails consistent with Responsible AI principles. * Support model evaluation, benchmarking, experimentation, and lifecycle management processes. You have experience embedding security and compliance: * Design and implement secure AI platform architectures using cloud\-native security controls. * Integrate encryption, IAM, secrets management, and audit logging capabilities. * Implement secure access patterns through AI Gateway platforms including authorization, policy enforcement, prompt security controls, and data protection measures. * Support compliance with regulatory and internal governance frameworks, including privacy, security, and Responsible AI requirements. * Partner with Information Security, Risk, Compliance, and Data Governance teams to ensure safe and compliant use of enterprise data and AI services. * Enable governance for models, agents, prompts, tools, and enterprise knowledge sources. You drive operational excellence: * Apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices to ensure reliability, scalability, and operational maturity. * Apply FinOps principles to optimize AI platform utilization, model consumption, and cloud spending. * Automate infrastructure provisioning and management using Infrastructure as Code (IaC). * Establish operational standards, platform runbooks, SLA/SLO metrics, and support procedures. * Drive continuous improvements in platform security, performance, resiliency, and developer experience. You collaborate and enable teams: * Partner with software engineers, platform engineers, architects, and product teams to deliver enterprise AI solutions. * Consult with application teams on AI platform integration patterns and best practices. * Create reference architectures, reusable patterns, and implementation guidance. * Develop documentation, runbooks, architectural diagrams, and operational standards. * Mentor team members and help promote adoption of enterprise AI platform capabilities. Required Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 7\+ years of experience designing, building, and operating distributed platform technologies or cloud\-native systems. * 3\+ years of experience building, operating, or supporting AI/ML platforms and services. * Hands\-on experience with Amazon Bedrock and enterprise foundation model platforms. * Experience designing and implementing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures using vector databases, embeddings, and enterprise knowledge sources. * Experience building or operating agentic AI systems utilizing AWS AgentCore or comparable agent frameworks. * Experience designing and implementing solutions based on Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Experience implementing AI Gateway solutions (e.g., Kong AI Gateway or equivalent) for AI governance, traffic management, observability, and security. * Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks, agent\-to\-agent communication patterns, and multi\-agent architectures. * Strong understanding of LLM operations including prompt engineering, model evaluation, guardrails, governance, and token optimization. * Proficiency in Python and/or other languages commonly used for AI and platform engineering. * Experience with AWS cloud services, containerization, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD practices. * Understanding of observability, monitoring, and operational support for AI and agent\-based systems. * Experience implementing security, privacy, governance, and compliance controls in AI environments. Preferred Qualifications * Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries. * AWS certifications related to AI, Machine Learning, Cloud Architecture, or Platform Engineering. * Experience with Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, Bedrock Guardrails, Agents for Bedrock, and AWS AgentCore services. * Experience with Kong AI Gateway or comparable API and AI Gateway technologies. * Experience implementing MCP servers, tool catalogs, and secure tool execution frameworks. * Experience with enterprise multi\-model strategies spanning Anthropic Claude, Amazon Nova, OpenAI, Google Gemini, and other foundation models. * Familiarity with AI\-specific observability and monitoring platforms. * Experience implementing Responsible AI frameworks, guardrails, explainability, and model governance processes. * Experience with FinOps practices and cost optimization for Generative AI workloads. * Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, and platform engineering practices. * Experience building enterprise self\-service AI platforms and developer enablement capabilities. **Kaleidoscope, an Infosys Company, is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, spouse of protected veteran, or disability.**

jobs.title: Applications and Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **Applications and Sales Engineer (Junior)** Elkton, MD \| Full\-time \| In person \| 10–20% travel \| $65,000–$90,000 per year plus revenue\-sharing bonus **Who We Are** Spectrum Advanced is a growing technology company. We're innovators with patented and patent\-pending technology, and we've been in the industrial non\-stick sleeve and coatings business for over 30 years. We're building our future right here in Elkton, MD. Our purpose is to build transformative technology platforms that elevate our customers, our employees, and our community. * Spectrum Advanced: \[www.spectrumadvanced.com ](http://www.spectrumadvanced.com) * Aegis Advanced: \[www.aegis\-advanced.com ](http://www.aegis\-advanced.com) (high\-performance industrial coatings) * Fluoron: \[www.fluoron.com ](http://www.fluoron.com) (specialty non\-stick roller sleeves and covers) * Radiant Cleaning: \[www.rollercleaning.com ](http://www.rollercleaning.com) (industrial roll cleaning) **The Opportunity** This isn't a typical sales job, and it isn't a desk engineering job. It's both. You'll learn our full product line directly from our team, then go out and help customers solve real problems in paper mills, packaging and converting plants, food processors and other manufacturers. We're looking for someone early in their career who wants to learn the technical side and the business side at the same time. You'll dig into what's costing a customer money, figure out which of our solutions fixes it, quote it, and follow it through. As we grow, this person grows with us. **Who We're Looking For** You don't need to know our products on day one. We'll teach you. What we need is: * Drive and grit. You push, you follow through, and you don't quit when a deal or a problem gets hard. * Self\-direction. You manage your own pipeline and find the next thing to do without being told. * A hunger to learn. You want to understand how things work and why a customer's process is failing. * Ownership thinking. You treat the customer's problem and our business like they're your own. **What You'll Do** * Learn our full suite of coatings, roller sleeves and covers, and roll\-cleaning services from our engineering and operations team * Talk with customers and prospects to understand their process, their pain points, and what those problems cost them * Recommend the right product or solution and explain the value in plain terms * Build and send quotes, then follow up until the customer makes a decision * Travel to customer sites (10–20%) to inspect rolls, equipment and applications and recommend solutions * Work with our shop and field teams to make sure what we sell gets delivered right * Keep customer and quote records up to date in our CRM **What You Need** * A technical background, either a degree (engineering, chemistry, materials science or related) or hands\-on technical experience from work, the military or a trade * Comfort talking with people, asking questions and listening * Strong written communication for quotes and follow\-up * A valid driver's license and the ability to travel overnight 10–20% of the time * Basic computer skills (Excel, Outlook, Word) **Helpful, But Not Required** * Sales experience, especially solution or consultative selling * Internship or co\-op experience in manufacturing, coatings or industrial equipment * Experience in paper, packaging, printing, converting or food manufacturing * Customer service, inside sales or technical support experience If you don't meet every item, apply anyway. We hire for drive and teach the rest. **How You'll Grow** Your first few months, you'll learn our products in the shop and alongside our team on customer calls and site visits. As you get comfortable, you'll own quotes and accounts on your own. From there, the path leads to Senior Applications Engineer, Account Manager or a larger sales role as the company grows. **Benefits** * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Life insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off and paid holidays * Revenue\-sharing bonus plan * Travel expenses covered **Work Location** In person at our Elkton, MD facility. This role is fully onsite during training so you can learn our products hands\-on with our team. Pre\-employment drug screen and background check required. Must be authorized to work in the United States. Spectrum Advanced is an Equal Opportunity Employer. You should be proficient in: * Customer Service * materials science * problem solving * Technical Sales

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in manufacturing or assembly process engineering, precision mechanical assembly, and digital manufacturing systems, along with a genuine passion for motorsports and Formula 1\. Preferred Qualifications * Microsoft Office Suite experience. * Siemens NX experience. * Experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), electronic build records, or digital manufacturing platforms. * Working knowledge of torque\-controlled assembly processes, fastening methods, and experience with Atlas Copco torque tools and associated software. * Previous experience in motorsports, high\-performance engine assembly, automotive powertrain manufacturing, or other precision manufacturing environments. Our culture rewards precision, innovation, and the relentless pursuit of performance. **Please note:** GM Performance Power Units and all affiliated companies are Equal Opportunity employer(s). jobs.title: Field Application Engineer - Data Center Power
jobs.description: About Arete Arete Intelligent Power is building the intelligent power architecture from grid\-to\-chip. As industrial loads push the market toward 800 VDC, the path from the medium\-voltage grid to the point of consumption is being rebuilt — and the hard problem is no longer only conversion, but control. We design conversion, storage, and intelligent power management as a single architecture. Formed in 2025 and headquartered in Fremont, California, Arete serves AI computing, electrified transportation, microgrids, and heavy industry. This role is focused on AI data centers. The Role This is a customer\-facing engineering role. You will spend most of your time in front of other people's engineers — data center architects, OEM hardware teams, and the specifiers who write a basis of design. Your job is to find out what a customer actually needs, often before they can state it themselves, and to translate that into solutions our engineering team can build. You will partner directly with the Commercial Lead. They own the executive relationships, pricing, and the business case. You own technical discovery, architecture validation, and the engineering close. This is a strong fit for a systems architect, power electronics engineer, or site deployment lead who wants to move into a visible commercial role. It is not a design seat. You will not own a schematic. What You Will Do Discovery. Sit with a customer who knows they need 96% efficiency but cannot say what topology, what redundancy, or what safety framework that implies. Ask the questions that surface the real requirement — load profile, input feed, form factor, thermal envelope, what they are replacing, and when. Architecture validation. Develop conceptual designs and integration guidance for HVDC Power Racks, high\-efficiency power shelves, and in\-rack DC\-DC conversion. Assess fit, derating, thermal envelope, and integration risk at the assembly and sub\-assembly level. Technical close. Lead technical responses to RFPs and RFQs. Evaluate hardware specifications against customer requirements and carry the technical argument to a decision. Translation, in both directions. Explain conversion efficiency, intelligent power routing, and topology tradeoffs to people who will not follow the math — including executives and financial buyers. Then carry what you learn in the field back to engineering as a requirement they can build against. Standards engagement. Represent Arete in OCP working groups and at OCP Global Summit. Guide customers on ORv3 and OCP HPR form\-factor fit, and maintain our published conformance position as the open specifications move. Safety and certification support. Field customer and AHJ questions on NEC 645, UL 62368, DC arc\-flash and IEEE 1584 analysis, and DC protection at 800 VDC. Coordinate with internal teams and third\-party engineers on PE\-stamp scope. Global engineering interface. Work daily with our Taiwan\-based R\&D organization — translating customer requirements into engineering\-ready requests, and bringing specification answers back to the field without loss of fidelity. Voice of customer. Give the product and engineering teams direct field feedback that shapes future HVDC architecture and power conversion hardware. Hands\-on support. Assist hardware engineering teams and system integrators through bench testing and prototype validation, to ensure seamless component integration. What You Need Education. BSEE or a closely related technical discipline, with a focus on power electronics. Experience. At least five years in technical applications, pre\-sales engineering, field applications, or power engineering. Experience with server\-level power supplies or power conversion hardware is what we are looking for; adjacent high\-power conversion experience — traction, industrial drives, utility\-scale inverters, energy storage — is credited where the physics and the customer work transfer. A customer\-facing track record. You have sat across from a customer's engineer and walked them through a design tradeoff they did not want to hear. We will ask you for specific examples, by company and by situation. Domain depth. Working proficiency in AC and DC power topologies, with emphasis on HVDC architecture and high\-density DC\-DC and AC\-DC conversion. Physical engineering literacy. You can read a single\-line diagram, evaluate site thermal loads, reason about available grid capacity, and work to HVDC specifications. This role lives in physical constraints, not in a configuration file. Standards familiarity. Working knowledge of Open Compute Project rack and power specifications (ORv3, OCP HPR), and of the safety and certification framework governing data center power — NEC 645, UL 62368, IEEE 1584\. Direct OCP working\-group participation is a plus, not a requirement; we expect to build that presence with you. Component knowledge. Analytical understanding of power electronics components and their performance characteristics in high\-heat, high\-load environments. Professional Skills Customer\-facing judgment. Exceptional communication, with a record of guiding hardware engineers and executive stakeholders through complex technical evaluations. Collaborative execution. Demonstrated success working across account executives, OEM hardware developers, and internal product managers. International fluency. Comfortable across time zones and cultures, including regular early\-morning coordination with engineering teams in Taiwan, and periodic international travel. Mandarin is a strong plus. Employment Basics Type: Full\-time, exempt Location: Fremont, California. Onsite, with flexibility around the early\-morning engineering cadence. Travel: Approximately 20%, domestic and international. Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus paid time off. Work authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Arete is not sponsoring employment visas for this position at this time. Essential Functions and Work Environment Travel: Regular travel of approximately 20%, domestic and international, including air travel. Site access: Access to customer data center and laboratory environments, including areas containing energized electrical equipment, subject to site safety and personal protective equipment requirements. Hands\-on work: Bench work with rack\-level hardware, including occasional lifting and positioning of equipment up to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation. Schedule: Regular early\-morning video conferences to coordinate with engineering teams in Asia. Workstation: Prolonged periods working at a computer. Reasonable accommodation. Applicants who require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process may contact hr@arete\-power.com. Equal opportunity. Arete Intelligent Power is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, reproductive health decisionmaking, marital status, age (40 and over), national origin, ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Name one power conversion product you personally debugged in the field. What failed, and how did you find it? * Name a customer you personally walked through a design decision. What did they want, what did you recommend, and did they take it? * This role requires regular early\-morning video calls with our engineering team in Taiwan, and approximately 20% travel. Are you able to work that schedule? Experience: * power electronics or power conversion: 5 years (Preferred) Ability to Commute: * Fremont, CA 94538 (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.description: **About Bidfinite** Bidfinite is a fantasy auction game for car people. It’s a prediction market for enthusiasts who can accurately guess what collector cars will sell for on auction sites. It’s fantasy football for gearheads, DraftKings for people who own a torque wrench and have opinions about 996 headlights. It'll be better than both, because of you. Why are we building it? Because somewhere out there is a jamoke lobbing car value comments without consequence. Who will hold him accountable? With your help, he can put his money where his mouth is. We also publish a shitty YouTube show that reviews, predicts and ridicules the collector\-car auction world. Fact, none of your friends are subscribed. **About the role** Still reading? We're hiring a contract developer, or a fractional full\-stack dev to join us as a trusted partner, to take Bidfinite from test mode through two launches: a public free\-play launch, then a launch with paid contests. The work is across three build phases. You choose how you're paid, from all cash to a mix of cash and equity that vests when each launch ships. We have had a POC running, tested it with car clubs and friends, but it was done on a tactical foundation. It was uglier than a 1 gen Honda Ridgeline, but it helped us improve game play. **What you'll build** You'll work directly with the founders to turn a working test\-mode game into a product ready for thousands of players hungry to put their useful and useless car knowledge to the test. Working from a Figma board and our working POC, you'll own features end to end, from design notes through shipped code, and help us make practical calls on architecture and tooling. **What we're looking for** * You've shipped at least one web app or game with real users and live, time\-sensitive data. * You've built secure sites with cash payments, ledgers, etc. * You're a beast in modern full\-stack web development: a front\-end framework, an API layer, and a relational database. Note: We have a solid front\-end dev, so if you're a car enthusiast with back\-end chops, reach out anyway. * You've built features that depend on outside data sources, such as scraped or third\-party listing data, and kept them reliable. * You've built real\-time or near\-real\-time features: countdowns, live updates, scoring, and leaderboards. * You work well in a small team: you scope, estimate, and flag risks early. * You can deal with two lifelong friends who sling slander and sarcasm, but it (probably) won't be aimed at you. Nice to have: payments integration, fantasy sports or contest platforms, and a soft spot for collector cars. Bonus points if you've ever yelled at a Bring a Trailer listing! **Engagement and pay** This is a contract role. We'd love to have someone in the tri\-state or Boston area \-\- founders are based in NY and Boston. You can work remotely, but we will have to meet in person in NY, CT or among the Massholes. Flexible on cash v. equity, but this is a boot\-strapped endeavor. Final hours, equity, and IP terms will be set out in a written agreement. **How to apply** You made it this far? Then you should email paul@bidfinite.com with the subject "Bidfinite contract developer" and include: * Links to one or two apps or games you shipped, and what you built on each * The pay option you'd lean toward, or questions about the options * Your availability and start date * 3 cars you hate, 3 cars you’ll buy when we all strike it rich We'll reply within 24 hours. Shortlisted applicants will have a quick call with the founders and, ideally, an IRL meetup. We do not discriminate on race or sex, but we’re douchey about car preferences. jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. Your work at Peregrine Advisors will cover both development and support for cloud\-native Python services running on Amazon Web Services (AWS). But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first project** On your first project, you will likely see user stories through every stage, from refinement to production. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Turn user stories into back\-end features written in Python on a cloud\-native AWS stack. * Create the React.js screens and components through which users reach those features. * Connect internal systems to commercial products by creating the integrations and application programming interfaces (APIs) between them. * Rely on Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\), AWS Lambda, and related AWS services to automate workflows. * Contribute to automating the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline, produce secure, accessible code, and provide production support for your services. * Write tests at both the unit and integration levels, take part in code reviews, and fix the defects you uncover as you carry the work through to production. * Support quality development practices, with test\-driven development and automated testing among them. * Make AI\-assisted development tools part of your daily routine, reviewing and testing all of their output. You take responsibility for delivering tested, working code, carrying it through production and finding and fixing its defects. Your automation replaces the spreadsheet workflows, manual checks, and validations in business operations, and you create deployment pipelines that make service releases routine. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of professional hands\-on software development experience, with back\-end work in Python and front\-end work in React.js * Bachelor's degree * Familiarity with development in the AWS cloud and with services including Amazon S3 and AWS Lambda * Skill in applying data modeling, design patterns, and object\-oriented design to turn a defined specification into tested code that works, then owning that code through production * A background working with relational database systems such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Oracle * A background using NoSQL databases, for example DynamoDB or MongoDB * Sound analytical judgment, applied through strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills * A history of Agile delivery, whether Scrum, Kanban, or similar, with work tracked in Jira or a comparable tool * The ability to communicate exceptionally well, collaborate directly with non\-technical stakeholders at the client, and translate requirements from the business into technical solutions * Reliable estimates for the tasks assigned to you and the effort they take * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * Familiarity with the practices used in DevSecOps and with CI/CD pipelines * Hands\-on experience delivering production workloads in AWS, or certification in Python or AWS * Experience providing consulting services while interacting with clients * Prior work in information technology for the federal government * Familiarity with tools that use AI to help developers **Who you are** You care about your work and assess it by how well it serves those who depend on it. You adapt when priorities change and develop enough depth in new tools or domains to make your own judgments instead of relying on instructions. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * Hands\-on fluency in modern cloud development, with the breadth to improve a system already in place or to create something new. * Delivery habits that cover secure coding, accessibility, code review, unit and integration testing, and version control. * Plain, clear communication with everyone who relies on your work, and an ear for what they actually need. * A meticulous streak wherever accuracy and auditability cannot be compromised. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $150,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.*

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** ==================== The Mechanical Engineer applies mechanical engineering principles to improve the safety, quality, repeatability, and efficiency of Genie Reconditioning’s heavy\-equipment reconditioning operations so the factory meets required mix and rate with fewer total labor and rework hours per unit. This is a production\-facing manufacturing engineering role, not a product\-design or product\-documentation position. The engineer develops manufacturing methods and provides advanced technical problem solving for mechanical, hydraulic, structural, and assembly processes. **Essential Job Functions** =========================== * Provide daily production\-floor engineering support across disassembly, preparation/paint, and assembly operations for Genie mobile elevating work platforms. * Apply engineering analysis and independent technical judgment to diagnose recurring production problems, determine root causes, and implement verified corrective actions. * Develop, validate, document, deploy, and improve production processes, ERP routings, standard work, workstation layouts, factory flow, common infrastructure, and assembly methods. * Conduct time studies and labor analysis; analyze cycle times, bottleneck constraints, ergonomics, first\-pass quality, safety, downtime, and rework; implement measurable improvements in throughput, cost, and total labor and rework hours per unit, verified at the whole\-unit level. * Collaborate with Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Maintenance, EHS, and Product Engineering to resolve manufacturing constraints and ensure process readiness. * Specify, evaluate, and support procurement, installation, commissioning, and validation of production tooling and equipment within approved authority. * Direct two manufacturing engineering technicians and project teams by setting daily priorities, delegating technical assignments, providing hands\-on coaching and training, monitoring execution, and addressing performance or quality concerns through the Engineering Manager. * Own labor control and the continuous improvement program (CIP); support lean manufacturing, 5S, structured problem solving, and waste\-reduction initiatives, and ensure savings are sustained. * Participate in open\-book management by tracking key engineering metrics (total labor per unit, rework hours per unit, bottleneck capacity, and sustained savings), explaining performance drivers, and connecting improvements to operating and financial results. * Maintain engineering process records, validation results, technical drawings, and change documentation; escalate product\-design changes to authorized product engineering personnel. * Engineer mechanical assembly, disassembly, alignment, fit\-up, fastening, and torque\-control processes for boom lifts and related equipment. * Analyze hydraulic and mechanical systems, components, interfaces, and failure modes; develop safe and repeatable production troubleshooting and verification methods. * Design or specify fixtures, jigs, lifting/positioning aids, tooling, and ergonomic improvements using engineering calculations and appropriate CAD tools. * Evaluate structural and mechanical assembly tolerances, material handling methods, fastening integrity, and process capability; coordinate any product\-design deviations through authorized channels. * Develop mechanical process trials, tooling acceptance criteria, equipment specifications, and documented validation plans. **Technical Direction and Authority** ===================================== Exercises independent professional judgment in manufacturing methods, process engineering, technical analysis, and recommendations within approved company standards. May serve as technical team lead for assigned technicians and cross\-functional improvement initiatives, including work planning, task delegation, coaching, and feedback. Formal personnel decisions, including hiring, discipline, termination, and performance ratings, remain with authorized management unless expressly delegated. **Minimum Qualifications** ========================== * Bachelor’s degree (four\-year) in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering with substantial mechanical coursework, or a closely related engineering discipline. * Three or more years of manufacturing, industrial equipment, or production engineering experience with demonstrated hands\-on problem solving. * Demonstrated ability to independently analyze technical problems, develop engineering solutions, and validate results. * Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, work instructions, and manufacturing documentation. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, demonstrated ability to lead and develop people, ability to coordinate technical work effectively on the production floor, and a practical, collaborative approach with a sense of urgency and a willingness to listen to production associates. * Mechanical design and manufacturing principles; hydraulics, pneumatics, mechanical power transmission, fasteners, tolerances, and structural assemblies. * Ability to interpret mechanical drawings, GD\&T, specifications, and assembly requirements. * CAD proficiency (e.g., SolidWorks or equivalent) and engineering\-based tooling/fixture evaluation. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience with heavy industrial equipment, aerial work platforms, or equipment reconditioning, including Genie S\-65, S\-85, or S\-125\. * Experience with lean manufacturing, 5S, root cause analysis, process validation, and continuous improvement. * Experience with Infor CloudSuite Industrial (SyteLine), production data systems, or comparable ERP/MRP tools. * Experience leading, coaching, mentoring, or coordinating manufacturing engineering technicians or cross\-functional production teams. **Work Environment and Physical Requirements** ============================================== Work occurs in engineering/office areas and on an active industrial production floor with noise, dust, fumes, moving equipment, and variable temperatures. Essential activities include regularly walking and standing to inspect processes; observing machinery and workstations; reading drawings and screens; communicating with employees; and using computers, measuring instruments, and tools. Occasional bending, reaching, and handling of components may be required. Use approved lifting equipment or assistance for heavy items. Required PPE and established machine\-guarding, lockout/tagout, and electrical safety procedures apply when relevant to assigned work. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable qualified individuals to perform essential functions. Production needs may require additional hours. **General Conditions** ====================== Comply with applicable safety, environmental, and quality requirements and company policies. Perform other related duties as assigned, consistent with business needs. Employment offers are contingent on satisfactory completion of applicable background screening and pre\-employment drug screening, conducted in accordance with law and company policy. Genie Reconditioning, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This description identifies principal duties and is not an employment contract; duties may evolve with business needs. Monday through Friday. Extended hours, including evenings and weekends, may be required to meet business needs. 40 hours per week; full\-time, salaried exempt.

stress testing, resilient CI/CD, and systematic reduction of flaky tests **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- * Highly competitive salary and equity * Comprehensive health coverage for you and your dependents * Strong 401(k) match * Meals and snacks on us \+ discretionary productivity budget *Strong preference for in\-person in Palo Alto or Brooklyn.* **About Inco** ============== Inco AI (inco.ai) builds the agent\-native inference platform for tomorrow's token economics. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Engineer
jobs.description: **Member of Technical Staff, ML Engineering** ============================================= **About Optica Industries** --------------------------- Optica Industries is a frontier metals company, building processing plants to sort the 3M tons/yr of exported secondary metal supply into alloy\-specific, segregated ore. Our research underpins our core LIBS (Laser\-Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy) technology for material analysis. Backed by Addition and Lightspeed Venture Partners. **The Role** ------------ We're developing new methods in scientific machine learning to predict the elemental composition of scrap metal from laser\-induced plasma emission spectra. LIBS measurements are affected by complex physical and chemical phenomena, including matrix effects, plasma dynamics, elemental interactions, and surface conditions. These effects introduce variability in measured spectra, making accurate composition prediction difficult across different alloys and experimental conditions. You'll work closely with our research and engineering teams to develop, train, and evaluate machine learning models for elemental composition prediction. You'll implement ideas from recent ML research, investigate model failures, build reliable experimental pipelines, and contribute to developing new methods that improve predictive accuracy. Our research is conducted in our SF\-based R\&D facility, with applications in our Nashville, TN processing plant. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Develop and train ML models for elemental composition prediction and alloy classification from LIBS spectra. * Implement and evaluate methods from recent machine learning research, adapting them to scientific and spectral data. * Build reliable training, evaluation, and data processing pipelines using Python and PyTorch or JAX. * Run controlled experiments, ablation studies, and error analyses to understand model performance and failure modes. * Investigate how measurement variability, data quality, and distribution shifts affect model predictions. * Explore new model architectures, training objectives, and representation learning approaches alongside the research team. * Work with experimental data collected from physical instrumentation to validate models against independently measured elemental compositions. * Collaborate with researchers and engineers to translate promising methods into reliable industrial systems. **What You Bring** ------------------ **Required** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Strong foundations in machine learning, deep learning, linear algebra, probability, and optimization. * Strong Python programming skills and hands\-on experience with PyTorch or JAX. * Experience training and evaluating ML models through research projects, internships, coursework, or industry work. * Ability to read ML research papers and implement methods from mathematical formulations or published code. * Experience debugging training pipelines, analyzing model performance, and designing meaningful experiments. * Strong problem\-solving skills, curiosity, and willingness to learn unfamiliar scientific concepts. **Preferred** * Research experience through undergraduate research, internships, independent projects, or publications. * Experience with representation learning, self\-supervised learning, probabilistic modeling, or scientific machine learning. * Experience working with spectral, time\-series, or other non\-text data. * Familiarity with numerical methods, physics\-informed learning, or scientific computing. * Experience with experiment tracking, GPU training, and reproducible ML pipelines. * Contributions to open\-source ML projects or implementations of recent research papers. Prior LIBS, spectroscopy, or materials science experience is not required. We're looking for strong early\-career ML engineers who enjoy understanding how models work, running rigorous experiments, and solving difficult problems with real\-world data. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- * Competitive base salary and equity * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 7\+ years of professional hands\-on back\-end software development experience in Python * 5\+ years of hands\-on front\-end software development experience in React.js * Bachelor's degree * A strong practical background developing cloud\-native applications on AWS with Amazon RDS, Amazon SQS, Amazon S3, and AWS Lambda * An advanced understanding that spans database design, data modeling, object\-oriented programming, design patterns, distributed systems, and software architecture * A strong background working with relational database systems such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Oracle * A strong background using NoSQL databases, for example DynamoDB or MongoDB * Strength in analysis, troubleshooting, and solving problems * A background directing Agile delivery in Scrum or Kanban, with the work tracked in Jira or a similar issue tracker * An established record of directing a team of developers and mentoring them * Direct, practical use of AI\-assisted developer tools, for example GitHub Copilot or Amazon Q Developer * Excellent communication skills that let you engage technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leaders * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * A background in putting CI/CD pipelines in place and following DevSecOps best practices * Certification in either Python or AWS * Prior work in information technology for the federal government * Experience heading technical delivery teams on consulting engagements involving direct client interaction **Who you are** You are accountable for what you build and invest time in helping fellow developers improve through code reviews, explanations of your reasoning, and the standard you establish. Others turn to you for difficult decisions because your judgment is sound, and you maintain a steady, productive team as priorities change. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * Deep expertise in modern cloud development, broad enough to enhance systems that are already running or to create something new. * Judgment to compare competing solutions, resolve design tradeoffs between components, and take ownership of technical direction in the area assigned to you. * Strong delivery discipline covering accessibility, secure coding, code review, automated testing, and version control, with the standing to establish these practices for a team. * The ability to explain your work in plain terms to those who depend on it, and to listen carefully for their needs. * Uncompromising rigor whenever accuracy and auditability are on the line. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $150,000 to $180,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: **About Citadel Aviation** Citadel Aviation has grown from a startup vision into a global leader in V/VVIP aircraft completions, maintenance, modifications, and luxury interiors. Located in Lake Charles, Dallas, and serving customers onsite where they're at, our teams deliver work on some of the most sophisticated narrow and wide body aircraft in the world. We have significantly expanded project volume since 2019, and that growth was built by people who take pride in doing the work right. Whatever your role, Citadel is a place to bring what you know and build what comes next. **Purpose** =========== The Software Developer builds and maintains the applications and integrations that serve Citadel's internal teams and external customers, with modern AI\-assisted development as a core part of how the work gets done. The role builds AI\-enabled features, automation, and decision\-support capabilities into Citadel's applications where they advance business outcomes, stays current as AI tools and workflows advance, manages assigned development work, and is accountable for the quality, reliability, and ongoing support of the applications it builds and maintains. This position reports to the Manager \- Software Development and partners with IT leadership and peers across IT and the broader business to ensure exceptional service to Citadel's internal and external customers, embodying Citadel's ethos of trust, respect, and collaboration. **Responsibilities** ==================== **Application Development \& AI\-Assisted Delivery** * Design, build, test, and ship business applications, integrations, and automation that serve Citadel's internal teams and external customers. * Use AI\-assisted development tools as a core part of the daily workflow; apply current best practices for prompting, task decomposition, context management, and output review, and bring proven advances into the team's practice as the field evolves. * Apply rigorous review discipline to AI\-generated code, including correctness validation, security review against known vulnerability patterns, test\-coverage verification, and adherence to Citadel's coding standards; maintain clear judgment about when AI tools can take the work and when human design, review, or rewrite is required. * Build AI\-enabled features and agent\-assisted workflows into Citadel's applications where they advance business outcomes, applying current patterns for prompting, context, tool use, evaluation, and safety controls. * Monitor and manage the cost of AI usage across development workflows and AI\-enabled features; share workflow learnings, prompts, and reusable patterns with the development team. **Business Partnership \& Portfolio Support** * Work directly with assigned business departments to understand workflows, identify opportunities, and build tools that improve how the business operates; partner with stakeholders from concept through prototyping, rollout, adoption, and ongoing support. * Maintain and modernize the existing application portfolio; pay down technical debt, address security and compliance findings, and keep applications current with platform and dependency updates. * Integrate applications with Citadel's core platforms, including ERP, finance, identity, and other operational systems, through APIs and data flows. * Build reporting and analytics deliverables for business consumers using Power BI, Crystal Reports, and the data flows that feed them. **Technical Craft \& Operations** * Develop in Citadel's primary stack (.NET, C\#, web technologies, SQL Server) with the supporting toolchain (Visual Studio, Git, IDE integrations, and AI assistants); design and maintain database schemas, queries, stored procedures, and reporting data flows. * Apply secure development practices, including input validation, secrets management, authentication and authorization controls, dependency management, and peer code review. * Perform in line with established sprint commitments, quality targets, and team KPIs; participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and peer code review. * Take ownership of incidents and issues in applications built or maintained by this role; participate in on\-call coverage as scheduled, diagnose and fix issues, communicate root cause and resolution, and maintain runbooks and technical documentation. * Identify and propose improvements in architecture, integration patterns, reusable components, deployment, and technical debt, and lead approved initiatives through delivery. **Requirements** ================ **Required** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline (equivalent professional experience considered in lieu of degree). * 3\+ years of professional software development experience. * Hands\-on experience with .NET, C\#, and modern web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and a current frontend framework). * Hands\-on experience with SQL Server, including writing queries and s gging, and test creation), with a demonstrated practice of validating, reviewing, and refining AI\-generated code before it reaches production; working familiarity with at least one mainstream tool such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, or comparable. * Experience supporting applications in production, including diagnosing issues, addressing user\-reported bugs, and managing release coordination. * Demonstrated ability to communicate technical concepts to non\-technical business stakeholders. * Demonstrated experience writing secure, maintainable, and well\-documented code. **Preferred** * Experience in aviation, aerospace, manufacturing, MRO, or other regulated operational environments. * Experience building AI\-enabled features into business applications, including large language model integration, retrieval patterns, prompt engineering, or agentic workflows. * Experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Devin, or comparable) and judgment about when to delegate work to agents. * Experience integrating with or supporting ERP and other operational business platforms (Microsoft Dynamics GP, Corridor Aviation, or comparable). * Experience with reporting platforms such as Power BI or Crystal Reports. * Experience with Python or Node.js as a complement to the .NET stack. * Familiarity with CI/CD build and release pipelines, and agile methodologies. **Working Conditions** ====================== * This position is considered OFFICE WORK, performed almost exclusively indoors during the day and occasionally at night. * Occasional exposure to airborne dust in the workplace; work surface is stable (flat). * Considered LIGHT work with frequent lifting up to 20 lbs; occasional climbing, stooping, kneeling, squatting, and reaching, with repetitive movements of arms and hands and seated work with back supported. * After\-hours and on\-call work is required for critical systems support and incident response. * Occasional travel to other Citadel sites for stakeholder embedding, project work, or collaboration; typically infrequent and primarily local or regional, with overnight travel only as project demands require. * May require flexible shifts, overtime, weekends, or holidays based on business demand. **Knowledge, Skills, and Other Attributes** =========================================== * Strong technical proficiency in .NET, C\#, SQL Server, and modern web development. * Working knowledge of API design and system\-integration patterns. * Strong fluency with AI\-assisted development tools and judgment about when to apply them, when human design and review is required, and how to verify outputs against common failure modes (security vulnerabilities, paper tests, over\-engineered solutions, architectural drift). * Ability to design clean, maintainable, and secure application architecture appropriate to the scope of the work. * Strong troubleshooting and debugging discipline, with a bias toward identifying and resolving root cause. * Project\-management and prioritization skills across simultaneous tasks and stakeholders. * Strong written and verbal communication with both technical peers and business stakeholders, including the ability to translate technical concepts for senior leadership audiences. * Customer\-service mindset, treating business stakeholders as partners in shipping the right thing. * Self\-motivated, adaptable, and willing to engage across the full lifecycle from idea through production support. **Equal Employment Opportunity** ================================ *Citadel Aviation, LLC. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Cobalt Assembly** *Build, ship, and operate software with confidence.* **Headquarters:** San Francisco, California **Industry:** Cloud infrastructure and developer tools Cobalt Assembly develops a cloud platform that helps engineering teams build, deploy, monitor, and operate production software. Its customers include technology companies and large digital businesses that need reliable infrastructure without forcing every development team to manage complex cloud systems independently. The company is recognized for technically demanding work, a high engineering bar, and products designed primarily for professional software developers. **Software Engineer — Developer Platform** **Location:** San Francisco, California **Work arrangement:** Hybrid — four office days, with Friday available for remote work **Employment:** Full\-time, salaried and exempt **Schedule:** Monday through Friday **Hours:** Approximately 40–45 hours per week **Base salary:** $180,000–$220,000, depending on experience, skills, and interview level **Annual cash bonus:** Not offered for this position **Equity:** Initial grant valued at approximately $160,000–$320,000 over four years **Estimated annualized compensation:** $220,000–$300,000 at the initial grant\-date equity value **Reports to:** Engineering Manager, Developer Platform **On\-call:** Approximately one week every ten weeks The role Cobalt Assembly is hiring a Software Engineer to build the tools and services that other engineering teams use to develop, test, deploy, and monitor production applications. You will work on internal APIs, deployment workflows, developer tooling, and shared cloud infrastructure. This is a mid\-level individual\-contributor position with ownership of meaningful projects, but it does not include direct reports. What you’ll do * Build services and APIs that support application deployment, configuration, and production operations. * Improve developer workflows from local development through testing and release. * Design reliable systems for service discovery, permissions, deployment history, and configuration management. * Work with product engineers to identify recurring development problems and turn them into reusable platform capabilities. * Improve platform observability, automated testing, documentation, and operational readiness. * Investigate production incidents and implement changes that prevent similar failures. * Review code and technical proposals from engineers across the company. * Participate in architecture discussions and document important technical decisions. * Join the platform on\-call rotation after completing onboarding and readiness training. What we’re looking for * At least three years of professional software engineering experience. * Production experience with Go, Java, Python, TypeScript, or another modern programming language. * Experience building backend services, APIs, or internal developer tools. * Working knowledge of relational databases and distributed\-system fundamentals. * Understanding of testing, code review, version control, and continuous delivery. * Ability to diagnose problems using logs, metrics, traces, and production data. * Clear written and verbal communication. * Experience owning a project from initial design through production release. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline is helpful but not required. Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, CI/CD systems, or developer\-platform engineering is helpful but not required. Technology The platform primarily uses Go, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, and AWS. Candidates do not need experience with the entire stack and will receive time to learn unfamiliar components. Compensation and equity The base salary is determined by relevant experience, technical scope, interview performance, and internal leveling. This position does not include an annual cash bonus. Instead, employees receive an equity grant that normally vests over four years, subject to the company’s equity plan and continued employment. The stated equity value is calculated at the time of the grant. Its future value may increase or decrease and is not guaranteed. Equity should not be treated as cash salary. Benefits * **Health and wellbeing:** Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees; dependent coverage subsidy; mental\-health support; life and disability insurance. * **Retirement and financial:** 401(k) with a 4% company match, pre\-tax commuter benefits, and access to financial\-planning resources. * **Time away and family:** 20 days of annual PTO, company holidays, paid sick leave, and 16 weeks of paid parental leave. * **Professional development:** $3,000 annual learning budget, conference support, technical mentorship, and dedicated engineering\-learning days. * **Office and work support:** Company laptop and home\-office equipment, lunch on office days, commuter reimbursement, and relocation assistance when approved. Eligibility and complete plan terms are provided in the official benefits documentation. Schedule and on\-call expectations Most collaboration takes place between 10:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. Pacific Time. Engineers may arrange the remainder of their schedule with their manager. After onboarding, the engineer joins an on\-call rotation approximately once every ten weeks. On\-call engineers respond to urgent platform incidents outside regular hours. When substantial overnight work is required, the following workday’s schedule is adjusted. What success looks like Within the first 90 days, you will understand the platform architecture, deliver a production contribution, and complete on\-call readiness training. Within six months, you should independently lead a platform improvement used by multiple engineering teams and demonstrate sound judgment during design reviews and production incidents. Success is measured through reliability, adoption, developer experience, and long\-term system quality—not the number of code changes submitted. Culture Cobalt Assembly combines high technical standards with a practical approach to engineering. Employees are expected to challenge unclear requirements, explain tradeoffs, and take responsibility for the systems they operate. The team prefers simple, well\-understood solutions over unnecessary novelty. Code reviews are direct but respectful, and engineers are expected to share knowledge rather than protect individual areas of ownership. Hiring process * A 30\-minute introductory call with a member of the Engineering Recruiting team. * A 60\-minute collaborative coding interview in a shared development environment. * A technical interview covering backend fundamentals, debugging, and production reliability. * A system\-design conversation based on a realistic developer\-platform problem. * A final conversation with the Engineering Manager and two prospective teammates. * Final reference and employment\-verification checks, followed by a conditional written offer. Pay: $180,000\.00 \- $220,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94114

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Software Engineer** Location: Remote Level: Mid\-level (3\+ years) **Company Summary** NourishedRx is the first operating system for Food is Health, providing a comprehensive platform that enables partners—including non\-profits, counties, and states—to operationalize and scale their own clinically integrated nutrition programs. Founded in 2019, we are a high\-growth digital health company built on the conviction that diet\-related disease – the single largest influenceable category of healthcare spending – is best solved by treating diet as a root cause rather than a downstream symptom. We provide the interoperable infrastructure that turns nutrition from a fragmented, manual effort into scalable healthcare infrastructure. By serving as the underlying operating system, we empower health plans and government entities to design, launch, and measure clinically integrated nutrition programs with a focus on outcomes\-based reimbursement to drive meaningful health improvements. Join us in revolutionizing healthcare through food. **The Role** NourishedRx is seeking a Software Engineer who already works the way modern engineering teams now work: with AI coding agents doing much of the typing, and the engineer doing the thinking. You will build across our TypeScript platform — member, clinician, and partner experiences, the services behind them, and the integrations and data that make outcomes\-based reimbursement possible. Here, being a software engineer means owning the problem, not just the code. You decide what should be built and how, write the plan and the guardrails, direct tools like Claude Code and Cursor to do the implementation, and then prove the result is correct before it ships. In healthcare, “the agent wrote it” is never an excuse: you are accountable for every line that reaches production, and for the members and clinicians who depend on it. You will work closely with Product, Clinical, and Operations, including on our new ACCESS product for Medicare beneficiaries, and help shape how our team builds with agents as the tools keep changing. **Responsibilities** Building with Agents * Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) as your primary way of building: plan the change, direct the agent, and steer it when it goes wrong. * Write the clear specs, acceptance criteria, and constraints that let agents produce correct work the first time — and recognize when a task is faster or safer to do by hand. * Review agent\-written code as carefully as a teammate’s: check the logic, edge cases, security, and whether it fits the codebase, not just whether it runs. * Keep our codebase easy for both people and agents to work in: clear structure, good project instructions and context files, and tests that tell an agent when it is wrong. * Share what works. Help evolve the team’s practices, prompts, and tooling as agentic tools improve. Product \& Platform Engineering * Own features end to end across our TypeScript/Node services and React web apps, from understanding the need through release and follow\-up. * Build and maintain integrations with health plans, partners, and clinical data sources, and the data pipelines behind outcomes and performance reporting. * Contribute to ACCESS, our AI\-enabled offering for Medicare beneficiaries, including the agentic guide that helps members reach clinical goals. * Work directly with Product, Clinical, and Operations to turn real workflows into simple, reliable software — including human\-in\-the\-loop steps where judgment matters. * Ship small changes often, watch how they behave in production, and fix what you find. **Quality, Safety \& Reliability** * Verify before you ship: automated tests, running the real app, and checking results against what was asked — not just trusting a green build or an agent’s summary. * Protect member data. Apply HIPAA\-aware practices in everything you build, and never let sensitive data reach tools or services that shouldn’t have it. * Build guardrails, logging, and escalation paths into AI\-enabled features so that failures are caught and handled safely. **Qualifications** Required * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience shipping production web applications. * Hands\-on, daily experience building with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc... not just autocomplete. You can describe how you plan work for an agent, how you review its output, and a time it confidently got something wrong and how you caught it. * Strong TypeScript and Node.js skills, and experience building React front ends. * Experience with relational databases (such as Postgres), APIs, and integrating with third\-party systems. * Experience deploying and running services in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or similar). * Solid fundamentals that let you judge code you didn’t type: data modeling, debugging, testing, security, and performance. * A habit of verifying your work — you test the real behavior, not just the happy path. * Clear written communication. Much of the job is writing precise plans, specs, and reviews for both people and agents. * Comfort with ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, ask the right questions, and turn it into working software. **Preferred** * Experience in healthcare, digital health, or another regulated industry, including working with HIPAA or similar data\-protection requirements. * Familiarity with healthcare data and interoperability (FHIR, HL7, EHR integrations, eligibility or claims data). * Experience building with LLM APIs, AI agents, or conversational products, including evaluation and guardrails. * Experience with data pipelines, analytics, or outcomes and performance reporting. * Experience setting up team\-level practices for AI\-assisted development (project context files, custom commands, review workflows, CI checks). * Experience at a startup or growth\-stage company. * Side projects or open\-source work built with agentic tools that you can walk us through. **Benefits** * Competitive salary and benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage. * Access to the agentic coding tools you need to do your best work. * The chance to build a new AI\-enabled, outcomes\-based product for Medicare beneficiaries from early stages through launch and scale. * A collaborative environment in which you can learn, grow, and contribute meaningfully to the success of a dynamic and innovative organization.
