jobs.title: Software Engineer — Core Platform
jobs.description: **Rutherford Exchange** *Trusted infrastructure for modern financial markets.* **Headquarters:** New York, New York **Industry:** Financial technology and institutional software Rutherford Exchange develops transaction, portfolio, and financial\-data infrastructure used by investment firms, banks, and corporate finance teams. Its platform processes sensitive financial activity where reliability, security, and accurate reporting are essential. The company is known for strong engineering standards, long\-term client relationships, and a product culture that values sound technical decisions over unnecessary complexity. **Software Engineer — Core Platform** **Location:** New York, New York **Work arrangement:** Hybrid — three office days and two remote days per week **Employment:** Full\-time, salaried and exempt **Schedule:** Monday through Friday **Hours:** Approximately 40–45 hours per week **Base salary:** $175,000–$215,000, depending on experience, skills, and interview level **Annual cash bonus:** 15% target; actual payout may range from 0% to 25% **Target cash compensation:** Approximately $201,000–$247,000 **Equity:** Initial grant with an estimated annualized value of $30,000–$60,000 **Reports to:** Engineering Manager, Core Platform **On\-call:** Approximately one week every eight weeks The role Rutherford Exchange is looking for a Software Engineer to build and improve the services that power its financial platform. You will work on APIs, transaction workflows, data processing, and internal platform capabilities used by multiple product teams. This is a mid\-level individual\-contributor position with meaningful ownership, but it does not require previous fintech experience or people\-management responsibilities. What you’ll do * Design, build, test, and maintain production services used across the Rutherford platform. * Develop reliable APIs and asynchronous workflows for financial and operational data. * Improve system performance, observability, security, and failure recovery. * Work with product managers and designers to turn business requirements into maintainable technical solutions. * Review code and design proposals while providing practical, constructive feedback. * Investigate production issues and implement fixes that address underlying causes. * Improve automated testing, deployment processes, and developer tooling. * Participate in architecture discussions and document important technical decisions. * Join a rotating on\-call schedule after completing onboarding and production\-readiness training. What we’re looking for * At least three years of professional software engineering experience. * Production experience with Java, Go, Python, or another modern server\-side language. * Experience designing APIs and working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL. * Understanding of testing, version control, code review, and continuous delivery. * Ability to investigate problems across application, database, and infrastructure layers. * Clear written communication and the ability to explain technical tradeoffs. * Experience delivering projects with product and engineering partners. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field is helpful but not required. Experience with distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, Kafka, Kubernetes, payments, or financial products is helpful but not required. Candidates are not expected to have every preferred skill. Technology The primary platform uses Java, Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Kubernetes, and AWS. Engineers are not required to know the entire stack before joining, but should be comfortable learning unfamiliar technologies. Compensation The base salary is determined by the candidate’s relevant experience, demonstrated technical skills, interview performance, and internal compensation level. The annual cash bonus has a 15% target and is based on company performance and individual contribution. It is not guaranteed. New employees may receive a prorated bonus for their first year. The equity grant follows a four\-year vesting schedule. Its future value is not guaranteed and should not be treated as cash salary. Benefits * **Health and wellbeing:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer\-funded health savings account contribution; mental\-health support; life and disability insurance. * **Retirement and financial:** 401(k) with a 5% company match, annual cash bonus eligibility, commuter benefits, and financial\-planning resources. * **Time away and family:** Flexible PTO with a recommended minimum of 20 days, company holidays, paid sick leave, and 16 weeks of parental leave. * **Professional development:** $2,500 annual learning budget, conference support, technical mentorship, and internal engineering workshops. * **Work support:** Company laptop and home\-office equipment, subsidized meals on office days, and reimbursement for approved on\-call transportation. Eligibility and detailed plan terms are provided in the official benefits documentation. Schedule and on\-call expectations Most engineering work takes place during regular Eastern Time business hours. Teams schedule core collaboration between 10:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. After onboarding, the engineer joins an on\-call rotation approximately once every eight weeks. On\-call engineers handle urgent production alerts outside normal hours. Routine issues remain within the next business day, and managers adjust schedules when significant overnight work occurs. What success looks like Within the first 90 days, you will understand the platform’s main services, contribute production code, and complete on\-call readiness training. Within six months, you should independently deliver a meaningful platform improvement, participate confidently in design reviews, and resolve production issues with appropriate support. Strong performance means producing reliable software, making sensible technical tradeoffs, communicating early when risks appear, and improving the systems around you—not simply writing more code. Culture Engineering at Rutherford Exchange is collaborative, direct, and low\-ego. Technical proposals are expected to withstand thoughtful review, regardless of who presents them. The company values careful execution, but does not treat constant overtime as a sign of commitment. Engineers are encouraged to challenge unnecessary complexity, document decisions, and leave systems easier to understand than they found them. Hiring process * A 30\-minute introductory call with a member of the Engineering Recruiting team. * A 60\-minute technical conversation with two engineers, including collaborative coding in a shared editor. * A system\-design interview based on a realistic platform scenario. * A conversation with the Engineering Manager and a cross\-functional product partner. * Final reference and employment\-verification checks, followed by a conditional written offer. No take\-home assignment is required. Candidates receive the interview format and preparation guidance in advance. Pay: $175,000\.00 \- $215,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10040

jobs.title: Solution Engineer
jobs.description: **This Isn’t Your Typical Engineering Job** Imagine this: you’re backstage at the NFL Super Bowl, making sure a physical AI agent is ready to go live in front of millions—and NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell walks by to check it out. A few weeks later, you’re at San Jose International Airport deploying AI alongside City Mayor Matt Mahan. Then you’re at NVIDIA GTC, the world’s biggest AI conference, and you bump into Jensen Huang himself. ***That’s not a hypothetical. That’s what our team actually did.*** At LiveX AI, we build physical AI agents—intelligent, embodied systems that interact with people in the real world. Not chatbots on a screen. Real AI that lives in airports, stadiums, conference halls, and beyond. We’re looking for a bold, driven Solution Engineer to join our core team full\-time and help us deploy these systems on the world stage. **About LiveX AI** LiveX AI is a fast\-growing startup headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, building the next generation of physical AI agents. Our technology combines advanced large language models, multimodal AI, and purpose\-built hardware to create AI experiences that people interact with face\-to\-face. We’re backed by leading investors and trusted by enterprises, cities, and major event organizers worldwide. **What You’ll Do** You’ll be embedded in our core deployment team—the people who take our AI from the lab to the real world. Here’s what the role looks like: * **Ship Physical AI Agents:** Build, test, and deploy AI\-powered hardware systems to real venues—airports, stadiums, conference centers, retail spaces. You’ll own deployments end to end and see your work in action, not just in a staging environment. * **Get Your Hands Dirty with Hardware:** Set up screens, sensors, networking gear, and edge compute devices. Debug on\-site. Make AI work in the physical world where Wi\-Fi drops, power flickers, and thousands of people walk by. * **Write Real Code:** Build software that powers our AI agents—Python, TypeScript, APIs, integrations. Contribute to the same codebase the rest of engineering works in. Your commits go to production. * **Work the World’s Biggest Stages:** Lead and support deployments at marquee events and high\-profile locations. Previous team deployments include the NFL Super Bowl, San Jose Airport, and NVIDIA GTC. You could be next. * **Talk to Real Humans:** Present demos to customers, partners, and VIPs. Explain how our AI works to both technical and non\-technical audiences. Your communication skills matter as much as your code. * **Shape the Product:** Feed real\-world observations back to engineering and product. When you notice something in the field, your input directly influences what we build next. **Where Our Team Has Been** **NFL Super Bowl** Physical AI agent deployed at the biggest sporting event in America. Commissioner Roger Goodell experienced the demo firsthand. **San Jose International Airport** AI agent deployed in a live airport environment, unveiled alongside San Jose Mayor Matt Mahan. **NVIDIA GTC** Live deployment at the world’s premier AI conference. Our team had an encounter with NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang. **How We Evaluate Candidates** We hire for the traits that make someone thrive in fast\-moving, high\-stakes deployments. Every candidate is evaluated on four things: * **Responsibility \& Dedication.** You take full ownership of your work and follow through. When a deployment is on the line, you do whatever it takes to get it right—and you can be counted on. * **Speed of Learning.** Our stack, our hardware, and our customers change fast. You pick up new tools, technologies, and contexts quickly and turn them into results without hand\-holding. * **Multi\-Tasking Capability.** You juggle code, hardware, customers, and live events at once—often in the same day—and keep all of them moving without dropping the ball. * **Communication Skills.** You explain technical concepts clearly to anyone—a mayor, a CEO, a teammate, or a curious bystander—and you keep the team aligned under pressure. **Who You Are** * Ideally, you’ve delivered enterprise software at a startup, or run enterprise projects at a consulting firm—you know how to ship for demanding customers and manage delivery end to end. * You code. Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or both. You’ve built and shipped things that went beyond the spec. * You’re genuinely excited about AI—not just the hype, but how LLMs, computer vision, and multimodal models actually work under the hood. * Hardware doesn’t scare you (or it does, but you want to learn anyway). You’re willing to carry a monitor, run cables, and troubleshoot on\-site. * You communicate clearly—to a mayor, a CEO, or a curious bystander at a trade show. * You thrive in chaos. Startups are messy. Deployments have surprises. You stay calm, figure it out, and keep going. * You’re a team player who brings energy, not ego. **Bonus Points** * Experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), prompt engineering, or RAG pipelines. * Familiarity with edge computing, IoT, AV systems, or robotics. * Prior startup or hackathon experience where you shipped something under pressure. * Background in CS, EE, information systems, or a related technical field. **Why You’ll Love This** * **World\-Stage Experiences:** Your LinkedIn won’t say “updated Jira tickets.” It’ll say “deployed AI at the Super Bowl.” * **Full\-Stack, Full\-Real:** AI \+ software \+ hardware \+ customer\-facing—you’ll build a skill set most engineers don’t reach until years into their careers. * **Silicon Valley, Front Row:** You’ll work at the center of the physical AI movement, with the connections and momentum that come with it. * **Mentorship That Matters:** You’ll work directly with founders and senior engineers who want to see you grow—not hand you busywork. * **Real Ownership \& Growth:** Top performers take on more scope fast—leading deployments, owning customers, and shaping the product.

to identify, research and address issues * Collaborate with application development teams, services engineering teams and product management to help understand and explain device limitations and requirements * Lead in strategies to ensure the quality and stability of our deployments, including testing strategies and telemetry approaches * Develop our project’s build system and continuous integration system as needed * Provide technical expertise or mentoring to developers on our team * Drive high development standards **Basic Qualifications** * Drive high development standards * 5\+ years of full software development lifecycle experience * BS or BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field or equivalent experience * Highly fluent in JavaScript and web technologies * Experience developing for web browsers \& other web\-based client devices * Experience developing and optimizing high\-performance client\-side media applications * Experience using build runners / This is a hands\-on engineering seat, not a people\-manager role: you design, build, and own production systems across the company and report directly to the Chief AI Officer. Title at offer (Senior, Staff, Principal, or Director) is set to the candidate based on proven work. Most self\-storage operators bolt together third\-party tools that don't talk to each other. 10 Federal builds in\-house instead, and every system is modular: a self\-contained piece with a clean interface that can be swapped, extended, or reused without breaking what's connected to it. At the center is the Unified Data Platform (UDP), the company's single source of truth, which every system feeds and every new product is built on. The role spans Technology, Construction, Marketing, Operations, Accounting, and any team with a process worth automating, plus outward\-facing products such as the website, web app, APIs, and DaVinci Solutions, our sister company's lock and access\-control platform. Every system you build should move 10 Federal toward its North Star: higher operational efficiency and a better customer experience at the same time. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Architecture \& Engineering Standards** * Define the architecture for every system before code is written, with specs that document the design and the reasoning * Design modular services with clean interfaces that can be replaced or reused without a rewrite * Instrument everything with full logging and debugging from the start * Connect systems to MCP servers so they can be queried through an AI front end * Own each system full stack, from data layer to interface, and ship it deployed, documented, and tested ### **Cross\-Functional Delivery** * Gather requirements with department leaders and solve the real problem, not just the first version of it * Evaluate requests by time cost, dollar cost, scaling impact, and difficulty to build * Take work from spec to proof of concept to a full breakdown for leadership (steps, timeline, cost, and ownership) to production * Build tools people can operate without an engineer standing next to them * Use AI tools across code, documentation, research, and communication, and review, test, and own everything they produce **What You'll Actually Build** ------------------------------ This isn't theoretical. Here's what's already on the table: * The Unified Data Platform: build and extend the pipelines, connections, and architecture that keep it the one place where everything in the company connects, instead of letting it become another silo * Real\-time voice AI: build and extend our own voice AI, running on live speech\-to\-speech models and trained on 10 Federal's own data, instead of leaning on an expensive, generic voice vendor * Chat and SMS: fix or fully replace the customer\-facing experience running across 130\+ properties. Right now it's a generic tool with none of our actual business logic in it * System connections: keep connecting the systems that run this company (the FMS, the camera network, BI and reporting, and marketing) into the UDP instead of leaving them as disconnected logins * Platforms for every part of the company: build systems for Operations, Accounting, Marketing, Investing, Construction, and any other part of the business that can be made faster or smarter. Each platform should own its domain, fit into one cohesive orchestration, and feed the UDP * DaVinci Solutions: optimize, re\-implement, integrate, and extend the lock and access\-control platform for a software and SaaS business serving the broader self\-storage industry The UDP is the operating system of this company. The platforms around it are modular parts of one coordinated machine. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Required** * A strong technical foundation in software, hardware, computer science, computer engineering, or an adjacent field (no degree required) * Full\-stack range: comfortable owning a service end to end, from backend and data layer to interface * Architecture thinking: you can draw a clean boundary around what a system owns and defend it * Modular design as default practice, with real work you can point to that was built that way * Debugging and observability instincts: you instrument what you build so it tells you why it broke * Self\-directed execution: you can take an ambiguous business problem, write the spec, and ship a working system * Proof over credentials: a portfolio, GitHub history, or systems you can walk through in depth ### **Preferred** * Microsoft ecosystem and Azure experience * C\# and .NET experience (relevant to DaVinci Solutions) * Experience building AI\-powered systems such as agentic workflows, RAG, and MCP integrations * Hands\-on experience with AI development tools such as Grok, Cursor, Claude, Codex, or Windsurf * Experience shipping public\-facing products, not just internal tools ### **Current Stack** The stack changes when something better can be proven. Today it includes: * Backend: Python and Go * Front end: TypeScript and React * Real\-time voice AI: LiveKit with xAI Grok * SMS: Twilio * Data: Postgres and Redis * Hosting and identity: Microsoft and Azure * Reporting: Power BI, Fabric, and internally built dashboards * AI integration: MCP servers connected to business systems * DaVinci Solutions: C\# and .NET **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * Ship production systems that are deployed, documented, tested, and modular enough to reuse * Complete the first 90 days, a mutual evaluation period, in the office, shipping, and building reusable work * Replace or substantially cut the cost of third\-party vendors with in\-house systems * Move 10 Federal up and to the right on its North Star: better operational efficiency and customer experience **Physical Requirements \& Work Environment** --------------------------------------------- * Work in office at Raleigh, NC headquarters five days a week; this role is not remote or hybrid * Standard office environment with extended periods of sitting and computer use * Relocation assistance can be negotiated if needed **Benefits** ------------ * Base salary and title set to the candidate based on proven work * Compensation reviewed quarterly, with increases based on demonstrated impact rather than tenure * A written share of the savings when you fully replace or substantially cut the cost of a third\-party vendor, paid as a raise or bonus at leadership's discretion * Eligibility for equity grants under 10 Federal's equity incentive plan once performance is proven (no equity in the starting offer; awards reviewed annually at leadership's discretion) * Several no\-cost premium health insurance options, plus a Health Savings Account with up to $1,200 in annual employer contributions * Dental, vision, life, and short\- and long\-term disability coverage * 401(k) with up to a 3% employer match and immediate vesting (eligible after 90 days) * 10 paid holidays and paid time off that grows with tenure * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Employee Recognition Program * Employee discounts on auto, home, and pet insurance, travel, electronics, and entertainment **Our Core Values** ------------------- Everything we do at 10 Federal is rooted in five core values. We look for team members who live them every day: * Master Your Craft — Take pride in your work, your process, and your performance. Own the full lifecycle from scoping through production. **Bridge product and engineering.** Bring customer insights back to the core product team. Identify patterns across customer needs that should become platform features. Help shape the roadmap based on what you're seeing in the field. **Technical problem\-solving under pressure.** Debug production issues in real time. Troubleshoot complex vendor integrations across 80\+ providers. Be the person customers trust to get things working. **Scale what works.** Turn one\-off solutions into reusable patterns. Write internal tooling, documentation, and runbooks that make the next deployment faster for everyone. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 3\+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems. You can read and write in Spanish to support our Spanish\-speaking customer base directly. * Bias toward action. You don't wait for perfect specs. You scope, build, and iterate. equipment such as compressors, pumps, turbines, blowers, expanders, gearboxes, or auxiliary systems. * Ability to support plant, shop, and field\-based work as needed. **Work Schedule \& Environment** jobs.title: SIPRNET System Administrator
jobs.description: Akira Technologies, Inc. is seeking an experienced SIPRNET System Administrator to support the Georgia Army National Guard (GA ARNG) at the Clay National Guard Center (CNGC) in Marietta, GA. The successful candidate will provide hands\-on administration, maintenance, troubleshooting, and cybersecurity support for systems operating within the Secret Internet Protocol Router Network (SIPRNET) environment. This role is responsible for ensuring the availability, reliability, security, and operational readiness of classified servers, workstations, and associated enterprise infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience administering secure DoD enterprise systems, implementing Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), remediating cybersecurity findings, and coordinating with Information System Security Managers (ISSMs) and Information System Security Officers (ISSOs). The position will also support Continuity of Operations (COOP) planning, testing, and recovery activities to maintain mission\-critical services. **Key Responsibilities** * Administer, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot SIPRNET\-connected servers, workstations, operating systems, and supporting enterprise infrastructure in accordance with DoD and Army cybersecurity requirements. * Perform daily system administration activities, including user account management, privileged access administration, system configuration, software installation, patch management, and performance monitoring. * Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows and Linux servers, virtualization platforms, databases, and associated infrastructure supporting classified operations. * Conduct DISA STIG assessments, identify Category I, II, and III (CAT I–III) findings, implement corrective actions, and validate remediation to maintain system security and compliance. * Coordinate with ISSMs, ISSOs, and cybersecurity personnel to document security findings, update Plans of Action and Milestones (POA\&Ms), track remediation progress, and provide supporting evidence for compliance assessments. * Support Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities, security control assessments, configuration baseline reviews, vulnerability scanning, and ongoing authorization requirements for classified systems. * Monitor system health, availability, capacity, and performance, proactively identifying and resolving technical issues that could affect SIPRNET operations. * Perform advanced troubleshooting across multiple Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) layers, conduct root\-cause analysis, and implement corrective actions to restore and maintain system functionality. * Support LAN/WAN connectivity, routing and switching, network integration, and coordination with Army Network Enterprise Technology Command (NETCOM) and other enterprise service providers. * Manage technical incidents, service requests, and escalations through the Army Enterprise Service Management Platform (AESMP), or other authorized service management systems, ensuring timely resolution and accurate documentation. * Support Continuity of Operations (COOP) planning and execution, including system backups, restoration procedures, disaster recovery testing, alternate operating capabilities, and recovery of mission\-critical services. * Develop, maintain, and test system recovery procedures, backup schedules, configuration documentation, and operational readiness plans to support continuity requirements. * Implement enterprise configuration management, system hardening, patching, vulnerability remediation, and change management processes within classified environments. * Develop, test, troubleshoot, integrate, and maintain custom applications, scripts, utilities, and automated solutions to improve system administration, monitoring, reporting, and mission business processes. * Support approved programming, scripting, database, robotic process automation (RPA), and Microsoft Power Platform technologies, where applicable to the authorized environment. * Assist with enterprise modernization and migration initiatives, including infrastructure assessments, system integration, workload transition planning, testing, cutover, and post\-migration stabilization. * Translate DoD and Army enterprise technical directives into local implementation requirements while identifying technical risks, security implications, and operational impacts. * Maintain accurate technical documentation, including system configurations, network diagrams, security assessment records, STIG checklists, POA\&M updates, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and COOP documentation. * Collaborate with government leadership, ISSMs, ISSOs, network engineers, cybersecurity teams, and other technical stakeholders to ensure secure and reliable SIPRNET operations. **Required Qualifications** * Eight (8\) or more years of progressively responsible experience in enterprise infrastructure, systems administration fications** * Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) or Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) certification. These certifications do not replace the mandatory Security\+ and applicable DoD 8140 requirements. * Experience supporting SIPRNET environments within the Army National Guard, U.S. Army, DoD, or other federal government organizations. * Familiarity with DISA Security Content Automation Protocol (SCAP) tools, STIG Viewer, vulnerability scanning platforms, and enterprise security compliance reporting. * Experience supporting RMF authorization activities, maintaining POA\&Ms, and coordinating security remediation with ISSMs and ISSOs. * Experience developing and executing COOP, disaster recovery, backup and restoration, and system recovery procedures for classified enterprise environments. * Experience with Army 365 (A365\), Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Power Platform, Azure, or comparable DoD\-authorized cloud environments. * Experience supporting enterprise cloud migration and modernization efforts involving secure or classified infrastructure. * Familiarity with NETCOM coordination, Army enterprise service management processes, and AESMP ticket escalation procedures. * Experience with PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other scripting and automation technologies used in enterprise system administration. **Salary Range: $120,000 to $135,000** Akira’s pay range for this position considers various factors including skills, years of experience, training, licenses, certifications, alignment with market data, and internal equity in the organization. This pay range estimate is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary, which Akira believes to be done in good faith in compliance with local laws. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. **General Description of Benefits** Akira offers its employees multiple options for medical plans (some with Health Savings Account), dental plans, and vision coverage, and a 401(k) plan with employer match. To promote work/life balance, Akira offers paid time off, including vacation and sick time, holidays, paid parental leave, military leave, bereavement leave, and jury duty leave. We also offer short and long\-term disability benefits to protect employee income in the event of sickness or injury, life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment insurance, and critical illness insurance. Akira also offers tuition, training, and certification reimbursement for professional development and career advancement. Akira regularly reviews our total rewards package to ensure our offerings remain competitive and reflect the values and needs expressed by our employees. **About Akira Technologies** Akira strives to meet and exceed the mission and objectives of US federal agencies. As a leading small business cloud modernization and data analytics services provider, we deliver trusted and highly differentiated solutions and technologies that serve the needs of our customers and citizens. Akira serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies across the intelligence, cyber, defense, civilian, and health markets. Every day, our employees deliver transformational outcomes, solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. *Akira is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.*

You will build a fact\-based view of the talent market, define where AWS should compete and invest, and develop the business cases, investment proposals, and executive narratives that fund and direct that work. You will structure and manage a portfolio of external relationships, with technical communities, professional networks, industry groups, and conference organizations, as channels that give AWS credible access to experienced engineers. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Do you want to apply your fire protection expertise to data center infrastructure that operates at a global scale? Are you excited about expanding your knowledge of building systems while contributing insights from your previous experience? In this role, you will influence all aspects of fire protection design, construction, operations, and maintenance for our data centers. This includes fire suppression, fire detection, fire alarm, and mass notification systems, as well as fire\-resistant construction and life safety. You will work with internal and external teams to define, design, detail, and document the fire protection features our facilities require, using both prescriptive and performance\-based design approaches. You will contribute your expertise to the continual improvement of our fire protection design standards, ensuring our buildings protect people and keep our customers' data safe and uninterrupted over the life of each facility. Key job responsibilities * Design and oversee fire water service infrastructure, including water supply analysis, coordination with utilities and fire officials, and establishing site\-level requirements for fire protection systems. * Review concept designs and construction documents from third\-party vendors to verify compliance with established design standards, local codes, National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) standards, International Code Council (ICC) requirements, and Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) expectations. * Prepare prescriptive and performance\-based designs for building fire suppression, alarm, and detection systems, and coordinate fire protection system space requirements, supporting utilities, and equipment locations. * Collaborate with construction, commissioning, operations, and risk management teams to resolve requests for information, value engineering queries, and technical questions throughout the project lifecycle. * Drive improvement of fire protection design standards and standard configuration templates across the organization, simplifying and strengthening systems with each iteration. A day in the life You will start your day reviewing active project designs, checking that fire protection elements meet our standards and local code requirements. You may join a cross\-functional call with architects, mechanical engineers, and construction managers to align on system layouts for a new build, then shift to evaluating a vendor's submittal package for a fire alarm system. In the afternoon, you might prepare a performance\-based design analysis or meet with local fire officials to secure approval of fire protection features. Throughout, you will mentor teammates and share lessons learned to improve quality across the team. About the team Our Data Center Design Engineering team includes architects, structural, mechanical, electrical, civil, fire protection, and controls engineers working together to design the next generation of data centers at Amazon. We are committed to delivering world\-class uptime for our customers and we build facilities that emphasize security, safety, and efficiency while meeting growing demand. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Sponsored Products and Brands
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Sponsored Products and Brands (SPB) helps millions of advertisers reach shoppers across Amazon's stores worldwide. Behind every ad we show are machine learning models that predict click\-through rate (CTR) and conversion rate (CVR). These predictions decide which ads are relevant, how they rank, and how advertisers get value. Our team builds and runs the ML infrastructure behind those models, end to end: * Offline feature engineering: a multi\-tenant platform used by several ML teams. It runs thousands of daily feature jobs over petabyte\-scale data and produces the features that train models in every marketplace we serve. * Model training: the standard system that retrains CTR and CVR models every day. How fresh these models are directly affects advertiser results and Amazon's revenue. * Online feature store and feature retrieval: low\-latency, high\-throughput services that provide features when a model makes a prediction. These predictions feed the scores used in real\-time ad ranking. * Next\-generation research platform: a platform that uses AI agents to help scientists explore, test and launch new model ideas faster. As an SDE II, you'll design, build and run distributed systems that work at very large scale, both in offline batch processing and online serving. You'll work closely with applied scientists and engineers to make models fresher, help scientists try ideas faster, and keep the systems that support ads ranking reliable. Key job responsibilities * Design and develop ML infrastructure for advanced recommendation models, from training through real\-time inference, that delivers highly relevant ads to shoppers worldwide * Improve the scalability, automation and efficiency of large\-scale training and real\-time inference systems * Work closely with applied scientists to optimize the performance of ML models and infrastructure, and take models from experimentation into production * Deliver ML solutions end to end: design, implementation, testing, deployment and operations * Collaborate with engineers and scientists across the team to build systems that serve ads across all Amazon platforms and surfaces * Participate in design and code reviews and mentor peers A day in the life You might start the day checking the health of the overnight feature and training pipelines. Then you'd work with scientists on how to support a new model architecture, and spend the afternoon building a performance improvement for the online feature store. You'll ship often, see your work affect ads served around the world, and influence how ML infrastructure grows across the organization. About the team The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re\-imagining the advertising landscape through industry leading generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re\-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising. We're the team behind the full ML lifecycle for Sponsored Products recommendation models, from raw data to features, training and real\-time serving. We value ownership, getting things done, and close collaboration with science partners. We invest in mentorship and in tools that make engineers and scientists more productive, including AI\-assisted development.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience * 3\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience * 1\+ years of building large\-scale machine\-learning infrastructure for online recommendation, ads ranking, personalization or search experience * 1\+ years of machine learning, statistical modeling, data mining, and analytics techniques experience * Experience programming with at least one software programming language **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 1\+ years of mathematics optimization such as linear programming and nonlinear optimization experience * Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Do you dream of working in a role where your talent with building HVAC and plumbing design and next\-generation data center design can be merged? Do you want to expand your current knowledge of building systems while providing input from your previous experience? Have you ever wondered what it is like to be able to influence construction on a global scale? YES! Then keep reading…. In this role you will influence all aspects of Mechanical design, construction, operations, and maintenance for our global fleet of data centers. This includes fire suppression, fire detection, fire alarm, and mass notification systems, as well as fire\-resistant construction and life safety. You will work with internal and external teams to define, design, detail, and document the various Mechanical features that our facilities require, using both prescriptive and performance\-based design approaches. As an Owner, you will strive to ensure the Mechanical features of our buildings protect our people and keep our customer’s data safe and uninterrupted over the life of the building. We expect you to contribute your expertise to the continual improvement of our Mechanical design standards. Primary responsibilities will be to perform and oversee project\-related work, such as water supply analysis and design for fire water service to buildings, including coordination with utilities and fire officials to establish basic site infrastructure requirements. The ability to coordinate Mechanical system space requirements, supporting utilities, and equipment locations, and to provide detailed construction specifications for all Mechanical\-related trades will be expected. You will typically be responsible for the preparation of detailed designs for HVAC, plumbing, and hydronic systems. You will review all design disciplines to ensure they meet the code requirements described in our design standards. In some cases, you will oversee and review this work and in other cases you will perform the work yourself. As the team’s subject matter expert, you will ensure that contractors have the information they need to build our data centers the way we expect them to, and that our operations teams are well equipped to operate and maintain them as needed to meet our goals. As part of this role you will work with internal and external stakeholders, including design, construction, commissioning, operations, vendors, and other service providers, as well as local building and fire officials. You will be part of a global team, and you will be an integral part of our work to change the world through technology. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Support Technology
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ Anthropic's products are growing fast in reach and complexity. Every new model, product, and channel brings problems no one predicted. We want to catch each issue as early as possible, get customers unblocked fast, and fix the root cause. The best experience is one where a customer never has to ask for help. We are building a Support Technology engineering team to solve what stands between a customer and Claude, whether they want to use it but can't or are unhappy with their experience. That covers individual users, businesses, and customers who reach Claude through partners. Our goal is a better product experience for everyone who uses Claude. We make it easy for customers to get help and talk to us, through Claude itself and via human specialists with the tools to solve their problems. We also determine why they needed help and fix the cause in the product. Billing is a good example. When a charge is confusing, a payment fails, or a plan doesn't unlock, a customer should be able to reach us and get it resolved in one conversation. Then we want to learn why it happened and change the product, whether that's the subscription flow, the payment error, or the invoice, so the next customer never has to ask. As one of the team's early engineers, you will set the technical direction and build the core systems behind this work. We expect Claude to handle more of each case over time, from diagnosing an issue to resolving it to flagging the product fix behind it. Success means customers run into fewer problems, get them truly solved when they do, and are happy with the help they receive, whether it comes from Claude or a person. This is a hands\-on role with high leverage. You will write a lot of code and lead across teams, since many fixes belong to other product teams. You will partner with our Product Manager, the Product Support team, and product engineering teams such as Billing Platform. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Improve the product experience at the root: Build agents that spot where customers keep getting stuck and find the root cause, then ship the fix or drive it with the owning team until customers stop running into the problem * Make our support agents reliable first responders: Build the tools, APIs, and safe, audited workflows our Claude\-powered support agents use for common fixes, with evals, guardrails, and clean handoffs to people, and measure whether customers' problems actually get solved * Build the platform foundations: Create a reliable support platform that scales with our growth, including the experience and tools for customers and specialists, and the data that shows what customers are running into and whether our changes help * Support enterprise and partner channels: Extend support to business customers, admins, and partner\-sold customers, including cases that start outside our own products * Raise the bar and build with Claude: Set standards for reliability, observability, testing, and rollouts, mentor engineers, and use Claude heavily in your own work **Minimum qualifications** -------------------------- * Deep backend and distributed systems skills, including APIs, data models, event\-driven systems, and third\-party integrations * Experience building production software, including technical lead roles on multi\-team projects * Experience building systems where correctness, access control, and auditability matter * A clear vision for how capable models like Claude can improve customer support, and motivation to build it * Judgment about when to ship a simple fix and when to invest in a platform * Track record of leading without formal authority and getting other teams to own and ship fixes **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * 8\+ years building backend or platform systems in production, including 3\+ years leading large\-scale, complex projects or teams as an engineer or tech lead * Experience building and improving customer\-facing products with measurable impact * Experience with billing, payments, or subscription systems * Experience shipping LLM\-based or agentic systems in production * Experience building with helpdesk or contact center platforms such as Intercom, Zendesk, or Salesforce Service Cloud * Experience building internal tools or platforms for operations teams such as support, risk, finance, or trust and safety * Experience building data pipelines for support or operations analytics * Full\-stack experience, including web UIs for internal tools or customer\-facing flows * Experience with enterprise features such as SSO, admin con  degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **For roles performing work in California:** We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Sr. AI Perception Engineer
jobs.description: * ### **About Anyware Robotics** Anyware Robotics builds general\-purpose mobile manipulator robots for industrial applications. Our robots are trusted by customers across logistics, retail, and manufacturing, supporting applications such as truck unloading, mobile palletizing, and machine tending. ### **Description** About Anyware Anyware Robotics builds general\-purpose mobile manipulator robots for industrial applications. Our robots are trusted by customers across logistics, retail, and manufacturing, supporting applications such as truck unloading, mobile palletizing, and machine tending. The Role The robots run on **AnywareOS**, our industrial physical intelligence system. Its architecture is modular and designed to generalize across applications without reprogramming. We are seeking a **Sr. AI Perception Engineer** to advance Anyware's production 3D AI perception stack for warehouse automation robots, with a focus on object localization, pose estimation, scene reconstruction, and deployment on robot compute within application cycle\-time constraints. This role is for an engineer who builds AI perception that works on real sensor data and physical systems — not only on benchmarks — and who wants to take it through production and real\-world operation. You will own perception capabilities end to end within your area — problem definition, model and pipeline development, deployment on robot hardware, monitoring, failure analysis, and production improvement — and make pragmatic tradeoffs across accuracy, reliability, latency, compute, data, maintainability, engineering effort, and delivery timelines. This is a hands\-on senior individual\-contributor role. You will own the design decisions in your area, contribute to architecture and design reviews, and work closely with the Perception Team Lead and Staff engineers who set technical direction across the perception stack. What you'll do * **Build 3D AI perception on physical systems, hands\-on** — develop robust object localization, pose estimation, and scene reconstruction models and pipelines using RGB\-D and other sensing modalities, running on robot compute within application cycle\-time constraints. * **Own perception capabilities end to end** — from problem definition and prototyping through deployment, monitoring, failure analysis, and production improvement within Anyware's existing perception stack. * **Improve perception reliability on physical robots** — diagnose and fix failures caused by difficult scenes, changing lighting, sensor noise, and gaps between training data and customer environments. * **Strengthen production readiness** — better data, evaluation, regression testing, release criteria, observability, and systematic root\-cause analysis of field failures. * **Make pragmatic engineering tradeoffs across the robot system** — balance accuracy, robustness, latency, compute cost, data availability, maintainability, and delivery timelines while integrating perception reliably with planning, manipulation, controls, and system software. Required Skills * BS, MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Vision, Computer Science, or a related field. * **3\+** years of professional experience developing **AI perception systems** for physical robots or comparable real\-world machines. * **Hands\-on proficiency building AI perception models** (PyTorch or similar) and real\-time perception pipelines in Python and C\+\+. Nice to have * Experience deploying and operating AI perception in production on physical robots — running models under latency and compute constraints on robot hardware and owning reliability in the field. * Strong foundation in 3D geometry, camera models and calibration, RGB\-D or point\-cloud processing, and 3D object localization, segmentation, or pose estimation. * Experience with ROS or ROS2 for real\-time robotic perception pipelines, including sensor\-data processing and model integration. * Experience deploying robotic perception systems in warehouse, logistics, or other industrial environments. Why Anyware * **An A\+ Team:** Anyware is built by top talents. Collectively, our team has won six Best Paper Awards and Finalists, including the ICRA 2025 Best Paper Award and ICRA 2024 Best Paper Award. * **An A\+ Robot:** Our robot, Pixmo, won the Best Innovation Award (top\-1\) at both ProMat 2025 and MODEX 2026 — the two largest logistics automation exhibitions in the world. Pixmo also won the RBR50 Robotics Innovation Award. * **Real Impact:** Your perception work does not stop at a demo. It ships into real customer sites, directly affects robot reliability and throughput, and must perform under real\-world variation. * **Fast Growth:** You will have strong ownership and real responsibility in a growing robotics company. * **Generous Equity:** We offer generous equity in addition to salary and benefits. Compensation The expected salary range for this role is 150K\-240K USD/year, depending on experience and qualifications. Additional compensation may include equity, benefits, or other incentives, where applicable. Benefits \& Perks * Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family * Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) * Paid sick leave * 401(k) plan support * Daily meal credit Equal Opportunity Statement Anyware is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. How to Apply Please submit your resume and any relevant materials through the **Anyware Career platform**. We look forward to learning more about your experience and interest in joining our team. #### **Salary** $150,000 \- $240,000 per year

jobs.title: PeopleSoft HCM Developer with NA Payroll Experience
jobs.description: **PeopleSoft HCM Developer — North America Payroll** ---------------------------------------------------- **Contract\-to\-Hire (CTH) or 1099 Consulting Opportunity** **Company:** Astute Business Solutions **Engagement Type:** Contract\-to\-Hire (CTH) or Independent Contractor (1099\) **Specialization:** PeopleSoft North America Payroll, Time and Labor, FLSA Regular/Blended Rates, and ADP Integration ### **About Us** Founded by former PeopleSoft professionals, Astute Business Solutions is a premier Oracle Cloud partner specializing in PeopleSoft, Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS), and Ellucian Banner consulting and support. Headquartered in Dublin, California, we help enterprises across North America modernize their applications and IT infrastructure through Oracle Cloud migrations, AI\-powered solutions, multicloud strategies, and managed services. ### **Position Overview** Astute Business Solutions is seeking an experienced **PeopleSoft HCM North America Payroll Developer** for a consulting engagement supporting a university’s payroll enhancement initiatives. This opportunity is available on a **contract\-to\-hire (CTH) or 1099 independent contractor basis**. For CTH engagements, any future conversion to employment will depend on business needs, performance, and mutual agreement. In this hands\-on technical role, you will develop payroll enhancements, customize paycheck reporting, and build integrations supporting FLSA regular/blended rate calculations, California sick\-pay requirements, and ADP paycheck rendering. You will collaborate with functional payroll leads and vendor teams to deliver accurate, thoroughly tested solutions while preserving delivered payroll calculations and controls. ### **Key Responsibilities** **Core Payroll and Paycheck Customization** * Assess existing PAY003 processes, BI Publisher paycheck layouts, payroll customizations, and relevant Job and Position data. * Enhance PAY003 and supporting staging structures to associate Job and Position identifiers with the appropriate earnings lines. * Support employees with multiple jobs or positions while preventing incorrect cross\-job attribution and duplicate earnings. * Preserve delivered gross\-to\-net calculations, payroll control totals, and reconciliation integrity. **FLSA Regular/Blended Rate and California Sick\-Pay Enhancements** * Develop Application Engine processes to identify applicable pay calendars, eligible non\-exempt employees, and qualifying sick\-pay earnings after payroll calculation. * Retrieve and apply calculated regular/blended rates from relevant delivered payroll tables, including PS\_PY\_EE\_REG\_RATE. * Develop Component Interfaces, where appropriate, to apply payroll rate overrides through PeopleSoft business logic. * Support controlled payroll recalculation, validation, and confirmation, including verification of earnings, taxes, and accounting results. **ADP Outbound Interfaces and Integration** * Develop and maintain outbound payroll interfaces according to ADP specifications. * Map employee, Job/Position, earnings code, hours, rate, current earnings, and year\-to\-date earnings data. * Implement file formatting, field\-length checks, transmission requirements, and pre\-transmission validation. * Coordinate end\-to\-end testing with payroll stakeholders, ADP representatives, and QA teams, from PeopleSoft payroll processing through final paycheck\-stub rendering. **Technical Delivery and Testing** * Prepare technical specifications, mapping documents, deployment instructions, and support documentation. * Perform unit, integration, and regression testing across standard and complex payroll scenarios. * Investigate discrepancies and reconcile interface outputs against PeopleSoft payroll results. * Coordinate with functional leads to confirm requirements and support user acceptance testing. ### **Required Qualifications** * At least **5 years of hands\-on PeopleSoft HCM development experience**, including version 9\.2, with a strong focus on North America Payroll and Time and Labor. * Strong proficiency in Application Designer, Application Engine, PeopleCode, Component Interfaces, SQR—including PAY003—and BI Publisher. * Working knowledge of PeopleSoft payroll data structures, pay calendars, and Pay Calculation and Confirmation processes. * Experience with relevant tables, including PS\_JOB, PS\_POSITION\_DATA, PS\_PAY\_CHECK, PS\_PAY\_EARNINGS, PS\_PAY\_OTH\_EARNS, and PS\_PY\_EE\_REG\_RATE. * Experience supporting multi\-job/multi\-position employee populations and FLSA regular\-rate calculations. * Demonstrated experience developing vendor payroll interfaces and performing reconciliation and data validation. * Advanced SQL skills using Oracle or SQL Server, including complex queries, staging\-table design, and batch performance tuning. * Strong troubleshooting, communication, and technical documentation skills. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience implementing California sick\-pay and FLSA blended\-rate enhancements in PeopleSoft North America Payroll. * Higher education or university payroll experience. * Familiarity with PeopleSoft Time and Labor payable\-time generation and integration with North America Payroll. * Direct experience working with ADP on paycheck\-stub rendering, file specifications, and interface troubleshooting. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience. ### **Equal Opportunity** Astute Business Solutions is committed to equal opportunity. All qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. ### **How to Apply** Please send your resume to **hr@beastute.com** with the subject line **“PeopleSoft NA Payroll Developer — CTH/1099\.”** Include your availability, preferred engagement type, expected hourly rate, and a brief summary of your relevant PeopleSoft Payroll, FLSA, and ADP integration experience.

Headquartered in Philadelphia with an office in central California, and backed by top Agtech and autonomy investors, including S2G, Catalyst, Translink, Cibus, FPrime, Toyota Ventures, FFVC, Xplorer, and Radicle, Burro was created to solve the labor shortages facing farmers using robotics. Burros can be described as Disney's Wall\-E for agriculture and work outdoors, in a 1\.0 format. They function, today, as computer vision based autonomous ground vehicles for carrying, towing, and scouting, and are designed to lay the base for the fully autonomous future of work outdoors. We have a growing triple digit fleet deployed in paid commercial use within vineyards, nurseries, berries, and beyond, and demand for our product is accelerating, so we are growing our team. Reporting to the Director of Software Platform \& Integration, we are seeking a highly motivated **Senior Software Development Engineer in Test** with experience in robotics and autonomous systems to join our team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in ensuring the quality and reliability of our robotics software, working closely with our User Acceptance Testing, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to ensure seamless development, testing, simulation, and deployment workflows, and helping to design, build, and deploy cutting\-edge agricultural and industrial autonomous robots. We are looking for a teammate who shares our enthusiasm for working with collaborative robots made to handle the tedious and physically demanding parts of agricultural work, has a passion for delivering a high\-quality end\-to\-end user experience, and maintains a collaborative attitude that supports and uplifts everyone they work with. ### **Responsibilities:** * Extend and maintain simulation\-based testing frameworks with Isaac and Gazebo, creating scenarios for our virtual fleet in industrial and agricultural environments. * Create and maintain ROS\-based testing frameworks for C\+\+ and Python robotics software applications, including functional, regression, integration, performance, acceptance, and stress testing on amd64 robotic platforms in both simulated and real\-world environments. * Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts to validate software functionality and performance across robotic systems, including embedded software, and cloud\-based services. * Drive the integration of QA processes into continuous integration, deployment, and testing (CI/CD/CT) pipelines, ensuring consistency and reliability. * Build and maintain internal tools and dashboards to monitor the health and performance of testing systems, collaborating with the Platform team on shared monitoring infrastructure to provide critical insights. * Identify, document, and track software defects and bugs, working closely with development teams for efficient resolution. * Support field testing and validation of autonomous systems in agricultural and industrial settings. * Collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and other cross\-functional teams to understand product requirements and specifications, to define and validate user acceptance criteria, and to provide timely feedback. * Advocate for overall product quality and promote best practices across the engineering organization. * Conduct periodic on\-site physical testing of robots (a few days per month), involving physical activity and requiring year\-round presence at both the Philadelphia office and the outdoor Phoenixville test farm. Serve as backup for the User Acceptance Technician as needed. ### **Requirements:** Required Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. * 3\+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or test engineering, preferably in robotics, embedded systems, or autonomous systems. * Strong experience designing and implementing software testing methodologies, including unit, integration, system, and acceptance testing. * Exceptional problem\-solving skills and a keen attention to detail. * Experience with robotic simulation tools such as NVIDIA Isaac or Gazebo. * Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively within a dynamic team environment. * Familiarity with ROS (Robot Operating System) or similar robotics middleware. * Proficiency in Python, Typescript/Javascript, C\+\+, and shell scripting for test automation. * Proficiency with Linux\-based development environments. * Proficiency with version control systems (e.g., Git). * Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI. Desired Qualifications * Experience robustly testing robotic software systems in simulation and data\-replay settings that may not be deterministic. * Experience working with 3D assets as used in simulation software. * Knowledge of computer vision and machine learning testing practices. * Familiarity with safety standards and compliance testing for autonomous systems. * Experience testing hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and software\-in\-the\-loop (SIL) systems. * A background in agricultural technology, industrial automation, or outdoor robotics. ### **Perks:** * Competitive salary and benefits package (medical/dental/vision) * Early\-Stage Equity * 401K Plan * Unlimited PTO * Paid parental leave RECRUITERS: We are not accepting agency resumes for this position. jobs.title: Senior AI & Automation Engineer
jobs.description: AustralianSuper is the largest superannuation fund in Australia – in the top 20 largest funds globally and top 50 asset owners globally. With more than US $300 billion in current assets under management, and a world\-class investment team, AustralianSuper has the appetite and capability to directly invest in large\-scale opportunities. Our New York office is made up of more than 75 colleagues and is expected to grow significantly over the next few years, so when you join, you become a key part of building our culture. **Your new role** Reporting to the Senior Manager Technology, Americas, the Senior AI \& Automation Engineer (Agentic) is a senior hands\-on technical specialist responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting AI, automation, and software engineering solutions. The role combines deep technical expertise with practical business understanding to deliver scalable, secure, and supportable solutions that improve operational efficiency, enhance colleague experiences, and enable innovation across the Fund. The position ensures that AI agents and automation solutions align with the Fund’s processes and comply with its architecture and data standards, governance frameworks, security requirements, risk controls, and regulatory obligations. Working collaboratively with Technology, Data, and Digital colleagues—including architects, engineers, delivery teams, and automation specialists—the role embeds intelligent and autonomous capabilities into enterprise platforms and end\-to\-end business processes. The Senior AI \& Automation Engineer (Agentic) champions continuous improvement through responsible AI and intelligent automation, reducing manual effort, improving decision\-making, increasing operational resilience, and translating AI\-driven insights into reliable real\-world execution. The role also contributes to the development of reusable standards, patterns, guardrails, and best practices that support safe, scalable, explainable, and maintainable solutions. The successful applicant will be a highly capable technology specialist with strong expertise in AI, automation, software engineering, and solution delivery. They will combine deep technical knowledge with a practical understanding of business needs to design, implement, and continuously improve scalable solutions. As a senior individual contributor, they will provide technical leadership across complex initiatives, contribute to engineering standards and best practices, and support the responsible adoption of AI and automation capabilities across the Fund. The successful candidate should bring strong financial markets experience gained within an asset manager, institutional investor, or broker\-dealer. Experience supporting public and/or private market investment processes is essential, enabling the role to apply AI and automation solutions within investment and trading contexts. This is a position based on\-site at 1251 Avenues of the Americas, with a hybrid schedule. **Key Responsibilities** **Agentic AI and Automation Engineering** * Design, build, maintain, and evolve agentic AI and automation systems that support goal\-driven planning, reasoning, autonomous task execution, and the execution of business and technology processes across the Fund. * Translate complex business problems into agent\-based solution architectures, selecting appropriate models, tools, memory strategies, control mechanisms, and automation patterns. * Develop AI\-enabled automation workflows incorporating autonomous decision\-making, orchestration, exception handling, adaptive behavior, and safe escalation paths. * Apply agentic automation patterns to reduce reliance on rigid, rule\-based processes and improve resilience across complex workflows. * Contribute to the definition and evolution of agentic AI and automation standards, patterns, and best practices within the hyperautomation capability. **Architecture, Orchestration, Integration, and Data** * Design and implement agent orchestration using frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent, enabling scalable and composable agent solutions. * Build and optimize Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines so agent behavior is grounded in trusted, approved, and governed knowledge sources. * Engineer prompts, tool\-use patterns, planning strategies, and reasoning approaches to deliver consistent, explainable, and reliable agent outcomes. * Integrate agentic AI and automation solutions with the Fund’s systems and platforms, including core applications, APIs, digital channels, and data services. * Work with Technology, Data, and Digital teams, including architects, engineers, delivery squads, Data Engineering, and Data Services, to align solutions with enterprise architecture, security, data quality, lineage, and governance standards. * Lead solution design activities and provide technical direction for AI, automation, and software engineering solutions, ensuring alignment with enter llaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across the full service lifecycle, including requirements discovery, solution design, implementation, deployment, operational support, continuous improvement, and service management. **Desired:** * Experience applying design thinking principles and/or working within recognized architecture frameworks. * Experience with Azure services, cloud concepts, and cloud\-native solution design within a Microsoft ecosystem. * Exposure to regulated environments, such as financial services, superannuation, or insurance, and familiarity with AI governance, risk, ethical, privacy, and compliance frameworks. * Experience working within Agile, Lean, startup, or DevOps delivery models. * Working knowledge of DevOps and MLOps concepts, including CI/CD, monitoring, and model, agent, or automation lifecycle management. * Knowledge of ITIL and service management practices, particularly change, release, incident, and operational management. * Experience with ServiceNow and/or PowerShell scripting. * Strong interest in emerging technologies, particularly AI, agentic systems, automation, and intelligent platforms. * Ability to articulate ideas, influence decisions, present opportunities, and contribute effectively within close\-knit, cross functional teams. **Pay transparency notice** The compensation range for this position is $200,000 to $230,000 (this is based on full\-time hours, located in New York City). The pay offered may vary depending on job related knowledge, skills, and experience and refers to the amount AustralianSuper is willing to pay at the time of posting. **Life at AustralianSuper** At AustralianSuper, we truly care about our colleagues. We know work and life are intertwined, that’s why we support the diverse needs of everyone and have policies that enable us all to thrive and be truly flexible. We ensure diversity is celebrated for the opportunity it provides us all to learn and grow, and ultimately to deliver better outcomes for members. As we collaborate with colleagues across multiple time zones flexibility in work hours are both a requirement and opportunity for this role. We offer great benefits, including generous 401(K) matching, health insurance and promote a blended working environment in which all roles can flex, and we’re happy to discuss what this looks like for you. We are committed to supporting our diverse workforce in a way that is inclusive and embraces diversity in all its forms. If you require any reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process or the role, please let our recruitment team know. **What’s next** Apply now, if you share our values of Energy, Integrity, Generosity of Spirit and Excellent Outcomes and would like the opportunity to work in a challenging, growing and rapidly evolving team to deliver outstanding results. ***Progress, powered by purpose*** *All employees and applicants are evaluated on the basis of their qualifications, consistent with applicable state and federal laws, without regard to race, color, ancestry, sex which includes pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, age, religious belief, national origin, marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, or other protected basis, all as defined by applicable laws. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all.* *AustralianSuper uses AI to review resumes and conduct initial phone interviews. This involves processing your resume, cover letter, and voice recording in Australia, the UK and the USA to help assess your suitability for the applied role. When invited to an AI phone screening, you may opt for a traditional phone screening instead. For information on how we handle your personal data, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy.*
