jobs.title: Marketing AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Avenue Z, Inc.** Avenue Z is a digital marketing and PR agency engineered to move fast. Brands partner with us to drive revenue and reputation through high\-impact public relations, performance media, AI search optimization (AEO), and our creator network. Trusted by leaders in emerging tech, finance and consumer brands, ***we drive influence*** across all channels \- from AI Search to The Wall Street Journal, Shopify to TikTok, Meta to Google. **The role** ------------ You are a growth marketer who builds. You have bought media on Meta, Google, or TikTok with your own hands, you know what a good ROAS looks like before the dashboard loads, and when something is manual, repetitive, or slow, your instinct is to open an editor and wire it to the platform API rather than schedule a working session. The Marketing AI Engineer builds and ships the AI agents, automations, and reporting systems that run paid media, creator and affiliate campaigns, CRO, and client reporting at Avenue Z. The work is concrete: agents that launch and QA ads across Meta, TikTok, and Snap; systems that reallocate budget toward top\-performing creators; reporting that ties creator content, ad spend, and attributed revenue into one picture; alerts that catch an expiring TikTok Shop affiliate code or a Meta partnership permission before spend stalls. You are also the technical lead for our AI builders. You set the standard for how agents are designed, reviewed, and shipped across service lines, you review their work, and you are the person leadership turns to when a build needs a decision. You will embed with the paid media, creator, and ecommerce teams to find where throughput or margin is lost, build the system that fixes it, drive adoption, and move to the next one. This is a builder and a leader role. You ship working systems yourself, and you raise the bar for everyone else who ships them. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Build against the marketing platforms our revenue runs on** * Integrate with the Meta Marketing API, TikTok Business and TikTok Shop APIs, Google Ads API, Snap, Shopify, and affiliate and creator platform APIs: OAuth and token refresh, rate limits, webhooks, and partnership\-access flows. * Build agents and automations for ad launching and QA, budget pacing and reallocation, creative tagging and performance intelligence, anomaly detection, and cross\-platform commission tracking. * Build the reporting layer that shows a brand what actually drove revenue, cross\-referenced against Shopify as the source of truth. **Embed with the teams and ship against real problems** * Sit with paid media, creator and affiliate, CRO, and ecommerce teams. Audit how they work today, map the workflow from input to output, and find the steps that should run automatically. * Turn a messy manual process into a working system inside weeks, not quarters. Define where a human approves and where the system acts on its own, especially where money or brand safety is on the line. * Drive adoption. A system that ships and sits unused does not count. Train the team, gather feedback, and iterate. **Build Innovative AI Driven Marketing SolutionsAI** * Provide technical leadership on product roadmap. Be an expert in building and shipping production ready solutions. * Set the standard for how Avenue Z designs, reviews, documents, and ships agents and automations across service lines, and enforce it through code review and design review. * Review and mentor the engineers and builders already working on AI automation across PR, SEO and AEO, organic social, and ecommerce. Unblock them, raise their quality bar, and own the outcome of their work. * Run the intake and prioritization of automation requests so the team builds what moves revenue, time saved, or client retention, in that order. * Report progress, blockers, and measured impact to the CTO and present to leadership. **Invent new capability** * Build things that create new advantages for the business, not just faster versions of old tasks: autonomous media buying, creative\-to\-landing\-page pipelines, creator performance ranking, and whatever you see next that we have not. **What you won't do** --------------------- * Be a passive project coordinator or a pure strategist with no build capability. * Spend months planning without shipping. * Wait for perfect requirements before building. * Build for novelty instead of business value. * Replace human judgment where brand, strategy, or client context still matters. * Treat marketing as someone else's domain. You have to understand the ad account as well as the people running it. **Who you are** --------------- **Required** * A background in growth marketing. You have personally run paid media on at least one of Instagram and Facebook, Google, or TikTok, and you understand campaign structure, pixels and events, attribution windows, creative testing, and what the numbers mean. * Hands\-on experience working with the Meta Marketing API and the TikTok Business or TikTok Shop APIs, plus other marketing platform APIs (Google Ads, Shopify, Klaviyo, affiliate and creator platforms). You have built something real against them, not read the docs. * Deep, current, hands\-on knowledge of the digital marketing industry: how agencies and brands actually operate, where the manual work sits, and what clients pay for. * Extensive hands\-on experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) and a working command of good coding practice: version control, code review, environment and secrets management, testing, and documentation. A computer science degree is not required. Shipped work is. * Experience leading others who build. You have been a principal engineer, a founder, a lead engineer, a technical team lead, or a leader of product managers, and you have set and enforced a quality bar for a team's work. * Experience building AI agents and automations in production: prompts, tool use, approval gates, error handling, and monitoring, using whatever stack fits (Python or TypeScript, agent frameworks, workflow platforms such as n8n or Make where they are the right tool). * A portfolio of projects or code repositories you can walk us through (see below). * Based in, or relocating at your own expense to, Miami or Orlando. Onsite. **Preferred** * Experience in an ecommerce or performance marketing agency, or on a DTC brand's growth team. * TikTok Shop, creator and affiliate marketing, or influencer campaign experience. * Data work: SQL, BigQuery or a similar warehouse, Looker Studio or similar BI tools. * Shopify app or Shopify API experience. * You have built and sold, launched, or run something of your own. **Critical traits** * Moves fast and learns fast. * Thinks in systems and sees ambiguity as a build opportunity. * Commercially aware: knows the difference between an impressive demo and a system that makes or saves money. * High agency. Does not wait to be assigned the problem. * Good judgment on what should be automated and what should stay human. * Can switch between a conversation with a media buyer and a code review without changing register. **Benefits** ------------ * Salary: $100k\-$120k * Medical, vision, and dental plans * 401(k) plan with 4% employer match * Unlimited PTO * Professional development stipend

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer - Engineering Simulation & Design Exploration
jobs.description: **About the Role** Engineering simulation is undergoing a structural shift. What used to be a slow, solver\-driven process is becoming a fast, exploration\-driven workflow, enabled by surrogate models, physics\-informed AI, and GPU\-accelerated methods. This changes not just how simulations run, but how engineers design—moving from evaluating a few options to exploring entire design spaces. We are looking for a **hands\-on Applied AI Engineer** to experiment with these emerging technologies. Your role is to try new tools, test them, benchmark them, integrate them into prototypes, determine what actually works in practice, and give an informed decision on its viability in Bentley’s products. The goal is to develop a clear understanding of where these approaches can realistically transform engineering workflows—and where they cannot. This is an experimental role. You will spend most of your time building and testing prototypes, not writing reports or maintaining production systems. \*\****This role does not offer sponsorship*** **What You Will Do:** * Keep track of new technologies in the field * Evaluate emerging simulation and AI tools through hands\-on prototyping * Build and benchmark surrogate models against traditional FEM/CFD workflows * Test robustness, limitations, and failure modes of new approaches * Prototype hybrid pipelines (e.g., surrogate \+ high\-fidelity validation) * Explore how these approaches can integrate into real engineering workflows * Report to stakeholders with clear recommendations **What We Are Looking For:** **Requirements:** * Strong programming ability (Python required) * Experience with PyTorch, JAX, or similar ML frameworks * Solid understanding of numerical simulation: + FEM, CFD, or multiphysics modeling * Familiarity with: + Deep learning, surrogate modeling, reduced\-order models, or optimization workflows + Good communication skills and collaborative mindset **Highly Valued** * Experience building experimental or research prototypes * Understanding of design space exploration (DOE, parameter studies, combinatorial optimization) * Exposure to physics\-informed ML or scientific machine learning * Experience working with GPU or high\-performance computing environments * Experience working with machine learning for physics simulations * Hands\-on experience developing Multiphysics simulation code **Mindset** * Hands\-on, experimental, and comfortable working with incomplete tools * Curious but skeptical—focuses on what works, not what is claimed * Naturally tests limits and edge cases, not just happy paths * Thinks in terms of workflows and iteration loops, not isolated tools Able to quickly move from idea prototype* insight * Good business acumen; able to understand what brings value to Bentley **What Success Looks Like** * You build prototypes that demonstrate new ways to accelerate design workflows * You identify where AI\-based approaches are genuinely useful—and where they fail * You provide clear, evidence\-based insights grounded in experiments, not assumptions . You will lead the technical deployment, hardening, and accreditation readiness of Blitzy across both Platform\-as\-a\-Service (PaaS) in a hardened DevSecOps environment and isolated customer\-hosted environments, starting with FedRAMP authorization and expanding into higher\-impact government compliance frameworks. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, implement, and maintain technical security controls across Blitzy’s PaaS and customer\-hosted deployments to achieve and sustain FedRAMP Moderate (Class C) and High (Class D) compliance baselines. * Engineer repeatable, containerized deployment patterns using Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) for air\-gapped, GovCloud, and on\-premises customer environments. * Establish continuous monitoring, automated container scanning, and static/dynamic application security testing (SAST/DAST) pipelines to meet strict federal Plan of Action and Milestones (POA\&M) timelines. * Build dashboards within Blitzy’s hardened DevSecOps environment to report on Blitzy’s vulnerability management posture, significant software changes, security incidents / tickets, and POA\&M remediation. * Implement and maintain FedRAMP supply chain security controls such as SBOMs, image signing and provenance. * Collaborate with internal security engineers, Third\-Party Assessment Organizations (3PAOs), and agency Authorizing Officials (AOs) to supply technical evidence, system diagrams, and System Security Plan (SSP) artifacts. * Configure secure data boundaries, FIPS 140\-3 validated cryptography, and zero\-trust identity controls around Blitzy’s codebase ingestion and multi\-agent inference workflows. * Work alongside Forward Deployed Engineers and public sector solutions teams to integrate Blitzy into complex, legacy government software estates while preserving agency security postures. * Build a scalable compliance foundation that transitions smoothly from the initial FedRAMP traditional Rev5 path to the automation\-first 20x model and towards DoD Impact Levels (IL4/IL5/IL6\). **Qualifications** ------------------ * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience building, deploying, and hardening production cloud applications in regulated enterprise or federal environments. * Deep FedRAMP \& NIST Expertise: Proven track record engineering systems compliant with deep FedRAMP and NIST SP 800\-53 security controls, including hands\-on participation in Authority to Operate (ATO) lifecycles. * Strong proficiency deploying and managing workloads across AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, or air\-gapped Kubernetes clusters using Terraform, Helm, and CI/CD automation. * Demonstrated experience implementing DISA STIGs, CIS Benchmarks, FIPS\-compliant encryption, RBAC, and zero\-trust networking architectures. * Strong coding skills in Python, Go, TypeScript, or similar languages to automate compliance checks, build deployment tooling, and troubleshoot complex distributed systems. * Ability to translate technical system architectures into clear compliance documentation, boundary diagrams, and audit evidence for 3PAOs and government stakeholders. ***Compensation: $125,000\-$185,000 \+ Bonus \+ Equity*** *Blitzy is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer, Advanced Insights & Modeling
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: It all started with an idea at Block in 2013\. Initially built to take the pain out of peer\-to\-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50\+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible. Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy. **The Role** The Advanced Insights and Modeling (AIM) team is a high\-impact, business\-savvy group of builders: machine learning engineers, data scientists, data engineers, and business strategists who combine technical skills with deep product and financial expertise. We hold high standards, move fast, and own our models end to end. AIM runs on curiosity, bold thinking, and collaboration, and we keep the culture decidedly non\-corporate. Teams across Block come to us when they need insight, speed, and real business impact. AIM sits within Block’s Foundational organization and is sponsored directly by the CFO, but our mandate runs well beyond Finance. We own most of the measurement and predictive modeling at Block: forecasting across Cash App, Square, and Afterpay, customer lifetime value, marketing incrementality and spend optimization, sales pipeline and prospect value, and actives and network\-effect measurement. Finance, Marketing, Sales, Product, and Risk all plan against numbers we produce. We also own the data foundations those models run on, and corporate functions including Finance, Accounting, Treasury, SFS, and Procurement increasingly come to us when they want to rethink how their work gets done with AI. **Automation across the enterprise.** AIM leads Block’s Foundational Automation program, a CFO\-sponsored effort to rebuild how Finance, Accounting, Treasury, SFS, and Procurement operate. Rather than layering AI on top of existing workflows, we rebuild the underlying data and process layer so that agents can take on the work itself: monitoring pipelines, reconciling positions, triaging exceptions, and escalating only the decisions that need a person. In Treasury, you will define and build the data systems and controls that make this automation reliable. **The Treasury opportunity.** Block moves money through hundreds of bank accounts across multiple legal entities, and Treasury’s view of that position today is stitched together from bank portals, a liquidity tool, portfolio accounting, and the general ledger, with the gaps closed by hand. No single system tells Treasury, in near real time, where every dollar sits and whether the books agree. You will build that system from the ground up. **Your mandate.** You will own the technical direction and hands\-on development of Treasury’s data foundation. Treasury manages Block’s own cash, liquidity, and investments across its businesses and legal entities. You will work directly with Treasury and Accounting to understand how they operate, identify what needs to change, and turn those needs into a technical roadmap. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role. You will make architecture and build\-versus\-buy recommendations, decide what to tackle first, and personally build and operate the core data systems. We’re looking for someone who can take an open\-ended business problem through to a working solution, bringing clear recommendations when decisions need broader agreement. Treasury is the first function to get this treatment. The architecture, controls, and operating model you establish will become the template for Accounting, Procurement, and the rest of Foundational. **Your initial priorities.** You will shape the roadmap around three connected needs: * **A trusted liquidity position.** Bring bank, custodian, portfolio accounting, and general ledger data into a reliable entity\-level view in Snowflake. Define the architecture, reconciliation approach, and data quality controls, then build the pipelines and data models. * **A foundation for forecasting.** Partner with AIM’s ML engineers to establish the datasets, features, and data contracts for predicting cash inflows and outflows. Own the underlying data systems through production. * **A clear direction for Treasury systems.** Lead the technical recommendation for Block’s 2027 Treasury Management System decision: what to build, what to buy, and how the pieces should fit together. Define the integration and migration approach for the chosen direction. You will determine the sequencing and trade\- ng orchestration with tools such as Airflow or Prefect, dependency management, monitoring, incident response, and recovery. * A track record of independently turning ambiguous business problems into production systems, setting technical direction, making architecture and build\-versus\-buy decisions, and personally implementing solutions through adoption. * Experience working directly with senior business partners, challenging assumptions, resolving competing requirements, and explaining technical recommendations in business terms. **Particularly valuable** * Experience with financial, Treasury, or general ledger data, especially cash positions, transaction reconciliation, and multi\-entity reporting. * Experience building datasets and data contracts for production ML models or forecasting systems. * Experience building workflow automation, including production AI agents with appropriate validation and human review. We’re working to build a more inclusive economy where our customers have equal access to opportunity, and we strive to live by these same values in building our workplace. Block is an equal opportunity employer evaluating all employees and job applicants without regard to identity or any legally protected class. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment in accordance with state and local laws and “fair chance” ordinances. We believe in being fair, and are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including providing reasonable accommodations to disabled applicants throughout the recruitment process. We encourage applicants to share any needed accommodations with their recruiter, who will treat these requests as confidentially as possible. While there is no specific deadline to apply for this role, U.S. roles are typically open for an average of 55 days before being filled by a successful candidate. Please refer to the date listed at the top of this job page for when this role was first posted. Block takes a market\-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on your location. U.S. locations are categorized into one of four zones based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. The successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. Zone A: $239,600—$359,400 USD Zone B: $239,600—$359,400 USD Zone C: $239,600—$359,400 USD Zone D: $239,600—$359,400 USD **Application Guidelines** Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60\-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed. **Use of AI in Our Hiring Process** We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws. Contact us here with hiring practice or data usage questions. *Every benefit we offer is designed with one goal: empowering you to do the best work of your career while building the life you want. Remote work, medical insurance, flexible time off, retirement savings plans, and modern family planning are just some of our offering.* *Block, Inc. (NYSE: XYZ) builds technology to increase access to the global economy. Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people.* ***Square*** *makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers.* ***Cash App*** *is the easy way to spend, send, and store money.* ***Afterpay*** *is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time.* ***TIDAL*** *is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs.* ***Bitkey*** *is a simple self\-custody wallet built for bitcoin.* ***Proto*** *is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone.*

Our model of care is proven to provide exceptional care to the homebound population, and we’ve generated outstanding quality results in CMS Innovation Center models compared to our peers. Software is a growing part of how Bloom delivers care, and we build custom tools that support clinicians and patients at every stage of their care journey. **The Role** You’ll join a collaborative tech team at an exciting time, help shape what we build from the first conversation, and see how your work makes a real difference in patients’ lives. We create and maintain cross\-platform healthcare applications for both internal and external users. You’ll work closely with a product manager, other developers, clinicians, and staff, and contribute across the full stack: front\-end, back\-end services, databases, and cloud infrastructure, with an emphasis on reliability and long\-term maintainability. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer (Payments)
jobs.description: At Bloomerang, we believe change happens on purpose. We champion the power and potential of nonprofits, igniting next\-level impact with the team and technology built for purpose. Our powerful giving platform and stellar support enable tens of thousands of nonprofits to raise more, recruit more, and retain more, fueling maximum impact and raising the bar on what's possible for the nonprofit sector. That's why, even as the nonprofit sector sees declines in giving, Bloomerang customers raise more year over year. We're also in the business of creating thriving employees. Join a mission\-driven culture built on our core values of Simplify, Care and Act. We know our people are the key to our success, and we're proud to be home to some of the most innovative and skilled individuals in the workforce today. Come feel invigorated and unstoppable with us! ### **The Role** As a Senior Software Engineer at Bloomerang, you'll be a hands\-on engineer and a key driver of technical success on your team. You'll design, build, and ship production software that helps nonprofits raise the money that powers their missions. Agentic AI tools are part of how we build every day, across the whole delivery lifecycle, and how we work keeps changing as those tools do. You'll join Paid in Dreams, the team that owns payments at Bloomerang. In payments, reliability and security can't be compromised. A bug here can mean a donation that didn't go through or money that didn't land where it should. Stripe is our primary processor, and the work covers processor integrations, webhooks, and the donor\-facing experiences built on top of them. We're looking for a pragmatic engineer who sees the bigger picture. You understand how a change ripples across systems, products, and the people who use them. You find the real problem before reaching for a solution, and you know when something needs rigor and when good enough is fine. You bring ideas without assuming you have all the answers, and you're curious about the customer problem behind the ticket. ### **How You'll Show Up** * **Own your work and drive it to done.** Treat commitments as promises, push through the murky middle, and share bad news early. * **Communicate directly.** Ask the question, raise the concern, and keep the team in the loop. * **Use good judgment and welcome feedback.** Make sound decisions with incomplete information, and treat feedback as useful information to act on. * **Keep learning.** Pick up new tools quickly and let go of approaches that no longer fit. * **Think like a product engineer.** Connect technical work to business goals and to the experience of nonprofits and their donors. ### **What You Will Do** * Design, build, test, and ship features and integrations across the payments stack, from processor APIs and webhooks to the UI. Partner with product, design, and support to understand the problem nonprofits and their donors face before you build. * Use agentic AI tools every day to deliver value faster, and help shape the harnesses, guardrails, and conventions that keep AI\-generated code aligned with our architecture. * Keep payment flows secure, reliable, and observable. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data & AI Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Requirements** **Your Job** Brooks is advancing its enterprise AI, data, analytics, and innovation capabilities to help teams make better decisions, move faster, improve operations, and create meaningful value for runners, teammates, and the business. The Senior Manager, Data and AIEngineering will lead the technical teams responsible for building the trusted data foundations, scalable AI engineering capabilities, and production\-ready platforms that power Brooks’ next generation of data and AI solutions. This role is accountable for leading the engineering function that turns business opportunities into reliable, secure, scalable, and reusable technical capabilities. The Senior Manager will oversee data engineering, AI engineering, ML engineering, integration patterns, platform engineering practices, engineering standards, and production operations for AI and data\-enabled products. **Your Responsibilities** **Lead Data Engineering and AI Engineering Strategy** * Own the engineering strategy for data platforms, AI solutions, machine learning systems, AI\-enabled applications, data pipelines, APIs, and reusable engineering patterns. * Partner with Brooks Enterprise AI \& Data Solutions (BEADS) leadership, product management, architecture, governance, security, cloud operations, and business stakeholders to define engineering priorities and delivery plans. * Translate Brooks’ AI and data strategy into a practical engineering roadmap that supports trusted data, practical AI, disciplined innovation, and measurable business value. * Set overarching objectives and ensure engineering investments support scalable data foundations, reusable AI capabilities, self\-service analytics, experimentation, automation, and production\-grade delivery. * Help Brooks move from one\-off AI and data projects to repeatable engineering capabilities that can scale across business functions **Manage and Develop Engineering Talent** * Lead, coach, and develop data engineers, AI engineers, ML engineers, solution engineers, platform engineers, and related technical contributors. * Build a high\-performing engineering culture based on technical excellence, ownership, continuous learning, collaboration, and Brooks values. * Set clear expectations for engineering quality, documentation, maintainability, delivery discipline, production readiness, and operational support. * Establish technical direction and mentor engineers on architecture, design patterns, code quality, data modeling, MLOps, LLMOps, observability, testing, security, and responsible AI delivery. * Own workforce and resource planning for the function, identifying capacity, capability, and skill gaps and recommending hiring, development, or external partnership strategies. * Support hiring, onboarding, role clarity, career development, performance management, and skill growth across the engineering team. **Build Data Foundations** * Lead the design, development, and modernization of enterprise data pipelines, data products, data models, integration patterns, and analytics\-ready datasets. * Ensure data engineering practices support quality, reliability, lineage, governance, access controls, and business usability. * Support scalable data delivery across domains such as product innovation, supply chain, marketing, retail experience, finance, HR, legal, and IT. * Establish engineering patterns that make data easier to discover, access, understand, and use responsibly. **Scale AI and ML Engineering Capabilities** * Lead the engineering practices required to move AI and machine learning solutions from prototype to production. * Establish reusable patterns for model deployment, model integration, API development, orchestration, monitoring, retraining workflows, and operational handoff. * Partner with data scientists, AI solution engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to convert promising use cases into production\-ready capabilities. * Support engineering for generative AI, predictive models, recommendation engines, optimization models, AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, semantic search, and workflow automation where appropriate **Establish Engineering Standards and Production Discipline** * Define and reinforce engineering standards for code quality, testing, CI/CD, version control, documentation, data quality checks, monitoring, logging, alerting, and release readiness. * Ensure teams build production\-minded solutions that can be operated, supported, maintained, and improved over time. * Partner with architecture and cloud operations to ensure solutions align with enterprise technology patterns, cloud standards, security requirements, and platform strategy. * Drive technical debt management and ensure engineering work balances speed, quality, scalability, and long\-term maintainability. **Partner Across Product, Program, Architecture, and Business Teams** * Work closely with Product Managers and Technical Product Managers to ensure engineering wor  and responsible AI expectations. * Partner with AI governance and data governance stakeholders to ensure sensitive data, intellectual property, model behavior, vendor integrations, and AI outputs are managed responsibly. * Ensure engineering teams understand and follow Brooks’ policies, architectural standards, security practices, and responsible AI expectations. * Help create a culture where innovation and governance work together rather than against each other. **Drive Value, Reliability, and Continuous Improvement** * Measure engineering success based on business value delivered, platform reliability, engineering throughput, solution adoption, quality, reuse, and operational health. * Use metrics, retrospectives, incident learnings, stakeholder feedback, and delivery data to continuously improve engineering practices. * Identify opportunities to reduce delivery friction, improve developer experience, automate manual work, and increase reuse. **Work Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field. MBA, master’s degree, or advanced technical degree preferred, but not required. Equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of degree. * 10\+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, AI engineering, ML engineering, platform engineering, analytics engineering, or related technical disciplines. * 5\+ years of people leadership experience, including direct or matrixed leadership of technical teams. * Experience leading teams that design, build, deploy, and operate scalable data platforms, data pipelines, AI/ML solutions, APIs, integrations, or enterprise technology platforms. * Strong technical fluency across data engineering, cloud platforms, data modeling, APIs, software development, DevOps, MLOps, LLMOps, system integration, and production operations. * Experience with Snowflake, AWS, Azure, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, semantic layers, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, orchestration tools, or enterprise integration platforms. * Experience with generative AI, large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, AI agents, embeddings, vector databases, model serving, prompt management, or AI application development. * Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, CI/CD, model monitoring, feature stores, data observability, logging, alerting, and production support. * Ability to translate business needs into practical technical direction and help teams make sound architecture and implementation tradeoff decisions. * Experience in agile, iterative, test\-and\-learn, or product\-based delivery environments. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical topics clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Demonstrated ability to embody and role model Brooks values **Benefits** Brooks is proud to offer a robust benefits package to our employees and their families! * Benefits\- including medical, dental, vision, life and AD\&D insurance, disability insurance, HSA and employer contribution, FSA, family \& fertility assistance, 401K Savings Plan and match, employee assistance program, and transportation assistance. * Paid Time Off\- Brooks offers generous time off including five weeks of paid time off, eleven paid holidays, paid sick and parental leave. * Bonus\- in addition to base pay, Brooks employees may also be offered an annual bonus based on company performance. * Perks\- including product discounts, employee recognition, fitness discounts, volunteer and donation benefits. * Location\- You will spend 4 days per week in our Seattle offices, as we believe our organization flourishes when connections, collaboration, creativity, problem\-solving, and celebrations happen in person. **Compensation:** The pay range for this position, based out of the Brooks Seattle HQ, is $169,246 \- $270,815 per year. Base pay offered will vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Analyst - Phoenix, AZ or Remote
jobs.description: **Please send a link of something you have built, such as a project on GitHub or a similar site. It can be big or small, the more unique the better. Please send to Tommy.Grace@livebryten.com** At **Bryten,** we're more than just a place to live—we're a community where residents feel welcomed, valued, and connected. We are seeking a data\-driven **AI Solutions Analyst** to join our team and help transform the way we work through innovative AI solutions, intelligent automation, and data\-driven insights. This role will play a key part in leveraging emerging technology to streamline operations, enhance decision\-making, and create smarter, more efficient experiences across our organization. We build and run our own business apps and reporting on Domo, with AI agents doing a lot of the building. The apps are in daily use by the people who run the portfolio. This role owns a handful of those apps from the first conversation to the thirtieth release: sit with the operators, learn how they work, ship what they need, and keep it running well after launch. **What You’ll Be Doing** * Own a set of apps or dashboards end to end, such as portfolio performance reporting, construction management billing, property and client lists, contracts and transitions tracking, and payroll tools. * Work directly with the operators who use them (asset directors, accounting, construction admin, property operations, HR) to gather requests, run walkthroughs, and get sign\-off before anything ships. * Build new features and fixes in our Domo custom apps and App Studio apps, using AI coding tools and agents. * Build internal automations and AI agents that take manual steps out of someone's week, using Domo Workflows, Code Engine and AI services. * Be the ongoing support: triage questions and bugs, keep a clear backlog, and release small and often. * Document what you build in our shared team notes so anyone can pick it up. * Ship every change through a reviewed pull request. **Tasks*** Own a set of apps or dashboards end to end, such as portfolio performance reporting, construction management billing, property and client lists, contracts and transitions tracking, and payroll tools. * Work directly with the operators who use them (asset directors, accounting, construction admin, property operations, HR) to gather requests, run walkthroughs, and get sign\-off before anything ships. * Build new features and fixes in our Domo custom apps and App Studio apps, using AI coding tools and agents. * Build internal automations and AI agents that take manual steps out of someone's week, using Domo Workflows, Code Engine and AI services. * Be the ongoing support: triage questions and bugs, keep a clear backlog, and release small and often. * Document what you build in our shared team notes so anyone can pick it up. * Ship every change through a reviewed pull request. **How we build*** Research, then shape the idea with the operator, then a go decision, then scaffold, build, publish and document. Nothing is built before it is shaped. * React and Vite for custom apps, published to Domo. Domo App Studio, cards, Workflows, Code Engine and AppDB for the rest. * Git from the first line, small commits, pull requests with a reviewer. * Claude Code and other AI tools are part of the normal workflow, along with a shared team playbook and notes so the AI and the people work from the same facts. **What we are looking for** * Comfortable talking with non\-technical business users and turning what they say into something that works. * Has built apps or internal tools, in any stack, and is excited to build with AI tools. * Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, SQL and React, or the ability to pick them up fast. * Extensive knowledge of front end visual elements and when to use them for impactful design. * Willingness to research and stay on the forefront of ever\-evolving agentic tools and procedures. * Understanding of collaborative cloud development environments like GitHub. * Good judgment about scope: small, useful, finished beats big and late. * Reliable, curious, and likes owning something after it launches. **Nice to have*** Domo experience (App Studio, Magic ETL, custom apps). Preferred, not required. We will teach it. * Experience with Yardi, RealPage, Paycom or other property management or accounting systems. * Real estate, property management or finance background. * Prior work building or using AI agents and automations. **Please send a link of something you have built, such as a project on GitHub or a similar site. It can be big or small, the more unique the better. Please send to Tommy.Grace@livebryten.com** **\*\* Must reside in one of the states Bryten does business in. \*\***

jobs.title: Principle Project Systems & Execution
jobs.description: Position: Principle Project Systems \& Execution Salary: $160,000\-$200,000 On Site **Basic Function** The Senior Manager, Technical Programs leads Bullen's most important cross\-functional projects and builds the simple, repeatable system the whole company uses to start, run, and finish important work. Working with the leadership team, this person turns strategic priorities ("rocks") into clearly chartered, well\-resourced projects. They personally lead Bullen's most complex capital, technical, and cross\-functional projects. They build on the team charter work already proven in engineering to create a project framework that fits Bullen's size and culture. They give leadership clear visibility into project health and resource capacity. The role leads mainly through influence. Functional managers keep responsibility for their people, technical decisions, and departmental deliverables. This person makes ownership clear, surfaces risks early, and develops managers and emerging leaders so smaller projects can run well inside their own departments. The goal is not the most sophisticated system possible. It is a practical, well\-documented, low\-burden system that people choose to use, introduced at a pace Bullen can sustain. This person leads the Bullen way, through teamwork, excellence, humility, and integrity, so that projects bring people together, everyone knows their role, and every voice is heard. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** Percentages are approximate and will shift as the project system matures. **Lead Strategic and Cross\-Functional Projects (about 45%)** * Partner with the leadership team to translate Bullen's rocks into chartered projects with clear scope, sponsors, owners, timelines, resources, and measures of success. * Personally lead Bullen's highest\-priority capital, technical, and cross\-functional projects from charter through closeout. * Work with functional managers to build integrated schedules, milestones, dependencies, and resource plans. * Run effective project meetings, communication routines, action tracking, and follow\-up. * Identify schedule, resource, technical, and execution risks early, and work with managers on practical solutions. * Facilitate decisions while keeping technical decisions with the right subject\-matter experts and functional leaders. * Run a disciplined process for reviewing and approving scope changes. * Use data to respectfully challenge unrealistic commitments, and bring leadership alternatives and recommendations. * Choose Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid methods based on what each project needs. * Build structured problem\-solving and risk tools (DMAIC, FMEA, risk register, root cause analysis, DOE, SPC, value stream mapping) into planning and execution where they add value. * Lead project closeout and lessons learned to improve future work. **Build Bullen's Project System and Capability (about 30%)** * Learn how projects are run at Bullen today, and work with the managers and employees who lead them now. * Design, document, and own Bullen's team and project charter process, from idea intake and approval through kickoff, execution, and closeout. * Build on what already works, including engineering's team charters and the existing project charter template. * Set up a tiered project classification, aligned with PMI/PMBOK practices, that matches planning and oversight to a project's size, cost, and risk (approval authority, charter requirements, reporting cadence). * Define how team charters capture purpose, scope, roles, norms, decision rights, and working agreements, with inclusion and psychological safety built in from the first meeting. * Create simple shared templates (charters, kickoff agendas, RACI, risk registers, status reports, lessons learned) usable from the production floor to the leadership table. * Design and deliver training on the charter process and project fundamentals for managers, engineers, supervisors, and emerging leaders, partnering with HR \& Culture on curriculum, reinforcement, and follow\-up. * Coach project leads one\-on\-one through their first chartered projects: model first, then guide, then step back. * Build a bench of internal project leaders so project capacity does not depend on a few people. * Mentor engineers and technical staff and support their individual development plans. * Start a community of practice where project leads share lessons, celebrate wins, and solve problems together. * Introduce new processes in small steps, keep paperwork to a minimum, and improve the system using PDCA and feedback from project teams. **Project Visibility, Resource Planning, and Tools (about 15%)** * Keep visibility of the company\-wide project portfolio, and help leadership prioritize, sequence, and resource work. * Set up project\-health reporting with clear green/yellow/red status and escalation criteria. * Build resource\-capacity views by person and skill to show current and future constraints. * Show leadership the reso  in engineering, engineering technology, manufacturing, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. * At least 8 years of manufacturing, engineering, or technical experience, including at least 5 years leading complex cross\-functional projects and teams. * Strong understanding of manufacturing and engineering environments. * Experience with project scheduling, risk management, resource and capacity planning, scope management, and project governance. * Experience managing capital projects and several concurrent projects with competing priorities. * Demonstrated ability to lead teams and influence outcomes without direct reporting authority. * Demonstrated experience teaching, training, or mentoring others, with examples of people who grew under your leadership. * Ability to make clear, persuasive presentations on complex topics to production personnel, senior leadership, and outside groups. * Ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries or concerns. * Ability to apply logical and scientific thinking to a wide range of practical problems. * Proficiency with project\-management software (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, monday.com), spreadsheets, and Microsoft 365\. **Preferred** * Master's degree (MBA, Engineering Management, or similar). * Six Sigma Green Belt; Black Belt a plus. * Project Management Professional (PMP) certification. * Experience building a process, system, or program from the ground up, or significantly improving organizational project\-management processes, and getting it adopted across an organization. * Experience in precision or advanced manufacturing, with working knowledge of GD\&T, DFM, DFMEA/PFMEA, DOE, and SPC. * Experience with dashboards and data tools such as Power BI, Minitab, or JMP, and familiarity with CAD. Software\-development experience is not required. **Physical Demands** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear and taste or smell. The employee is frequently required to stand; walk; sit; and use hands to finger, handle, or feel. The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is frequently required to lift up to 10 pounds and occasionally required to lift up to 50 pounds. jobs.description: Junior Software Developer \[NO RELOCATION] PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE NEEDING TO RELOCATE. WE ARE ONLY HIRING IN PHOENIX. Phoenix, AZ — onsite · $60,000–$80,000 BusinessRate turns public customer reviews into scores and rankings for local businesses. We collect review data at scale, score each business, rank it against its local competitors, and recognize the top performers in their market. We're profitable and growing, with an engineering team of six. Everything — the data pipelines, the web applications, the payment flows, the internal tooling, the infrastructure — is built and maintained in house. The role You'd be writing code day to day, working closely with our senior engineers, who review your pull requests and are there when you get stuck. We're a small team, so you won't be handed a narrow slice of the product and left there — you'll see how the whole thing fits together, and you'll get more ownership as you show you're ready for it. The work is genuinely interesting. The data side involves large partitioned tables, queries that need to stay fast as volumes grow, and pipelines processing substantial amounts of data. There's also a customer\-facing web application, payment flows, and internal dashboards, all of which need to be reliable. We're looking for someone who wants to get good at this, not just someone who can already do it. What you'll do \- Build and maintain backend services and APIs, with support on the design decisions \- Work on our Next.js and tRPC frontends — customer\-facing pages and internal dashboards \- Write SQL against large datasets and learn what makes queries fast or slow \- Fix bugs and ship improvements across the product \- Have your pull requests reviewed carefully, and start reviewing others' as you grow \- Take smaller projects from idea through to production What we're looking for You should have: \- Working knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js, and something real you've built with them — a job, an internship, a personal project you can walk us through \- Familiarity with SQL and relational databases; you don't need to know how to optimize a query against a partitioned table yet, but you should want to learn \- Experience building with React, ideally Next.js \- Comfort with AI\-assisted development tools alongside solid engineering practices — we use them regularly and expect the same care with code written that way \- A willingness to ask questions early rather than disappear for three days Nice to have: \- tRPC, Fastify, or similar typed API layers \- Docker and modern deployment pipelines (we use Render) \- Stripe or other payments experience \- Any exposure to data pipelines or ETL \- A CS degree, a bootcamp, or no formal background at all — we care about what you can do Compensation and process Base salary is $60,000–$80,000, depending on experience. Health insurance included. This role is onsite in the Phoenix area. Our process is only two steps: an intro video call, an onsite visit PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE NEEDING TO RELOCATE. jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer, Perception

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Security
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role:** The Crusoe Cloud Software Development team is seeking a passionate and experienced Senior Software Engineer specializing in Linux Kernel Security. This critical role is essential in strengthening the security posture of our core Linux kernel and operating system components, which underpin our cutting\-edge hardware and software solutions for the AI cloud. A deep understanding of Linux kernel internals, security vulnerabilities, mitigation techniques, and secure development practices is paramount for developing reliable, high\-assurance systems. This is a full\-time position. **What You'll Be Working On:** * **Kernel Hardening \& CVE Triage**: Implement kernel security enhancements, manage configuration hardening, and triage incoming CVEs to assess severity and exploitability. * **Access Control, Boot Security \& Guardrails: Enforce mandatory access controls, secure the boot path, and establish CI guardrails and fuzzing coverage to prevent regressions.** * **Vulnerability Research \& Analysis**: Research vulnerabilities across kernel, driver, and OS components to build proactive mitigations and backport non\-trivial upstream fixes to production. * **Secure Development Practices**: Establish and advocate for secure coding standards and best practices for kernel\-level development. Conduct security\-focused code reviews to identify and eliminate potential vulnerabilities early in the development lifecycle. * **Security Auditing \& Tools**: Utilize and develop specialized tools for kernel security auditing, fuzzing, static analysis, and dynamic analysis to uncover hidden vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with security policies. * **Incident Response Support**: Provide expert support during security incidents involving kernel or OS\-level compromises, assisting with root\-cause analysis, containment, and recovery efforts. * **Performance and Security Balance**: Work to ensure that security enhancements do not unduly impact system performance, especially critical for our high\-performance AI infrastructure. * **First 90 days: Own kernel CVE triage end to end and have shipped at least one backported fix through our full release path. You have an independent read on where our kernel configuration is weakest.** * **First year: Kernel security response has a defined SLA by severity and we consistently hit it. A hardening baseline is defined, enforced in CI, and rolled out across supported SKUs. Cloud Hypervisor has been audited and the highest\-value isolation gaps are closed or scheduled.** * **Cloud Hypervisor \& Isolation**: Audit, harden, and reduce privilege across Cloud Hypervisor device models and vhost\-user datapaths, contributing upstream security fixes and advancing confidential computing primitives (AMD SEV\-SNP, Intel TDX). * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**: Collaborate closely with other engineering teams (hardware, hypervisor, OS development, cloud infrastructure, and security operations) to integrate security best practices and ensure a comprehensive security strategy across the stack. * **Technical Leadership**: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers on kernel security best practices, fostering a culture of security awareness and excellence. * **Debugging and Root\-Cause Analysis**: Debug and root\-cause a variety of complex security\-related issues at the kernel level. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * **Linux Kernel Security Expertise**: Proven deep knowledge of Linux kernel internals (e.g., memory management, process scheduling, system calls, I/O subsystems) with a strong focus on security aspects. * **Vulnerability \& Exploitation Knowledge**: Solid understanding of common kernel vulnerabilities (e.g., privilege escalation, information disclosure, denial of service) and associated exploitation techniques. * **Security Mitigations**: Experience with existing Linux kernel security mitigations (e.g., ASLR, DEP/NX, SMEP/SMAP, KASLR, namespaces, cgroups, LSMs like SELinux/AppArmor). * **Secure Coding**: Strong background in secure coding principles and experience conducting security\-focused code reviews, particularly in C. * **Debugging \& Analysis Tools**: Proficiency with kernel debugging tools (e.g., GDB, crash, kgdb) and security analysis tools (e.g., valgrind, address sanitizers, fuzzers). * **Hardware Security Concepts**: Familiarity with hardware\-assisted security features (e.g., Intel SGX, AMD SEV, ARM TrustZone) and their relevance to kernel security. * **Education \& Experience**: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, and a minimum of 5 years of relevant industry experience with at least 3 years focused on low\-level operating systems or kernel security. * **Safety and Compliance**: Must be able to pass a background check. * **Company Values**: Embody the Company values. * Experience dealing with CVE Remediation and automation * First 90 days: **You own kernel CVE triage** end to end and have shipped at least one backported fix through our full release path. You have an independent read on where our kernel configuration is weakest. * First year: **Kernel security response has a defined SLA** by severity and we consistently hit it.A hardening baseline is defined, enforced in CI, and rolled out across supported SKUs. Cloud Hypervisor has been audited and the highest\-value isolation gaps are closed or scheduled. **Bonus Points** * Experience with specific kernel security projects or contributions to open\-source kernel security initiatives. * Familiarity with hypervisor security and the interaction between the hypervisor and the guest kernel’s security. * Experience with hardware security modules (HSMs) or Trusted Platform Modules (TPMs). * Background in offensive security or penetration testing at the kernel level. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $170,000 \- $205,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Sr. Model Engineer, RL Data
jobs.description: Engineering · Full\-time · Palo Alto, CA SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. **Sr. Model Engineer, Safety** SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. We train frontier coding agents and scale RL on real user data to make them increasingly effective. We're looking for Research Scientists who can drive effective RL or mid\-training research in a small\-team setting. You'll own ambiguous, hard research problems end\-to\-end: forming hypotheses, designing experiments, building the training/eval/data needed to test them, and pushing results into the next model. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Design and run rigorous experiments that turn research ideas into measurable gains in model capability * Improve data recipes through data quality, deduplication, and mixture experiments * Define what makes RL data and rewards good, including grader design and preventing reward hacking * Advance training science, from architecture and scaling experiments to post\-training recipes for coding and computer\-use agents * Build evals and targeted tasks that expose model weaknesses and guide where the team invests next * Partner with engineers to take promising results from small experiments to frontier\-scale training runs **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience training or post\-training large neural networks (1B\+ parameters), including work on pre\-training, fine\-tuning, or RL\-based methods (e.g., RLHF, DPO). * Experience writing production\-quality code in Python, PyTorch, JAX, Rust, or C\+\+ **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Able to handle ambiguous research tasks with little guidance, and to own a research direction end to end * Care an unusual amount about data quality, and can dive into the data when appropriate * Truth seeking, aiming to learn more about the science than to prove your ideas are correct * Experience with RL algorithms for language models, scaling laws, or building RL environments and evals * Experience with distributed training at scale and debugging problems that only show up at scale * Experience training frontier\-scale models * Strong background in RL and machine learning fundamentals * An excellent programmer and software engineer, comfortable working across the research stack in Python and PyTorch or JAX * Hands\-on experience training large models, through pretraining, post\-training or RL * A track record of original work in ML, such as new methods or real improvements, shown through research, open source or production impact * MS or PhD in CS, ML, math, physics or a related field, or equivalent research experience **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the Palo Alto office **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:** The annual following considerations: job\-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short \& long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

jobs.title: Azure Identity & Access Management Engineer

Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **Position Summary** The Identity and Access Management Engineer is responsible for contributing to the design, engineering, and supporting identity capabilities across workforce, privileged, cloud, and customer\-facing environments. A primary focus of the role is helping establish and mature a new Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) capability, creating the identity architecture, engineering patterns, integrations, and operational foundations required to securely support customer\-facing digital applications at scale. This engineer will work across Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Entra ID, applying identity engineering principles to both enterprise Workforce IAM and CIAM. The role spans authentication, authorization, federation, identity lifecycle management, privileged access, and application identity, with particular emphasis on integrating customer identity services with applications and APIs using OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC). These capabilities must balance security and privacy requirements with availability, scalability, reliability, and customer experience. Customer Identity \& Access Management (CIAM) * Design, implement, and support CIAM solutions for customer\-facing web, mobile, and digital applications. * Implement secure customer registration, sign\-in, authentication, account recovery, and identity lifecycle patterns. * Integrate customer identity services with applications and APIs using standards including OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC). * Partner with application engineering teams to integrate authentication and authorization into application architectures. * Support federation and external identity integrations across customer and partner ecosystems. * Troubleshoot complex login, token, federation, authorization, and application integration issues. * Ensure CIAM implementations balance security, customer experience, availability, scalability, and privacy requirements. failures, privileged access, or unauthorized access. * Develop reusable engineering patterns, technical standards, runbooks, and reference architectures. * Automate provisioning, access management, reporting, and identity governance processes where practical. * Support production availability and operational reliability of business\-critical identity services. * Partner with Security, implementing CIAM or external/customer identity solutions. * 3\+ years of experience implementing enterprise SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, RBAC, federation, and identity lifecycle management. * 3\+ years with OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, authentication, authorization, tokens, and federation. * 2\+ years of experience integrating IAM capabilities with enterprise web applications, APIs, and cloud\-native applications. * 2\+ years of experience working with APIs, scripting, or automation technologies such as Microsoft Graph, PowerShell, Python, or Terraform. **Preferred jobs.title: Senior Hardware Validation Engineer
jobs.description: **This role requires working from Canopy headquarter in Detroit and various testing facilities in the Metro Detroit/Dearborn area. Candidates should be prepared to work onsite testing and collaboration within this geographical area on a weekly basis.** **The Senior Hardware Validation Engineer leads end\-to\-end hardware validation activities across the product\-development lifecycle for Canopy products. This role is responsible for establishing validation strategies, managing test plans and execution, maintaining requirements traceability, and driving testing best practices and process improvements.** **The engineer will combine hands\-on testing and test\-rig development with validation\-management responsibilities, including coordinating with cross\-functional teams and suppliers, tracking test progress and risks, and communicating validation readiness. The role also leads technical issue triage and root\-cause analysis to ensure timely containment and corrective actions. This position provides technical leadership and mentorship but does not include direct people\-management responsibility.** **Responsibilities:** * **Validation Management: Lead and manage end\-to\-end hardware validation activities across all development phases, ensuring plans, schedules, execution, and deliverables align with product requirements and program milestones.** * **Test Strategy and Planning: Develop and maintain validation plans, test procedures, test cases, and execution strategies that provide complete requirements coverage and traceability.** * **Testing Best Practices and Process Excellence: Establish, champion, and continuously improve testing standards, tools, workflows, and validation processes to drive consistency, efficiency, quality, and repeatability.** * **Test Execution and Reporting: Oversee and participate in hardware, vehicle\-level, and controlled\-environment testing; clearly communicate test status, results, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.** * **Issue Triage and Root\-Cause Analysis: Lead the investigation of hardware defects and test failures, partnering with engineering teams and suppliers to identify root causes, define containment actions, and implement permanent corrective actions** * **Supplier and Cross\-Functional Coordination: Manage validation activities with suppliers and collaborate with hardware, software, systems, quality, DFMEA/PFMEA, and vehicle integration teams to resolve risks and ensure product readiness.** * **Test Infrastructure and Documentation: Support the development of test rigs and test environments, and maintain validation documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures, test reports, lessons learned, and Interface Control Document verification.** * **Technical Leadership: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior engineers while promoting a disciplined, data\-driven validation culture across the organization.** **Requirements** **Minimum Requirements and Qualifications:** * Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. * Relevant Experience: Five or more years of experience in hardware validation, hardware test engineering, quality engineering, or a similar product\-development role. * Hardware Validation Expertise: Demonstrated experience developing and executing hardware validation plans, test procedures, test cases, and test reports across product\-development phases. * Test Equipment and Test Rig Experience: Hands\-on experience building or supporting test rigs and using bench\-level test equipment, including oscilloscopes, programmable power supplies, CAN analyzers, digital multimeters, and spectrum analyzers. * Testing and Troubleshooting Skills: Strong knowledge of hardware, sensors, and peripherals, with the ability to execute tests, triage failures, perform root\-cause analysis, and support corrective\-action development. * Requirements and Documentation Discipline: Experience translating hardware requirements into test cases, maintaining requirements traceability, and documenting test results, issues, and lessons learned. * Collaboration and Communication: Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional engineering teams, suppliers, and quality stakeholders in a fast\-paced product\-development environment. * Vehicle Testing Capability: Valid driver’s license and ability to support vehicle testing as needed. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Education: M.Sc degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. * Automotive Experience: Previous experience in automotive product development, ideally within an OEM, Tier 1 supplier, or automotive technology organization. * Vehicle Network Knowledge: Proficiency with automotive communication protocols, including CAN 2\.0, CAN FD, Ethernet, LIN, SENT, and FlexRay. * Systems and Vehicle Integration: Experience with vehicle\-level integration testing, Interface Control Document (ICD) verification, and automotive electronic systems architecture. * Quality and Risk Management Methods: Working knowledge of structured problem\-solving and quality methods, including 8D, DFMEA, PFMEA, change management, and Six Sigma principles. * Test Automation and Development Tools: Experience with test automation, continuous integration or deployment pipelines, and tools such as GitLab, AWS services, Jira, Zephyr, Asana, or Microsoft Office applications. * Embedded and Linux Testing: Hands\-on experience testing Linux\-based or embedded hardware devices, including integration, regression, performance, stress, end\-to\-end, and security testing. * Electronics and Compliance Knowledge: Ability to interpret electronic schematics and PCB layouts, with practical experience supporting EMC/EMI design compliance and validation. **Working Conditions For Roles in the US Region only:** * Work is generally performed in a well\-lit, temperature\-controlled indoor environment with occasional exposure to the outdoors or any number of elements. * Work is performed with exposure to any number of elements which may occasionally require some precautions such as safety glasses, protective clothing, gear protection, etc. * Ability to travel in\-state and out\-of\-state or globally. * Ability to work irregular shifts and extended hours, including evenings and weekends. **Benefits** * Comprehensive medical benefits coverage, dental plans and vision coverage. * Health care and dependent care spending accounts. * Employee and Family Assistance Program (EAP). * Employee discount programs. * Retirement plan with a generous company match. * Generous Paid Time Off, Sick, and Holidays * Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity) * Short\- and long\-term disability * Life insurance and accidental death \& dismemberment insurance Compensation Range Compensation may vary depending on skills and experience. **Base Salary: $111,775 \- $136,935** **Diversity, Equity and Inclusion:** At Canopy, we're on a mission to end theft from vehicles and revolutionize vehicle security by building cutting\-edge technology. We will achieve this by prioritizing individuals and staying attuned to the evolving needs of our people, users, and industry trends. We foster a workplace culture that embraces diversity and authenticity, enabling us to flourish as a team of exceptional individuals working towards a common purpose. We gain a deeper understanding of our users' experiences by continuously improving our skills and expanding our knowledge. A more diverse, equitable, and inclusive Canopy leads to greater innovation and success. **Equal Opportunity:** Canopy does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other reason prohibited by law in provision of employment opportunities and benefits.

jobs.title: Associate, Data Scientist - US Card
jobs.description: Associate, Data Scientist \- US Card Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast\-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 100 company and a leader in the world of data\-driven decision\-making. As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives. **Team Description:** The US Card Data Science organization at Capital One leverages our massive wealth of customer data to drive business strategy and deliver world\-class customer experiences. Our team builds and deploys sophisticated data science and machine learning models across the entire credit card lifecycle—including marketing, acquisitions, underwriting, and fraud prevention. In this role, you will turn complex insights into real\-world impact, shaping financial products that serve and protect millions of cardholders daily. **Role Description** **In this role, you will:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love * Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, SQL or Databricks, PySpark and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data * Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation * Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals **The Ideal Candidate is:** * Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies.
