jobs.company: Center for a New American Security
jobs.title: AI Engineer/Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Policy research needs to catch up to AI. Researchers at the Center for a New American Security (CNAS) are pushing today’s AI tools to their limits, and the next generation of research and product tools for national security analysis hasn’t been built yet. CNAS is seeking an AI Engineer / Senior AI Engineer to embed with some of the nation’s top AI and national security researchers, editors, and designers. You will prototype AI\-enabled tools and products, refine the ones that work, and scale the best of them across the Center. CNAS is making a substantial investment in its well\-established AI and national security team by launching the AI Policy Lab, and the AI Engineer / Senior AI Engineer will be instrumental to that effort. You will report to the Vice President of Strategy and Communications. As an early member of the AI Policy Lab, you’ll help shape how the lab operates from the ground floor. In this role, you’ll design, build, and deploy custom software, applications, and AI agent workflows that expand what CNAS researchers can accomplish in their work on AI policy, national security, and AI\-related economic competition. You will serve as a technical partner embedded with CNAS research and business teams to build out innovative solutions to increase productivity and maximize policy impact. The ideal candidate has a software engineering or computer science background, is highly proficient at using AI coding tools and agents to build applications and automated workflows and has a genuine interest in AI policy and national security. You enjoy working alongside non\-engineers, turning research questions into durable, reusable tools, and teaching colleagues to get the most out of what you build. This is a hands\-on technical role with significant autonomy. This is not a research position. You might be well\-suited for this role if you’re: * Experienced at building working software with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or Cursor, from quick prototypes to tools colleagues rely on daily. * Excited to work alongside researchers, learn how they work, and build custom tools and agent workflows that take their research further. * Skilled at explaining technical concepts to non\-engineers and helping colleagues become more capable AI users. * Interested in how AI is reshaping national security. * Comfortable with shifting priorities in a field that moves fast. * Able to juggle short\- and long\-term projects while building durable tools others can use. * Motivated by seeing your work used, not just shipped. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Build Custom Software and Tools** + Embed with CNAS researchers to build custom code, applications, and AI agent workflows that support their research and analysis. + Rapidly prototype tools and refine them based on how colleagues use them. + Build agents and pipelines that gather, process, analyze, and visualize documents, transcripts, and datasets for CNAS research. + Build custom tools and software to automate business functions and accelerate productivity. * **Train and Empower Staff** + Train staff to use, adapt, and build on the tools you create, and document best practices for advanced AI use. + Help CNAS researchers who are already proficient AI users push their work further with code, agents, and advanced AI capabilities. + Track new AI models, harnesses, systems, and capabilities and assess which are worth adopting. * **Sustain AI Integration** + Standardize AI\-enabled workflows for recurring tasks such as baseline research, copy editing, citations, contact management, and data tracking. + Test, refine, document, and maintain AI tools for durable use. + Test AI\-assisted outputs for accuracy, objectivity, and sourcing to meet CNAS’s quality standards for independent, fact\-based research. + Ensure tools meet CNAS standards for data security and responsible AI use. **QUALIFICATIONS** **Required:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * Experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor) and demonstrated ability to explain, test, debug, and take responsibility for the resulting code. * Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript) including work with APIs and software integration. * Full\-stack engineering experience building and deploying custom software, agent workflows, or data pipelines with AI coding tools. * Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and train non\-technical colleagues. * Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities. * Legal right to work in the United States. **Preferred:** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Interest in AI policy, national security, or AI safety and security. * Experience with think tank, government, or academic research analysis and workflows. * Experience with data visualization and web development. **COMPENSATI \& BENEFITS** * $125,000 – $215,000, depending on qualifications and experience. * CNAS offers a complete and competitive benefits package for employees which includes medical, dental, vision, life and AD\&D insurance, short\- and long\-term disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, 403(b) retirement accounts, transportation subsidies, and an employee assistance program. **LOGISTICS** * This is a full\-time, in\-person role based in Washington, D.C. * Occasional travel to the San Francisco Bay Area and other locations may be required. * This role is within the CNAS AI Policy Lab and reports to the Vice President of Strategy and Communications. * This is a two\-year, term\-limited appointment. * We are open to hiring a range of experience levels. Title and compensation will be commensurate with experience. * Applications will be considered on a rolling basis. Candidates are encouraged to apply early. * Candidates may start as soon as available. **About the CNAS AI Policy Lab** AI progress is fast outpacing policy. The opportunities and challenges of the AI age demand bold new ideas for U.S. national security that meet the moment. The CNAS AI Policy Lab fuses in\-depth AI and national security expertise to produce cutting\-edge, technically informed policy analysis. The United States and its allies must harness the benefits, manage the risks, and ensure democracies lead in this era\-defining technology. The AI Policy Lab integrates CNAS’s technology, defense, regional, and economic expertise to address how AI is reshaping every dimension of national power and geopolitical competition. The Lab will serve as a hub for curated workshops, discussions, partnerships, and other convenings to bring industry, researchers, and the national security community to develop policy solutions. By bridging the divide between innovators and national security policymakers, the Lab will ensure that policy can match the unprecedented pace of technological innovation, harnessing the transformative power of AI while managing risks. The AI Policy Lab builds on a sustained track record of CNAS leadership in AI policymaking. CNAS experts and alumni have written the rules for how the Pentagon incorporates autonomous systems, developed policies intended to preserve the United States’s AI lead, and served in the highest levels of AI policymaking. **About CNAS** The Center for a New American Security develops bold, innovative, and bipartisan national security and defense policies that promote and protect American interests and values. Building on the deep expertise and broad experience of its staff and advisors, CNAS engages policymakers, experts, and the public with innovative fact\-based research, ideas, and analysis to shape and elevate the national security debate. As an independent 501(c)(3\) non\-profit research organization, CNAS leads efforts to help inform and prepare the national security leaders of today and tomorrow. CNAS is located in Washington, D.C. CNAS is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. **To Apply** CNAS accepts online applications only. A complete application will include a cover letter explaining your interest in and qualifications for the position, along with your resume or CV and a link to a portfolio, GitHub profile, or other examples of software, applications, or agent workflows you have built. Your cover letter should explain, in your voice, why this role fits your interests and experience. Candidates who advance in the process will be asked to share references and will also be asked to complete a timed practical technical exercise. Because this role centers on AI tools, we encourage you to use AI freely in your application materials and in the work samples you share and to tell us how you used it.

The team partners with Schwab business units to identify high‑impact use cases, pilot innovative analytical solutions, and transition successful models into compliant, resilient production systems. partnering with business stakeholders to convert high‑level business objectives into clear, actionable data science and AI solutions that address critical business and technology challenges. * **Set and elevate engineering standards for data science** by establishing best practices that treat data science as a rigorous engineering discipline, including modular code design, testing, version control, and production readiness. * **Advance technical capabilities in emerging areas** by leading complex initiatives involving advanced machine learning, recommender systems, real‑time and low‑latency inference, or other evolving technologies that require deep technical expertise and comfort with ambiguity. **What you have** ----------------- ### **Required Qualifications** * Experience in data science and machine learning. * Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) in a quantitative field such as computer engineering, statistics, mathematics, physics, chemistry, or related discipline. * Hands‑on experience using Python and SQL to develop production‑grade, modular, and optimized code. * Proven ability to convert business requirements into technical end\-to\-end machine learning solutions delivered against roadmap milestones for two or more lines of business. * Proven experience developing supervised and unsupervised machine learning solutions, with delivery of three or more distinct models supported by documented evaluation metrics, performance tracking, and value measurement. * Experience in ing natural language processing techniques to unstructured data with at least one solution delivered to production. * Practical experience designing LLM solutions (such as retrieval‑augmented generation, agent workflows, or fine‑tuning), including at least one LLM system deployed for internal use. * Strong software engineering fundamentals, including version control, CI/CD, and MLOps practices, demonstrated through three or more production deployments. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working in financial services or other highly regulated industries. * Strong background in statistics, forecasting, or causal inference. * Hands‑on experience architecting machine learning solutions within cloud ecosystems. * Experience building, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines that support machine learning workflows. * Experience developing large‑scale recommender or personalization systems. * A demonstrated commitment to mentorship, including coaching senior data scientists or engineers and elevating team capability through feedback and code quality. * Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization. * Self\-starter with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and desire to continually reevaluate existing products and processes. * Comfort in a dynamic, fast\-moving environment, with a positive attitude, solid work ethic, and strong track records of performance. In addition to the salary range, this role is also eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities. **What’s in it for you** ------------------------ At Schwab, you’re empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis. jobs.title: AI Agent Developer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **Overview:** We don’t simply hire employees. We invest in them. When you work at Chatham, we empower you — offering professional development opportunities to help you grow in your career, no matter if you've been here for five months or 15 years. Chatham has worked hard to create a distinct work environment that values people, teamwork, integrity, and client service. You will have immediate opportunities to partner with talented subject matter experts, work on complex projects, and contribute to the value Chatham delivers every day. We are seeking an AI Agent Developer to design, build, and deploy AI agents that transform how teams at Chatham work. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who wants to apply modern AI to real business problems and see the impact firsthand. You will report to one of our Software Engineering Directors to maintain alignment with our organizational AI objectives. In each role, you will embed with a partner team as a forward\-deployed engineer. You will review past work, shadow team members on live tasks, and map where time is spent and why. From there, you will identify and prioritize the highest\-value opportunities, then build, evaluate, and release agents that triage requests, research and draft answers, investigate issues across systems and data, and prepare work for review. The team’s experts stay in the loop throughout, and people review agent output before it reaches a client or a production system. Once a team’s agents are running reliably, you will hand them over to the people who own the work and bring the same approach to the next team. Over time, you will partner with teams across the firm, from engineering and operations to client service and Marketing, wherever repetitive work can be improved through agentic means. You will work closely with Chatham’s AI evaluation and platform teams and help set the standards that other teams adopt. This is a new role at Chatham and an opportunity to help define how the firm builds and scales agentic capabilities. The ideal candidate is a pragmatic engineer who enjoys learning new domains from the people who do the work, collaborates easily with technical and non\-technical colleagues, and measures success by the problems solved for users. **In this role you will:** Discovery \& Partnership * Embed in a partner team and learn how it works. Review past work, shadow live tasks, and map the steps that the team repeats. * Find and rank the tasks where agents can save the most time or improve quality and agree on priorities with the team’s leaders. * Work closely with the team’s experts. They supply the domain knowledge and test cases, and they review agent output. Agent Development * Design, build, and deploy cloud\-native AI agents that do repetitive work from documented processes, with a person in the loop where judgment is necessary. * Build agents that triage and route incoming requests, research questions and draft answers, and investigate issues across systems, logs, and data. * Build agents that prepare work for people to review, such as draft responses, reports, and code changes as merge requests. * Turn each team’s playbooks and procedures into agent instructions and tools and keep them current as processes change. Evaluation \& Quality * Create evaluation sets from real past work. Measure each agent’s accuracy before release and whenever models or techniques change and monitor the results in production. * Partner with our AI evaluation team, and adopt its tools, techniques, and processes as they mature. * Follow Chatham’s standards for security, data handling, and the responsible use of AI. Reuse \& Handover * Document each agent’s purpose, tools, and limits so that other teams can adopt and extend it. * Build reusable tools and patterns that make each new team’s agents faster to deliver. Hand each team’s agents over to the people who own the work, then move to the next team. * **Your Impact:** For each partner team * Agents do a growing share of the team’s routine work correctly, and people review the output. * The team spends less time on repetitive tasks and more time on work that needs judgment. * Requests that wait in a queue today get faster and more consistent answers. * Each agent meets its accuracy targets before release and keeps them in production. Across Chatham * Each agent has documentation and tests, and other teams reuse its tools and patterns. * Each engagement ends with a clean handover to the people who own the work. A ranked list of agent opportunities is ready for the next team before you move to it. * **Contributors to your success:** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Strong proficiency in Python or C\#, with experience in APIs, services, or automation. * Hands\-on experience with applications built on large language models (LLMs), including prompt and context design, tool use, and agent workflows. * Experience with evaluation of AI output: test sets, accuracy measures, and regression checks for systems that do not always return the same answer. * Solid SQL skills, and comfort with logs and telemetry to find the root cause of a problem. * Experience with Git, code review, and CI/CD. * Curiosity and patience to learn complex business domains from the people who do the work. * Ability to turn a business process into clear steps that an agent can follow, and to judge where a person must stay in the loop. * Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non\-technical colleagues. * Experience with tools and integrations built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Experience with platforms or frameworks for AI agents, such as Microsoft Foundry or the Claude Agent SDK. * Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot. * Experience in a forward\-deployed, solutions engineering, or internal tools role, or a background in operations, technical support, or site reliability engineering. * Experience with Azure. Familiarity with tools such as GitHub, Grafana, Jira, and Confluence. * **About Chatham Financial:** Chatham Financial is the leading independent capital markets advisor, delivering an integrated blend of expert advice and powerful technology to help you reduce risk and seize opportunity. With decades of capital markets strategy, execution, monitoring, and performance expertise, we serve as an unwavering advocate for your best interests and your innovation partner. Our technology platform unifies data across assets, debt, and derivatives, giving you unmatched agility, transparency, and insight. **It’s clear ahead.** Our commitment is to carry that light forward in every partnership, every solution, and every market we serve. We help guide the way—giving clients the insight and momentum to move forward with confidence, no matter what lies ahead.

jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Us:** We're not just another SaaS company. We're chiropractors and software veterans who got tired of watching practices struggle with clunky, outdated systems. So we built something better. ChiroHD (https://www.chirohd.com/) is the cloud\-based practice management platform that actually gets chiropractic. Scheduling, EHR, billing, patient communication \- everything a modern practice needs, built specifically for how chiropractors actually work. No more trying to force\-fit horizontal software into your vertical world. We've cracked the code on product\-market fit \- prepped, proven, and ready for scale! ### **Role Overview:** You are a go\-to\-market operator with a technical mindset who builds the complex. You understand how pipeline, forecasting, attribution, and quota actually work, and you are just as comfortable writing the script, API call, or Claude workflow that makes them rock\-solid and reliable. Sitting inside Revenue Operations, you will own the technical build layer behind our GTM engine: the integrations between HubSpot, Maxio, Stripe, Intercom, data platforms, and beyond—including the automations that keep them in sync and the AI tools our reps and leaders rely on daily. This is a go\-to\-market role with a technical edge, not a product engineering role. Your primary customers are our GTM individual contributors (AEs, BDRs, CSMs) and GTM leaders. ### **Why This Role:** We've proven the use cases. Our data pipelines, automations, dashboards, and AI tooling already work, and the revenue team relies on them daily. You take them to production grade and build what comes next. You will multiply what both RevOps and our GTM teams can do. RevOps continues leading on strategy, definitions, governance, and cross\-functional alignment, and still owns a significant portion of the hands\-on building. You take on the technical, code\-heavy work, translating ad\-hoc business requests into clean technical systems and efficient processes. ### **What You'll Do:** * **Data Infrastructure \& Identity:** Build and maintain the GTM data layer: pipelines, data models, and identity matching that connect CRM, product telemetry, billing (Stripe/Maxio), and market data into one trusted, unified view of every account. * **Event\-Driven Systems \& Integrations:** Build monitored, documented integrations and automations in place of manual workarounds and one\-off fixes. Manage routine technical administration across key systems, handling webhooks, rate limits, and error alerting. * **A Reporting Foundation Leaders Can Trust:** Deliver accurate, timely, warehouse\-backed data reflecting shared business definitions for pipeline, funnel velocity, sales activity, and multi\-touch attribution. * **Production AI Tools \& Agents:** Build Claude skills, internal apps, and LLM workflows for prospect research, enrichment, scoring, summarization, deal hygiene, rep enablement, and key handoff milestones. Ensure workflows are production\-grade, durable, and actively deliver value over time. * **Signals to Action:** Convert customer usage signals, prospecting triggers, account intent, and enrichment data into prioritized, automated routing and actionable tasks for sales and CS teams. * **Measurement \& Iteration:** Track the tangible impact of the systems and tools you build (rep hours saved, user adoption, data quality, pipeline influence). Scale what drives revenue and aggressively retire what doesn't. ### **Who You Are:** * **GTM Fluency:** You have 3–6\+ years of experience across RevOps, Sales Ops, or technical GTM roles. You have a strong, working grasp of pipeline, funnel conversion, quota, forecast models, and attribution mechanics. * **Deep HubSpot Mastery:** You have hands\-on architectural depth with HubSpot: custom objects, properties, advanced workflows, and the HubSpot API. * **Hands\-On Coder \& Builder:** You possess strong SQL skills for querying and data transformation, paired with working Python (or an equivalent scripting language) for interacting directly with REST APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines. * **Proven AI Builder:** You have direct, hands\-on experience building practical workflows with Claude or other LLMs—with a track record of builds that are still active and relied upon today. You integrate AI coding tools into your daily workflow to ship faster. * **Systems Architect \& Translator:** You excel at turning ambiguous, ad\-hoc business requests into clean, scalable technical systems and efficient operational processes. You explain technical trade\-offs back to commercial leaders in plain language. * **Relentless Documenter \& Outcome Owner:** You document your architecture, instrument monitoring so syncs never fail silently, and take end\-to\-end ownership of business outcomes rather than just checking off tasks. ### **Nice\-to\-Have:** * Experience modeling Stripe, Maxio, or recurring subscription billing data. * Hands\-on experience with modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery) and dbt. * Familiarity with automation and orchestration engines (n8n, Clay, Temporal). * Prior experience operating in a multi\-product SaaS environment or navigating data consolidation post\-acquisition. ### **Probably Not a Fit (Disqualifiers):** * **No\-Code Only Admins:** Operations admins whose experience is strictly limited to point\-and\-click UI configurations and who do not write scripts, SQL, or code. * **Core Product Software Engineers:** Developers who want to own a customer\-facing product roadmap and sprint backlog rather than GTM systems and revenue infrastructure. * **Task\-Takers:** People who prefer to wait for pre\-scoped engineering tickets and hand back finished tasks without understanding or owning the underlying business outcome. * **Candidates Lacking GTM Literacy:** Anyone lacking a moderate understanding of pipeline stages, rep quotas, and funnel math. ### **Why ChiroHD:** **Impact \& Growth** * Vertical SaaS category leader in a wide market. * PE\-backed with $26M in growth capital to scale aggressively. * Established product\-market fit; scaling outbound\-led growth engine now. * High\-caliber sales culture focused on coaching, commercial excellence, and real career growth. * Direct leadership access, no bureaucracy, high visibility. **Culture \& Values** * Customer\-obsessed team that puts patient care at the center of everything we do * Low\-ego, builder\-first environment where the best ideas win * High\-accountability culture with emphasis on ownership and results * Commitment to work\-life balance and professional development **Compensation \& Benefits** * Competitive salary * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Flexible PTO and remote\-first culture **Equal Employment Opportunist** ChiroHD is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, or disability status.

jobs.description: **Discover your future at Citi** -------------------------------- Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. **Job Overview** ---------------- Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations \& Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first\-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services. Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well\-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together. **Position Overview:** The Site Reliability Engineer is based in North America (NAM) to serve as the regional pillar of our global reliability engineering function within Markets Technology. In this role, you will be part of a distributed, high\-impact three\-person global team, working closely with your counterparts in EMEA and APAC to provide resilient, round\-the\-clock ("follow\-the\-sun") operational excellence, infrastructure automation, and architecture reliability for mission\-critical enterprise systems. As a VP\-level Individual Contributor, you will operate as a technical authority for the NAM region. You will champion modern SRE principles—bridging software engineering, systems architecture, and production operations—to maximize service uptime, optimize performance, and drive end\-to\-end automation across hybrid\-cloud and on\-premises environments. **Key Responsibilities:** **Reliability Engineering, Observability \& Incident Governance** * **SLO/SLI Framework Ownership:** Define, monitor, and enforce Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Error Budgets across core regional and global platforms in collaboration with development and product teams. * **Incident Management \& Root Cause Elimination:** Act as the Tier\-3 technical escalation authority for critical production incidents during NAM market/operational hours. Conduct blameless Post\-Incident Reviews (PIRs) and implement preventative architectural and automated remediations. * **Advanced Observability:** Design and maintain unified monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting ecosystems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog) to ensure deep system telemetry and proactive anomaly detection. **Automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) \& Continuous Delivery** * **Toil Elimination:** Identify repetitive operational tasks and eliminate toil through software engineering, creating resilient tools, automated runbooks, and self\-healing infrastructure. * **Infrastructure as Code \& Configuration:** Architect, provision, and maintain secure, highly available cloud and bare\-metal environments. * **CI/CD Pipeline Reliability:** Partner with application engineering teams to design robust, secure, and automated release deployment patterns (Canary, Blue/Green, Feature Flags) that minimize change failure rates and deployment friction. **Global "Follow\-the\-Sun" Collaboration \& Hand\-Offs** * **Global Continuity:** Execute structured, high\-context operational and incident handoffs with counterparts in EMEA and APAC, ensuring seamless 24/7 reliability coverage without requiring overnight on\-call shifts. * **Global Standardization:** Align regional operational standards, automation scripts, and disaster recovery procedures with the global pod to maintain parity across  on, and failover perspective. * **Observability Tooling:** Hands\-on experience configuring and scaling telemetry stacks. **Leadership \& Interpersonal Attributes (Individual Contributor)** * **High Autonomy \& Ownership:** Demonstrated capability to operate independently as the sole regional subject matter expert while maintaining strong synergy with global peers. * **Communication \& Stakeholder Management:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate complex technical issues and trade\-offs to senior leadership and cross\-functional engineering teams. * **Problem\-Solving \& Bias for Action:** Calm under pressure during high\-severity production incidents, with an analytical mindset focused on data\-driven decision\-making. **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** * **Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) \& Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR)** across NAM service components. * **Service Availability \& SLO Attainment** against target thresholds. * **Toil Reduction Rate:** Quantifiable percentage of operational tasks automated and transitioned to self\-service. * **Change Failure Rate \& Rollback Frequency:** Reduction in deployment\-related service disruptions. * **Quality of Global Handoffs:** Zero\-drop continuity across NAM/EMEA/APAC shift transitions. **Education:** * Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience * Master’s degree preferred This job description provides a high\-level review of the types of work performed. jobs.title: Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers
jobs.description: CleanSpark (Nasdaq: CLSK), is a market\-leading data center developer with a proven track record of success. commitments. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Own and maintain CleanSpark’s AI data center engineering standards, Basis of Design (BoD), and design criteria across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, controls, telecom, and site infrastructure disciplines * Define and approve system architecture for medium\-voltage and low\-voltage electrical distribution, generation and backup power, technical issues, RFIs, and design conflicts that exceed consultant or project\-team authority * Own the owner\-side commissioning program: define commissioning scope and levels, approve commissioning agents and test scripts, witness integrated systems testing, and sign off on energization and turnover readiness * Lead operational readiness from an engineering standpoint: handover documentation, as\-builts, O\&M requirements, spare parts and maintainability criteria, and alignment of design intent with Operations’ requirements * Evaluate and recommend equipment vendors, long\-lead procurement specifications, and standard equipment platforms; support procurement with technical bid evaluations and scopes of work * Assess engineering risk across the portfolio; identify design, power, cooling, and integration risks early and drive mitigation into standards and project plans * Support tenant and customer technical requirements, including design review responses, change evaluations, and and executive leadership This role requires professionalism, respect, strong communication, and the ability to work well with others in a team\-oriented, inclusive environment. ### **Required infrastructure (MV/LV distribution, generation, UPS, protection and coordination) and mechanical infrastructure (chilled water, air and liquid cooling, heat rejection) for high\-density compute * and energization planning for large loads * Experience leading commissioning (Levels 1–5 / integrated systems testing) and facility turnover on mission\-critical projects * Proven ability to lead engineering consultants, contractors, and internal technical staff, and to make and defend technical decisions with executives, customers, and partners * Strong constructability judgment and experience partnering with construction teams through design, procurement, and field execution * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade\-offs clearly to non\-technical stakeholders ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred * Experience with AI, HPC, or hyperscale data center design, including liquid\-cooled and high\-density rack deployments * Owner\-side experience with a hyperscaler, colocation provider, or large infrastructure developer * Experience developing and governing engineering standards or Basis of Design programs across multiple sites * Familiarity with Uptime Institute Tier concepts, ASHRAE TC 9\.9 guidelines, NEC/NFPA 70 and NFPA 70E, IEEE power system standards, and jobs.title: Junior Legal AI Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Cleary Gottlieb is a pioneer in globalizing the legal profession. We have 14 offices in major financial centers around the world, but we operate as a single, integrated global partnership and not as a U.S. firm with a network of overseas locations. The firm employs approximately 1,100 lawyers from more than 50 countries. Since 1946 our lawyers and staff have worked across practices, industries, jurisdictions, and continents to provide clients with simple, actionable approaches to their most complex legal and business challenges, whether domestic or international. We support every client relationship with intellectual agility, commercial acumen, and a human touch. Cleary Gottlieb’s AI Acceleration Team combines frontier AI with elite legal expertise to redesign legal work from first principles. We are AI engineers, data scientists, software engineers and lawyers. We began as Springbok AI, a startup, and still run like one: we ship bespoke AI workflows, co\-pilots and tools that lawyers choose to use, backed by a world\-class law firm. Responsibilities: **The Role:** We’re hiring a Junior Legal AI Engineer fluent with both lawyers and technical teams. In the morning you’ll analyze a workflow with a partner; in the afternoon you’ll discuss knowledge graphs with our data scientists and engineers. You translate between them, and the product improves as a result. Ideally, you’ve trained and worked as a lawyer, however, we are considering alternative legal / legaltech backgrounds. You don’t need to code, or to have used code editor; you do need to be willing to learn both. **What You’ll Be Doing:** * **Design legal workflows**: Turn legal processes into automations lawyers adopt and find where automation can save time or reduce errors. * **Engineer prompts**: Write, review and refine prompts with our NLP specialists until outputs meet a lawyer’s standard. * **Bridge law and engineering**: Translate legal requirements into technical specifications, and technical constraints into terms lawyers trust. * **Configure and test**: Tailor our AI tools to real legal use cases; test and iterate until they work in practice, not just in a demo. * **Champion our users**: Provide first\-line support to our lawyers and turn their feedback into prioritized input for engineers. * **Get hands\-on**: Work alongside our engineers with AI coding assistants and at the command line: edit templates and configuration, run scripts and inspect outputs. We’ll teach you the tools. Qualifications: **What You Bring:*** 3\+ years’ experience in or alongside legal teams, including drafting, review, summarization and data extraction * You meet the requirements but don’t have a JD or extensive legal experience beyond the minimum * Command of the principles of legal work: accuracy, explainability, confidentiality and privilege, rigor, risk\-awareness and accountability * Working knowledge of AI concepts such as agents, retrieval, chain\-of\-thought prompting and few\-shot learning, and the ability to discuss them with data scientists and engineers. We’ll make you an expert within 90 days. * Familiarity with the legal AI landscape (Harvey, Legora, Thomson Reuters, LexisNexis) and a view on its direction * Clear written and verbal communication: you can explain a model’s limitations to a partner and a lawyer’s risk concerns to an engineer * Self\-direction: you build processes where none exist and dig in when something isn’t working * Willingness to learn how to use a code editor and basic scripting; no prior experience required **Bonus Points:*** Experience in practice development, knowledge management, legal operations or legal service delivery * Startup or legal tech experience, ideally in agile or product\-led teams * Experience with no\-code or low\-code builders (e.g. Framer, Squarespace) * Existing comfort with code editors or scripting, or something real you’ve vibe\-coded **Why You’ll Love It Here:*** Build from the ground up and change how lawyers at a world\-class firm practice * Join a small, ambitious team * Learn across AI, product, design and engineering * Have a voice: we want your ideas, not just your execution The estimated base salary range for this position is $120,000 to $140,000 at the time of posting. The actual salary offered will depend on a variety of job\-related factors, including skills, education, training, credentials, experience, scope and complexity of role responsibilities, geographic location, and performance. This role is exempt meaning it is not overtime pay eligible. Cleary provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health care benefits. More information can be found here: Benefits We are an equal opportunity employer and prohibit discrimination based on any category protected by law. Cleary provides reasonable accommodations to enable otherwise qualified employees to perform the essential functions of their position, provided the accommodation does not pose an undue hardship to the Firm. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Claims & AI Billing
jobs.description: At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs. Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.” Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here. The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation. **About the Role** ------------------ Running a healthcare practice is hard. It's a highly regulated, low\-margin business. Practices deliver care upfront, then have to navigate a complex insurance system to get paid. Much of that work is manual, and it isn't always clear which claims or tasks are worth tackling first. When a practice can't operate efficiently, patients are impacted through reduced access to care or unexpected out\-of\-pocket costs. Our Claims team builds software that helps clinics and hospitals get paid for the care they deliver. We build automations that can be configured to fit each practice's needs, ensuring their entire business pipeline functions smoothly. We also build tools that help billers and administrators figure out where their time will have the biggest impact. We help them go after the highest ROI work first, work claims in bulk, and spot trends early that need their attention. We're also building AI agents as coworkers that can take on work between fixed automations and fully manual workflows and make customer onboarding and billing setup more accurate and automated. The end goal is to help clinics and hospitals work more efficiently and collect more of the revenue they've earned. As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll work across the stack, from data\-dense workflows in the UI to the backend pipelines, integrations, and rule engines that power them. You'll own important projects and subsystems, make thoughtful technical decisions, and help us solve the right problems for the people working through claims every day. Our scope is broad: you might build a CDC pipeline, design an API, or create a new automation workflow on any given day. As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll own multi\-component projects where requirements may be incomplete or evolving. You'll define the approach, sequence the work, anticipate failure modes, and own problems from the first conversation through launch and beyond. This role is for someone who likes working with messy real\-world data, cares about the people using their software, is looking for high levels of ownership, and enjoys turning a complicated problem into something useful. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Build fast, intuitive claims workflows in Air that help billers find, understand, correct, and prioritize work, whether they're working one claim or thousands. * Design and build full\-stack features with React, TypeScript, Python, and PostgreSQL, from user experience and APIs to data models and production operations. * Build and scale the claims generation and submission pipeline, transforming encounter data into valid electronic claims across professional, institutional, and dental formats, as well as paper claims when needed. * Integrate with clearinghouses and handle the varied responses, verification requirements, and errors that come with getting claims to payers. * Improve coverage and payer routing, with guardrails that protect against using the wrong person's coverage information. * Build configurable automations and AI\-assisted workflows that reduce repetitive work. Give billers and administrators the visibility and control to manage agents and correct mistakes. * Use LLMs and agents to streamline customer onboarding and billing setup, helping each customer get configured accurately with as much automation as practical and appropriate human review. * Design and build reliable subsystems with clear interfaces and data models. Improve their maintainability and operational stability over time. * Solve hard reliability and scale problems, including bulk operations, partial failures, idempotency, performance, observability, and auditability. Find root causes and prevent recurring issues. * Work closely with product, design, billing operations, and other engineers to understand real user problems, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and measure improvements in user experience and operational outcomes. * Lead technical discussions and design reviews within the team, and coordinate dependencies with other teams. * Make decisions that account for downstream dependencies, persisted data, and the long\-term health of the system. * Mentor other engineers, including peers and those earlier in their careers. * Raise the bar through thoughtful code reviews, clear documentation, and practical patterns other engineers can use. **What You Have** ----------------- * 5\+ years of professional software development experience building and operating production applications. * Strong full\-stack engineering skills, including experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React and backend development in Python or Go. Our primary stack includes TypeScript, React, Python, and PostgreSQL. * Experience designing and building production subsystems, including their interfaces, reliability, and evolution. * Strong technical judgment in ambiguous situations. You can balance speed, correctness, performance, compliance, and simplicity while considering downstream dependencies and future changes. * A track record of leading complex work from problem definition through delivery and ongoing operation, with measurable improvements to user experience, reliability, or operational outcomes. * Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills, including using monitoring, logging, and alerting to identify root causes and prevent problems from recurring. * Product\-mindedness and empathy for users: you want to understand how people actually work and build software that makes their jobs easier. * Clear communication and collaboration skills. You can explain decisions and tradeoffs, lead team\-level technical discussions, and coordinate with stakeholders across teams. * Experience mentoring other engineers and raising the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and practices others adopt. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building data\-dense operational tools, workflow automation, bulk operations, or high\-volume transaction systems. * Familiarity with healthcare billing, claims, EDI, or clearinghouse integrations, or a demonstrated ability to learn a complex domain quickly. * Experience shipping AI\-assisted features in real workflows, with good judgment about where automation is appropriate and where people need visibility and control. * Experience improving React performance, building interactive analytics, or designing intuitive experiences for non\-technical users. * Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and modern observability tools. * Experience working in a regulated industry with a focus on security and compliance. * A passion for improving healthcare and healthcare operations in America. Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization. Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis. Compensation Range: $180K \- $230K

jobs.title: AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: ConRes helps organizations adopt AI across public cloud, government cloud, and local and air\-gapped data centers. As clients move AI from pilots into production, their security, compliance and audit teams need an independent answer to one question: is this AI system safe to run? The AI Security Engineer provides that answer. You will assess, test and help govern our clients' AI systems, and turn findings into prioritized, defensible remediation they can act on. **Responsibilities** AI Security Assessments * Lead AI security assessments of LLM applications, RAG pipelines and AI agents: architecture review, data flows, identity, tenancy and data separation, logging and model\-provider configuration. * Run threat\-modeling workshops using STRIDE with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, OWASP Agentic AI guidance and MITRE ATLAS. * Map findings to AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act) and to the client's control baseline (NIST SP 800\-53, NIST SP 800\-171 / CMMC, FedRAMP, HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001\) so stakeholders can defend severity and remediation decisions and produce audit\-ready evidence. * Write executive\-ready reports and present results to client security, compliance and leadership teams. Adversarial Testing * Plan and execute AI red\-team exercises: direct and indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, system\-prompt and data leakage, insecure output handling, excessive agency and tool abuse in agents, RAG and vector\-store poisoning. * Validate that guardrails and content filters (native guardrail services in public and government cloud, and self\-hosted guardrail models in air\-gapped environments) actually hold under attack. Local and Air\-gapped AI Deployments * Define and verify security controls for self\-hosted and air\-gapped AI: inference servers (i.e., vLLM, Ollama, NVIDIA NIM), GPU hosts, local vector stores and the networks around them. * Secure the model supply chain without internet access: provenance and hash/signature verification of model weights, scanning for unsafe serialization, and an approved internal model and package registry. * Design and audit controlled data\-transfer processes for moving models, updates, containers and datasets across the air gap. * Harden hosts and containers; ensure logging, monitoring and incident response work without cloud services. * Assess data\-isolation guarantees and document them for accreditors and auditors. AI Governance and Risk * Help clients develop AI acceptable\-use, data\-handling and model/vendor risk standards suited to their regulatory obligations. * Assess the AI vendors and SaaS tools clients are adopting: data residency, retention, training\-data use, SOC 2 / ISO 42001 posture. * Define AI security requirements and acceptance criteria for client solutions, working with the client's teams and ConRes delivery teams. * Help clients detect and manage shadow AI and AI\-related data loss (data classification, DLP and AI threat\-protection tooling). Incident Response and Enablement * Support clients in investigating and responding to AI\-related incidents: data leakage, model abuse, compromised AI identities or keys. * Track emerging AI attack techniques and regulation, and keep client assessments and test cases current. * Deliver AI security training and workshops for client teams, and help shape ConRes's AI security services and thought leadership. The pay range for this position begins at $180,000 up to $200,000 per year. This range reflects the annual salary that Continental Resources reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of posting, consistent with the Massachusetts Pay Transparency Law (M.G.L. c. 149, § 105E). \#ConRes \# of Hires Needed 1 Exemption Type Exempt Hiring Manager Job Requirements **Requirements** * 5\+ years in information security (application security, cloud security, penetration testing or security architecture), including 2\+ years focused on AI/ML or LLM security. * Hands\-on experience testing LLM applications or agents for prompt injection, jailbreaks and data leakage. * Strong, hands\-on experience securing local and air\-gapped AI deployments: self\-hosted open\-weight models, offline model and package supply chains, cross\-domain transfer, and host hardening. * Working knowledge of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS and NIST AI RMF. * Familiarity with compliance frameworks and audit evidence: NIST SP 800\-53, NIST SP 800\-171 / CMMC, FedRAMP, HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 42001\. * Strong understanding of how LLM apps, RAG and agent frameworks (including MCP) are built, enough to find where they break. * Security experience across public cloud, government cloud (FedRAMP / DoD IL environments) and local or air\-gapped data centers: identity, network isolation, key management, logging. * Python scripting for test automation and analysis. * Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable leading client workshops and presenting technical risk to executives and auditors. **Preferred** * Prior consulting or professional\-services experience. * Experience with healthcare (HIPAA/PHI), financial\-services or defense/government compliance, including supporting an ATO or CMMC assessment. * Certifications such as OSCP, GWAPT, CISSP, CCSP, IAPP AIGP, ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditor, CompTIA SecAI\+ or cloud\-provider certifications. * Published AI security research, CVEs, bug\-bounty findings or AI CTF participation.

jobs.title: E11 Bio - Machine Learning Scientist I/II
jobs.description: E11 Bio is on a mission to advance connectomics towards the scale of whole mammalian brains. We are a collaborative and interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers engaged in a neuroscience moonshot project to develop a radical technology platform for scalable brain mapping. E11 Bio is a non\-profit Convergent Research focused research organization located in Alameda, California, pursuing blue\-skies neuroscience research yet operating like a nimble, tight\-knit start\-up. Read our technology roadmap. We are seeking a creative and mission\-driven Machine Learning Scientist to develop scalable automatic proofreading methods leveraging barcode and shape information. In this role, you will own core ML pipelines for automated proofreading of neuron and synaptic reconstructions in optical connectomics datasets, working closely with wet lab scientists, microscopists, and domain experts to ensure biological fidelity and scalability. Your work will directly support E11’s goal of making reliable connectomic data accessible to the broader neuroscience community. In this role you will be focused on decreasing segmentation and proofreading costs for optical connectomics datasets that we are generating at E11, a critical bottleneck in the connectomics field. You will be responsible for improving initial segmentations using large spatial contexts with rich data features, and ingesting resulting datasets into scalable proofreading software for dissemination to the scientific community. ### **Responsibilities** * Contribute to developing innovative ML approaches for automatic proofreading of segmentations in large PB\-scale optical connectomics volumes, leveraging shape and barcode information * Own the deployment of scalable workflows to ingest large connectomic datasets into standard proofreading software (WebKnossos, CAVE) * Collaborate with academic and industry experts on building and extending tools for automated proofreading and interactive visualization * Develop, implement, and evaluate scalable pipelines for synapse detection and partner assignment in large\-scale optical connectomics datasets, integrating morphological and protein labeling information * Identify and build ML\-based image processing tools that remove key bottlenecks in our data processing and analysis pipeline * Maintain excellent laboratory science practices, communicate results through reports and presentations, and contribute to and assist in preparation of manuscripts, abstracts and other scientific documents. ### **Required qualifications** * Ph.D. in computer science, machine learning, applied math, computational biology or a related field in science and/or engineering or Ph.D.\-equivalent publication history * 3\-5 years of relevant work or research experience, with strong history of independent and autonomous execution of novel ML solutions * Strong background in computer vision and applying ML tools to the analysis of large microscopy data sets * Experience with software engineering best practices (e.g. version control, code reviews, etc) * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, record keeping ability, and attention to detail ### **Preferred qualifications** * Experience with graph, sequence, or point based ML methods (GNNs, Transformers, Pointnets, etc.) * Experience with processing large chunked data (e.g Zarr) in the cloud (e.g. AWS or GCP) * Experience with large scale connectomics data and tools (e.g. Neuroglancer, WebKnossos, CAVE, CATMAID, etc.) * Strong record of publications in peer reviewed scientific journals a plus. ### **In the first six months, you will:** * Become familiar with our existing ML and distributed processing code bases * Own the processing (segmentations) of a new dataset end\-to\-end and identify areas for improvement (accuracy and efficiency) * Integrate internal graph\-based methods for automatic proofreading into standard block\-wise workflows for PB\-scale optical connectomics volumes * Optimize ingestion of smaller segmentation graphs into standard proofreading software (e.g WebKnossos, CAVE) for improving efficiency of ground truth generation ### **In 12 months, you will:** * Develop novel innovative ML approaches for automatic proofreading of neuron segmentations, leveraging both shape and barcode information * Contribute to algorithmic development across the segmentation pipelines increasing computational throughput * Contribute to achieving cubic\-mm scale reconstruction at 100x lower proofreading costs * Scale ingestion of PB\-sized optical volumes into proofreading software and pilot proofreading and dissemination of large connectomic subgraphs ### **You would love this job if…** * You are passionate about moonshot neuroscience, and want to broadly accelerate science through long\-term commitment to a high\-impact project with a tight\-knit team * You have a strong desire and intrinsic motivation to work collaboratively and inclusively as part of an interdisciplinary team science effort * You are committed to the ethos of open science, and want to see your work transparently disseminated * You’re mission\-driven, and are seeking an environment where you can take long\-term risks on jobs.title: Process Data Scientist
jobs.description: Requisition Number: 79606 **The company built on breakthroughs.** **Join us.** Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible. How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward. At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at\-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more. Come break through with us. Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry\-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical\-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical\-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use. **Purpose of Position** The Process Data Scientist will serve as an embedded technical partner to process engineering and manufacturing teams, applying traditional statistics, advanced analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to improve process understanding, control, capability, quality, yield, and cost. The role connects rigorous statistical thinking with modern data\-science methods to convert manufacturing and quality data into practical, scalable solutions. The individual will work with data from manufacturing execution systems, measurement and inspection equipment, process\-control systems, sensors, ERP systems, and quality systems. Work will range from designed experiments and statistical process control to predictive modeling, anomaly detection, optimization, computer vision, and responsible use of generative AI. The role requires hands\-on analysis, close collaboration with process experts, and clear communication of methods, assumptions, uncertainty, and business impact. This person will be expected to work independently in ambiguous problem spaces, select methods appropriate to the process and data, and help move successful analytical solutions from exploratory analysis into sustained use across manufacturing sites. **Key Responsibilities** * Partner with process engineering, manufacturing, quality, technology, IT, and data engineering teams to frame business and technical questions as well\-defined analytical problems. * Plan, execute, and analyze designed experiments, statistical process control, measurement system analyses, hypothesis tests, and other statistical methods. * Analyze manufacturing and quality data to identify sources of variation, quantify relationships among inputs and outputs, establish evidence\-based conclusions, and recommend actions. * Develop predictive and prescriptive models using machine learning and statistical techniques for applications such as anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, throughput improvement, process optimization, and defect reduction. * Explore and apply AI capabilities, including computer vision and generative AI, in a manufacturing setting. * Use Python, SQL, and big\-data platforms including Databricks to prepare data, engineer features, build reproducible analyses, and work effectively with large and complex datasets. * Collaborate with data engineering and IT partners to define analysis\-ready datasets, data\-quality checks, contextual data requirements, and scalable analytical workflows. * Create dashboards, reports, visualizations, and technical summaries that communicate process performance, analytical findings, limitations, and recommended actions to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Develop reusable analytical methods, code, templates, and standards that improve consistency across sites and reduce duplicated effort. * Train and coach engineers and other stakeholders in statistical thinking, data interpretation, and appropriate use of advanced analytics and AI. * Deliver value where problems may be loosely defined and data may be incomplete, requiring initiative, sound judgment, scientific rigor, and attention to detail. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field. * 3\+ years of experience in data science, statistics, or a related field, preferably in a manufacturing or industrial setting. * Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using big data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Spark, and Hadoop). * Strong foundation in statistical mod ommunication and leadership skills with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree or Ph.D. in a data\-related field, such as statistics, data science, computer science, or a related discipline. * Experience with manufacturing systems (MES, ERP) and industrial data platforms (e.g., OSI PI). * Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools for model deployment and monitoring. * Experience with JMP and/or Minitab statistical software. * Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma, quality engineering, process improvement, and Manufacturing 4\.0 concepts. * Bilingual or multilingual capability and experience working with global teams. **Soft Skills** * Strong collaborator who can build productive relationships with process experts and cross\-functional partners. * Curious and hypothesis\-driven, with the judgment to distinguish correlation, prediction, and causation. * Self\-motivated and able to define a path forward with limited direction. * Comfortable balancing analytical rigor, speed, practical constraints, and business value. * Able to challenge assumptions constructively and communicate limitations transparently. * Able to train, coach, and influence others in statistical and data\-driven thinking. * Detail\-oriented, with a strong focus on accuracy, reproducibility, documentation, and follow\-through. **Travel Requirements** * Up to 20%, including international travel to support global teams and initiatives. * Normal business hours are expected, with flexibility to collaborate across regions and time zones as needed. **This position does not support immigration sponsorship.** The range for this position is $91,311\.00 \- $125,553\.00 assuming full time status. Starting pay for the successful applicant is dependent on a variety of job\-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education. **A job that shapes a life.** **Corning offers you the total package.** Your well\-being is our priority. Our compensation and benefits package supports your health and wellness, financial aspirations, and career from day one. * Company\-wide bonuses and long\-term incentives align with key business results and ensure you are rewarded when the company performs well. When Corning wins, we all win. * As part of our commitment to your financial well\-being, we provide a 100% company\-paid pension benefit with fixed contributions that grow throughout your career. Combined with matching contributions to your 401(k) savings plan, Corning’s total contributions to your retirement accounts can reach between 7% and 12% of your pay, depending on your age and years of service. * Our health and well\-being benefits include medical, dental, vision, paid parental leave, family building support, fitness, company\-paid life insurance, disability, disease management programs, paid time off, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to support you and your family. * Getting paid for our work is important, but feeling appreciated and recognized for those contributions motivates us much more. That’s why Corning offers a recognition program to celebrate successes and reward colleagues who make exceptional contributions. We prohibit discrimination on the basis of race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected status. Corning is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and considers requests for reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable laws. Individuals with disabilities or sincerely held religious beliefs may request reasonable accommodations to participate in the application or interview process, perform essential job functions, or access other benefits and privileges of employment. To submit a request for reasonable accommodation related to disability or religion, please contact us at accommodations@corning.com.

Monitor air and water quality with field instruments. Collect air and water quality samples for laboratory analysis. Collect accurate field notes and data, clearly communicate both verbally and in writing with supervisors and peers, assist with troubleshooting and repair of electromechanical devices. Monitor gas vapers and/or ground water, and fusing construction pipes. The incumbent in this position will assist Engineers with data research collection and preparation. Competitive candidates will have prior experience within a waste, landfill, or engineering environment as well as data entry and GIS software experience. Candidates who have a background which demonstrates that they are mechanically inclined are highly desired (electric motor operation, variable frequency drivers, pressure sensors, etc.). Ability to keep clear and accurate notes, perform simple drafting and be proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook. jobs.title: Director of Architecture and Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Who is Credible?** Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre\-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score. On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third\-party partners and distribution channels. About the Role Credible is looking for a motivated, experienced Director of Architecture and Infrastructure to join our growing team. This is a remote, player\-coach leadership role reporting to the SVP of Technology. You will directly lead two platform teams of four engineers each, the foundation that every Credible customer\- and partner\-facing application runs on: * Infrastructure Platform (DevOps): infrastructure, AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD processes, and the internally developed applications that support them. This team works primarily in Golang. * Application Platform: the shared services and libraries used across our customer\- and partner\-facing applications, primarily written in Ruby. Examples include authentication, user disclosures, logging, integrations with SaaS products (such as email marketing systems), Kafka tooling, and GraphQL API tooling. You will also partner with other engineering teams during the architecture and design phase of larger projects, and help advance how we approach architecture and design review across the broader engineering organization. Your work will sit closely alongside our Security team. This role is posted at the Director level; an exceptionally qualified candidate may be hired at the Senior Director level. Responsibilities * Lead, mentor, and grow the Infrastructure Platform and Application Platform teams; hire well, set clear expectations, and develop future leaders * Make stability the first priority: drive reliability, resilience, and operational excellence across our infrastructure and shared services * Bring a security mindset to every decision, working in close partnership with our Security Director and team * Support SOC 2 and SOX compliance through well\-designed controls, processes, and tooling * Own the on\-call rotation for the Infrastructure Platform team, ensuring it is sustainable, well\-documented, and continuously improving * Provide architecture and design guidance on larger projects, partnering with other engineering teams in the design phase and leading design reviews * Help evolve our architecture and design review process across the engineering organization * Guide our microservices architecture, including the thoughtful decomposition of remaining larger components * Set technical direction for CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and developer tooling so that engineers across Credible can ship quickly and safely * Stay close to the code: contribute hands\-on where it adds value (coding is welcome, though not required) * Collaborate with Product, Security, Operations, and engineering leaders to align platform priorities with business goals Education and Experience * 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, infrastructure, or platform engineering * 7\+ years of experience managing engineering teams, with strong people management skills * Strong software architecture and design skills, with experience leading architecture and design reviews * Deep experience with AWS and Kubernetes, and with infrastructure as code and deployment tooling such as Terraform, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions, and Helm * Experience building and operating microservices\-based systems, including decomposing larger components * Experience with event\-driven systems (Kafka) and API design (REST and/or GraphQL) * Familiarity with SOC 2 and SOX compliance requirements * A strong security mindset, with experience working closely alongside a security organization * Experience running on\-call rotations and driving reliability improvements * Experience with Go and/or Ruby is preferred; experience with similar languages is welcome * Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field preferred, but not required Technical Taste We are looking for someone who does more than "get something working." You have strong aesthetic leanings about how systems should be built, and you can explain why. For us, that means: * Results\-oriented simplicity: you don't overcomplicate things and keep solutions simple wherever possible * Intelligent abstractions: you know when an abstraction earns its keep, and when it doesn't * Systems thinking: you build once and create leverage far into the future * Strong API design: you care deeply about the interfaces that teams and services build on **Why work at Credible?** We combine the intelligence, expertise, and confidence of a financial advisor with the approachability and honesty of a friend. In other words, we're the friend you always wish you had in finance. We are optimistic, challengers, trustworthy, clever, and smart. We are open and transparent. We strive to act as advisors by being friendly, objective, and open in our communication. We use language that is intelligent yet approachable. When appropriate, we'll drop in a bit of wit to position ourselves as a fresh, reliable voice in the financial world. We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

identity, behavioral events, and profile attributes support segmentation and personalization. * Experience delivering web\-based experiences within Windows or macOS desktop applications. **Additional You’ll also receive exclusive employee discounts—and best of all, you’ll be surrounded by some of the most talented, creative, and curious minds out there. A Quick Note Before You Apply… Cricut is in an exciting chapter of transformation. We’re evolving fast—refining our strategy, growing our teams, and raising the bar across everything we do. This is an incredible opportunity for the right kind of person—but it’s not for everyone. We’re looking for A\-players—people who thrive in dynamic environments, turn challenges into momentum, and consistently deliver their best work. If that sounds like you, read on. **Here’s what makes someone a great fit for this role (and for this moment at Cricut):** * You move with urgency. You don’t wait for perfect clarity to act—you start, learn, and adjust. * You set high standards. You take ownership, deliver quality, and hold yourself accountable. * You stay focused when things move fast. You prioritize what matters most and tune out the noise. * You collaborate like a pro. From idea exploration to data analysis and creative problem\-solving, you leverage AI to accelerate innovation and amplify impact—because technology and creativity go hand\-in\-hand here. **One More Thing (It’s a Big One)** This role is in\-office at least 4\-5 days per week. We believe real collaboration, innovation, and culture are built face\-to\-face. If you’re looking for a fully remote role, this may not be the right fit. But if you’re excited by challenge, purpose, and building something better—let’s make something amazing together. **Relocation Statement:** * **This position is not eligible for relocation assistance.** What to Do Next: Please attach your resume, cover letter and/or include links to your portfolio or other social presence.
