jobs.title: Software Developer III
jobs.description: Overview: **Who We Are:** Crowley is a privately held, U.S.\-owned and operated company serving the maritime, logistics and energy industries with scale in 36 nations and island territories. Our Purpose is to bravely advance what’s possible to elevate people and planet, guided by our values of Integrity, Sustainability and Drive. With more than $3 billion in annual revenue, our solutions provide integrated supply chains with a commitment to safety and reliability in our ocean and land transportation services and facilities. We set high standards, operate with discipline, and continuously improve how we work. Performance, operational excellence and innovation drive how we compete, grow and deliver to our customers and partners. **Work Arrangement:** Hybrid **What You'll Do:** Responsible for utilizing established procedures, guidelines, and industry knowledge and experience to identify and implement moderately complex to complex solutions to meet information technology (IT) systems needs and requirements through designing, coding, testing and analyzing new and existing software, under general to minimal direction. Responsibilities: **Key Responsibilities:** * Design, build and maintain full stack web applications with Angular or React on the front end and ASP.NET Core on the back end. * Architect scalable, secure and observable systems using clean architecture, domain\-driven design and SOLID principles. * Build and document REST APIs (OpenAPI), and where needed gRPC or GraphQL endpoints and event\-driven integrations. * Implement authentication and authorization with Okta (OIDC, OAuth 2\.0, SAML), including SSO and role\- or policy\-based access. * Deploy and operate services on AWS using containers or serverless, with infrastructure as code and automated CI/CD pipelines. * Write automated unit, integration and end\-to\-end tests, and keep quality gates in the pipeline. * Lead code reviews and code and configuration audits for accuracy, performance and security. * Monitor production with logging, metrics and tracing; troubleshoot incidents and drive root\-cause fixes. * Use AI coding assistants responsibly to speed delivery and help set team standards for their safe use. * Perform need, trend, feasibility and performance assessments so business requirements are met, risks are reduced and value is maximized. * Create technical documentation, architecture decision records and user guides. * Plan and estimate SDLC phases for medium\-scale projects or major components of larger ones. * Partner with product, design, QA, security and business teams to resolve software and system issues. * Coach and mentor less experienced developers. Qualifications: **Experience:** 8 \- 10 years of software/application development experience. **Education \& Credentials:** Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field; or equivalent combination of post\-high school education and experience equal to nine (12\) years. **Technical Skills:*** Back end: C\# 12\+, .NET 8 and .NET 10 (LTS), ASP.NET Core Web API and Minimal APIs, Entity Framework Core, dependency injection, async programming, background services. * Front end: Angular 18\+ (standalone components, signals, RxJS, NgRx) or React 18/19 (hooks, Server Components, Redux Toolkit or TanStack Query, Next.js); TypeScript 5\.x, JavaScript (ES2023\+), HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, responsive and accessible (WCAG 2\.2\) UI. * APIs and integration: RESTful API design, OpenAPI/Swagger, API versioning, microservices, messaging with Amazon SQS/SNS or EventBridge. * Identity and security: SSO with Okta (OIDC, OAuth 2\.0, SAML), JWT, OWASP Top 10, secrets management with AWS Secrets Manager. * Data: SQL Server (T\-SQL, query tuning, indexing) or another relational database; NoSQL such as Amazon DynamoDB or MongoDB; caching with Redis. * AWS cloudseeds/Fargate or EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS/Aurora, S3, CloudWatch, IAM. * DevOps: GitHub (branching, pull requests), CI/CD with GitHub Actions or AWS CodePipeline, Docker, infrastructure as code with AWS CDK, CloudFormation or Terraform. * Testing: Unit or NUnit, Moq or NSubstitute, Jest or Vitest, Playwright or Cypress, test\-driven development. * Architecture: Design patterns, SOLID, clean architecture, CQRS, domain\-driven design. * Ways of working: Agile/Scrum, Jira or similar; Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel). * AI\-assisted development with tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, including prompt practices and review of generated code. * Building AI features into applications with Amazon Bedrock or other LLM APIs: retrieval\-augmented generation, Semantic Kernel or Microsoft.Extensions.AI. NET Aspire for local orchestration and service defaults in cloud\-native .NET apps. * Observability with Open Telemetry, AWS X\-Ray, Datadog or a similar platform. * Real\-time features with SignalR or WebSockets. * Micro\-frontends (Module Federation) and design systems such as Angular Material, Tailwind CSS or a shared component library. * Performance work: Core Web Vitals, server\-side rendering and hydration, profiling with BenchmarkDotNet. * Security tooling in the pipeline: SAST, dependency scanning (Dependabot, Snyk), container image scanning. * AWS certification, such as AWS Certified Developer – Associate or Solutions Architect – Associate. **Competencies:** Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing, including the ability to convey technical information to technical and non\-technical users. jobs.title: Data Engineer, OCR and Table Extraction (Contingent)
jobs.description: **Location:** Gaithersburg, MD (on site at a federal research campus) · **Pay:** $120,000–$155,000 per year · **Type:** Full\-time, contingent on award **About the role** CyberStorm Defense is a Maryland small business building research software for a federal science agency. tracing, logging\-e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, SolarWinds, Splunk); environment integrity and drift prevention across pre\-production and production; and segregation\-of\-duties controls (least\-privilege/RBAC, deploy approvals, secrets management) in partnership with security and risk. * 3\+ years jobs.title: COBOL Developer (All Levels & Internal Paths Available)
jobs.description: **The Opportunity** Dillard's is seeking passionate technical talent to join our Application Development team on\-site at our corporate headquarters in Little Rock, Arkansas. Our COBOL infrastructure powers the financial systems behind almost 300 stores nationwide. We don't just maintain the past; we build the efficient, high\-scale foundation for Dillard's future. **Pathways \& Timelines** * **The Experienced Mainframe Expert** : Bring your deep knowledge of enterprise systems to optimize, modernize, and architect high\-volume data streams. jobs.title: Principal Visual Designer, Merchant
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ At DoorDash, design means making experiences for the people who order, the people who prepare, and the people who deliver. As a Designer at DoorDash, you want to build things that matter to real people. You're at your best when you can move from idea to shipped product quickly, bringing experiences to life that reach and influence users at massive scale. You'll care about whether the product you make solved a real problem for real people, or changed how someone experiences their day. You'll work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with Engineering and Product Management, dig into the data, and use LLM\-powered tools alongside traditional design tools. If the LLM powered tools don't exist yet, you build them. **About the Role** ------------------ Restaurants are the heart of every neighborhood, yet most run on a patchwork of disconnected tools. We're building DashOS, the operating system for the restaurant of the future. It's one platform that connects delivery, in\-store dining, reservations, and loyalty, across software, kiosk and POS hardware, and agentic experiences that take work off operators' plates. As Principal Visual Designer, you'll set the look, feel, and identity of DoorDash's merchant products. You'll own the visual direction for DashOS and give merchants a recognizable identity across every surface, including hardware, where no design conventions exist yet. These products already work. Your job is to make merchants love using them. Visual craft is the center of this role, and you'll ship it yourself. You'll prototype and use AI tools like Cursor and Claude to generate and refine UI, so your ideas reach production with full fidelity. You'll also define the visual foundation of the design system (tokens, components, guidance, and examples) so designers, engineers, and AI tools all produce on\-brand, high\-quality UI. Engineering partners build and maintain the tooling, and you set the rules and the quality bar. You'll report to the Senior Director, Product Design for Merchant. This role is hybrid, with 1–2 days a week in a Design Hub. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will…** ----------------------------------------------------------- * **Set the visual direction for merchant products across DashOS** and bring multiple teams around a shared vision, so the work compounds instead of duplicating. * **Ship high\-craft interfaces with a clear point of view**, turning complex, data\-dense workflows into screens merchants can read at a glance in a busy kitchen or at the counter. * **Own the visual foundation of the design system**: define the tokens, components, usage rules and examples that both people and AI tools apply. Review generated UI against that bar, record what good looks like, and improve the system based on how teams actually use it. * Design for new surfaces. Create visual systems for points\-of\-sale, handhelds and agentic experiences where no existing paradigm applies. * **Influence through the work.** Earn trust with prototypes and shipped products instead of decks, and keep your prototypes production\-ready. * **Raise the bar across the team.** Mentor senior designers, help close strong hires, and help people sharpen their sense of what to build and why. **We're excited about you because…** ------------------------------------ * You've designed interfaces that defined or reshaped a product's look and feel, and your portfolio shows top\-of\-bar visual craft with range across brands and styles. * You can build what you design. You work in React, TypeScript or similar, and use AI tools to explore directions and refine UI faster than you could by hand. * You've set direction across a product area, and people adopted your work because it was good, not because you told them to. * You'd rather build a visual system that makes 20 designers faster and more consistent than ship one great screen yourself. * You've worked on complex, information\-dense products such as point\-of\-sale, fintech, marketplaces or platform teams, and you've shipped with product and engineering partners, including pushing back constructively. * Bonus: you've designed for devices or contexts with no existing design paradigm and built the visual system from scratch. **About DoorDash** ------------------ At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------------------------- We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Statement of Non\-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on "protected categories," we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non\-binary or gender non\-conforming, LGBTQIA\+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently\-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation. **If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.** **Notice Regarding Use of AI and Automated Tools:** To streamline our hiring process, DoorDash utilizes an automated recruitment tool called Metaview. **How it works:** Metaview assists our recruiting team by evaluating job related qualifications and characteristics in connection with hiring. In this role, you will define, establish, and operationalize R\&D wide data governance, policies, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) from a systems perspective. Reporting into the R\&D organization and closely partnering with Enterprise Data Office (EDO), Operations, and IT, you will drive foundational data readiness across key R\&D scientific platforms—including **ARCHI**, **Benchling** (ELN / Registry / Inventory), **Revvity** (Signals / Informatics), and **Clinical Systems** (EDC, CTMS, eCOA/ePRO). You will ensure that research, discovery, and clinical trial data are structured, lineage\-tracked, and AI\-ready to accelerate pipeline breakthroughs and regulatory submissions. **This includes four strategic priorities:** * **R\&D Governance \& Systems Policy:** Support the interoperability of Data across R\&D and Enterprise\-wide ecosystems. * **Attribute\-Level Data Architecture:** Determine and advise on critical R\&D data attributes, controlled vocabularies, schemas, and master data entities required to ensure cross\-system interoperability. * **Pipeline Acceleration \& AI Readiness:** Excellence:** Establish automated data quality frameworks, lineage monitoring, and compliance controls (FAIR principles, GxP, ALCOA\+) across interconnected scientific systems. **Your Responsibilities:** * **R\&D Data Governance \& Policy Formulation:** Author, establish, and govern enterprise\-wide data policies, standards, data classification, and operating procedures across R\&D software platforms, ensuring seamless alignment between scientific workflows and enterprise IT architecture. * **Attribute\-Level Control \& Metadata Management:** Evaluate data models across scientific applications to define what must be controlled at the enterprise level (e.g., compound IDs, study attributes, subject identifiers, assay parameters) versus local system configurations; establish standardized ontologies and controlled vocabularies. * **R\&D Systems Integration \& Data Strategy:** Serve as the lead data science advisor for core discovery and development platforms: + **ARCHI:** Standardize enterprise architecture definitions, repository schemas, and data pipelines. + **Benchling:** Oversee data schema design, entity registration, inventory tracking, and API\-based data extraction for downstream analytics. + **Revvity :** Guide assay data capture, screening data harmonization, and analytical workflow standardization. + **Clinical Systems:** Ensure clinical trial data attributes (EDC, CTMS, CDISC/SDTM models) adhere to enterprise standards for traceability and submission readiness. * **End\-to\-End Data Science \& Modeling:** Design, build, and deploy machine learning and statistical models that leverage harmonized data assets from Benchling, Revvity, and Clinical platforms to solve complex R\&D challenges (e.g., predictive screening, clinical outcome modeling). * **Data Quality Frameworks \& Automated Monitoring:** Implement automated data validation, anomaly detection, and data completeness metrics at ingestion points across enterprise endpoints. * **Cross\-Functional Influence \& Stakeholder Management:** Partner with senior stakeholders across Discovery, Translational Medicine, Clinical Operations, Regulatory, Quality Assurance, and IT to drive adoption of data governance practices without impeding scientific velocity. * **Collaborate on Infrastructure \& Deployment:** Work alongside Data Engineers, ML Engineers, and Cloud Solution Architects (Azure / GCP) to design scalable data pipelines, data mesh/lakehouse architectures, and secure data ac ecifically: + Electronic Lab Notebooks \& Registries (e.g., Benchling). + Scientific Informatics \& Chemistry/Biology platforms (e.g., Revvity Signals, PerkinElmer informatics). + Architecture \& Enterprise modeling tools (e.g., ARCHI / ArchiMate). + Clinical data platforms (EDC, CTMS, CDISC standards). * **Programming \& Querying Proficiency:** Strong programming skills in Python or R, along with advanced SQL capabilities for relational, document, and graph database querying. * **Data Science \& ML Capabilities:** Demonstrated experience developing and applying statistical and machine learning models (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, NLP for scientific text, predictive modeling). * **Communication \& Data Storytelling:** Exceptional ability to synthesize complex data architecture and analytical concepts into actionable recommendations for scientific, operational, and executive stakeholders. **What Will Give You the Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications):** * **Life Science Ontologies \& Metadata Standards:** Deep familiarity with biomedical ontologies (e.g., MeSH, SNOMED, ChEMBL, CDISC/SDTM/ADaM) and FAIR data implementation frameworks. * **API \& Pipeline Engineering:** Experience with REST APIs, ETL/ELT pipelines, and integration of scientific SaaS platforms into enterprise data lakes/lakehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks). * **Cloud Analytics Platforms:** Familiarity with data and analytics services across Microsoft Azure (e.g., Azure Synapse, Purview, Data Factory) and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * **Regulatory \& Quality Knowledge:** Working knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, data privacy requirements, and computerized system validation (CSV) in life science environments. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: ##### ***Electrosoft Services, LLC is an award\-winning company that provides comprehensive technology\-based solutions and services to federal customers. While cybersecurity is our specialty, we also focus on ICAM, Zero Trust, digital engineering and transformation, and enterprise AI and intelligent automation. We always seek to delight our customers, so we retain highly qualified employees and offer them meaningful work, growth opportunities, and work\-life balance. What sets us apart from all other contractors is the sense of*** ***teamwork*** ***our employees feel – and the knowledge that outstanding effort is recognized and rewarded. The camaraderie we share emanates from Lunch \& Learn sessions where we explore new ideas together, fun group activities ranging from escape rooms to miniature golf, and much, much more. If we’ve described you and your dream workplace, please apply and share in the many benefits and opportunities we offer.*** **Data Engineer – Scientific Document and Data Pipelines** Responsible for designing, developing, and implementing automated scientific data extraction and standardization solutions supporting the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) CHIPS METIS initiative. Develops advanced Python\-based pipelines to extract figures, charts, and tables from scientific documents and transform non\-standard research data into structured, machine\-readable formats. Implements Optical Character Recognition (OCR), document layout analysis, data normalization, and schema validation capabilities. Integrates data processing tools and microservices into existing web applications and research data repositories. Works closely with government scientists and technical stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, accessibility, and interoperability. Develops technical documentation, maintains source code repositories, and supports the delivery of reliable, reusable software solutions. **Responsibilities / Tasks** * Design and implement automated OCR and document layout analysis pipelines to extract scientific figures, charts, and tables from PDF and Microsoft Word documents. * Develop algorithms to identify and extract figure captions, axis labels, measurement units, and associated scientific metadata. * Implement table extraction capabilities that preserve row and column structures, headers, and data relationships. * Integrate extracted metadata with established controlled vocabularies and ontologies within the Controlled Vocabulary Curation System (CVCS). * Develop and enhance user interfaces that enable scientific domain experts to validate extracted content and correct OCR errors. * Develop Python\-based parser libraries to convert proprietary instrument outputs, legacy spreadsheets, and non\-standard text files into standardized CSV formats. * Implement automated data normalization, schema validation, and quality assurance procedures to ensure compliance with METIS data schemas. * Develop heuristic data\-cleaning capabilities to address missing values, merged cells, inconsistent headers, and extraneous metadata. * Integrate extraction and standardization tools as microservices or software modules within the existing CVCS web application architecture. * Develop data export capabilities to support integration with the METIS Discovery Portal. * Prepare design documentation, implementation guides, API specifications, and deployment procedures. * Develop, test, and maintain documented source code within GitHub repositories, including code intended for public release. * Prepare and deliver technical demonstrations of extraction workflows, data conversion capabilities, and system enhancements. * Monitor and report technical performance metrics, including document processing volumes, OCR accuracy, data conversion success rates, and system integration status. * Collaborate with government scientists, developers, and technical stakeholders to identify requirements, troubleshoot technical issues, and improve system functionality. **Required Skills:** * Bachelor's degree (four\-year) in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field. * Four (4\) years of advanced Python programming experience, specifically with Pandas and OCR libraries. * Four (4\) years of experience with OCR pipelines and table extraction logic. * Four (4\) years of experience with data format normalization and schema validation. * Four (4\) years of experience integrating microservices into web applications. * Experience developing and maintaining automated data processing and transformation pipelines. * Knowledge of OCR and document processing technologies such as Tesseract, PaddleOCR, pdfplumber, Camelot, LayoutParser, or comparable tools. * Familiarity with JSON Schema, XML/XSD, controlled vocabularies, and ontology\-based metadata tagging. * Experience with REST APIs, GitHub, and software development and deployment practices. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, technical documentation, and communication skills. * Must be able to successfully complete a federal background investigation appropriate for an IT\-Low Risk position and meet applicable HSPD\-12/PIV credentialing requirements. * Must be able to work on\-site at the NIST campus in Gaithersburg, Maryland. * This position is contingent upon contract award. #### ***Electrosoft is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled***

jobs.title: Machine Learning (ML) Engineer - Applied
jobs.description: **ModelCat \| Remote from Europe** **About ModelCat** ------------------ ModelCat is transforming how companies develop AI models for embedded, edge, and IoT devices. Our innovative platform uses AI to build AI — turning model architecture selection, training, optimization, and validation into a single powerful step. ModelCat takes what was previously a 12–24 month process requiring highly skilled AI professionals and reduces it to a 24–48 hour AI\-powered job that can be run by developers, data scientists, and product owners. Trusted by industry leaders like NXP and Silicon Labs, ModelCat is a venture\-backed startup headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. **The Role** ------------ We're seeking a motivated ML Engineer to help advance our AutoML platform. You'll play a key role in expanding its capabilities, onboarding new ML use\-cases across vision, time\-series, and beyond, and improving the product as we scale. This role offers meaningful growth potential toward a technical leadership track. **What You'll Do** ------------------ ### **AutoML Platform Development** * Contribute to the development and enhancement of our AutoML system for Edge AI, including pipelines that combine deep\-learning and conventional algorithms for embedded devices. This includes object tracking, multi\-model pipelines, and emerging use\-cases. * Build and improve platform features across compute clusters and our web application. * Define abstractions and contribute to the architecture of cloud, cluster, and embedded components. ### **ML Use\-Case Expansion** * Integrate new ML use\-cases across a broad range of data domains and maintain and improve existing ones. * This includes time\-series and audio, object re\-identification, segmentation and keypoints. * Includes action recognition (video), radar and point cloud data, and multi\-modal systems (vision \+ audio \+ sensor). * Also includes small language models (NLP/SLM), classification, and object detection. * Work with foundational computer vision and non\-CV ML models — train, evaluate, modify, and combine them to unlock new functionality. ### **Edge AI Optimization \& Deployment** * Optimize AI solutions for edge devices using TinyML frameworks, creating models that fit a range of chip sizes and memory constraints. * Deploy ML and non\-ML algorithms on embedded targets (MCU and application\-class microprocessors). * Productize research\-quality code into robust, production\-ready systems. ### **Collaboration \& Craft** * Partner on data strategies, preprocessing pipelines, and model training workflows. * Stay current with Edge AI and AutoML advancements. * Document your work and contribute to technical reports. **Who You Are** --------------- ### **Required** * Master's degree in CS, EE, or a related field (PhD a plus). * 4\+ years of relevant industry experience in ML (AutoML and Edge AI experience highly valued). * Strong Python skills with the ability to write production\-quality code; C/C\+\+ a plus. * Solid command of ML frameworks: TensorFlow, PyTorch, ONNX. * Proficient with the standard DS toolset: scikit\-learn, OpenCV, pandas. * Comfortable working in Linux\-based development environments. * Experience onboarding new ML use\-cases and expanding into new data domains. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and strong written and verbal English communication. ### **Preferred** * Experience with cloud platforms (AWS) and web technologies (Node.js, REST APIs). * Familiarity with compute cluster tools such as Ray and Optuna. * Knowledge of model compression techniques: pruning, quantization, transfer learning, knowledge distillation. * Experience defining software architecture for ML systems. * Familiarity with CI/CD practices. * Understanding of embedded systems concepts. * Experience with non\-ML algorithms and signal processing. **Mindset** ----------- * Proactive, entrepreneurial approach — you thrive with ownership and ambiguity. * Startup mentality: you move fast, learn faster, and care deeply about the outcome. **Why Join ModelCat** --------------------- **Market Opportunity** — Edge AI is exploding, and we're solving a critical pain point in a massive and growing market. **Real Customer Impact** — Our platform compresses 12–24 months of model development into 24–48 hours — validated by customers like NXP and Silicon Labs. **Technical Depth** — Work on hard, meaningful problems at the intersection of AutoML, TinyML, and embedded systems. **Growth Trajectory** — Join during a pivotal growth phase with significant room to grow into technical leadership. **Competitive Compensation** — Base salary, performance\-based bonus, and meaningful equity stake. ‍ *ModelCat is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.*

jobs.description: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. **Introduction to the Team** Within CTO Enablement, the AI Enablement and Culture Office is helping Expedia Group become AI\-native by turning AI experimentation into measurable business impact: creating capacity, improving speed and quality, and building AI fluency across the enterprise. As a Principal AI Learning Engineer, you are an engineer by background and a learning designer by craft. You build the programs, prototypes and proof that turn emerging AI capabilities into everyday practice, primarily for developers who write and ship code, and also for builders across Expedia Group who create with AI agents and tools. Engineers trust you because you build alongside them, and they change how they work because your learning lives inside their tools and workflows. **In this role, you will:** * Define the technical learning architecture for AI\-native engineering at Expedia Group: role\- and level\-based pathways for developers (software, machine learning and data engineering) and for builders (product, program, design and business roles), mapped to role expectations. * Build hands\-on learning that lives inside the work: reference implementations, starter repositories, guided labs, agent and workflow templates, and sandboxes in the tools engineers already use. Prototype tools when they unblock learning, then hand them to owning teams. * Convert proven patterns from business\-unit engagements into reusable, teachable engineering standards, covering prompting, evaluation, AI\-assisted code review, agentic delegation and responsible AI guardrails. * Define success measures before launch and connect skill and behavior change to usage and delivery data, reporting impact on capacity, speed and quality without overstating cause and effect. * Develop senior and principal engineers across multiple organizations into multipliers of AI\-native practice, mentoring them on design and technical judgment as well as teaching, and scale through champion, lab\-leader and train\-the\-trainer models. * Partner with Developer Experience, Learning and Development, AI platform and business\-unit technology leaders to align learning investment with platform roadmaps and business priorities, influencing across multiple organizations without formal authority. Safely integrate and operate AI/ML\-enabled solutions that improve outcomes, evaluating emerging capabilities pragmatically and deciding what becomes standard practice, what stays an experiment, and what gets retired. * **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience. * 10\+ years of relevant professional experience. * Deep hands\-on software engineering across the full development life cycle, including coding standards, code review, testing and observability, with a record of building reference solutions other teams adopt. * Proficiency in system design, API development and data modeling, with a working command of the large\-scale distributed environments where reference patterns must run. * Hands\-on experience building, deploying or operating AI\-enabled systems, tools, agents or workflows, and applying AI/ML concepts to real\-world products or engineering work. * Experience teaching engineers at scale through curricula, workshops, labs, documentation or developer education that measurably changed how teams build. Experience setting engineering standards or practices that were adopted across multiple teams or organizations. * **Preferred Qualifications** **:** * Background in developer relations, developer education, developer experience or AI enablement engineering, where building and teaching are the same job. * Working command of learning science applied to technical audiences, including adult learning, deliberate practice, curriculum architecture and assessment design. * Experience designing and productionizing LLM, agentic or AI\-assisted developer workflows, including evaluation, human\-in\-the\-loop controls and responsible AI guardrails. * Experience measuring whether AI skills and behaviors actually improved, and connecting that to engineering productivity or business outcomes. * A track record of turning skeptical senior engineers into adopters and partners, and scaling hands\-on learning across global teams through champions or train\-the\-trainer models. * Experience enabling both developers and non\-engineering builders from one common, tool\-agnostic framework adapted to each role's real work. * Public evidence of building and teaching, such as talks, courses, open\-source examples or technical writing. jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **THE POSITION** Our roster has an opening with your name on it We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our Casino Analytics team to support the Product organization. You will support the Casino business driving scalable analytics products (data assets, dashboards, visualizations, tools/services) and analytic frameworks. You will work alongside a group of analysts to facilitate the team's success, evolving the various tools, models, and data visualizations used to drive the FanDuel Group business. This is a tremendous opportunity to collaborate cross\-functionally as well as develop the analytics team's data infrastructure and visualization capabilities. **THE GAME PLAN** Everyone on our team has a part to play * Create interactive Tableau dashboards, custom visualizations and reports to visualize customer behavior, drivers of business performance, and support strategic decision making * Prioritize best practices in design, usability, and scalability to ensure sustainable and quality reporting * Communicate technical findings/insights to non\-technical stakeholders to drive strategic success * Drive the team's analysis roadmap, ensuring we prioritize high\-value projects with actionable insights * Become a key business partner to the analytics team and stakeholders across the Casino business, supporting them in driving insights and key decision making * Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to ensure that data is accurately represented and enable richer analysis * Stay up\-to\-date with the latest trends and technologies in data visualization, and evaluate new tools and techniques to improve our capabilities **THE STATS** What we're looking for in our next teammate * 1\-2\+ years' experience in an analytics/technical role preferred * Bachelor's Degree in a highly numerate major (Math, Stats, Econ, etc.) or relevant experience in data and/or business analysis preferred * Strong personal organizational and time management skills * Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with a lot of ambiguity * Proficiency in SQL and Excel required; jobs.title: Data Science Engineer III
jobs.description: * Engineering * Miami * Full\-time ### **Description** Fetcherr builds responsible AI that transforms market complexity into measurable profit growth. At the core of the company is the Market Model \- a proprietary AI\-powered model delivering accurate, granular demand predictions with 96% forecast accuracy and real\-time decision intelligence for commercial teams. Built on a glass\-box architecture, it uses market data \- not personal data \- with full transparency into logic and outcomes. First deployed in global aviation, the technology is industry\-agnostic and scales across volatile markets. Fetcherr delivers a consistent average profit uplift of 7%, with corporate partners including Delta, Virgin Atlantic, WestJet, Viva, and Azul. While Fetcherr initially focused on the airline industry, the company is now expanding into additional verticals, bringing its dynamic AI\-driven optimization capabilities to new industries such as travel, mobility, retail, e\-commerce, and beyond. **About the Role** This is not a pure research role but one that is actively involved in building our product. You will be joining a team of Data Science Engineers and you will be directly contributing to code. You will own well\- scoped modeling problems end to end, from exploring market data and designing features to validating models and getting them running in production, so that our pricing, inventory, and network optimization engines make better decisions in real time. This is a high\-impact individual contributor role at the intersection of applied AI and production software, working directly with other data scientists, ML and data engineers, and product teams. **What you will do:** * Develop, validate, and iterate on demand forecasting, pricing, and optimization models using large\-scale, high\-velocity market data. * Explore and analyze data from diverse internal and external sources to uncover signals, define features, and identify opportunities to improve model accuracy and business impact. * Design and run offline experiments, backtests, and online evaluations to measure model performance and profit uplift. * Write production\-grade Python code and work with ML and data engineers to productionize models, ensuring they are reliable, observable, and cost\-efficient. * Monitor deployed models for drift, accuracy, and data quality issues, and troubleshoot and fix problems quickly. * Keep our glass\-box principles front and center: build models whose logic and outcomes can be explained to commercial teams and customers. * Partner with product and commercial stakeholders to translate business problems into clear modeling approaches and communicate results. * Contribute to the technical direction of the modeling stack as Fetcherr scales across new customers, verticals, and product lines. ### **Requirements** * 5\+ years of full\-time experience as a Data Scientist, Applied Scientist, ML Engineer, or similar role building models that run in production. Lab, proof of concept, prototype, academic, and part\-time experience does not count toward this requirement. * Strong programming skills in Python, with production\-grade coding practices (testing, code review, version control). * Solid foundation in statistics, machine learning, and time\-series forecasting, with sound judgment on model validation and experiment design. * Strong SQL skills and experience working with large relational and non\-relational datasets. * Experience and comfort with AI\-assisted software development, along with the ability to write and reason about code yourself. * Experience with cloud platforms (GCP and BigQuery preferred) and modern data warehouse and lakehouse technologies. * Familiarity with orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster) and CI/CD practices for ML and data pipelines. * Strong analytical mindset and a pragmatic, get\-it\-done approach. * Excellent collaboration and communication skills, comfortable working cross\-functionally with engineering and product teams. **Nice to Have** * Experience with dynamic pricing, revenue management, or optimization problems. * Experience in travel, e\-commerce, logistics, or other real\-time decisioning domains. * Exposure to MLOps practices such as model registries, monitoring, and automated retraining. * Experience with real\-time OLAP engines such as ClickHouse. * Experience in a Software\-as\-a\-Service environment.

jobs.title: Test Engineer - 1st Shift (AOI, AXI, SPI, EOL systems / SMT)
jobs.description: Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market\-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary. **Job Summary** --------------- \&\#xa;\&\#xa; **Test Engineer \- 1st Shift (AOI, AXI, SPI, EOL systems / SMT)** **New full\-time position in Walker, MI** **Principle Accountabilities:** * Directs and/or coordinates electronic engineering and/or technical personnel in fabrication and design of testing and test control apparatus and equipment, or software and systems testing. * Directs and coordinates electronic engineering activities concerned with development, procurement, installation and calibration of instruments, equipment and control devices required to test, and record test data. * Interfaces and confers with scientific, engineering and technical personnel to resolve testing problems such as product or system malfunctions, incomplete test data, data interpretation or coding issues. * Analyzes and interprets test data and prepares technical reports for use by electronic or software engineering, and management personnel. * May develops or use computer software and hardware to conduct tests on electronic products and systems or software. * Trains and instructs floor support, test technicians and test operators on test hardware and/or software, as well as problem solving techniques. * Resolves test yield problems by performing analysis of root causes, developing and coordinating corrective action measures and monitoring improvements. * Perform and support equipment verification and integration in production. * Create and maintain process documentation. * Actively search for new technologies or procedures in the test sector. * Determines conditions under which tests are to be conducted and sequences and phases of test operations. **Specialized Job Responsibilities may be required for certain positions. These could include one or more of the following duties:** **IN\-CIRCUIT** * Develops and/or supports quality comprehensive test programs. * Develops or modifies test models. * Performs written analysis of fault grade. * Develops quotes for test development and enhancements. * Performs test ability analysis (DFT). * Performs mechanical analysis of test fixtures. Coordinates 3rd part development of in\-circuit programs, enhancements, and test fixtures. * **FUNCTIONAL** * Develops and/or modifies test programs using various languages (i.e. Python, Lab View, Perl etc.). * Develops instrument drivers. * Develops and/or supports diagnostic tests at the card edge level. * Designs and supports functional test hardware, computer platforms and interfaces. * Develops test plans and procedures. * Coordinates 3rd party development of functional test development,enhancements, test fixtures. Develops quotations for functional test hardware and software. * **ENVIRONMENTAL STRESS SCREENING (ESS)** * Designs, develops and/or supports environmental test programs, procedures and profiles * Designs and/or supports mechanical/electrical interfaces for product tests. * Performs failure analysis on environmental test failures. Coordinates 3rd party development of ESS activities. * **SYSTEMS \& Software** * Analyzes and interprets software or system level diagnostic failure (software and hardware). * Develops and/or modifies software or system level plans and tests. * Develops and/or supports quality comprehensive test programs. * Develops quotes for test development and enhancements. Performs test ability analysis (DFT). * **Education / Experience** Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in related field or equivalent experience and training. Typically requires 4 years of experience in test engineering in the high technology electronics industry or related area. **Knowledge / Skills / Abilities** Demonstrates operations and technical skills and understanding of Flex’s functional standards. Demonstrates working knowledge of functional concepts and a solid understanding of Flex policies and procedures. Typically requires some knowledge of computerized electronic test equipment and programming. Demonstrates advanced functional and technical skills and basic process skills. Demonstrates advanced/thorough knowledge of the function and Flex business. Typically requires skill and troubleshooting, and diagnostics, and overview of the entire test process and the ability to train others. Use of the following tools may be required: Electronic Assembly: color code, component, schematics. May require various PCB operations. Testing: oscilloscope, cable and harness testing, trouble shooting, component testing, logic analyzer. Inspection: bare board, systems, components, cable and harness, microscope, measuring t and dies, alignment tools, measuring tools. Software Testing: design software, coding programs, and simulation models. Office skills: telephones, office software to include, word processing, spreadsheet and presentation package. Ability to read, analyze and interpret common scientific and technical journals. Ability to write reports, business correspondence and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively communicate with managers and employees of the organizations. Ability to apply advanced mathematical concepts such as exponents, logarithms, quadratic equations and permutations. Ability to apply mathematical operations to such tasks as frequency distribution, determination of test reliability and validity, analysis of variance, correlation techniques, sampling theory and factor analysis. Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form, and deal with several abstract and concrete variables. **Scope / Impact** Impacts the near\-term (quarterly/semi\-annual) operational success of the function. Enhances and provides input to functional processes or technologies. Assists in achieving section/sub\-function objectives for a functional area. Demonstrates capability in leading a major initiative that may impact multiple sites/customers. **Decision Making / Discretion** Exercises independent judgment within generally defined procedures and policies for selecting methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Provides input for team decisions. Decisions may affect sections/sub\-functions. **Supervision / Leadership** Normally receives no instruction. Identifies skills needed within team and works with team to achieve them. Demonstrates Flex values. **Work Environment:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to risk of electrical shock. The employee is occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts. **Physical Demands:** *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to talk and hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, sit, handle small components and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, and depth perception. **JT05** **AA01** **LB34** **What you'll receive for the great work you provide:** * Full range of medical, dental, and vision plans * Life Insurance * Short\-term and Long\-term Disability * Matching 401(k) Contributions * Vacation and Paid Sick Time * Tuition Reimbursement \&\#xa; Application Deadline: Applications for this job position will be accepted for at least five days following the job posting start date below and continuing until the end date below or until the position is filled. jobs.title: Student Worker - Computer Engineering

Engineering ### **JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY** Under the direction of the assigned Faculty, the student worker will support classroom instruction, ranging from grading to lab preparation to tutoring. ### **JOB DESCRIPTION** **RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:** * Faculty Support. * Grading. * Lab Preparation. * Tutorial support for students. * Other duties as assigned. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:** population. * Demonstrated knowledge of relevant course content. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:** * Must have a high school diploma or equivalent. * Must be in good academic standing. * Must be currently jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer | Robotics
jobs.description: **What We Do** ============== Gecko Robotics is helping the world’s most important organizations ensure the availability, reliability, and sustainability of critical infrastructure. Gecko's complete and connected solutions combine wall\-climbing robots, industry\-leading sensors, and an AI\-powered data platform to provide customers with a unique window into the current and future health of their physical assets. This enables real\-time decision making to increase the efficiency and safety of operations, promote mission readiness, and protect the environment and civilization from the effects of infrastructure failure. **Role at a Glance** ==================== We’re looking for a **Full Stack Software Engineer, Robotics** to own and improve the software that supports robotic inspections, from the application operators use on their laptops to software deployed on the robot. This full\-stack role spans user interfaces, Python services, and hardware integration, with most software running locally on field laptops and robot computers. You will work closely with field operators to improve robot controls, inspection monitoring, and visibility into data quality. The application allows operators to monitor live camera feeds and view ultrasonic thickness measurements mapped onto 2D or 3D models of the asset as the robot scans it. Projects may include extending support to new asset types, integrating sensors and cameras, and improving calibration and diagnostics. This role is based in our Pittsburgh office, with potential for occasional field visits. **What you will do** ==================== * **Partner with field operators.** Understand inspection workflows, gather feedback, and translate operational needs into software improvements. * **Develop across the software stack.** Build and maintain the operator application and software deployed to the robot, integrating user interfaces, backend services, and hardware. * **Expand inspection capabilities.** Extend support to additional asset types, such as tank roofs and horizontal tanks, and integrate new sensors and cameras, including LiDAR. * **Improve operator controls and visibility.** Develop robot controls, live camera feeds, 2D and 3D data views, calibration workflows, and inspection monitoring and review tools. * **Integrate and troubleshoot connected systems.** Coordinate robot motion, localization, cameras, sensor data acquisition and processing, calibration, and inspection management. Diagnose issues across hardware communication, services, and the operator interface. * **Deliver reliable field software.** Test and release software for field laptops and robot computers. Improve logging, recording, and diagnostics, and support recovery from dropped connections, disconnected sensors, and interrupted inspections. **Technologies We Use** ======================= * Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript * Svelte and FastAPI * Message\-based services, real\-time data streaming, and 3D visualization in the browser * ROS, ZMQ, and Docker * Linux, macOS, and Windows, including embedded Linux computers on robots **About You** ============= **Required Skills** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 2\+ years developing user\-facing desktop applications. * 2\+ years working on distributed systems for real\-time data processing. * Experience building and maintaining production applications or services in Python that communicate with hardware and process sensor data. * Experience developing user\-facing applications with a modern JavaScript frontend framework, such as Svelte or React. * Clear written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues and collaborate across software, hardware, and field operations teams. **Preferred Skills** * Robotics software development experience, including software that interacts with embedded Linux computers, hardware, or sensors. * Experience with real\-time or streaming data, where information arrives continuously and timing matters. **Who We Are** ============== At Gecko, our people are our greatest investment. In addition to competitive compensation packages, we offer company equity, 401(k) matching, gender\-neutral parental leave, full medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health, ongoing professional development, family planning assistance, and flexible paid time off. Gecko values collaboration, innovation, and partnership, and we believe we do our best work when we're together in person. We’re an office\-first culture but understand that sometimes you may need to work from home. Many people are in the office five days a week, others need a bit more flexibility. Ultimately, we care about the outcomes we achieve \- and creating a culture of autonomy and trust that enables that impact. Gecko is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission to protect today’s infrastructure and give form to tomorrow’s. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our critical mission, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - AV Data & Analysis Tools
jobs.description: **Job Description** General Motors is a global leader in advanced driver assistance. With Super Cruise hands\-free technology in more than 500,000 Super Cruise–equipped vehicles on the road and over 700 million hands\-free miles driven, GM is proving that automation can be trusted, intuitive, and helpful. GM has the global reach to bring cutting\-edge advances to everyday drivers at unprecedented scale. Join us to help deliver the next generation of safe and delightful personal autonomous vehicle experiences. **About the Team** Every autonomous\-driving engineer at GM eventually asks the same questions: *What happened on that drive? Where else has this happened? Why did the vehicle do that? Did my change fix it?* The AV Analysis team builds the tools that answer them, across the full life of AV data: * Record and catalog new data as it comes in from the fleet, so engineers know what exists, where it came from, and whether it's ready to use. * Index and mine road data alongside simulation output, so engineers can find the scenes that matter using structured filters, similarity search, and natural\-language queries. Analyze what happened by replaying sensor data, perception output, and planner decisions in synchronized 3D, camera, plot, and map views. Engineers do this to triage and diagnose an issue, or to validate a new change. * Perception, planning, simulation, mapping, validation, and data teams use these tools every day. That work spans next\-generation autonomous development vehicles, Super Cruise programs, and autonomous mobile robots in GM factories. We're part of AV Tooling, which also builds GM's fleet\-operations tools and AI\-assisted triage. We share one goal: shorten the loop from collecting data, to understanding it, to fixing the vehicle. **About the Role** Our senior engineers don't wait for a spec. Demand for our tools outpaces any roadmap, so the most valuable thing you'll do is decide what to build. That means finding the problem that's quietly costing engineers hours every week, designing the tool that removes it, and shipping it. You'll own a major part of the data lifecycle end to end, such as how engineers search and mine data, or how they analyze and debug it. You'll also help connect cataloging, search, and analysis into one workflow. **What You'll Do** * Find the highest\-leverage gaps in how engineers find, analyze, and debug AV data. Work alongside users, read support channels and bug reports, and notice where teams are building their own workarounds. Then turn those gaps into tools people adopt. * Record and catalog new AV data as it arrives, with the context engineers need to trust and use it: vehicle, software version, location, and ingestion status. * Index and mine road data alongside simulation output. Build search that combines structured metadata queries in SQL with embedding\-based similarity search in vector databases, plus natural\-language queries and LLM\- and VLM\-powered curation. * Build high\-performance tools for analyzing what happened, with synchronized replay of camera video, lidar, 3D scenes, plots, and maps. jobs.title: Research Scientist
jobs.description: **Posting Details** ------------------- I. DEPARTMENT INFORMATION **Job Description Summary:** The Biostatistics Center (BSC) of the Milken Institute School of Public Health is an off\-campus research facility of The George Washington University located in Rockville, Maryland. The BSC serves as the coordinating center for large scale multi\-center clinical trials and epidemiological studies funded by federal agencies including the National Institutes of Health. The BSC is a leader in the statistical coordination of major medical research programs of national and international scope. Visit our website at: **www.bsc.gwu.edu**. We are seeking a **Research Scientist** specializing in **Machine Learning, Data Science, Data Harmonization, and Synthetic Data Generation** to lead the integration, standardization, and privacy\-preserving algorithmic modeling of complex, multi\-site datasets. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex data infrastructure, cutting\-edge machine learning, and synthetic data generation—building automated transformation pipelines, harmonizing disparate clinical/observational data structures (e.g., OMOP CDM, FHIR), and generating high\-fidelity synthetic datasets to accelerate secure collaborative research without compromising data privacy. **Experience with high\-dimensional multi\-omics data analysis and integration is highly desirable.** **Key Responsibilities:** **Synthetic Data Generation \& Privacy Engineering** * **Generative Modeling:** Design, train, and validate generative machine learning models (GANs, VAEs, diffusion models, and LLM\-based tabular synthesizers) to generate high\-fidelity synthetic tabular, longitudinal, and multi\-omic datasets. * **Privacy Assurance \& Risk Assessment:** Implement rigorous privacy\-preserving methodologies (differential privacy, membership inference attack testing, re\-identification risk metrics) to guarantee synthetic datasets meet strict governance and compliance standards. * **Utility \& Fidelity Evaluation:** Establish automated benchmark suites comparing distributional fidelity, feature correlations, cross\-sectional/longitudinal validity, and downstream task performance between real and synthetic cohorts. **Data Harmonization \& Infrastructure** * **ETL** **\& Data Standardization:** Design, execute, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to map complex, longitudinal datasets from multi\-center registries and disparate source systems into common data models (e.g., OMOP CDM, PCORnet). * **Ontology Mapping \& Quality Control:** Implement vocabulary mappings (SNOMED, RxNorm, LOINC, ICD\-10\) and robust data quality frameworks to handle missingness, inconsistent formatting, and cross\-site measurement variation across clinical and molecular datasets. * **Registry \& Pipeline Integration:** Architect automated validation workflows ensuring privacy preservation, site blinding, and reproducible data harmonization across large\-scale cohort studies. **Machine Learning, Omics \& Statistical Modeling** * **Multi\-Omics Data Integration:** Analyze, harmonize, and model high\-dimensional biological data layers (e.g., genomics, transcriptomics, metabolomics, proteomics) alongside EHR and clinical registry data. * **Algorithmic Modeling:** Develop, evaluate, and deploy advanced machine learning models (gradient boosted trees, neural architectures, ensemble learning) and semi\-parametric causal inference techniques on high\-dimensional harmonized and synthetic data. * **Longitudinal \& Trajectory Analysis:** Build statistical and ML frameworks for analyzing longitudinal trajectories, biological aging markers, and time\-varying exposures. * **Model Explainability \& Transportability:** Conduct rigorous cross\-validation, sensitivity analyses, and transportability evaluations to ensure model fairness, robustness, and biological/clinical validity when trained on real vs. synthetic inputs. **Collaborative Research \& Leadership** * **Interdisciplinary Collaboration:** Work closely with biostatisticians, bioinformaticians, privacy officers, software engineers, and domain experts to translate scientific hypotheses into secure, end\-to\-end data products. * **Methodological Dissemination:** Lead the drafting of peer\-reviewed scientific publications, technical whitepapers, and method documentation regarding privacy metrics, synthetic data utility, and multi\-omic jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Testing
jobs.description: **About Glasslake** Glasslake is building the operating system for SAP delivery — the infrastructure layer underneath the most complex and expensive IT projects companies run. SAP implementations move billions of dollars and thousands of consultants, but the knowledge generated in these projects is never captured: it lives in people’s heads, disappears when the project ends, and gets rebuilt from scratch on every new engagement. Glasslake solves this with an agentic orchestration platform that coordinates every phase of SAP transformation, capturing decisions, tests, and context as a byproduct of work already underway — building an organizational memory that accumulates across projects instead of resetting. We’re a team based in San Francisco and São Paulo, moving fast and already deployed with some of the largest SAP integrators in the world, including Delaware Consulting, KPMG, and NTT Data. The team comes from Stanford, Meta, Two Sigma, Microsoft, and NASA. **The Opportunity** You’ll own some of the hardest problems in applied AI: making agents reliable, fast, and trustworthy on enterprise systems where being wrong is expensive. Testing is one of the most critical and labor\-intensive parts of any SAP transformation. Our AI agents plan, execute, and validate tests of business processes inside real customer SAP landscapes, work that has traditionally taken teams of consultants weeks to do by hand. Making agents perform at that level is an open frontier. You’ll take on problems with no off\-the\-shelf answers, explore them, define what success looks like, and carry the solution all the way to production with real customers. **What You’ll Do** **Explore and define the problem** * **Frame the problem.** Turn observed agent behaviors into a clear problem statement, backed by evidence and your own experiments. * **Define success.** Set the metrics, benchmarks, and evals that measure agent performance. **Build and own the solution** * **Ship end to end.** Design and ship agent and LLM features, from prompts and orchestration to the infrastructure behind them. * **Own the results.** Watch how your work performs in production and keep improving it. **Work with experts and raise the bar** * **Validate with experts.** Work with SAP domain experts and present findings and decisions clearly. * **Raise the bar.** Review code and designs, and help shape the team’s AI engineering practices. **What We’re Looking For** * **6\+ years of engineering experience**, including building AI agents or LLM features from scratch and shipping them to production with full ownership. * **A research\-like approach.** You set hypotheses, run experiments, and verify results before you build. * **Evaluation rigor.** Experience measuring agent performance through evals, benchmarks, or regression suites, and acting on what they show. * **Strong Python and SQL**, with hands\-on experience with LLM APIs and agent frameworks. * **Infrastructure ownership.** Comfortable running the workflow orchestration and cloud services behind your features. * **Production investigation.** You query databases and read logs and traces to find out what actually happened. * **Self\-direction and clear communication**, including with domain experts who aren’t engineers. * **AI native.** You use AI tooling daily as a force multiplier. **Nice to have** * **Experience with computer\-use or browser\-automation agents.** * **Software testing background**, such as test automation or QA for complex systems, or familiarity with SAP testing. * **Familiarity with enterprise software ecosystems** (SAP, ERP, CRM). * **Ability to work in TypeScript** when a feature needs it. * **Early\-stage startup experience** where you owned a problem with no playbook. * **Experience mentoring engineers** or acting as a technical reference on a team. **Why Join Glasslake Now** * Own open\-ended agent problems end to end, from the first exploration to results in production. * Time to explore a problem and test ideas before committing to a solution. * Your agents run inside multi\-million dollar transformations at the largest SAP integrators in the world, in a category being defined right now. * Direct access to the founding team, customers, and SAP domain experts.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Experimentation - Product Analytics | NASA | Remote
jobs.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40\+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X. We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open\-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation\-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career\-defining opportunity. **This is a full\-time remote opportunity. We are considering candidates from US and Canada only (EST time zone).** **The opportunity:** Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did. It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first\-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user\-experience capabilities. You'll join the **Product Analytics team**, a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team's dedicated software engineer, you'll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You'll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands\-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role. **About the product:** The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform: * **Frontend:** a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels. * **Backend:** Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes\-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps\-style management. * **Feature flags:** integration with **OpenFeature** and the **OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP)**, Grafana's multi\-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator. * **Statistics engine:** a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction\-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample\-size recommendations. * **Data:** experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources. * **AI:** experiment authoring assisted by **Grafana Assistant**, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review. **What You’ll be doing:** * **Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product.** Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration. * **Build the experimentation experience.** Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers. * **Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust**. Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts. * **Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user\-experience stack.** Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and out  You use AI coding tools thoughtfully, validate their output, and share practices that improve the team’s speed *and* quality. * **Clear communication.** You can explain technical and statistical tradeoffs to engineers, analysts and product managers in a fully remote, asynchronous environment. **Bonus Points For:** * Hands\-on experience with feature flags and OpenFeature. * A working understanding of experiment statistics: Bayesian or frequentist testing, sample sizing, variance reduction, and common pitfalls such as peeking and sample ratio mismatch. * Experience with Kubernetes concepts: custom resources, operators, admission webhooks, GitOps. * Experience building Grafana plugins or apps, or with the Grafana App SDK or Scenes. * Familiarity with frontend observability and product analytics tooling, such as Grafana Faro, RUM, session replay, RudderStack or Segment. * Open source contribution or maintainership. * Experience as a user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo, whether at work or on a homelab. **Compensation \& Rewards:** In US, the base compensation range for this role is USD $167,000 \- $209,000\. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. * *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range \& benefits at the beginning of the process.* **Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:** * **100% Remote, Global Culture \-** As a remote\-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. * **Scaling Organization** – Tackle meaningful work in a high\-growth, ever\-evolving environment. * **Transparent Communication** – Expect open decision\-making and regular company\-wide updates. * **Innovation\-Driven** – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. * **Open Source Roots** – Built on community\-driven values that shape how we work. * **Empowered Teams** – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. * **Career Growth Pathways** – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. * **Approachable Leadership** – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. * **Passionate People** – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. * **In\-Person onboarding** \- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. * **Balance is Key** \- We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *\*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.* **Equal Opportunity Employer:** *Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.* *Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.* \#LI\-Remote *For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our* *privacy policy**.*

jobs.description: ### **Description** Guardian Service is hiring a Lead AI\-Native Software Engineer to build and scale technology that transforms how we deliver insurance quotes to customers. You'll work directly with Marketing, Sales, and business leadership to translate operational challenges into reliable, scalable software. Guardian Service is building a technology\-enabled insurance agency that combines the choice and personalized service of an independent agency with the efficiency of a scaled operation. Technology is central to our ability to simplify the insurance shopping experience, eliminate manual work, and help agents serve more customers effectively. You'll have the opportunity to lead one of Guardian Service's highest\-priority engineering initiatives, shape our technical foundation, and build the team and systems that will support our next phase of growth.### **Your Day\-to\-Day** * Lead the design, development, and deployment of technology that improves insurance quoting workflows, speed, and accuracy * Build backend systems, APIs, opportunities and prioritize development based on business results * Rapidly prototype, test, and deploy solutions, incorporating feedback from frontline teams * Leverage AI\-native development years to build Guardian Service into a leader. * **Ownership \& Impact:** You’ll own initiatives that directly affect company performance, with leadership fully aligned around growth. * **Exposure \& Learning:** Work alongside leaders who have built and scaled businesses, led large teams, and driven results at Fortune 500 companies. * **Career Growth:** No cap on advancement or the ability to own high\-impact projects. * **Stability:** Privately owned, debt\-free, and financially strong. * **Culture:** High standards, but also a team that values fun and camaraderie. As an independent insurance agency, we compare 50\+ top\-rated carriers to find the right coverage at the best price, while proactively reshopping policies over time so our members never overpay.
