jobs.title: Prototype Assembly Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary:** Our catalog model depends on moving many new designs quickly and reliably from tape\-out to first samples. The Prototype Assembly Engineer owns that handoff. You are the technical bridge between our RF IC designers and our outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) partners. You turn design ideas into machine\-assembled products, drive prototype builds to schedule, and close the feedback loop to the factory for continuous improvement. **Roles \& Responsibilities:** **Design Team Interface** · Engage with RF IC designers early in each program to select package type(s) that meet RF, thermal, and cost targets. · Own bonding diagrams, package outline selection, and assembly drawings for each new prototype. · Translate lessons from each build back into design rules and packaging guidelines for the design team. **OSAT Interface** · Serve as the primary technical contact with OSAT partners for all assemblies. · Prepare and release complete build packages: bonding diagrams, BOMs, wafer maps, marking, tape\-and\-reel requirements, and special instructions. · Review and approve OSAT engineering deliverables, including substrate and lead frame drawings. · Lead technical calls to resolve assembly issues and drive yield improvement. **Prototype Build Management** · Plan and track prototype builds from wafer ship to sample delivery, holding OSATs and internal teams to committed dates. · Run multiple concurrent prototype programs across QFN, DFN, Air\-cavity, WLCSP, flip\-chip, and laminate module packages. **Package Development \& Continuous Improvement** · Evaluate new package platforms, materials, and processes to extend our catalog, including laminate SiP and multi\-die modules. · Drive 8D corrective actions with OSATs when assembly defects occur. **Transfer to Production \& Qualification** · Support package and reliability qualification (MSL, HAST/THB, temperature cycling, HTOL) in partnership with quality engineering. · Transition validated prototype assemblies into robust, production\-ready products for high\-volume manufacturing. · Maintain accurate records in document control for every assembly configuration. · Support technical issues as needed after release to production. **Minimum Educational Qualifications:** · BS in Electrical, Mechanical, Materials, or Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field. **Preferred Previous Experience:** · 3\+ years of semiconductor packaging or assembly engineering experience · Experience working with OSATs on new product builds is desired, including preparation of OSAT assembly request forms. · Hands\-on knowledge of wire bond, die attach, molding, singulation, and tape\-and\-reel processes. · Familiarity with JEDEC package and reliability standards. · Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain trade\-offs clearly to designers, OSATs, and management. **Key Competencies:** · **Bridge builder:** earns the trust of both designers and OSAT engineers and gets them to agreement quickly. · **Schedule owner:** treats prototype dates as commitments and escalates early when they are at risk. · **Hands\-on problem solver:** comfortable at the microscope, in the lab, or on the factory floor. · **Speed with discipline:** moves many designs in parallel without cutting corners on documentation or quality. · **Clear communicator:** writes build instructions and reports that leave no room for misinterpretation. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Professional development assistance * Referral program * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- We are building a browser\-based 3D virtual science lab. Students assemble apparatus, perform experiments, and are assessed on their technique — all rendered in real time with React 19, React Three Fiber (Three.js), and Zustand, built with Vite. The simulation runs on ordinary school hardware, including low\-end Chromebooks, so it has to be both convincing and fast, and its behavior has to be deterministic enough to score reliably **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Build and own complex React Three Fiber features: interactive 3D equipment, a selection\-driven action system, real\-time visual effects, and the UI around them. * Keep the app fast on low\-end hardware — profile and tune the render loop, manage GPU/CPU cost, and hold a frame budget on Chromebook\-class devices. * Keep application state coherent as it grows (simulation state, equipment state, an event log used for assessment, and UI state) using Zustand. * Make accessibility real: full keyboard operation, focus management, ARIA, and screen\-reader support are core requirements here, not polish. * Direct Claude Code effectively — decompose work into well\-specified, agent\-sized tasks, review the output with a senior eye, and know when to write something by hand instead. * Help maintain the conventions, CLAUDE.md guidance, and repo structure that keep AI\-generated code consistent and safe. * Collaborate with our 3D technical artist to integrate assets and shaders cleanly. **Skill Requirements** ---------------------- * Deep, senior\-level React (React 19 / modern React): the render model, hooks discipline, memoization, effect timing, and a real feel for where re\-renders and stale closures come from — which matter acutely in an app running a physics loop every frame. * Three.js and React Three Fiber in production. You'll work across both the new AI platform and the existing CRM experience, including the services behind them.### **What you'll do** * Build product in our Next.js / React / TypeScript Nx monorepo: the AI application experience, the donor CRM, segmentation, and email and SMS campaigns. * Build and extend NestJS services, gRPC contracts and Postgres schemas behind those screens. * Build the human\-in\-the\-loop side of our agents: previewing what an agent drafted, approving or rejecting it, execution history and manual override. * Build UI for AI output that people trust: streaming responses, structured answers with clear next actions, loading and error states that don't hide what happened. * Ship behind feature flags, with logging, monitoring and a rollback plan. * Write a short design doc before big builds. Review other people's. * Get on calls with customers and customer success. Small team, so you'll hear the feedback directly. ### **What we're looking for** * You drive a collaborative culture. You pair with teammates, review generously, document what you build and share ownership instead of holding it close. You make the people around you better. * 7\+ years building production web applications, with 3\+ years in TypeScript on both front end and back end. * Deep React and Next.js: App Router, server components, state management, performance. * Strong Node.js back end. NestJS preferred. You design APIs other people want to use. jobs.title: AI-First Software Developer - Softeon
jobs.description: **Company Description** IFS is a billion\-dollar revenue company with 6,000\+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award\-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters, at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting\-edge. IFS Softeon builds warehouse management and supply chain execution software (WMS, WES, distributed order management and the Elastic UI platform) for some of the most demanding fulfillment operations in the world. At IFS, we are flexible, we are innovative, and we are focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive workforce that represents the many cultures, backgrounds and viewpoints of our customers, partners and communities. We are looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can \#MakeYourMoment, so that we can help others make theirs. Join Team Purple. Join IFS. **Job Description** Ship more of what customers need, faster, and prove every change works. Our applications run the warehouses that get orders out the door on time. We are changing how that software gets built: AI agents and AI\-assisted CI/CD help us deliver more functionality to our customers, faster, with higher quality. We are looking for an AI\-first developer: someone who treats AI agents as a team to direct, not a fancy autocomplete. You will pair deep Java engineering with hands\-on experience building through agents to deliver great new functionality across our applications, and you will help set the standard for how the rest of engineering works this way. You know that speed only counts if it comes with proof, so automated testing, validation and agent\-assisted review are part of how you ship every change. **What you will do** * Deliver great product functionality. Design and build new features and enhancements across our Java applications (receiving, inventory, picking, replenishment, shipping, integrations and user experience) that customers value and rely on. * Build with agents every day. Use Claude Code and similar coding agents to plan, implement, refactor and test features. Break work into clear specs, give agents strong context, and know when to delegate and when to step in. * Author and maintain agent skills. Write and refine skills, prompts, tool definitions and MCP servers that encode Softeon's domain knowledge, such as Elastic UI form and flow authoring, WMS configuration and integration patterns. * Own a fully automated delivery pipeline. Build and run CI/CD where every change passes automated builds, unit and integration tests, static analysis, security scanning and AI agent code review before a human approves it. * Make quality provable. Build and extend automated validation (unit, API and Playwright end\-to\-end tests) so that AI\-generated code, configuration and integrations are verified automatically, with evidence. * Operate what you ship. Build the telemetry, logging and monitoring your features need, and treat performance and reliability as product requirements rather than a late pass. * Modernize with confidence. Use agents to understand, refactor and modernize existing code, add missing test coverage, and pay down technical debt without slowing feature delivery. * Measure velocity and quality. Track cycle time, defect rates and escaped bugs, and use the data to keep improving how agents and pipelines are used. * Work with product and customers. Turn real warehouse and supply chain needs into well\-specified, testable software, and talk with product managers, customers and Ops teams in their language. * Raise the bar for the team. Share patterns, review others' agent workflows, measure what works, and help colleagues become effective AI\-first developers. **Why it is interesting** * Agents can write code faster than any team can review it. The hard part is no longer typing; it is deciding what to build, giving agents the right context, and proving that what comes back is correct in a domain where a plausible answer can still stop a warehouse. That means designing the specs, skills, tests and pipeline gates that let a small team ship enterprise software at a pace that used to need a much larger one, and there is no settled playbook to copy. * You will do this on mature, mission\-critical applications with real customers, real data and real operational stakes, which is a harder and more rewarding problem than a greenfield demo. **Frameworks and tools you will work with:** **Languages \& core** * Java 17\+, Spring / Spring Boot, REST and messaging APIs, SQL and relational databases **Front end** * TypeScript, Angular, and Elastic UI, our met  skills: clear written specs, structured prompts and the judgment to evaluate and correct agent output. * Comfortable across the boundary: you can write the front\-end, service and database code a feature needs end to end. * Solid fundamentals in relational databases and SQL, system design, and secure coding practices. * Permanent resident of the United States, legally authorized to work in the US without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. **Also valuable** * A platform where behavior is configured through data or metadata rather than written in code, such as low\-code, rules engines or schema\-driven UI. * Modern TypeScript and Angular (or React), including component architecture and design\-system work. * Direct experience with warehouse management (WMS), warehouse execution (WES), transportation management (TMS) or MRP/ERP platforms, as a developer, implementer or operator. * Experience with warehouse automation: conveyors, sortation, pick\-to\-light, AMRs, goods\-to\-person systems or their control software. * Mobile or progressive web applications, including RF/handheld devices, offline behavior and poor connectivity. * Experience building MCP servers, custom agent tooling or AI\-powered developer workflows. * Familiarity with XSLT and Groovy, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP). * Based in the US Eastern or Central time zone. **How we work** * AI\-first by default. Agents are part of the team; you are responsible for their output. * No change ships without proof. Automated tests, agent review and validation evidence on every pull request. * Close to customers. We learn from warehouse floors and Ops leaders, not just tickets. * Small, senior and fast. High ownership, low ceremony, measurable results. **What success looks like** * First 30 days: you ship production changes through the full agent\-assisted pipeline and know our Java platform and WMS domain. * First 90 days: you own a feature area end to end, have contributed new agent skills or pipeline checks, and have measurably sped up delivery without lowering quality. * First year: you have delivered significant product functionality and are a go\-to person for AI\-first engineering practices across Softeon engineering. **Location and eligibility** This is a remote, US\-based role. Candidates must be permanent residents of the United States. We prefer candidates in the Eastern or Central time zones to support collaboration with our teams and customers. Occasional travel to customer sites or company offices may be required. **Additional Information** **What We’re Offering** * Salary Range: $114,000 to $152,500 annually \+ bonus * Flexible paid time off, including sick and holiday * Medical, dental, \& vision insurance * 401K with Company contribution * Flexible spending accounts * Life insurance and disability benefits * Tuition assistance * Community involvement and volunteering events M/F/Disabled/Vet VEVRAA Federal Contractor. We are a Drug\-Free Workplace. Interested candidates should apply at: www.ifs.com/about/careers\-at\-ifs All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Experienced Technology New York **Machine Learning Engineers** at IMC play a pivotal role in building the systems that drive training and deployment of large\-scale ML models across IMC's global operations. They collaborate with quantitative researchers, hardware specialists and software engineers to build robust systems that get the most out of GPU acceleration, distributed computing and the broader open\-source ML ecosystem. ML Engineers' work directly shapes how fast we can experiment, iterate and deploy — accelerating the cycle that turns a research idea into a live trading strategy. This is a unique opportunity to solve problems at the intersection of advanced machine learning and trading, where your contributions will shape the future of IMC's technology and trading capabilities. As a team, our Machine Learning Engineers broadly work across two areas: **ML Research Engineering**, focused on the systems and frameworks researchers use to train, evaluate and iterate on models at scale; and **ML Performance Engineering**, focused on making ML workloads execute as efficiently as possible, typically through GPU and low\-level systems optimization. These aren't rigid tracks, and there is overlap between them. You will bring depth of expertise in at least one of these focus areas and collaborate closely with global team members. **Your Core Responsibilities** *The responsibilities below are representative of the role — the exact mix depends on your team, area of expertise and location.* **ML Research Engineering** * Develop large\-scale distributed training pipelines that manage complex datasets and models. * Partner with quantitative researchers to automate ML experiments, hyperparameter tuning and model retraining. * Work with HPC specialists to optimise workflows, improve training speed and reduce compute cost. **ML Performance Engineering** * Build and optimise low\-latency inference pipelines, ensuring models deliver real\-time predictions in production systems. * Maximise performance in training and inference using GPU hardware and acceleration libraries. **Across both areas** * Extend and improve the internals of machine learning frameworks and open\-source tools to raise their performance for our workloads. * Design scalable model infrastructure capable of handling high\-volume trading data and delivering real\-time, high\-accuracy predictions. * Evaluate and roll out third\-party tools that enhance model development, training and inference capabilities. **Your Skills and Experience** **Core, regardless of focus area:** * 3\+ years of experience in machine learning, with a focus on training or inference systems. * **Production software engineering —** Python, testing discipline and genuine ownership of systems once they ship. * **Machine learning fundamentals —** you understand modern ML workloads beyond high\-level APIs and can reason about model behaviour, correctness and performance at the level relevant to your area of expertise. * **A systems mindset —** you reach for measurement before opinion on performance, scale or reliability issues, and can make sound build\-versus\-buy decisions. * **Strong collaboration —** comfortable explaining the reasoning behind your technical decisions, working through differing perspectives with researchers and adapting your approach when the evidence supports it. **Depth in one or more of the following:** * **Distributed training and large\-scale systems —** parallelism strategy, data pipelines and checkpointing; frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or JAX. * **GPU performance and low\-level optimisation —** reasoning about memory, compute and latency at the device level, and optimising performance across kernels, compilers and hardware (e.g. CUDA, Triton or equivalent). * **Production inference systems —** hands\-on experience building and hardening real\-time, low\-latency prediction pipelines in high\-performance environments. * **Numerics and correctness at scale —** low\-precision effects, KV caching, batching, and knowing which optimisations stay bit\-exact. *Technologies listed above are examples rather than requirements; equivalent depth developed using other stacks or hardware platforms is equally relevant.* **Also a plus:** * Exposure to cloud platforms and orchestration tools. * A track record of contributing to open\-source projects in machine learning, data science or distributed systems. **Not sure this is the one?** If your strength is mainly in modelling and research direction, our Deep Learning Researcher roles are likely a closer fit. If your strength is in general infrastructure rather than ML\-specific systems, take a look at our broader infrastructure engineering roles. \#LI\-DNP **About Us** *IMC is a research\-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real\-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.* We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist our recruiting team review applications (for example, to help match applications against job criteria and organize large volumes of submissions). All hiring decisions are made by people, not AI. We continuously monitor our AI tools to ensure they are used responsibly, with appropriate human oversight. Your personal data will be handled in line with applicable privacy and data protection laws. For more information, please see the IMC Privacy Statement. Where legally required, you may have the right to request human review of any AI\-assisted decision, to object to the use of AI in your application, or to obtain further information about how your data is processed. To exercise these rights, please contact us at uscvreview@imc.com. We use Tofu AI Resume Review as part of our hiring process for jobs in certain locations. The Tofu tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. Results of the audit may be viewed here: AI Assurance Dashboard \- Tofu. The Base Salary range for the role is included below. Base salary is only one component of total compensation; all full\-time, permanent positions are eligible for a discretionary bonus and benefits, including paid leave and insurance. control logic on purchased third\-party machinery to improve throughput, fix recurring faults, or integrate it into our broader plant network. * **Mechatronic Troubleshooting:** Diagnose complex electromechanical failures across sensors, actuators, pneumatics, hydraulics, servo systems, and robotics—bridging the gap between software logic and physical hardware. * **Electrical Design \& Documentation:** Create and update electrical schematics, panel layouts, and bills of materials (BOMs) using AutoCAD Electrical or EPLAN; ensure all documentation accurately reflects field modifications. * **Safety \& Compliance:** Design, implement, and validate machine safety systems (safety relays, light curtains, E\-stops, safety PLCs) in compliance with OSHA, NFPA 79, and ANSI/RIA standards. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner closely with mechanical engineers, maintenance technicians, and machine builders during assembly, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT). **Required Qualifications** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent hands\-on industrial automation experience). * **Experience:** 3 to 7 years of experience in industrial controls, automation engineering, or machine building within a manufacturing environment. * **PLC \& HMI Programming:** Proven proficiency programming and troubleshooting industrial controllers (e.g., Allen\-Bradley/Rockwell, Siemens, Beckhoff, or Omron) and designing intuitive operator interfaces. * **Motion \& Robotics:** Hands\-on experience sizing, tuning, and integrating servo drives, stepper motors, VFDs, and multi\-axis motion systems. * **Hardware \& Schematics:** Ability to read, redline, and draft electrical and pneumatic schematics, as well as physically wire, debug, and test control panels when needed. * **Industrial Networking:** Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, or IO\-Link. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience integrating industrial robots (e.g., FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Universal Robots) or machine vision systems (e.g., Cognex, Keyence). * Familiarity with legacy equipment retrofits (e.g., migrating older PLC\-5/SLC\-500 systems to modern platforms). * Basic understanding of mechanical CAD (SolidWorks, Inventor) to collaborate effectively on custom machine builds. * Knowledge of SCADA systems, data collection, or IIoT protocols (MQTT, OPC UA). #### **Education** Preferred* Bachelors or better in Mechanical Engineering * Bachelors or better in Electrical Engineering Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.description: **Position Title:** **Data Engineer III** **Pay Rate** : $83,000 \- $121,000 *Multiple factors, including Individual experience, skills and abilities will determine where an employee is ultimately placed in the pay range.* **Category/Shift** : Salaried Full\-Time **Physical Location** : 75 5th Street NW Atlanta, GA 30308 United States **The Job You Will Perform:** The Data Engineer is an important member of the Cost Innovation Team, which is a strategic, innovative, and cross\-functional team that is focused on creating value for the company through the advanced analytics of manufacturing data. This position offers a flexible working arrangement provided that the home office is within a typical commuting distance to the A2C office. **Core Responsibilities** **Analytics \& Data Science Enablement** * Partner with analysts, data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate functional requirements into scalable technical data solutions. * Deliver self\-service, analytics\-ready datasets that empower downstream teams to consume data without deep knowledge of underlying source systems. * Enable industrial analytics use cases by providing trusted, contextualized time\-series, asset, event, and operational data for analytics platforms and applications. * Eliminate redundant data\-preparation and contextualization efforts across disparate analytics and application teams. * Help establish standard data definitions, reusable data products, and consistent business context across enterprise and industrial analytics environments. * Support downstream analytics workflows, including advanced analytics, data science, visualization, and industrial process analytics. **Data Ingestion \& Integration** * Design, build, and maintain robust pipelines to ingest data from relational databases, operational systems, industrial historians, APIs, cloud platforms, and flat files. * Establish reliable and secure connections between source systems, cloud data platforms, and industrial data platforms. * Write optimized SQL queries and extraction logic for high\-performance data retrieval. * Implement flexible ingestion patterns including batch, incremental, streaming, and replication\-based approaches based on business latency requirements. * Integrate high\-volume time\-series data and industrial metadata while maintaining relationships between assets, measurements, events, and other operational entities. * Support ingestion and integration patterns used by platforms such as Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), Seeq, and Microsoft Fabric. **Data Storage \& Lakehouse Engineering** * Design and manage scalable storage structures across raw (bronze), intermediate (silver), and curated (gold) layers. * Leverage Spark\-native formats and engines such as Delta Lake to support scalable analytics workloads. * Design curated data structures that support both enterprise analytics and industrial data consumption. * Enforce data retention, archiving, and purging policies to manage data lifecycles. * Monitor and optimize storage, compute costs, and cloud resource utilization. **Data Transformation** * Develop Python and SQL\-based transformations to clean, standardize, enrich, and unify data. * Develop, tune, and proactively optimize scalable PySpark applications to efficiently process high\-volume datasets. * Build modular, reusable transformation components rather than siloed, application\-specific logic. * Resolve complex data\-quality anomalies including schema drift, missing values, duplicates, timestamp alignment, and inconsistent identifiers. * Engineer efficient incremental processing patterns to handle high\-volume, frequently changing datasets. * Transform raw operational and historian data into analytics\-ready time series, calculations, conditions, events, and contextualized datasets for downstream consumption. * Enable reusable data transformations that can support platforms such as Seeq, Cognite, Fabric, and custom analytics applications. **Semantic Modeling \& Industrial Data Contextualization** * Translate complex source schemas into intuitive, business\-aligned semantic entities, asset hierarchies, and industrial data models. * Build and maintain relationships between assets, equipment, time series, events, files, and other operational data. * Standardize naming conventions, identifiers, metadata, and relationship mappings across source systems. * Perform data contextualization to connect operational data with relevant equipment, process, and business context. * Support asset\-centric and knowledge\-graph\-style data models commonly used in industrial data platforms such as Cognite. **Pipeline Orchestration \& Operations** * Architect end\-to\-end workflows that seamlessly coordinate ingestion, transformation, contextualization, validation, and publication. * Orchestrate data movement between source systems, lakehouse environments, industrial data platforms, and analytics applications. * Implement resilient error handling including retries, automated recovery, checkpointing, and alerting. * Monitor pipeline health, SLA compliance, data freshness, and data drift using centralized observability tools. * Design pipelines capable of supporting both traditional enterprise data and high\-frequency industrial time\-series workloads. **Data Governance, Security \& DevOps** * Enforce data security and privacy standards, including row\- and column\-level security, RBAC (Role\-Based Access Control), and masking of sensitive data. * Apply consistent access\-control and governance patterns across enterprise data platforms and industrial analytics environments. * Embed automated validation checks as needed to enforce data quality. * Maintain Git\-based development workflows using branching, code reviews, and pull requests. * Implement automated CI/CD pipelines for code testing, data validation, configuration management, and repeatable environment deployments. * Support deployment and lifecycle management of data pipelines, transformation logic, semantic models, and analytics configurations across development, test, and production environments. * Maintain comprehensive documentation of data architectures, pipeline schemas, source\-to\-target mappings, contextual relationships, and lineage maps. **Preferred Experience** * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Engineering, or related field \+ 2 years of relevant experience; equivalent Master’s degree accepted; non\-relevant bachelor’s degree requires 5\+ years of equivalent hands\-on experience. * Experience working with: + SQL and Python for data engineering and transformation. + PySpark and Microsoft Fabric for lakehouse transformations.

measures, and dashboards for manufacturing and quality reporting (e.g., yield, defects, IPC, order status). * Gather, analyze, and document site requirements, and manage them through the change and reviews. * Support deployments and site replication across environments (DEV, TEST, PROD) with strict environment verification. * Troubleshoot data discrepancies, resolve RITMs and incidents, and English. **Required qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. * Experience working in a regulated pharmaceutical or life sciences environment (GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11\). * Strong SQL proficiency (T\-SQL / SQL Server) and relational data modeling. * Hands\-on experience with Power BI (Power Query, DAX, data modeling). * 3\+ years of experience in data analytics or reporting, ideally in pharmaceutical, biotech or medical device manufacturing. * Knowledge of GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11 and data integrity (ALCOA\+) principles. * Fluent in English, written and spoken. **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with MES platforms, ideally Rockwell PharmaSuite, or with batch records, EBR, and manufacturing execution data. * Experience with computer system validation (CSV) and documentation under a formal validation plan. * Python for data analysis and automation; familiarity with HTML/CSS/JS for lightweight web tools. * Cloud experience (Azure preferred), including Azure SQL, Azure Web Apps, and Azure AD authentication. * Familiarity with SQL Server high availability (Always On Availability Groups) and with Denodo or other data virtualization layers. * Experience with Agile practices, GitHub, and workflow automation (Power Automate). * Ability to review and recommend design patterns, performance optimization, and deployment strategies. * Knowledge of Data Governance, Master Data Management, and Business Intelligence concepts. * Spanish, Portuguese, Japanese, or other language skills are a plus for working with global sites (English required). **Soft skills** * Attention to detail and a strong quality mindset in a regulated setting. * Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ownership: able to manage multiple deliverables, dependencies, and deadlines. * Curiosity and willingness to challenge assumptions with data. * Clear communicator with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Self\-directed and organized; able to manage several site deliverables at once. * Comfortable working remotely with teams across time zones.

jobs.description: **JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way**. Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward. Overview The Operations Manager, Governance sits at the critical intersection of operational excellence, process re\-engineering, and digital innovation. Reporting directly to the Bay Area Governance Lead, the role is responsible for converting strategic governance frameworks into scalable digital workflows, custom applications, and standardized operational procedures. While rooted in Bay Area account operations, this position drives cross\-regional alignment, incubating novel solutions locally before scaling them across the broader AMER region. Rather than maintaining static administration, this role is built for a proactive builder and systems thinker. This is a dynamic, evolving account that cares as much about launching to iterate as it does about establishing deep operational rigor. As account priorities and operating models evolve, role responsibilities are expected to fluidly shift. The ideal candidate embraces ambiguity, tests Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) to rapidly address operational friction, and methodically embeds lasting institutional discipline. Key Responsibilities A. Technology, AI Enablement \& Continuous Process Improvement * AI \& Workflow Integration: Identify, evaluate, and operationalize emerging AI capabilities (such as LLM\-driven synthesis, document processing, and predictive analytics) alongside enterprise productivity tools to automate repetitive governance workflows and accelerate decision\-making. * Continuous Improvement Engine: Conduct ongoing audits of account\-level workflows to identify bottlenecks, redundancies, and manual friction points; engineer lean, automated alternatives that enhance team velocity and accuracy. * Tool Development Lifecycle: Lead the product lifecycle—from business requirements gathering and rapid prototyping to UAT and deployment—for custom governance tools, approval routing portals (e.g., headcount, travel, contract changes), and self\-service trackers using Google Workspace, AppSheet, Smartsheets, and low\-code platforms. * Data Hygiene \& Architecture: Establish automated validation checks, schema standardization, and data pipelines connecting operational systems (e.g., CMMS/Corrigo, CRM databases) to ensure a single source of truth for executive reporting. jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description: At Journal Technologies, we believe our technology can be a force for good in the world ensuring the proper and efficient functioning of some of the most foundational aspects of society \- the courts and justice system. We create and implement enterprise software that supports the administration of justice, currently in the United States, Canada, and Australia. While our eSeries product suite enables governments and their employees to deliver continued foundational court processes, our R\&D focuses on leveraging emerging possibilities with technology to improve access and efficiency. Headquartered in Los Angeles, Journal Technologies is a long\-time, wholly\-owned subsidiary of Daily Journal Corporation (NASDAQ: DJCO). We also have a major office in Logan, Utah, a team in Melbourne, Australia, an office in Victoria, Canada and a growing number of remote staff across North America. Under our next generation of leadership, we're implementing a vision for the company that prioritizes building an extraordinary workplace with empowered people at the heart of our business. Great people want to collaborate with great people, and we are actively looking for smart, motivated people who care deeply about the work they do. **Chief Technology Officer** The Chief Technology Officer leads technology strategy, architecture, product development, and engineering across Journal Technologies. This leader sets and champions the technical vision, brings strong product and engineering thinking to every initiative, and ensures the company's platforms remain secure, reliable, and positioned for growth. The CTO works cross\-functionally with every department and plays a central role in building out the new technology team described above, helping recruit talent and shape how new ideas are evaluated, developed, and scaled. **What you'll do** * Develop and lead a multi\-year technology vision and roadmap aligned with the long\-term goals of Journal Technologies and drive it across the organization. * Bring a customer\-centric, problem\-first approach to product development, ensuring teams deeply understand user needs before committing to solutions. * Identify emerging technologies and market opportunities that strengthen existing products and open new areas of value for the company. * Advise executive leadership on technology investments, build\-versus\-buy decisions, and potential acquisitions or partnerships. * Define architectural vision and principles, ensuring systems are configurable, repeatable, scalable, secure, appropriately modular, and engineered to upgrade and evolve over time. * Apply platform thinking by promoting reusable services, APIs, and shared components that serve multiple products and business units. * Own the modernization of the Company's technology portfolio, balancing investment in existing platforms with technical debt, modernization, consolidation, and next\-generation capabilities. * Lead the engineering organization with a culture grounded in ownership, craftsmanship, continuous improvement, and pragmatic decision\-making. * Maintain and advance modern engineering practices, balancing speed of delivery with quality, reliability, and security. * Support our organization\-wide transition to Agile methodologies and Scrum\-at\-Scale. * Serve as a true partner to other departments, building alignment on priorities, timelines, and resources across the organization. * Translate complex technical concepts into clear business terms for non\-technical stakeholders, and bring business context back to technical teams. * Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing technology organization, including organizational design, leadership development, succession planning, workforce strategy, and recruitment of critical technical capabilities needed for the Company's future. * Ensure appropriate standards for security, privacy, compliance, and data governance, including requirements common to courts, government agencies, and criminal justice systems (such as CJIS). * Oversee technology investment, performance, and operational resilience, ensuring resources are aligned with priorities and systems remain reliable, scalable, and prepared for business continuity. * Establish effective technology governance and risk management, partnering with Security, Cloud Operations, IT, Legal, and business leaders to manage architectural, cybersecurity, regulatory, and third\-party technology risks. **Qualifications \& Skills** * 12\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in senior technical leadership roles (CTO, VP of Engineering, Head of Engineering, or similar). * Proven experience leading and scaling engineering organizations and enterprise software platforms. * Deep expertise in software and systems architecture, including distributed systems, cloud\-native design, APIs, and data platforms. * Strong product sense, with experience making customer\-driven product decisions. * A track record of setting a compelling technical vision and rallying teams and executives around it. * Proven success working cross\-functionally, with excellent communication skills and the ability to engage executives, engineers, customers, and partners alike. * Background in government technology, justice or court systems, legal technology, or other regulated public sector markets is highly desirable. * Experience incubating new products or working in a startup, innovation lab, or venture environment is preferred. * Hands\-on experience applying AI, machine learning, and data\-driven technologies to real products is preferred. * Experience working within Agile teams or formal training in Scrum or Agile methodologies * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus. * Given the highly collaborative nature of this role, preference will be shown for candidates able to work on a regular/hybrid basis from our Los Angeles headquarters. The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed in this job function. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties; additional responsibilities may be assigned. At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are U.S. (or potentially Canadian) citizens or permanent residents due to employment authorization requirements. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or work authorization support for this position. **Why Journal Technologies?** Visit www.journaltech.com/careers for more information, but highlights include: * Competitive compensation \* The salary range posted for this position reflects a good\-faith estimate of the base salary we reasonably expect to offer a successful candidate upon hire. Final compensation will be based on job\-related factors, including qualifications, experience, geographic location, and internal compensation considerations. * Quality medical, dental, and vision coverage. * Discretionary profit sharing for eligible employees. * Competitive paid time off as well as paid holiday time. * 401(k) retirement (US) and GRRSP (CDN) programs. * Annual professional development funds – minimum $1,500 USD annual per employee (amount depends on role; however, our goal is to invest in our people). * Book subscriptions with an extensive library in each office for personal and professional growth. * Travel opportunities between Journal Technology offices and to interesting client locations. We provide technology that matters in the world, and we're a stable employer comprised of quality people, with a commitment to investing in our people. **The pay range for this role is:** 205,000 \- 275,000 USD per year(JTI Los Angeles, USA) 200,000 \- 270,000 USD per year(United States (Remote)) 200,000 \- 270,000 USD per year(JTI Logan, USA) 225,000 \- 275,000 CAD per year(JTI Victoria, Canada)

jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineer
jobs.description: **Location:** Any US Office including Boston, MA ### **LOCATION INFORMATION** In order to be considered for a position, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the location specified without relocation support or visa sponsorship now or in the future, unless explicitly noted otherwise in the position overview. If a position does not specify a location, applicants whose primary residence is a location where JSI is registered to conduct business will be considered: * **U.S. Locations:** AZ, AR, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, HI, IN, IL, LA, ME, MD, MA, MI, MN, NH, NJ, NM, NY, NC, PA, RI, TN, TX, VT, VA, WA, DC, and WI. * **Global Locations:** Bangladesh, Benin, Cambodia, Cote d'Ivoire, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Ethiopia, Haiti, Laos, Madagascar, Mali, Mozambique, Niger, Nigeria, Pakistan, Tanzania, Uganda, and U.S. **Position Category:** Direct hire, paid in US **Posting Date:** 11/11/2026 **Deadline Date:** 11/24/2026 **Salary Range**: $94,774 \- $166,270 Commensurate with experience and location. #### **Description** **Organizational overview** JSI is dedicated to strengthening health and education systems to improve the lives of individuals, families, and communities. We believe all people should have what they need to live their healthiest lives and reach their full potential. To accomplish this, JSI works hand\-in\-hand with government agencies, community organizations, and the private sector to design pragmatic strategies for complex problems. We drive measurable impact in public health, health care, and education to enhance the well\-being of people in the United States and around the world. As a global organization, JSI has designed, delivered, and scaled programs in more than 50 countries worldwide. In the U.S., JSI has worked in evaluation, training and technical assistance, policy, and strategy in all 50 states and has teams in Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, DC, Georgia, Colorado, and California. **Position overview** As part of the Corporate Information Technology team, the AI Engineer serves as an enterprise catalyst for internal AI adoption, connecting technical execution with practical governance. This role designs, builds, and deploys practical AI\-driven solutions—including prompt architectures, automated workflows, and light application integrations—to resolve operational bottlenecks across divisions. Blending a hands\-on builder mindset with technical oversight, the AI Engineer ensures all internal AI implementations achieve measurable operational efficiencies while adhering to strict safety, security, and ethical standards. This full\-time role reports to the Chief Information Technology Officer and can be located in the U.S. where JSI is registered. #### **RESPONSIBILITIES** Results \& Execution * Creative Problem Solving: Actively seek out complex internal operational challenges across the organization, applying a creative and analytical mindset to design tailored AI interventions that eliminate redundancies and save staff time. * Prototyping \& Development: Design, build, test, and deploy practical AI solutions, including prompt engineering architectures, custom GPTs, workflow automations, and light application integrations via APIs, low\-code/no\-code platforms, or scripts. * Implementation \& Rollout: Lead end\-to\-end implementation of approved AI tools, working alongside business unit leads to embed AI into daily workflows and track operational ROI/efficiency gains. * Access Control \& Asset Lifecycle: Define user permissions, data access controls, and usage monitoring protocols across all regional and divisional teams. People \& Influence * Use Case Discovery: Partner with division leadership to evaluate internal processes and pinpoint high\-impact opportunities for AI integration. * User Enablement: Serve as an internal champion for AI, generating excitement and buy\-in across all levels of the organization. Develop internal prompt libraries, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and targeted training programs to elevate AI literacy and adoption across teams. Thought \& Strategy * AI Strategy: In collaboration with IT leadership develop and execute JSI’s AI strategy, aligning technical initiatives with long\-term enterprise goals. * Environment Architecture \& Management: Provide operational oversight of the company’s enterprise AI environment, including vendor platforms (e.g., OpenAI Enterprise, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Anthropic), internal tools, and API usage across global sites. * Vendor \& Tool Evaluation: Benchmark, select, and manage relationships with third\-party AI vendors, ensuring platform reliability, scalability, alignment with corporate strategy, and cost optimization. Expertise \& Growth * Framework Enforcement: Establish and enforce guardrails for safe, transparent, and ethical AI deployment across the global organization. * Data Security Partnership: Collaborate closely with InfoSec and Legal teams to ensure enterprise data remains secure, non\-public data is protected from LLM training sets, and output integrity is maintained. * Stay Current: Maintain subject matter expertise in modern generative AI architectures, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) concepts, and emerging automation technologies to continuously modernize internal toolkits. Finance \& Resource Management * Risk \& Compliance Reviews: Evaluate prospective AI use cases for data privacy risks, intellectual property concerns, algorithmic bias, and compliance with emerging regional regulations (e.g., EU AI Act, global privacy laws). * Financial Acumen :Conduct cost\-benefit and procurement analyses for off\-the\-shelf and custom AI tools, tracking quantified labor efficiencies to ensure execution within approved budget parameters. #### **QUALIFICATIONS** **Education, experience, skills, and competencies** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Business Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Formal background or certification in AI Ethics, Enterprise Risk Management, or IT Governance (e.g., CRISC, CGEIT) is preferred. * 8\+ years of relevant, progressive experience in technology deployment, digital transformation, or systems engineering including leadership experience; with 2\+ years of direct experience building with and implementing Generative AI tools in an enterprise environment. Experience scaling AI solutions across a global organization with multi\-regional compliance needs is preferred. * Demonstrated track record of identifying business pain points and successfully deploying technology to resolve them; and passion for operational efficiency and creative problem solving. * Demonstrated skill in prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) concepts, and building workflows using modern AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, Make/Zapier, or internal platform builders). * Proficiency in basic scripting (Python, JavaScript) for API integration and data processing is preferred. Familiarity with enterprise automation suites (UiPath, Power Automate) integrated with AI modules is preferred. * Deep knowledge of data security, privacy standards (GDPR, CCPA), IP protection, and ethical AI principles. * Exceptional analytical and cross\-cultural communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to mentor colleagues and partner effectively across matrixed technical and non\-technical teams. **Language** * Fluent oral and written English communication skills. Fluency in a second language (French, Spanish, Portuguese, or others) is preferred. **Travel expectation** * Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally, if necessary (up to 10%). **Work environment** * Mostly operates a computer in a virtual first environment. * Ability to maintain a comfortable and ergonomic posture while working. **Work authorization/visa requirements/sponsorship** * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States, without visa sponsorship now or in the future. **Other duties** * Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. **Interested candidates should submit their resumes and cover letters online by 11/24/2026\.** **No phone calls please.** **Principals only please.**

Jabil is seeking a **Test Engineer III** to join our team in Northern Kentucky. This role will be a key contributor to the transformative growth of our Advanced Compute team by applying innovative approaches to developing end\-customer product solutions. The Test Engineer III will drive improvements in product quality and efficiency, playing a pivotal role during the integration phase and supporting both **new and sustaining AI/ML, GPGPU, and hardware accelerator\-based server, networking, and storage platforms** . **SUMMARY** The **Test Engineer III** is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining test procedures, hardware, and software in a dynamic server manufacturing environment. The Test Engineer III also identifies, diagnoses, and resolves hardware and software challenges during testing and integration processes. Advanced knowledge of statistical analysis for data\-driven decision\-making. * **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** Include the following categories (other duties may be assigned): Essential Skills \& Knowledge : * Proficiency in scripting languages, hardware and network troubleshooting, and Linux command\-line operations. * Strong understanding of networking concepts, including WAN, LAN, switches, transceivers, and optical fibers. * Expertise in computer/server hardware and software integration, diagnostics, and repair. * Experience with performance and functional testing of complex compute systems. * Analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to make data\-driven decisions and recommend improvements. Excellent communication skills to explain complex concepts effectively. * Technical Responsibilities : * Design, develop, and maintain test procedures, hardware, and software in a dynamic server manufacturing environment. * Conduct failure analysis to identify root causes and implement corrective actions. * Diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues during testing and integration. * Develop and maintain automation scripts for testing, data collection, and performance evaluation. Lead test engineering staff to deliver high\-quality results, fostering a culture of technical excellence. * Leadership \& Collaboration : * Train and mentor engineers, technicians, and support staff on testing processes and procedures. * Serve as a technical liaison for assigned customers, ensuring clear communication and collaboration. * Drive continuous improvement by researching and implementing new testing methods and technologies. Create and validate training materials to support team competency. * Performance Management : * Set measurable goals for the team and monitor progress. * Provide constructive feedback, coaching, and recognition to team members. Provide regular updates on cost trends and strategies to improve value. * **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Focus (Center for Technology in Education)
jobs.description: Affiliated Office Address Baltimore, MD, United States Requisition ID 123009 Date Created November 09, 2026 Job Family Information Systems, IT Job Subfamily Applications Development Job Function Information Technology Exempt Status Exempt Shift Type Casual / On Call Schedule Monday \- Friday, 9:00 am \- 4:30 pm Worksite 01\-MD:Homewood Campus Work Modality Remote: Not on\-site or \< 10% of hours worked on\-site The Center for Technology in Education in the School of Education at Johns Hopkins University seeks a ***Software Engineer \- AI Focus*** to continue the development of AI\-powered data tools for early intervention programs. In this role, the Software Engineer extends the build of an interactive dashboard that helps Part C teams explore their Child Outcomes Summary (COS) data and receive guidance grounded in that data and in national technical assistance resources. The position owns the application end to end, from data processing and the user interface to its AI capabilities and their evaluation. The role involves working independently with a domain expert who calibrates the work at key milestones, and calls for sound engineering judgment, fluency with generative AI, and vigilance over the privacy of sensitive education data. Responsible for the creation, implementation, maintenance, performance, production support and documentation of various departmental and enterprise\-wide application systems. This includes but is not limited to the installation, modification, and testing of new and/or upgraded applications (packages or homegrown), operating systems, file structures, hardware, communication devices, and productivity tools. Applies analysis techniques and procedures to gather and then translate business requirements into functional/technical specifications and designs. Using functional specifications and designs, produces all or part of the deliverables. Maintains databases and application system code. Responsible for full life cycle of medium to large sized complex projects; strong technical skills; strong ability to understand complex business processes. Develops solutions based on extensive technical knowledge, skills and experience; influences client towards innovative/integrated solutions. **Specific Duties \& Responsibilities** * The responsibilities listed below are typical examples of the work performed by this position. * Not all duties assigned to this position are included, nor is it expected that everyone in this position will be assigned every job responsibility. *Analysis \& Requirements Gathering* * Define complex business/clinical/education problems by meeting with clients to observe and understand current processes and the issues related to those processes. Provide written documentation of findings to share with the client and other IT colleagues. * Gather complex system requirements by meeting with clients and researching existing technology to understand the business requirements and possible solutions for new applications. *Design \& Development* * Develop detailed tasks and project plans by analyzing project scope and milestones for complex projects to ensure product is delivered quickly according to software lifecycle standards. * Write functional/technical specifications from the complex system requirements, putting them into functional and technical descriptions for use by programmers and business analysts to develop technical solutions. * Develop/change data input, files/database structures, data transformation, algorithms, and data output by using appropriate computer language/tools to provide technical solutions for complex application development tasks. * Document code and associated processes by adhering to development methodologies, adding code comments and appropriate documentation to various knowledge\-base system(s) to simplify code maintenance and to improve support. * Provide monitoring and guidance in application design and development to more junior staff. * Provide thought leadership in designing and developing innovative integrated solutions. *Testing \& Documentation* * Create and document complex test scenarios using the appropriate testing tools to validate and verify application functionality. * Test all changes by using the appropriate complex test scenarios to ensure all delivered solutions work as expected and errors are handled in a meaningful way. * Author and maintain documentation by writing audience\-appropriate materials to serve as technical and/or end\-user references. * Mentor junior staff in testing tools and technologies by reviewing their work. *Implementation \& Maintenance* * Implement changes by adhering to the change management policies and procedures for any given project to communicate to all parties the nature, significance, and risk factors of the solution. * Monitor changes and resolve complex problems by responding as they occur, by reviewing all processing and output of the newly implemented solution, and by proactively ensuring yees' health, life, career and retirement. More information can be found here: https://hr.jhu.edu/benefits\-worklife/. ***Education and Experience Equivalency*** Please refer to the job description above to see which forms of equivalency are permitted for this position. If permitted, equivalencies will follow these guidelines: JHU Equivalency Formula: 30 undergraduate degree credits (semester hours) or 18 graduate degree credits may substitute for one year of experience. Additional related experience may substitute for required education on the same basis. For jobs where equivalency is permitted, up to two years of non\-related college course work may be applied towards the total minimum education/experience required for the respective job. ***Applicants Completing Studies*** Applicants who do not meet the posted requirements but are completing their final academic semester/quarter will be considered eligible for employment and may be asked to provide additional information confirming their academic completion date. ***Background Checks*** The successful candidate(s) for this position will be subject to a pre\-employment background check. A prior criminal history does not automatically preclude candidates from employment at Johns Hopkins University. In accordance with applicable law, the university will review, on an individual basis, the date of a candidate's conviction, the nature of the conviction and how the conviction relates to an essential job\-related qualification or function. ***Diversity and Inclusion*** The Johns Hopkins University values diversity, equity and inclusion and advances these through our key strategic framework, the JHU Roadmap on Diversity and Inclusion. ***Equal Opportunity Employer*** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. ***EEO is the Law*** https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023\-06/22\-088\_EEOC\_KnowYourRights6\.12ScreenRdr.pdf ***Accommodation Information*** If you are interested in applying for employment with The Johns Hopkins University and require special assistance or accommodation during any part of the pre\-employment process, please contact the Talent Acquisition Office at jhurecruitment@jhu.edu. For TTY users, call via Maryland Relay or dial 711\. For more information about workplace accommodations or accessibility at Johns Hopkins University, please visit: https://accessibility.jhu.edu/. ***Vaccine Requirements*** Johns Hopkins University requires all faculty, staff, and students to receive the seasonal flu vaccine.
