The marketplace DoW uses to procure counter\-drone systems to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI\-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks, not years. This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies. Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital. **Location** New York, NY (Hybrid). In office Monday to Thursday. Candidates must live in or be able to commute to New York City. **The Role** Most companies building with AI connect someone else's models to their software. Kaizen's AI\-native platform turns requirements into working applications, and today much of that intelligence comes from general\-purpose models that carry capabilities we don't need, lack knowledge we do, and leave us and our customers paying frontier\-model token costs for intelligence we don't control. This role changes that. You'll fine\-tune, adapt and distill open\-weight models into specialized intelligence Kaizen owns, and prove where it beats the general\-purpose alternative. The goal isn't the biggest model or the most papers: it's public\-sector software that works better, costs less to run, and is harder to replicate. **What You'll Do** * Fine\-tune, adapt and distill open\-weight models for requirements interpretation, code generation, repository understanding, structured output and software validation. * Own the experiment loop: curate datasets, build training pipelines, and test architectures and techniques until a promising idea becomes a working model. * Build evaluations on real software engineering tasks that set baselines, expose failure modes, and separate real gains from benchmark noise. * Work with platform engineers to find where current models fall short, then build the capabilities that close those gaps and ship them into production. * Experiment with supervised fine\-tuning, synthetic data, preference optimization and reinforcement learning to improve model behavior on specialized tasks. * Deliver applications built around each customer's needs without frontier\-model token spend, so public budgets go to residents, not inference. * Lay the groundwork (datasets, evals, research practices) for Kaizen to eventually train its own models from scratch. **What You'll Bring** * Hands\-on experience training, fine\-tuning or adapting language models. You've worked with model weights, not just model APIs or prompts. * Strong software engineering fundamentals. You build reliable training pipelines, debug complex systems, and write code other engineers build on. * Strong Python and PyTorch, with a working understanding of transformer architectures, tokenization and language model training. * Something you've built that shows real model engineering ability: a fine\-tuned model, an original training approach, or a meaningful open\-source ML contribution. Industry, research or independent work all count; demonstrated ability matters more than years or credentials. **Strong Candidates May Also...** * Have fine\-tuned models for code generation, program synthesis or repository understanding. * Design experiments and evaluation sets that tell a meaningful improvement from noise or overfitting. * Bring experience with synthetic data, distillation, quantization, or preference optimization and RL with verifiable rewards. * Have contributed to open\-source model development, published applied ML research, or reproduced significant research results. **Don't Apply If...** * Your model experience is prompt engineering and API calls. * You'd rather publish a result than ship a model people use every day. * You hand off notebooks and expect someone else to make them run in production. * You assume the biggest model is the right answer and don't want to think about cost. Residents and public servants rely on the software we build because they don't have another option. The models underneath it have to earn that. **What Kaizen Offers** ---------------------- **Health \& Insurance** * 100% coverage across the board: medical through Oxford/United (Gold and Platinum PPO plans), dental through Guardian PPO, and vision through Beam — all fully covered for employees, with 100% coverage for dependents. * $100,000 in fully paid life insurance. FSA and Dependent Care FSA. * One Medical membership, on us — same\-day primary care, 24/7 virtual visits, and offices all over the city. * Fertility and family\-building support through Carrot. * 401(k) through Guideline, with a 2% company match. **Family \& Time Off** * 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents. 10 weeks fully paid for non\-birthing parents. * Unlimited PTO, with a two\-week minimum (we mean it when we say take time off!) * Closed for all federal holidays. * Company\-wide winter break the week of Christmas. * Company offsites throughout the year. **Office \& Remote Setup** * Up to $750 one\-time home office or desk setup stipend for NYC\-based employees. $500 for remote employees. * $50/month commuter benefit (company contribution). * Expensed lunch while in the office. * Dinner and Uber rides home will be expensed if you choose to work in the office past 7pm. * Company\-provided laptop of your choice. **Wellness** * NYC employees: Fully covered gym membership at Grindhouse — right across the street from our office at 47 W 17th St (and in Williamsburg). A $225/month value, on us. * Non\-NYC employees: $100 per month, dedicated to gym / physical fitness reimbursement. **Stipends** * $100/month utility stipend. * $250/quarter home cleaning stipend * $500/year professional development. * $250/year recreation. * $300/quarter pet care stipend. Compensation Range: $240K \- $280K

jobs.title: Help Desk Technician
jobs.description: Kelley Create is a dynamic and innovative business technology company dedicated to helping our partners grow their businesses while supporting the wild success of our co\-workers and ourselves. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional customer service and are committed to driving growth and success in our industry. **Summary** The Help Desk Technician is primarily responsible for providing helpdesk support for client end users, which may include onsite or remote diagnosis and repair, performing planned system maintenance on client networks, and troubleshooting support requests and systems analysis, including consulting with users, to determine hardware, software, or system functional specifications. Hardware may include workstations, printers, servers, firewalls, switches, and phones. Support requests may entail tier I/II issues related to active directory management, line of business applications, routing/switching, server and network hardware, or their associated services and roles. **Essential functions of the job** * Provide IT support relating to technical issues involving Microsoft’s core business applications and operating systems * Support of disaster recovery solutions * Provide basic technical support at the network level: WAN and LAN connectivity, routers, firewalls, and security * Provide basic remote access solution implementation and support: VPN, Terminal Services, and Citrix * Monitor remote monitoring and management system alerts and notifications; respond accordingly through service tickets. * Perform system documentation maintenance and review in ConnectWise * Respond to queries professionally, timely and accurately. Communicate with customers as required including keeping them informed of incident progress or notifying them of impending changes or agreed outages. * Improve customer service, perception, and satisfaction * Work with the Service Desk Dispatcher to ensure requests are routed to the proper resource to be resolved quickly and efficiently * Escalate service requests that require engineer\-level support * Enter time and expenses in ConnectWise according to company procedures * Complete assigned training materials and blueprints on the ConnectWise University * Work through project tickets and phases in ConnectWise as assigned by a Project Manager * Enter all work as service or project tickets into ConnectWise * Maintain positive, cooperative, and team\-oriented relationships with co\-workers, supervisors, managers and others you come into contact with through your job. * Other duties as assigned. **Competencies:** To perform the job successfully, an individual must demonstrate the following competencies to perform the essential functions of this position. * **Customer Focus**: The individual needs to demonstrate understanding and compassion for concerns and issues. The individual should promptly address customer inquiries and complaints and go above and beyond to ensure customer satisfaction. * **Communication Skills**—Clearly and effectively communicate with customers and team members. Writes concise, clear, and professional emails and messages. Pays full attention to customers, understands their needs, and responds appropriately. * **Problem\-Solving Skills**: The individual identifies the root cause of customer issues and develops effective solutions. They think outside the box to resolve customer problems and improve service. They make sound decisions quickly to address customer needs and issues. * **Time Management:** The individual effectively prioritizes tasks to manage multiple customer inquiries and issues. Completes tasks. * **Adaptability**—The individual adapts to changing customer needs, policies, and technologies. Remains calm and effective under pressure during high\-volume periods. Quickly learn new procedures and systems as required. **Skills and abilities** * Ability and desire to provide exceptional customer service * Ability to act with a sense of urgency while paying attention to detail * Ability to multi\-task effectively and thrive in a fast\-paced environment * Ability to communicate in a positive, effective, and efficient manner * Ability to work independently and as part of a team * Ability to prepare, organize, and present information to groups of people * Ability to match solutions to prospective client needs * Ability to work after\-hours and on\-call shifts * Technical skillset in hardware setup and troubleshooting * Technical skillset in Windows operating systems: Windows (XP,7,8,10\) Windows Server (SBS,2008 R2,2012, etc.) * Proficient with typing, use of Microsoft Office Applications, and the Internet **Qualifications:** * Minimum of one (1\) year of experience in an IT bench, support, or consulting role * Minimum of one (1\) year of experience with Microsoft Exchange \& Microsoft Active Directory * Minimum of one (1\) year of experience with LAN and WAN configuration, setup, and troubleshooting * Minimum of one (1\) year of experience providing excellent exceptional service directly to end users * A BA/BS in related field is preferred * One or more of the following industry certifications Net\+, MCSA/E, MOS, CCNA, are preferred * Must have reliable transportation To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. **Language Skills:** Read and interpret documents such as safety rules, invoices, SOP, and instructions; write routine reports and correspondence. Effectively present information in one\-on\-one situations and small group situations to customers or vendors, and other employees. **Math Skills:** Add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals; compute rate, ratio, and percent and draw and interpret bar graphs. **Reasoning Ability:** Apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form; to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations. Identifies problems, gathers information, and offers solutions. **Computer Skills** Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook is required. Proficiency with email is required. **Physical requirements essential to perform the duties of the job** * Frequently communicates with co\-workers, customers, and vendors in person, on the telephone, and the computer to aid * Frequently operates a motor vehicle while traveling to client site * Frequently exposed to outside elements when traveling to client site * Frequently sits and/or stands for long periods * Frequently uses the computer with fingers and hands for documentation, research, and troubleshooting * Frequently work in a well\-lit, tempered room * Frequently views the computer to perform duties * Frequently bends, stoops, kneels, or climbs when installing or moving computers, monitors, servers, etc. * Occasionally lifts objects such as office supplies, computers, monitors, and servers that can weigh up to 50 pounds While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for long periods. The employee is also frequently required to talk and hear on the telephone and in person with individuals and groups. The employee must be able to reach with hands and arms. Type frequently throughout the day. Vision is required as the incumbent is required to read and respond to documents in hard copy and electronic form. **Competitive Benefits Package Include:** * Medical Insurance * Dental/Vision Insurance * Life Insurance * Flexible Spending Account Options * Supplemental insurance * 401K with company match * Profit Sharing upon goal attainment * Paid Time Off * Paid Holidays * Ongoing training opportunities Must have reliable transportation and pass pre\-employment screening. **Equal Opportunity Employer** **Kelley Create** is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, or veteran status. In addition to federal law requirements, Kelley Create complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

jobs.title: Lead AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **About Kendra Scott** We are a fashion\-lifestyle brand of big dreams, colorful confidence, and inspired design. Founded on Family, Fashion and Philanthropy, we believe that our employees and customers are the heart and soul of our brand, and that giving back is the truest form of success. Fashion meets innovation in the design of our two state\-of\-the\-art facilities based in the heart of Austin, Texas, and overflows into the design of our growing retail environment across the country. **Position Overview** Kendra Scott is seeking a Lead AI/ML Engineer to advance how we use artificial intelligence to improve business performance and reduce manual work. Your primary focus will be partnering with business teams to design and deliver AI\-enabled workflows. You will also maintain existing machine learning models and conduct prioritized advanced analysis to support business decisions. As a hands\-on technical lead, you will guide solutions from discovery through production support, working with shared data engineering, application development, DevOps and QA resources. You will help establish our AI engineering practices while building solutions directly. The Vice President, Digital Technology owns program direction and prioritization. Functional process owners remain accountable for business process decisions, acceptance and adoption. This role provides technical input into governance reviews and implements approved requirements. **Responsibilities** Build AI\-enabled workflows and applications * Partner with business process owners to understand current workflows, identify automation opportunities and establish measurable outcomes. * Determine when to use AI, conventional automation or existing enterprise capabilities. * Design and build workflows that connect enterprise applications and data through APIs and other integration methods. * Develop AI assistants and agents that retrieve information, support decisions and execute approved business actions. * Incorporate human review and approval where business judgment or risk requires it. * Work with business owners to validate solutions, support adoption and measure realized benefits. * Maintain deployed solutions and improve them based on operating performance and user feedback. Deliver applied data science and machine learning * Translate prioritized business questions into analytical approaches and predictive modeling opportunities. * Conduct advanced analysis to explain business performance and recommend actions. * Develop and validate machine learning models using appropriate statistical methods. * Maintain existing models, monitor performance and address changes in accuracy or business relevance. * Communicate findings, assumptions and model limitations in language business partners can use. * Partner with data engineering to ensure models and AI applications use reliable data. Establish production controls and support practices * Evaluate AI outputs and workflow behavior against defined acceptance criteria before deployment. * Implement approved access permissions, including limits on the actions automated workflows can perform. * Establish audit logs, monitoring and exception handling. * Design workflows so they can be stopped safely, with recovery or reversal procedures where feasible. * Apply data protection requirements in partnership with Information Security and designated governance owners. * Coordinate deployment and production support with shared technical resources, including clear escalation paths and backup coverage. * Monitor solution operating costs and recommend changes that improve value. Build a sustainable delivery capability * Establish reusable approaches for development, testing and documentation. * Maintain code in shared repositories with version control and appropriate review practices. * Document solution dependencies, operating procedures and known limitations. * Transfer knowledge to designated backup resources so production support does not depend on one person. * Work with PMO and business owners to estimate effort and manage delivery through a prioritized backlog. * Provide technical input into AI technology evaluations and governance reviews. **Our Ideal Candidate Will Have** * Typically five or more years of relevant experience in applied data science, machine learning engineering or software engineering, with ownership of production solutions. * Demonstrated production experience in both predictive modeling and AI\-enabled application or workflow development. * A strong foundation in statistics, model validation and interpretation of business results. * Strong Python and SQL skills. * Hands\-on experience building applications with large language models and evaluating their outputs. * Experience integrating enterprise systems through APIs and working with cloud services. * Experience deploying and supporting production applications or models, including automated testing and monitoring. * Ability to design appropriate controls for unreliable AI outputs and automated business actions. * Ability to work directly with business partners, clarify requirements and explain technical tradeoffs plainly. * Sound judgment about when to build a custom solution and when an existing capability meets the need. * Ability to prioritize competing demands and communicate capacity constraints. * Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience. **Experience that would be valuable** * Retail or ecommerce experience, particularly in customer analytics, merchandising, marketing or business operations. * Experience with AWS and Snowflake. * Experience with workflow automation platforms or enterprise integration tools. * Experience building applications that retrieve information from enterprise sources to inform AI responses. * Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Salesforce or Zendesk integrations. * Experience measuring automation benefits, including time saved and improvements in process quality. *We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.*

jobs.title: Sr. Full Stack .NET Developer
jobs.description: Keyhole Software is looking for a seasoned Full Stack .NET Developer who builds modern web applications from the database to the browser and uses AI\-assisted development tools as a natural part of how they work every day. You'll join a team of senior consultants delivering high\-quality software for enterprise clients, where your experience, judgment, and ability to ship quickly with AI in your toolkit will make a real impact. * **Title:** Senior Full Stack .NET Developer Consultant * **Location:** Remote within the United States. Preference given to candidates in the Kansas City metro area, followed by Kansas, Missouri, or Nebraska. * **Eligibility:** Must be authorized to work and live in the U.S. without current or future visa sponsorship. We do not accept Corp\-to\-Corp (C2C), 1099, or third\-party candidates. Apply Now **About the Role** ------------------ As a Senior Full Stack .NET Developer Consultant, you'll design, build, and modernize business\-critical applications for Keyhole clients. Our engagements typically involve C\# and .NET on the back end, a modern JavaScript framework on the front end, SQL\-based data stores, and cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS. We're looking for someone who is comfortable owning features end to end: understanding the business problem, designing the solution, writing clean and testable code, and seeing it through to production. **This is a client\-facing consulting role.** You'll work directly with client stakeholders, product owners, and technical leaders, often as the primary point of contact for your work. That means joining video calls regularly (camera on), leading conversations about requirements and technical decisions, giving demos, and keeping clients informed without needing someone else to translate for you. Strong spoken and written English communication is essential. **AI\-assisted development is a core expectation of this role, not a nice\-to\-have.** Keyhole consultants use tools like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, and ChatGPT to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and explore solutions faster. We need developers who already use these tools daily, know how to prompt and review AI output critically, and can explain how AI fits into their workflow without sacrificing quality, security, or maintainability. **Your Responsibilities** ------------------------- * Design, develop, and maintain full stack applications using C\#, .NET, and ASP.NET Core * Build responsive, user\-friendly front ends using Angular, React, or a similar modern framework * Develop and consume RESTful APIs and integrate with internal and third\-party services * Design and optimize relational databases, queries, and stored procedures (SQL Server or similar) * Use AI\-assisted development tools daily to write, refactor, test, and document code more efficiently * Critically review AI\-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability * Modernize legacy .NET Framework applications to current .NET versions and cloud\-ready architectures * Write unit and integration tests and contribute to CI/CD pipelines * Deploy and support applications in Azure or AWS environments * Participate in code reviews and help raise the technical bar for the team * Serve as a trusted, client\-facing consultant, interfacing directly with client stakeholders, product owners, and technical leaders * Participate in and lead video calls (camera on) for standups, requirements sessions, design reviews, and status updates * Present demos and walk clients through completed work, technical approaches, and recommendations * Ask the right questions to clarify requirements, uncover the real business need, and recommend solutions * Communicate progress, risks, and technical tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences * Write clear, professional emails, documentation, and status updates for client and internal audiences * Mentor other developers and share best practices, including effective use of AI tools **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * **7\+ years of professional software development experience**, with a strong focus on **C\# and .NET** * **Full stack experience** building production web applications on both the back end and front end * Hands\-on experience with **ASP.NET Core**, Web API, and Entity Framework * Strong front\-end skills with **Angular, React, or Vue**, plus JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS * Solid **SQL Server** (or comparable relational database) experience, including query optimization * **Demonstrated, daily use of AI\-assisted development tools** (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or ChatGPT) in professional work * Ability to describe specific examples of how you've used AI tools to deliver features, debug issues, write tests, or modernize code * Experience with cloud platforms, preferably **Azure** (AWS also considered) * Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing practices * Strong understanding of software design principles, design patterns, and clean code * Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams * **Excellent verbal and written communication skills**, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical audiences * **Proven experience interfacing directly with clients or business stakeholders**, including leading meetings and presenting your work * Comfortable and professional on **video calls with your camera on**, including client meetings, demos, and team collaboration * Confidence to push back respectfully, raise risks early, and guide clients toward the right technical decisions **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience modernizing legacy .NET Framework, WebForms, or WCF applications * Experience with microservices, containerization (Docker), or Kubernetes * Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar DevOps tooling * Experience building or integrating AI/LLM features into applications (Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel, etc.) * Familiarity with message queues and event\-driven architecture (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, Kafka) * Familiarity with NoSQL databases such as Cosmos DB or MongoDB * Familiarity with application security best practices (OWASP, authentication/authorization, OAuth/OIDC) * Prior consulting or client\-facing experience * Microsoft or cloud certifications **What It’s Actually Like to Work at Keyhole** ---------------------------------------------- Our average employee tenure is 5\+ years, and some of our developers have been here more than a decade. Here's why people stay: * **You're an employee, not a contractor.** Every Keyhole consultant is a full\-time W2 employee. When a client project wraps up, you move to the next Keyhole project, ideally one that adds to your skills, instead of starting a job search. * **You work on a team, not alone.** Most projects are staffed with 2 to 7 Keyhole developers, so you'll have teammates who share your standards, review your code, and have your back with the client. * **You stay in code, not politics.** Our culture is developer\-centric. We keep the red tape to a minimum so you can focus on building great software. * **You won't get bored.** Over time you'll work on modernization, greenfield builds, project recoveries, and enhancements across a range of industries and tech stacks. * **You'll grow your reputation.** Keyhole developers have published 950\+ technical blog posts and white papers, and many speak at conferences. We'll help you do the same, including dry runs of your talk with the team. * **You'll keep learning.** Regular Lunch \& Learns let the team share what they're working on and what's new. **What We Offer** ----------------- **Compensation:** Based on experience and qualifications. * Medical insurance (traditional and HDHP options) * Dental and vision insurance * FSA and dependent care accounts * Life and disability insurance * 401(k) with discretionary employer contributions * Supplemental insurance options **How to Apply** ---------------- To apply, complete the form below. Be sure to include a short description (3 to 5 sentences) of how you use AI\-assisted development tools in your day\-to\-day work, including which tools you use and one specific example. Applications without this will not be considered.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Kimball Midwest, a national distributor of maintenance, repair, and operations products, is searching for an experienced Data Engineer to join our IT team. As a Kimball Midwest associate, you'll be part of a company built on long\-term growth and strong values. From $1 million in sales in 1983 to over $500 million today, our success has been driven by our people. Despite our growth, we have stayed true to our family\-owned and operated roots, where employees are recognized as individuals and our culture remains a top priority. The Data Engineer will work primarily within our Microsoft data ecosystem, designing pipelines, transforming large datasets, troubleshooting production issues, and partnering with business and technology teams to make data useful and accessible across the organization. This role is responsible for building and supporting reliable data solutions that make accurate, timely, and trusted data available for reporting, analytics, operational processes, and emerging AI capabilities. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, and support scalable ETL/ELT pipelines that integrate data from databases, APIs, business applications, files, and other internal and external sources. * Develop and optimize SQL, Python, and PySpark solutions to transform large datasets and make reliable data available for reporting and analytics. * Build and maintain data warehouses, data lakes, dimensional models, and related data structures within Microsoft Fabric and other enterprise data platforms. * Monitor and troubleshoot production data issues, including pipeline failures, unavailable data, processing delays, and performance bottlenecks, and implement long\-term solutions. * Partner with analysts, business stakeholders, architects, and technology teams to understand requirements and deliver secure, maintainable data solutions. * Participate in technical discussions, peer reviews, documentation, and continuous improvement efforts, including opportunities to responsibly use AI and automation. **Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, data integration, analytics engineering, or a related field. * Bachelor's degree in a computer\-related field or equivalent relevant experience. * Strong experience with SQL and Python/PySpark, including building and optimizing production data pipelines. * Experience with Spark and cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. * Strong knowledge of ETL/ELT, data warehouses and lakes, data modeling, data quality, and production support. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex data and pipeline issues and communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders. * Experience building and optimizing pipelines that process large\-scale datasets, including millions of records. * Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Databricks, or similar modern data platforms preferred. * Experience with Scala, NoSQL technologies, AI\-assisted development, or AI\-enabled data solutions preferred. **Additional Information:** =========================== This is a fully on\-site position reporting to the Columbus, Ohio office Monday through Friday. This salary range for this position is between $105,000\-$130,000\. We offer a benefits package that includes health, dental and vision insurance, company sponsored life, optional life and disability insurance, Health Savings Accounts and Flexible Spending Accounts, a 401(k) plus match, Tuition Assistance, Paid Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (PTO), a Dress for your Day dress code and paid holidays. Kimball Midwest is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to a program of recruitment of females, minority group members, individuals with disabilities, qualifying veterans and any other classification that is protected by federal, state, or local law. We Participate in E\-Verify. Participamos en E\-Verify. Compensation: $105,000\-$130,000

jobs.title: Manual QA Engineer
jobs.description: We live in a world where technology is rapidly changing the educational experiences of students and teachers everywhere, and we have the opportunity to shape how this change takes place. Kira's mission is to harness transformative AI technologies to make world\-class personalized teaching and learning accessible to everyone. Kira is a rapidly growing startup backed by top\-tier Venture Capital funds including New Enterprise Associates (NEA), Andrew Ng’s AI Fund, and Primavera. Quality is critical to ensuring teachers and students can rely on our product every day. As a Manual QA Engineer, you will help ensure a high\-quality, reliable experience across our platform. You’ll be embedded in a product pod with a PM, tech lead, designer and engineers, testing throughout development, not just at the end. This role is focused on hands\-on manual testing, exploratory testing, and validating new features before they reach production. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, and designers to deeply understand new features, identify potential issues early, and advocate for the end\-user experience. You will play a key role in verifying functionality across complex workflows, including AI\-powered features where outputs may be non\-deterministic. This role is ideal for someone who is detail\-oriented, curious about how products work, and passionate about delivering high\-quality user experiences. We have offices in San Francisco, CA and New York City, NY and we ask that employees work from one of the two locations and come into the office in\-person 4 days a week (Wednesdays WFH). **What You’ll Do** * Perform manual testing of new product features across web applications and AI\-driven workflows * Execute regression, exploratory, and acceptance testing to validate new functionality before release * Run sanity checks on staging and release builds to ensure stability prior to deployment * Test across the devices and browsers our teachers and students use, including iPad, Chromebook, and a range of laptops * Write clear, detailed, and reproducible bug reports, including steps to reproduce, logs, and impact assessments * Collaborate closely with engineers to debug issues and verify fixes * Develop a deep understanding of the product to identify edge cases, usability issues, and quality risks * Validate complex teacher and student workflows, including AI\-generated outputs and interactive experiences * Evaluate features not only for correctness but also usability, clarity, and user experience * Help prioritize testing efforts based on product impact and risk * Contribute to QA documentation, testing checklists, and release validation processes * Participate in release readiness and post\-release validation to ensure product stability **What We’re Looking For** * 5\+ years of experience in manual software testing or quality assurance * Experience and expertise in QA processes and UI/UX testing on web, including across devices and browsers * Strong experience performing manual regression, exploratory, and functional testing * Experience testing web applications and user\-facing products * Ability to write clear and actionable bug reports * Strong debugging skills and ability to work closely with engineers to reproduce issues * High attention to detail and strong product intuition * Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across engineering, product, and design * Comfort working in a fast\-moving startup environment * Strong curiosity and willingness to deeply understand product behavior and edge cases * Experience using AI tools to work more efficiently **Nice to Have** * Experience testing AI or LLM\-powered products * Testing complex workflows that involve APIs, backend systems, or data pipelines * Familiarity with basic developer tools (browser dev tools, logs, network inspection) * Hands\-on use of cross\-device testing tools such as BrowserStack * Exposure to distributed systems or modern web stacks Our services currently span: * Next.js \+ React frontend * Kotlin \+ Java Spring Boot backend * Python FastAPI AI services * Langsmith agent workflows **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * Critical user flows consistently work for teachers and students * Bugs are caught early during development rather than after release * Engineers have clear, actionable bug reports that speed up debugging * Product releases ship with high confidence and minimal regressions * AI\-driven features behave reliably and degrade gracefully when issues occur **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive compensation and equity. For applicants in the US, the salary range for this role is $115,000 – $130,000, depending on relevant experience and skill set * Medical, dental, vision and life insurance, including a medical insurance plan with 100% coverage of employee premiums * Daily lunch credit through DoorDash in office \+ free DashPass to use anytime for work or personal use * Wellhub Membership: 100% company\-paid access to premium gym networks (Orangetheory, SoulCycle), 60\+ wellness apps (Headspace, MyFitnessPal, Apple Fitness\+), and 1:1 coaching sessions spanning fitness, mental health, nutrition, and sleep * 401(k) matching * Pet friendly office ***Equal Employment Opportunity Employer*** *At Kira, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Kira believes that diversity and inclusion among our employees are critical to our success as a company, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. Selection for employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.* ***Background Check*** *Kira will make a conditional job offer in line with local, state and federal laws, and a subsequent criminal, education, and employment history background check will then be issued.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Flows Experience
jobs.description: *At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you're a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you'll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit* *klaviyo.com/careers* *to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.* Software Engineer II \- Flows Onsite in Boston, MA 5 days a week Flows is how tens of thousands of brands automate their marketing on Klaviyo, from welcome series and abandoned\-cart reminders to complex multi\-channel journeys that reach 100M\+ consumers. The Flows Experience team builds everything a marketer touches in a flow: the canvas, triggers, filters and actions they configure, the analytics they use to decide what to do next, and the APIs that developers and AI tools use to build flows for them. Our mission: **Flows should be the easiest, most trusted place to run sophisticated marketing automation.** Complex journeys should feel simple, mistakes should get caught before they cost revenue, and the product should keep up as an account grows. Travel is coordinated in advance.* **Get to Know Klaviyo** We're Klaviyo (pronounced clay\-vee\-oh). jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description: **Join Komatsu and Be Part of Something Big!** **Job Overview** ---------------- The key business reason for this position is to identify and reduce/eliminate quality related issues with the Komatsu America Corp. (KAC) facility of Chattanooga Manufacturing Operations (CMO) built products. The Quality Assurance Engineer functions as a liason between Suppliers, Engineering, Manufacturing, Komatsu Ltd. (KLTD), etc. to ensure a high quality product is the final result from our Manufacturing operation and in the Field. To confirm quality, core actions are: Collect failure data from warranty claims, TSI/ETSI information, feedback from Service Headquarters/Customers, etc. regarding specific machine failures. Summarize this data in terms of the number of failure occurences, affected machine models and lead in the Juhin (Serious Quality) process to resolve the issue effectively. The Quality Assurance Engineer must collect all relevant data (ex. in\-house data and external data) and prepare reports to outline how to move forward in the applicable area of quality improvement. Reports must be furnished to Quality Assurance Managers. Determine where corrective actions, design changes, process changes, etc. are required and follow through to closure of the actions. Support Suppliers, Engineering, Manufacturing, KLTD, etc. in the areas of countermeasures, verify effectiveness. Ensure progress through monitoring of repeat failures and react as necessary. Based on the above findings, Parts and Service News, Field Campaigns, etc. may be required to address machines that are in the field at customers of Distributors. **Scope** * Execute the Quality activities to reduce warranty expense and improving Customer acceptance by improving quality through the identification and elimination of machine quality problems. * Assist other Quality Assurance Staff, Suppliers and CMO Manufacturing personnel in basic quality control methods to enhance overall CMO capability in measurement of performance. * Review and manage field actions issued by KLTD and or KAC to address quality matters. * Manage CMO Quality Assurance improvement efforts with some supervision and make necessary decisions based on acquired background knowledge of Products and Issues. * Communicate the Komatsu Way to CMO employees. Provide help with 5S projects, QC circle actives, continuous improvement activities. * FOR REMAN FOCUS POSITION: Coordinate New Model release activity. This can be as many as 150\-200 new assemblies annually. This will entail gathering all manufacturing, assembly, testing, and BOM information in order to successfully perform the remanufacturing of these products. * Determine which Parts and Service News and other updates must be applied to Reman products through sound engineering judgments and review of warranty costs and update costs. **Key Job Responsibilities** ---------------------------- * Review and summarize Field Campaign’s (FC’s) and Parts and Service News issued by KLTD – determine if applicable for KAC – if so, issue KAC versions. Manage creation of internal PSN’s applicable for CMO products – issue CMO drafts and KLTD version for creation and use by KAC. Summarize and report the status of FC’s monthly. * Register Juhin’s for failure issues found that meet the criteria. Summarize failure data in Juhin sheets, communicate failure to responsible parties. Coordinate root cause analysis, confirm C/M actions, Field actions if applicable to resolve and close issue. * Research field data (warranty claims, TSI/ETSI’s, etc.) to confirm quality issues and quantify seriousness. Facilitate action plan to countermeasure (C/M). Communicate with KLTD. Mother plant, Component plants, Suppliers, etc. to get corrective action steps enacted and reduce/eliminate future failures. * Coordinate failed parts recalls, conduct technical studies of parts, coordinate failed parts analysis with Suppliers, outside laboratories, and KLTD (Mother plants and Component plants), etc. * Inspection support (test methods, inspection standards, acceptance criteria, actual conducting tests). * Coordinate new model start\-ups – document problems found – hold meetings and oversee issues to closure. Manage technical data needed for inspections, sign offs, and traceability (ie: Assembly Check Sheets) for all CMO production machines. Review Engineering changes as they are released to judge effect on QA documents. * Other duties as required by Manager. **Qualifications/Requirements** ------------------------------- * BS Degree in Engineering or equivalent is required. Knowledge of quality control methods is desired. * Ability to manage multiple tasks, assess their current situation and develop necessary means to foster improvement. * Proficiency in software applications including SAP, Microsoft Excel, Word, and Power Point, at a minimum. * Proficiency in the use of applied standards and practices. Ability to understand and use Komatsu Engineering Standards and drawings. * A good personality and attitude are important for this job. You must be able to work and communicate effectively with all management, fellow staff, shop workers, suppliers, customers and other Komatsu America/Komatsu plants. * Occasional travel to distributor or supplier locations, KAC Locations or Japan plants. Proven leadership ability a plus. * Must comply with all environmental, quality and Safety rules, practices and standards. **Additional Information** -------------------------- **Diversity \& Inclusion Commitment** At Komatsu we come from diverse backgrounds, with unique perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We are committed to creating a workforce that is reflective of the communities we work and live in. We believe that our people are part of our shared purpose. We are authentic, ambitious, and innovative in our pursuit of Diversity \& Inclusion. United, we are on a journey towards a sustainable future that creates value together. **Company Information** Komatsu is a world leader in manufacturing construction, mining, forestry, and industrial heavy equipment. Founded in 1921, Komatsu has a long history of quality, reliability, innovation, and excellence. Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Komatsu facilities, distributors and dealers are in more than 140 countries and employ more than 60,000 people. Komatsu offers a diverse and challenging work environment, where you can grow your skills and career, and contribute to a sustainable, clean\-energy future. If you are looking for a company that values your talent and potential, be a part of something big and join a team that is shaping the world! If you want to learn more about Komatsu, please visit our website at https://www.komatsu.com/ .

Simply put, we take care of our advisors and institutions, so they can take care of their clients. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com. Join the LPL team and help us make a difference by turning life’s aspirations into financial realities. Please log in or create an account to apply to this position. Principals only. EOE. **Information on Interviews:** LPL will only communicate with a job applicant directly from an **@lplfinancial.com** email address and will never conduct an interview online or in a chatroom forum. During an interview, LPL will not request any form of payment from the applicant, or information regarding an applicant’s bank or credit card. Should you have any questions regarding the application process, please contact LPL’s Human Resources Solutions Center at (855\) 575\-6947\. EAC 5\.19\.26

jobs.title: Technology Support Specialist

This is an entry\-level role for someone early in their career who has a solid foundation in technical support and systems administration and wants to grow it in a professional enterprise environment. The Technology Support Specialist is often the first point of contact for colleagues who need technology help. The role resolves support requests; sets up and maintains devices, accounts and access; and helps administer the systems the firm relies on every day, including Microsoft 365, endpoints and the network. As a member of the Larson Technology Services team, the Technology Support Specialist works alongside senior engineers on projects and day\-to\-day operations, gaining broad hands\-on experience across infrastructure, applications and security. **Key responsibilities:** **Technical support** * Respond to and resolve support requests through the service desk, in person, by phone and remotely, within agreed service levels. * Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, printing and access issues, and escalate complex problems to senior team members. * Log, track and update tickets accurately, and communicate clearly and courteously with the colleagues you support. * Support collaboration tools, video conferencing and meeting\-room technology. **Endpoints and devices** * Set up, configure, deploy and retire laptops, desktops, mobile devices and peripherals. * Enroll and manage devices with endpoint management tools and apply software updates and patches. * Install and support standard business applications. * Maintain an accurate inventory of hardware, software and licenses. **Systems administration** * Manage user accounts, groups, licenses, shared mailboxes and permissions in Microsoft 365 and Entra ID. * Carry out onboarding and offboarding: accounts, devices, access and equipment returns. * Assist with the administration of servers, file shares, SharePoint and other infrastructure. * Assist with infrastructure projects such as upgrades, migrations, hardware rollouts and office moves. **Security** * Follow security policies and data\-handling practices, including those for confidential client information. * Support multi\-factor authentication, endpoint protection and access requests, and report suspicious activity promptly. **Documentation and continuous improvement** * Write and maintain knowledge\-base articles, how\-to guides and technical documentation. * Identify recurring issues and suggest improvements, including simple scripts and automation. * Work with technology vendors and service providers on support cases and deliveries. Requirements: * Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 2\+ years of experience in technical support, help desk or systems administration. Internships, co\-ops and campus technology roles count. * Working knowledge of Windows and macOS, including installation, configuration and troubleshooting. * Familiarity with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive) and its administration. * Understanding of networking fundamentals, such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi\-Fi and VPN. * Strong troubleshooting skills and a logical, methodical approach to solving problems. * Clear written and verbal communication, including with non\-technical colleagues. * A customer\-service mindset, reliability and discretion with confidential information. * Ability to manage multiple requests, prioritize effectively and follow through. **Preferred qualifications** * Entry\-level certifications, such as CompTIA A\+, Network\+ or Security\+, or Microsoft 365 Fundamentals or Endpoint Administrator. * Exposure to Entra ID (Azure AD), Intune or Active Directory. * Experience with a service\-management or ticketing tool, such as Jira Service Management or ServiceNow. * Basic scripting in PowerShell or Python. * Hands\-on use of AI tools, such as ChatGPT, Claude or Microsoft Copilot. * Interest in financial services or another regulated industry. *Larson is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI\-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end\-to\-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100\+ customers across 80\+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White \& Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to **$200M\+ in ARR**, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world\-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. * We **lean in:** ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. * We **fight for excellence:** high standards, direct, ego\-free feedback. * We **grow together:** as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. **The role** ------------ As Engineering Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering, you'll lead a team of engineers who put Legora to work inside our largest enterprise customers. Our Forward Deployed Engineers sit between customers, product and engineering. They work directly with the world's leading law firms and legal teams to understand how they operate, then build the software that connects Legora to their systems and workflows. You'll lead by example: hands\-on in the code while guiding a talented team, helping them deliver complex customer engagements and grow into owners who can run those engagements independently. You'll work closely with Product Engineering, Product, Design, Legal Engineers, Engagement Managers and our commercial teams. What your team builds shapes how thousands of lawyers use AI every day, and what it learns in the field helps decide what becomes part of the core product. This is a New York City\-based role, five days a week in our Union Square office. We believe building together in person drives better outcomes. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Lead, coach and grow a team of Forward Deployed Engineers in New York, review code, mentor engineers at every level, contribute to hiring, and keep the team healthy and effective. * Set team objectives that connect to the goals of the FDE function, and plan how engagements are scoped, staffed, delivered and handed over. * Stay hands\-on by leading technical discovery and delivery on strategic accounts, building end\-to\-end features and integrations across our fullstack platform with Node.js, React, Azure, AWS and Kubernetes. * Make architecture and technical decisions for your team's work, holding a high bar for quality, security and performance. * Act as a trusted technical partner to customer stakeholders, aligning them on scope, tradeoffs and timelines. * Work with Product, Design and Product Engineering to turn what the team learns in the field into reusable integrations, tooling or core capabilities. * Track your team's delivery health, such as time to value, deployment quality and reuse, share it with FDE leadership, and champion good practices in development, DevOps and continuous improvement. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Strong experience as a fullstack or backend engineer building and owning complex, scalable systems end to end, with confidence across backend, frontend and infrastructure. * Experience leading and managing engineers, ideally in a customer\-facing function such as forward deployed engineering. * Strong ability to stay hands\-on while setting technical direction for a team. * Strong ability to communicate with empathy and clarity, and to earn the trust of senior technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including reframing a request or resetting expectations when it's the right call. * Strong product judgment, including knowing when to build something bespoke, when to push back, and when a customer need should shape the core product. * Ability to take ownership, solve the most pressing problems independently, and make progress where the answers aren't clear and processes are few. * Familiarity with enterprise integrations, APIs, authentication and data flows across systems you don't control. Nice to have: forward deployed experience at a high\-growth B2B or AI company, work in legal, financial services or other regulated environments, experience shipping LLM\-powered products, or TypeScript (we use it extensively, but welcome strong engineers from other stacks). **What’s In It For You** * **Global collaboration:** Partner with teams and clients domestically and internationally. * **Competitive package:** Comprehensive salary, benefits, and tools for success. * **Meaningful work:** Your efforts shape how thousands of lawyers use AI daily. * **In\-person environment:** Union Square office designed for ambitious builders. * **Benefits \& Perks:** We invest in our people with a comprehensive, thoughtfully designed benefits package: Medical, Dental \& Vision + Multiple medical plan options through Aetna and Kaiser Permanente + HSA or Healthcare FSA (based on plan selection) + Dental plans via MetLife + Vision plans via Vision Care Family Support + Generous parental leave + Free access to Maven Clinic + Dependent Care FSA + Free One Medical membership for employees and dependents Additional Perks + Pre\-tax commuter benefits + Life Insurance \+ STD/LTD + 401(K) with generous company match + Unlimited PTO + Robust voluntary benefits, including identity protection (via Aura), legal coverage via MetLife, pet savings programs, and more **Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer** At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high\-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. trends from DCS historians to identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions * Lead and manage capital projects focused on improving safety, throughput, and operational efficiency * Oversee contractors and cross\-functional teams executing maintenance and sustaining projects, ensuring alignment with safety and operational standards * Provide technical mentorship and guidance to engineers, operators, contractors, and consultants * Champion and drive a strong safety culture, ensuring compliance with environmental and regulatory requirements * Develop and implement systems to track, measure, and improve plant performance, productivity, and asset utilization * Build and maintain strong cross\-functional relationships while reinforcing Lithium Americas’ Purpose, Vision, and with the ability to manage complex technical challenges * Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage stakeholders at all levels * Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 applications (Word, Excel, Outlook, Project, Teams, etc.) * Experience with DCS control systems jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: **About Lumafield:** Lumafield was founded in 2019 to upgrade manufacturing. We are engineers with deep experience across the product development cycle, from initial ideas to shipping hardware, across industries and specializations, who became frustrated by the cost and complexity of modern manufacturing. So we decided to upgrade it. Engineers make million\-dollar decisions every day, and they need tools that give them the greatest possible insight into their products. By offering unprecedented visibility into products, as well as AI\-driven tools that highlight problems and generate quantitative data, Lumafield promises to revolutionize the way complex products are created, manufactured, and used across industries. We started with industrial CT scanning, which for us was the most valuable but underutilized tool in the manufacturing toolbox, enabling us to rapidly inspect essential components non\-destructively. We rebuilt the whole system, from X\-ray capture, to computer vision analysis, to web\-based collaboration, to the entire business model, making the most advanced manufacturing tech more accessible to every industry. Our company, like our platform, is designed for upgrades. We’re building for greater intelligence, autonomy, and speed. For deeper vision, operational excellence, and powerful insights. And then we'll upgrade it all again. Lumafield is headquartered in San Francisco, CA. and has an office in Cambridge, MA. **About the role:** Lumafield is seeking a highly proactive Manufacturing Engineer to drive continuous improvement of our production processes and ensure that our hardware products maintain high quality standards. As a member of the Manufacturing Team, you’ll collaborate closely with our Hardware and Build teams to identify and resolve production issues and drive excellence in our manufacturing operations across all product lines. This role offers a unique blend of influence and scope, where you’ll be making a tangible impact on hardware that’s revolutionizing the way physical products are manufactured everywhere. If you are interested in joining a well\-funded growth stage company, this is the perfect opportunity for you to become a part of the Lumafield team! ### **What you'll do:** * Work closely with our build team to identify and correct production issues, implement process improvements, and help us get our scanners out the door on time. * Identify and execute process changes to improve the safety, quality, ease, ergonomics, and speed of assembly of all our hardware products. * Triage electromechanical issues on the production floor and execute short\-term corrections \& long\-term corrective actions. * Conduct root cause analysis studies and determine appropriate material disposition for nonconforming items. * Execute design changes and documentation updates using sound CAD and 2D drawing best practices. * Develop and document SOPs for manufacturing processes, including assembly instructions and IQC. * Design, build, and evaluate jigs and/or fixtures to improve assembly tasks. * Collaborate with the Hardware Engineering team to ensure smooth transition of products from design through NPI and mass production. ### **About you:** * 3\-5 years of relevant engineering experience. * Are a hands\-on, deeply detail\-oriented engineer, well versed in quality control and testing/validation. * Have strong knowledge of 3D modeling best practices, particularly in OnShape or Solidworks. * Have experience working with product lifecycle management systems. * Have a desire to deeply understand the interactions of complex electromechanical products. * Have excellent written and graphical communication skills. * Have a Bachelor's degree in an applicable engineering field. (Mechanical, Electrical, Systems, etc.) ### **Bonus:** * Aptitude for electronics and reading electrical schematics. * Have experience working in an ISO 9001 quality system or a regulated field industry like Aerospace or Medical Devices (e.g. an AS9100 or ISO 13485 quality system). * Have experience working directly with assembly technicians. Lumafield offers both competitive cash and equity compensation, as well as a health \& wellness stipend, 401k, parental leave, flexible PTO, commuter benefits, company wide events and more! Lumafield is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, because the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking an AI Engineer to architect, build, and scale our production AI systems. You will move beyond simple API wrappers to design reliable agentic workflows, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation infrastructure. You will own the full lifecycle of AI features, including rapid prototyping to deployment, observability, and cost optimization. ### **About MD Ally** MD Ally is a 9\-1\-1 Telehealth solution that enables greater connectivity between public health \& safety and the broader healthcare ecosystem. Our solutions allow dispatchers and first responders to transfer non\-emergency callers from 911 to virtual care instead of dispatching valuable, emergency resources. ### **Description** **About the Role** MD Ally integrates with public\-safety systems so eligible non\-emergency 911 callers can reach care from a clinician instead of defaulting to the highest\-cost transport and emergency department pathway. That adds a clinical step before a member enters that pathway. We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer to architect, build, and scale our production AI systems. These systems handle PHI and support clinical decisions, so they have to be accurate, private, and auditable. You'll build the infrastructure that makes that true: deterministic guardrails, HIPAA\-compliant data pipelines, clinical evaluation suites, and real\-time voice and text workflows integrated into our telehealth platform and Electronic Health Records (EHR). **What You Will Build and Own** **Clinician Productivity and EHR Automation** Doctors and nurses spend hours clicking through Electronic Health Records. You'll build tools to automate that administrative work: * **Ambient Clinical Scribes:** Build audio\-to\-text pipelines using models like Whisper or Deepgram combined with LLMs that listen to telehealth video visits, filter out small talk, and draft structured SOAP notes (Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan). * **EHR Read/Write Agents:** Build integrations using FHIR or HL7 standards that pull a patient's past labs and medications before a visit, and push approved clinical notes, ICD\-10 billing codes, or draft prescriptions back into systems like Epic, Athenahealth, or Elation. * **Pre\-Visit Chart Summarization:** Architect Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems that digest dozens of pages of messy PDF medical records or specialist referrals into clean, concise summaries with exact source citations for the provider. **Patient\-Facing Intake and Care Navigation** Before or after a virtual visit, patients interact with chat or voice interfaces. You'll build the backend logic that keeps these interactions helpful and safe: * **Dynamic Symptom Intake:** Build conversational agents that gather a patient's medical history and symptoms before a video call, and ask follow\-up questions based on clinical protocols. * **Smart Triage and Routing:** Develop classification systems that analyze patient messages to route urgent red\-flag symptoms (such as chest pain) immediately to an on\-call nurse, while routing routine prescription refills or scheduling requests to automated workflows. * **Post\-Visit Follow\-Up and Care Plans:** Create automated systems that translate complex medical jargon from a doctor's note into plain\-language instructions, medication reminders, and check\-ins in the patient's preferred language. **Clinical Safety, Privacy, and Guardrail Infrastructure** Because we handle Protected Health Information (PHI) and human health, you'll build the safety infrastructure around every model: * **PHI Redaction and Zero\-Retention Pipelines:** Build middleware that strips names, dates of birth, and SSNs before data reaches external APIs, routing all traffic strictly through HIPAA\-compliant endpoints (such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or GCP Vertex AI) under a Business Associate Agreement (BAA). * **Deterministic Clinical Guardrails:** Implement real\-time validation layers that block models from diagnosing conditions, recommending unapproved treatments, or hallucinating drug dosages, forcing standard fallback responses whenever clinical boundaries are crossed. * **Real\-Time Audio/Video Processing:** Engineer low\-latency streaming infrastructure using WebSockets and WebRTC so voice agents and live transcription tools respond in milliseconds during live telehealth calls without awkward pauses. **Clinical Evaluation and Observability Systems** We don't ship a prompt or model change without proving it's safe. You'll build automated testing harnesses: * **Synthetic Patient Simulators:** Build AI agents programmed to act like patients with specific conditions, accents, or edge\-case behaviors to stress\-test intake workflows before real patients interact with them. * **LLM\-as\-a\-Judge and Clinical Grading Pipelines:** Build automated test suites that grade generated SOAP notes against gold\-standard physician notes, checking for omitted allergies, incorrect dosages, or hallucinated symptoms. * **Audit Logs and Traceability:** Maintain full logging systems so that if a clinician or regulator asks why the system suggested an output, our team can trace the exact prompt, retrieved medical document, and model version used. **What We're Looking For** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with 2\+ years shipping production LLM, NLP, or speech\-to\-text applications. * **Strong Engineering Fundamentals:** High proficiency in Python and TypeScript/Node.js, with deep experience designing reliable APIs, state machines, asynchronous workers, and CI/CD pipelines. * **Hands\-On Applied AI Stack:** Practical experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or custom agent harnesses), RAG pipelines, vector databases (such as pgvector or Pinecone), and structured output validation. * **Security and Privacy Mindset:** Experience building systems under strict compliance frameworks (HIPAA, SOC2\) and working with Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) and encrypted data flows. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Ability to partner directly with clinicians, Product Managers, and Security teams to translate medical protocols into deterministic, testable software. **Preferences** * Direct experience in digital health, telehealth, or health\-tech startups. * Familiarity with healthcare data standards (FHIR, HL7\), medical coding (ICD\-10, CPT), or EHR integrations (Epic, Athenahealth, Elation). * Experience with real\-time audio processing and medical transcription models (such as Whisper, Deepgram Medical, or AWS Transcribe Medical). **Benefits:** Salary and equity package, full medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k) plan, and flexible PTO.
