jobs.title: Principal AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Matter Health** Matter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in public housing communities. Our mission is simple: to improve healthcare access by meeting patients where they are and building trusted relationships within the communities we serve. We are rapidly expanding and are seeking mission\-driven professionals who thrive in fast\-paced, people\-centered environments. **We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.** **About the Role** Matter Health is seeking a hands\-on, mission\-driven AI Automation Workflow Specialist to join our Information Technology team. This individual contributor role is responsible for building and deploying AI\-assisted workflow automations that support our operations, clinical, care support, and field\-based teams—helping them spend less time on repetitive tasks and more time on the patients and work that matter most. Working directly with business and clinical stakeholders, you will identify day\-to\-day workflow opportunities, configure and deploy automations using Matter Health's established AI tools and platform, and support adoption across the organization. This is a building and operational role—not a platform architecture or people management position. This role is ideal for someone who learns new AI tools quickly, enjoys partnering with non\-technical teams to solve real problems, and is excited about applying emerging AI capabilities in service of a genuine mission. This position reports to the Chief Technology Officer. This is a fully remote role with up to 10% travel for occasional in\-person meetings or team offsites. **Key Responsibilities** * Partner with clinical, care support, operations, and field\-based teams to understand day\-to\-day workflows, pain points, and opportunities for AI\-driven automation * Gather requirements from stakeholders with varying levels of technical fluency and translate real operational problems into automation ideas that can be built and tested quickly * Collect structured and informal feedback from clinicians, care support agents, operations staff, and field\-based teams to guide ongoing iteration of deployed automations * Submit identified opportunities into the team's intake process and collaborate with the AI Platform Engineer and requesting\-team leadership to define priorities * Use approved AI tools, agent platforms, and automation software to configure, build, and deploy workflow automations and AI\-assisted processes for operations, clinical, care support, and field\-based teams * Write and refine prompts and configure workflow logic within existing platform tooling, templates, and standards to automate repetitive day\-to\-day tasks * Test and refine deployed automations with real users, iterating based on usage feedback and observed performance * Monitor day\-to\-day performance of deployed automations and escalate issues related to accuracy, reliability, or unexpected behavior to the AI Platform Engineer or Engineering team * Follow established platform standards, prompt and context templates, and controls when building and deploying automations—including those handling protected health information (PHI) * Create documentation, training materials, and enablement content to support successful adoption of new AI\-driven workflows * Maintain a library of deployed automations, prompts, and workflow configurations to support consistency, reuse, and knowledge sharing across the organization * Support change management and adoption efforts as new automations are rolled out across operational teams * Partner with the AI Platform Engineer and stakeholders to evaluate when a deployed automation is ready to expand, refine, or retire **Qualifications** Required * Associate's or Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience * 1–3 years of experience in business operations, process improvement, workflow automation, or a related operational role * Hands\-on experience using AI tools, chatbots, or no\-code/low\-code automation platforms to build or configure workflows * Strong ability to gather requirements from business and clinical stakeholders with varying levels of technical fluency * Comfortable working within established technical standards, prompt and context templates, and controls without needing to design underlying platform architecture * Experience documenting workflows and automation configurations clearly for both technical and non\-technical audiences * Basic understanding of responsible AI practices and safe handling of sensitive data, including protected health information (PHI) * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain new tools clearly to non\-technical audiences Preferred * Experience in the healthcare industry; familiarity with clinical operations, call center or care support workflows, or field\-based care models is a plus * Experience with EMR systems, healthcare data, or clinical workflow tools * Familiarity with value\-based care, Medicare, or Medicare Advantage environments * Experience supporting distributed, remote, or field\-based teams * Background in change management, user training, or internal enablement * Comfort working in a fast\-paced, high\-growth organization where priorities evolve **What Success Looks Like** * Meaningful hours saved for operational, clinical, and field\-based teams through deployed automations * Strong adoption of deployed automations by their target teams and users * A growing library of automations successfully built, deployed, and actively maintained in production * Efficient intake\-to\-launch cycle time from approved automation request to deployment * Collaborative, trusted relationships with clinical and operational stakeholders across the organization * Clear and accessible documentation that enables teams to understand and build on deployed workflows * Active contribution to a growing culture of AI\-native thinking across the organization **Why Matter Health** At Matter Health, we believe that where you live should never determine the quality of care you receive. Every team member is vital in improving healthcare access for older adults who have historically been underserved by traditional healthcare systems. This isn't just a mission statement—it's the work we do every day. We Lead with Love in Everything We Do. **Working at Matter Health** We're committed to supporting our team both professionally and personally. Benefits for full\-time team members begin on the first of the month after your start date. Health \& Wellness * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Employer\-funded HSA options * Employer\-paid life and disability insurance * Voluntary illness, accident, and hospitalization coverage * Access to Matter Health's in\-person and virtual care services Financial Security * Competitive compensation * 401(k) with company match starting on Day 60 * Financial wellness resources and support Time Away * Up to 4 weeks of PTO * 10 paid company holidays * 2 volunteer days annually for meaningful causes Eligibility is based on full\-time employment status. Additional details will be shared during the interview process. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Matter Health is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences and foster an environment where every team member feels valued, respected, and supported.

jobs.title: Mechanical Designer: Junior & Senior Level Openings
jobs.description: Maybell Quantum is redefining the future of computing. As a venture\-backed quantum hardware innovator experiencing rapid growth, we're building technology that will transform industries for decades to come. Quantum computers will be as transformative to the next 30 years as the internet was to the last 30—and our team is creating the hardware foundation to make this revolution possible. Maybell Quantum is seeking Junior and Senior Mechanical Designers / CAD Specialists to develop accurate 3D models, detailed assemblies, and production\-ready manufacturing drawings for precision mechanical hardware. This is a hands\-on CAD design and drafting role. You'll translate concepts, sketches, and engineer\-provided requirements into clear, manufacturable documentation, working closely with engineers, technicians, manufacturing, and suppliers. **Key responsibilities** * Create, revise, and maintain detailed 3D part models, complex assemblies, and 2D production drawings from sketches, specifications, prototypes, and engineering direction. * Produce complete, fabrication\-ready drawings with appropriate dimensions, tolerances, notes, and GD\&T in accordance with applicable drafting standards (including ASME Y14\.5 / Y14\.100\). * Apply practical knowledge of machining, sheet metal, welding, brazing, and other manufacturing processes to improve part and drawing manufacturability. * Develop assembly models and documentation that support reliable fit, straightforward assembly, and repeatable production. * Create and maintain bills of materials (BOMs), part numbers, CAD files, drawing packages, and revision records. * Perform interference checks, dimensional reviews, and routine tolerance stack\-ups; work with engineers to resolve more complex fit or tolerance issues. * Prepare CAD and drawing packages for prototypes, suppliers, and in\-house fabrication; update designs and documentation based on build feedback. * Implement approved design changes and engineering change requests/orders (ECRs/ECOs), ensuring released drawings and files remain accurate. * Partner with machinists, technicians, manufacturing personnel, and vendors to troubleshoot fabrication and assembly issues. * Collaborate with mechanical engineers and physicists to translate new product concepts into detailed CAD models and practical manufacturing drawings. * Maintain organized CAD standards, templates, shared part libraries, and documentation practices. **Required qualifications** * 3\+ years of professional, hands\-on mechanical CAD design and drafting experience, ideally producing parts and assemblies for physical manufacturing. * Demonstrated ability to independently create accurate parametric 3D models, assemblies, and complete 2D fabrication drawings. * Strong proficiency with at least one parametric mechanical CAD platform (such as Onshape, SolidWorks, Creo, Inventor, Fusion 360, or NX). * Working command of mechanical drafting conventions, GD\&T, dimensional tolerancing, and drawing interpretation. * Practical familiarity with manufacturing methods, materials, and the information fabricators need from a drawing. * Experience organizing assembly documentation, BOMs, drawing revisions, and released CAD data. * Careful attention to drawing accuracy, file organization, and detail while managing multiple deliverables. * Ability to communicate clearly with engineers, machinists, technicians, and outside fabrication partners. **Preferred qualifications** Onshape is our primary CAD platform. Prior Onshape experience is valuable, but expertise in another parametric CAD system is equally welcome; we can support the transition. * Hands\-on Onshape experience with Part Studios, assemblies, drawings, and release/version workflows. * Experience preparing precision mechanical components, thermal hardware, vacuum equipment, or cryogenic\-system drawings. * Experience creating manufacturing drawings for machined parts, sheet metal, weldments, or brazed assemblies. * Experience with CAD/PDM or PLM release procedures and engineering change documentation. * Formal education in mechanical design, drafting, or mechanical engineering technology, or relevant CAD certifications. Equivalent practical experience is fully acceptable. **What we offer** * $35\.00 / hr \- $45\.00 / hr \+ potential bonuses commensurate with experience and performance * Company Equity options * Health, dental and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off and holidays. * Professional development, training and certification support. Maybell Quantum is solving incredibly challenging problems at the cutting edge of physics and engineering. Don't meet every single requirement? We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workforce, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't aligned perfectly, we still encourage you to apply. *Maybell Quantum is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse team.*

Independently evaluates, selects, and applies standard engineering techniques, procedures, and criteria, using judgment in making minor adaptations and modifications. 2\. Identifies and implements any changes necessary to ensure and maintain the continued suitability and effectiveness of the quality management system through the use of: quality policy, quality objectives, audit results, analysis of data, etc. 10\. jobs.title: Privacy Security Engineer, Privacy & Data Protection - Applied AI
jobs.description: Meta is seeking Security Engineers with Privacy and Data protection expertise to join our Applied Artificial Intelligence (AAI) organization. You will apply deep privacy engineering expertise to hard, real\-world problems in how systems collect, use, retain, expose, and delete data. Your work is AI\-augmented from day one: you leverage AI tools and agents to accelerate your impact, and where the models fall short, your expertise directly drives their improvement.The problems that matter here are the ones a capable engineer cannot solve by reading the code in front of them: which jurisdiction's deadline applies to a deletion request, whether a derived dataset clears an anonymity threshold, where a deletion has to cascade. Models already handle the privacy obligations that are stated as ordinary good engineering practice, so the work is the obligation they cannot derive.This role is for privacy engineers who want to operate at the intersection of deep privacy expertise and frontier AI, not just applying AI to privacy work but shaping what it is capable of. ### **Privacy Security Engineer, Privacy \& Data lifecycle controls, and data access reasoning * Shape how privacy expertise translates into AI capabilities: define the methodologies that make model improvement systematic and scalable * Drive cross\-organizational partnerships that define how privacy and AI intersect: influence technical direction beyond the immediate team * Break down problems into smaller scoped work streams, owning the most technically complex pieces while enabling others to execute against the overall solution * Mentor other engineers across the organization, build a community, and act as a role model for privacy engineering practices and Meta values * Disseminate findings through internal publications, knowledge sharing, and contributions to the broader privacy and security community ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field, or equivalent experience * 8\+ years of hands\-on engineering experience in technical privacy, data protection, or privacy\-adjacent security engineering * Deep expertise in at least one privacy subdomain with demonstrated ability to advance the state of the art: purpose limitation, retention and deletion, data access control, jurisdictional obligations, de\-identification, consent, or ML and model privacy * Experience implementing privacy obligations in production systems, in addition to reviewing or advising on them * Software engineering proficiency, including code review and maintenance, with experience coding in Python, PHP, Java, C/C\+\+, or an equivalent language * Track record of architecting privacy systems, controls or programs that operate at scale and influence how others build * Demonstrated ability to define and drive complex, ambiguous problem spaces with group\-level impact ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) * Experience improving AI model performance through expert feedback, red teaming, or evaluation design * Experience with pseudonymization lifecycle, including deletion of the user\-to\-pseudonym mapping * jobs.description: Job ID JR117361 **Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.** Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing. As an **SoC Physical Design Formal Verification Engineer** in the Heterogeneous Integration Group (HIG), you will own the formal verification signoff of advanced HBM SoC logic/base die designs as they move from RTL through synthesis, DFT insertion, place\-and\-route, and ECOs to tapeout. You will work closely with RTL design, physical design, DFT, low\-power, and STA teams to ensure every implementation step preserves functional intent and power intent. This is a hands\-on role with opportunities to own block and full\-chip formal signoff and shape formal methodology across multiple product generations. **Key Responsibilities** * Own formal equivalence checking (LEC) for HBM SoC blocks and full\-chip across the implementation flow, including RTL\-to\-netlist, netlist\-to\-netlist (post\-synthesis, post\-DFT insertion, post\-CTS, post\-route), and ECO netlists. * Develop and maintain robust equivalence setups, including handling of retiming, clock gating, multibit banking, constant/unreachable register optimization, scan and MBIST insertion, and black\-boxed hard IP. * Debug and resolve non\-equivalence and abort points efficiently, partnering with RTL, synthesis, DFT, and physical design teams to root\-cause issues and converge designs to clean signoff. * Perform static low\-power verification (e.g., Conformal Low Power, VC LP) against UPF power intent, covering isolation, level shifting, retention, power switches, and always\-on connectivity through implementation. * Drive functional ECO generation and implementation using formal ECO tools (e.g., Conformal ECO, Formality ECO), minimizing patch size and physical impact late in the design cycle. * Run and review netlist\-level structural and formal checks such as CDC/RDC, X\-propagation, and connectivity checks as required by signoff criteria. * Define formal verification signoff criteria, checklists, and QoR metrics, and represent formal verification status in tapeout readiness reviews. * Build and improve automated formal verification flows and regression infrastructure using Python, TCL, and shell to improve runtime, capacity, and debug productivity. * Collaborate with EDA vendors to resolve tool issues, evaluate new capabilities, and adopt best\-in\-class methodology across product generations. * Develop agentic AI flows based on latest LLM and Gen\-AI capabilities. **Required Qualifications** * Strong hands\-on experience with formal equivalence checking on complex SoC designs at advanced process nodes. * Proficiency with industry formal verification tools (e.g., Cadence Conformal LEC/LP/ECO, Synopsys Formality/VC LP, Siemens Questa or equivalent). * Solid understanding of the RTL\-to\-GDSII implementation flow, including synthesis, DFT insertion, placement, CTS, routing, and ECO flows, and how each step impacts equivalence. * Experience debugging non\-equivalence, aborts, and setup issues caused by synthesis optimizations such as retiming, register merging, clock gating, and multibit flops. * Working knowledge of power intent (UPF/CPF) and low\-power design concepts, including isolation, level shifting, retention, and power gating. * Familiarity with DFT structures (scan, compression, MBIST, JTAG) and their treatment in formal verification. * Good understanding of Verilog/SystemVerilog and gate\-level netlists, and ability to read and reason about RTL and synthesized logic. * Proven tapeout history on advanced foundries (e.g., TSMC) and understanding of full\-cycle SoC development flows. * Strong scripting/automation skills using Python, TCL, Perl, and/or shell. * Ability to work in a global, cross\-functional environment with strong communication and debugging skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with HBM / DRAM adjacent SoC designs, or memory\-subsystem\-heavy SoCs. * Experience with functional ECO generation and implementation on large hierarchical designs. * Exposure to property\-based formal verification (SVA, formal apps) or netlist\-level CDC/RDC signoff. * Familiarity with physical verification and signoff concepts such as DRC, LVS, and STA. * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. * Minimum 7 years of experience in a related field. * Proven ability to mentor and develop junior engineers. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. tensor/parameter sharding, model parallelism, KV\-cache optimization, and Flash Attention etc. * Practical experience with large\-scale model evaluation, including benchmarking state\-of\-the\-art LLMs and fine\-tuning (SFT or RL) large models. * Strong programming skills in Python, C, and C\+\+. * Excellent communication abilities and a proven capacity to collaborate effectively in hybrid jobs.title: AI Engineering Manager
jobs.description: We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on \- 4 Dec 2026 At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world. **About the Role** ================== MiniMed is building a lean, high\-leverage AI \& Data Science team that designs, builds, and runs AI agents and models across the business. We are looking for a Manager, AI Engineering to lead our AI Agent Engineering team, including Principal AI Engineers, Senior AI Engineers, and contract engineers, and to turn a growing portfolio of AI use cases into reliable production systems. This is a player\-coach role. Most of your time goes to leading the team and its delivery. You also stay close to the work, spending about a quarter of your time reviewing designs and code, prototyping, and working on hard production problems, so your technical decisions reflect how the systems actually work. Principal AI Engineers set the team's technical standards; you make sure the team has the people, plan, and quality bar to deliver against them. What success looks like A strong, growing team. Engineers are hired well, developed, and retained, and Principal AI Engineers have room to lead technically. Predictable delivery. AI use cases move from approved idea to production on a plan the business can rely on. Reliable systems. What the team ships passes the readiness bar and holds up in production after handoff. This is a hybrid position based in Atlanta, GA or Northridge, CA **A Day in the Life** Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned. *Lead the team and its delivery (about 45%)* * **Build and grow the team.** Hire, onboard, and develop AI engineers; run performance and career conversations; give Principal AI Engineers the support and room to set the technical standard for the team. * **Run delivery.** Turn the team's part of the AI roadmap into a sequenced, predictable plan; run sprint planning and backlog prioritization; manage capacity across concurrent initiatives; raise risks with leadership early. * **Work with product managers and the business.** Partner with AI product managers, the enterprise transformation team, and business leaders to choose what to build, size the effort, and decide when a prototype is ready for engineering hardening. * **Represent the team.** Report progress, risk, cost, and value to the Data Science \& AI Lead and business stakeholders in clear, plain terms. *Own production readiness and standards (about 30%)* * **Set the production\-readiness bar.** Define what an agent needs before it ships: evaluation evidence, guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop where required, fallback behavior, monitoring, and an incident plan. You own this release gate for everything the team builds. * **Own escalation and shape the handoff.** Serve as the escalation point for production issues in the team's systems. As our platform and operations functions take shape, help define how capabilities move from build to steady\-state operation, including ownership, service levels, and runbooks. * **Set development standards.** With the Principal AI Engineers, define testing, documentation, versioning, and release practices, and make sure agents built by enablement engineers inside the business follow the same standards. * **Build in security and compliance.** Partner with AI governance and security on access controls, data flows, and prompt\-injection safeguards. PR) locations (USD):$138,000\.00 \- $234,000\.00 For roles located in California, Seattle WA, Washington DC, Boston MA, and New York City, the base salary range is $153,000 to $261,000 annually. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer (Storage)
jobs.description: **Company Description** **About Mirantis** Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes\-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data\-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production\-ready developer platforms across any environment—on\-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI\-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy\-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock\-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. https://www.mirantis.com/ **Job Description** **Role Overview** Design and build the software that provisions, integrates, and operates high\-performance storage for GPU\-accelerated compute and AI platforms. You will own a Storage as a Service component of the platform end\-to\-end, working with the Product Management, other development teams, and partner engineers to deliver against a dynamic set of requirements. You will develop the control\-plane services, drivers, and tooling that connect enterprise and scale\-out storage systems to Kubernetes\-based workloads across hybrid, edge, and air\-gapped deployments built on the Mirantis K0rdent stack. **About the Role** We are looking for a principal\-level software engineer who thinks in systems and data paths — someone who can reason about throughput, latency, consistency, and failure across a storage stack, then express that understanding as clean, testable Go. software development best practices, including version control, code review, testing, and documentation. * Ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision and to identify, collect, and analyze data. * Ability to lead effective mentoring relationships utilizing appropriate coaching and development methods. * Exceptional interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with research and clinical leadership, faculty, and staff. **Experience:** * 5 years of experience in development, required. * 4 years of experience in full stack development, preferred. * Experience with cloud computing environments, including containerization technologies, preferred. * Experience producing applications or pipelines aligned with defined product requirements, preferred. * Experience leading cross\-functional technical initiatives, including decomposing roadmaps into milestones and measurable outcomes, preferred. **Physical Requirements:** jobs.title: Data Engineer I
jobs.description: **The Job in a Nutshell:** The Data Engineer I will be primarily responsible for support, management, transportation, and reporting of business data across multiple systems. This includes designing, building, monitoring, and modifying ETLs through various technical systems utilizing different technologies. Additionally, this role will include solutioning data quality and access governance throughout the systems through designing and implementing programmed solutions and administrative setup. This role also supports the end users on the reporting and analysis tools with an emphasis on developing self\-sufficiency. Applications are accepted by the date below, which may be updated if the hiring timeline is extended. 11/20/2026 **Main Ingredients:** * Build and manage ETL and API processes, including development, reverse engineering, and optimization utilizing python, shell/powershell, SSIS, jobs/workflows, REST and/or SOAP APIs * Troubleshoot data transfer problems across multiple systems * Create datalakes, datawarehousing, \& datamarts for various business areas and technicals tools (preferred with Databricks) * Develop programs and jobs to check data quality throughout the systems * Create solutions for users to respond to data quality problems including an overall dashboard and feedback of incorrect data for error resolution * Basic skills to support SQL database performance monitoring and query optimization * Troubleshoot database and query performance on servers, including RAM. automation * Basic networking knowledge and Windows/unix system administration * Ad vanced skills or experience in one or more BI tools – Business Objects, SSRS, Power BI, required * Strong Environmental Requirements: * Must be able to work occasionally with cold, heat, sharp tools/equipment, noise, contact stress, dust, fumes and congested worksite.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Core AI
jobs.description: **About the Role** We are building a fleet of specialized AI services that improve high\-value human workflows across the company. As a **Senior Software Engineer, Core AI,** you will design, build, evaluate, and operate production\-grade AI services and agents. You will own work end to end—from data and context design through tool use, application logic, evaluation, and production monitoring. **What You'll Do:** * **Build specialized AI services:** design and implement task\-specific services and agents, including data serialization, retrieval, memory where appropriate, tool integrations, and bounded multi\-step reasoning. * **Define and evaluate quality:** work with partners to make expected behavior explicit, write and maintain evals against representative examples, and use results to measure performance against expectations. * **Improve quality systematically:** use evaluation findings, failure analysis, and production feedback to improve context and data, service logic, tools, and model behavior. * **Build for production:** integrate tracing, observability, versioning, monitoring, reliability practices, and success metrics into the services you own. * **Run controlled experiments:** compare models, data, and implementation approaches using repeatable benchmarks so improvements are attributable and reproducible. * **Partner on architecture:** work with AI Architecture, AI Ops, and Platform teams to make services secure, reliable, cost\-aware, and deployable at scale. * **Ship iteratively:** move quickly from user problem to prototype to production, learning from real workflow outcomes. **What We're Looking For:** * 5\+ years of strong software engineering experience delivering production services or products, ideally at senior or staff level. * Hands\-on experience building AI/LLM\-powered applications or agents with real users or operational use. * Experience with evaluation methods for AI behavior: defining expected outcomes, building test sets or evals, tracking regressions, and acting on results. * A data\-first mindset: able to shape retrieval, context, and serialization to give a model the information needed for the task. * Good judgment about tool use, autonomy, human review, failure handling, privacy, reliability, latency, and cost. * A product\-minded approach focused on solving specific workflow problems and measuring whether the solution works. * Comfort learning tools and frameworks; experience with agent runtimes, model APIs, MCP, tracing, or evaluation tools is helpful. Navan uses AI\-assisted Automated Employment Decision Tool (Metaview) to assist with evaluating resumes against job qualifications for this role. All final decisions are made by human recruiters and hiring managers. **Human oversight:** Metaview does not automatically reject candidates or make final hiring decisions. Our recruiters and hiring managers review all outputs and make the final hiring decision regarding every application. * **Your rights:** If you prefer to have your application reviewed without AI assistance, you may request a human evaluation by entering your email here. Your decision to do so will not affect how your candidacy is evaluated. Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about our processing of personal data, and your rights.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **Who is Navanta?** Navanta is the community bank technology outfitter that inspires confidence for community banks, by providing purpose\-built solutions that make technology work for them, instead of the other way around. Founded in 1991, our purpose is to Empower Community Banks and Our People to Thrive – Together. We live that Purpose by always putting people first in our decisions and actions. Our engaged culture is strongly influenced by the passion our team members bring while serving Community Banks and their communities. We believe in encouraging confidence in each other and delivering solutions that make our customers confident with us. To that end we seek out problem solvers, creative thinkers and engaged individuals that thrive in a fast\-paced yet supportive environment. We believe engaged employees lead to loyal customers, which in turn drives results for our business. We are caring, intense, and approachable, and have a lot of fun along the way. **Summary** Navanta empowers community banks and our people to thrive – together. We are a growing company of passionate, talented and driven individuals who care deeply for one another and our customers. As part of a diverse and skilled Customer Success Solutions team, you will be tasked with providing existing client support, new client deployment and configuration, and general product development as directed. You will work directly with our Navanta financial institutions. You’ll answer questions via phone and email for support issues. This position works under the leadership of the Senior Director of CRM Product Delivery and in collaboration with other teammates across the company. **Knowledge and Skills** A qualified individual will possess the following: * Enjoy working in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment * Strong analytical, creative problem\-solving and troubleshooting abilities * Motivated, curious and independent learner with a strong sense of ownership and accountability * Ability to work effectively with deadline requirements * Professional verbal and written communication skills * Effective time\-management, prioritization and scheduling skills * Take ownership of customers issues and follow problems through to resolution * Motivated to learn and understand CRM architecture * Writes high\-quality code, documentation and unit tests to implement software designs as directed by manager or team lead * Advanced skills with C\#, SQL, .NET framework, XML, SSMS, JavaScript, MVC, JSON, and Visual Studio * Advanced skills with ETL * Advanced skills with IIS, SQL Server, and Windows Server * Proficient with API infrastructure, development, and support * Proficient with managing mobile apps on Apple and Google Play stores and supporting client implementations (currently development is done through Flutter SDK) * Strong communication skills with spoken English language * Desire to continually improve and contribute to our Purpose of Empowering Community Banks and our People to Thrive – Together **Qualifications** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Essential Duties and Responsibilities This list of duties and responsibilities is not all inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities. * Works on software development initiatives at a new enhancement or feature level * Troubleshoot and resolve customer support issues with the Web/Desktop/Web Services using browser developer tools and SQL Profiler * Debug source code * Perform testing of all support, deployment, and upgrade changes * Collaborate with team members to resolve more complex problems and escalate as needed * Configure new client onboarding and deployment for web and desktop applications, web services, windows services, ETL processes, Outlook Add ins, APIs, and mobile applications. * Build and deploy upgrades * Test and deploy new software and procedures, installations, conversions and upgrade activities * Follow procedures and policies * Look for and provide efficiencies for process improvement * Assists with technical and professional skill training for CRM Solutions Engineer role * Other duties as assigned **Education and/or Experience** * Technical degree in related field or equivalent experience is required * 5\+ years software support and development experience desired with required technical skills * Previous experience with work organization tools like Jira or similar * Previous experience at a financial institution or fintech is a plus **Physical Demands** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The employee frequently is required to talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, usually waist high, up to 50 feet away. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. **Work Environment** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. jobs.title: Software Engineer in Test 5 - Discovery & Viewing Experiences
jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. We’re hiring a senior Software Engineer in Test to lead how Netflix tests the experiences members use on their TVs and phones. You’ll define what quality means for complex, fast\-moving features, build the tools and automation that prove it, and help every engineer around you ship with confidence. **The Teams** **Live UI** The Discovery and Viewing Experience (DVX) Live team owns the UI engineering and architecture that powers Live viewing experiences across TV, iOS, and Android. Members show up for live events once, with no second airing and no patch mid\-show, so every feature we build is a promise that it will work at that moment on every device that tunes in. As our senior SDET, you’ll lead the way we test Live: recreating the moments a live event creates, like a vote opening just as an ad ends, long before the event does, so we know we’re ready instead of finding out during the show. **What we’re working on:** * The FIFA Women's World Cup, coming to Netflix in 2027 and 2031, will feature new experiences built for global, multi\-match sport tournaments. * Interactive and navigational features that help members move through a live event and catch the moments that matter. * Real\-time voting , which lets members influence a live show as it unfolds, alongside millions of others watching at the same moment. **Mobile Core** The DVX Mobile Core team develops and advances the architecture of Netflix's Android member app. We leverage systems and infrastructure widely available at Netflix and determine the best way to adopt and apply them on Android, enabling easier, more efficient patterns for downstream product engineering teams. **What we’re working on** : * Modernizing our app architecture for the iOS and Android member app. This involves driving migrations and a cross\-platform Player rewrite, creating leverage for product teams to ship faster and more reliably on iOS and Android. * Driving Quality of Experience (QoE). Owning monitoring and performance improvements across Player UI and canvases, as we scale. **The Role** **Problem you’ll help solve:** * Testing and making sure millions of members see our Live\-specific UI features and capabilities at the right moment, on every TV and phone. * Giving every platform the same test plan, so TV, iOS, and Android are consistently validated the same way. * Making tests reliable enough that PMs, designers, engineers, and our partners trust them, and fast enough to run on every change. * Keeping quality steady while the iOS and Android apps modernize, including a cross\-platform player rewrite, so faster delivery doesn’t come with more regressions. **What you’ll do:** * **Lead testing for complex features across platforms.** Agree on one test plan per feature that teams can trust and validate together, and implement it on TV, iOS, and Android, rather than reconciling differences afterward. * **Build automation that people trust.** Evolve our test systems and CI integration across platforms so tests are fast and reliable. * **Make tricky live moments easy to test.** Build ways to recreate them on demand instead of waiting for a real event, using mocks, overrides, real devices, and test data that looks like a real event and doesn’t expire. * **Make large migrations safe.** Build the test strategy that lets the iOS and Android apps modernize without regressions reaching members * **Own quality metrics.** Track how well we’re covered, how reliable our tests are, and which bugs reach members, and use that to decide what to improve next. That includes the client metrics that reveal problems only scale shows, and the alerts that tell us about them quickly. * **Make sure bugs only surprise us once.** When a bug reaches members, make sure it comes back as a test, using agents to turn each finding into several, and document how to test each feature so the knowledge doesn’t live in one person’s head. * **Build and leverage AI tools.** Act as a force multiplier to flag unwanted behaviors before they reach members, and apply agents to test authoring, failure triage, and bug analysis. * **Shape testability from the first commit.** Partner with engineers on architecture and code that are easy to test, and help them write better tests themselves. * **Test where teams meet.** Agree with partner teams on the contracts between our features and theirs, so end\-to\-end tests verify where teams meet and rehearse what members experience, rather than retesting every team’s systems. * **Collaborate beyond the team.** Work with partner teams on shared test data, environments, and tools, and with teams that run live event ort working across platforms.** You’ve tested consumer apps on more than one platform, and you’re eager to learn the platforms you haven’t used yet. * **Strong coding skills,** with experience designing and building test frameworks and tools, not just writing test cases. * **Experience or strong interest in using AI for testing** , such as writing tests, triaging failures, or finding gaps in coverage, with clear ways to check its results. * Deep experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and diagnosing flaky tests, infrastructure failures, and dependency issues. * Experience with mocking, test data, or other ways to make hard\-to\-reproduce situations repeatable in tests. * A practical, risk\-based approach to quality: knowing where to invest in tests, which risks are acceptable, and when more testing isn’t the answer. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including explaining quality risks and trade\-offs to engineers, product managers, and partners in terms they can act on. * Alignment with Netflix's culture and values. **Nice\-to\-haves:** * Experience with live streaming, video playback, ads, or other systems where split\-second timing matters. * Hands\-on experience with testing frameworks on several platforms, such as Jest, Puppeteer, Espresso, or XCUITest. * Experience driving shared testing infrastructure or quality strategies adopted by multiple teams. * Experience testing how systems behave when things go wrong, such as chaos testing or failure drills. **Growth opportunities:** We’re hiring a senior engineer, and we see this role growing into one that sets the standard for how Netflix tests its Live experiences and mobile apps at scale. Over time, you can: * **Lead testing strategy across teams** , creating the practices and tools that other teams adopt. * **Shape client architecture for testability** across platforms. * **Influence partner teams' tooling and roadmaps** , so our experiences are easy to test for everyone. * **Mentor and grow** engineers and SDETs across the organization. Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $266,000\.00 \- $442,000\.00\. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full\-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full\-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here . Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here . Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

jobs.title: Process Chemist | Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a motivated, curious, and detail\-oriented **Process Chemist (or Engineer)** to join our R\&D team at Novex. This role focuses on laboratory studies and the development of processes to extract, separate, and purify elements from a variety of liquid and solid materials. You will plan and conduct experiments, evaluate how operating conditions affect process performance and product quality, analyze results, and recommend next steps. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, including chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science and engineering, hydrometallurgy, biotechnology, and pharmaceuticals, as well as other laboratory or manufacturing fields. Recent graduates and candidates interested in applying their experience to a new field are encouraged to apply. We value curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to tackle challenging and exciting experiments, learn new techniques, and explore unfamiliar problems. This position is based at our R\&D facility in Bellingham, WA, and offers substantial opportunities to learn, grow professionally, and take on increasing responsibility while contributing to innovative research and process development projects. ### **Why join us?** * **Work on meaningful scientific challenges.** Contribute to cutting\-edge projects focused on critical materials recovery, separation, and purification. * **Put advanced equipment to work.** Gain hands\-on access to a unique suite of analytical and materials characterization instruments, alongside laboratory automation and robotic platforms from **Hamilton, Chemspeed, Sirius Automation, ABB, and FESTO**. Connect detailed material analysis with automated experimentation to investigate complex problems and develop better processes. * **Keep learning and growing.** Expand your expertise across chemistry, engineering, materials science, and automation through challenging experiments and collaborative research. Take on increasing responsibility and help shape new research directions as your skills develop. * **Enjoy flexibility and professional development.** Benefit from flexible work arrangements that accommodate laboratory and project needs, along with opportunities to develop your technical skills and advance your career. * **Make an impact in a growing team.** Bring your ideas, contribute to technical decisions, and see your work help move promising concepts from laboratory studies toward practical applications. * **Live and work between the mountains and the sea.** Bellingham, Washington, offers access to skiing at Mount Baker, sailing in the San Juan Islands, and hiking through Pacific Northwest forests. Enjoy a vibrant local community, cultural attractions, and the character of a smaller city, with Seattle and Vancouver, BC, within reach. **Requirements** ### **Required qualifications and skills** * A bachelor’s or an advanced (M.Sc. or Ph.D.) degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science and engineering, metallurgy, biochemistry, biotechnology, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related scientific or engineering field. * Demonstrated hands\-on laboratory experience with strong understanding of relevant chemical principles and proficiency in laboratory calculations, including solution preparation, concentrations, dilutions, stoichiometry, and material balances. * Ability to plan, execute, and troubleshoot controlled experiments; identify relevant variables; and maintain consistent, reproducible test conditions. * Proficiency with quantitative data analysis, including evaluating variability, identifying trends and inconsistencies, and drawing conclusions supported by experimental evidence. * Ability to operate laboratory equipment, follow and critically evaluate experimental procedures, and maintain accurate, traceable records of samples, methods, conditions, and results. * Strong technical communication skills, including preparing clear experimental summaries, test reports, and recommendations for subsequent work. * Demonstrated commitment to laboratory safety, including chemical handling, hazard assessment, and proper waste management. * Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage assigned work independently while collaborating effectively with the team. ### **Good to have:** * Experience with analytical instrumentation, experimental design, process development, or scale\-up. * Laboratory or process experience in chemical manufacturing, metallurgy and hydrometallurgy, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, or environmental testing. * Experience with separation and purification methods, such as leaching, precipitation, solvent extraction, ion exchange, filtration, or electrochemistry. * **Experience working with laboratory automation**, including automated liquid handling, robotic platforms, instrument integration, or programming and troubleshooting automated experimental workflows. * **Experience using laboratory information management systems (LIMS)** for sample tracking, experimental documentation, data management, and workflow coordination. Novex provides training in its specific methods, equipment, and workflows. Candidates are expected to bring a solid foundation in laboratory practice, quantitative analysis, and scientific problem\-solving. ### **Work authorization** Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States for Novex by their start date. Novex does not offer employment visa sponsorship. However, limited employer support for TN status may be considered for eligible Canadian citizens on a case\-by\-case basis, depending on the position’s duties, the applicant’s qualifications, and the required documentation. **Benefits** * Salary will be commensurate with experience and qualifications. * Comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance. * Retirement savings plan with employer matching. * Paid time off, including vacation, sick leave, and holidays. * Professional development opportunities, including conference attendance and training support.

jobs.title: Process Engineer | Scientist - Materials Processing & Metallization
jobs.description: We are seeking a motivated, curious, and hands\-on **Process Engineer** with **at least five years of relevant experience** in materials processing, metallurgical process development, or related thermal and electrochemical technologies to join our R\&D team at Novex. This role combines **thermal processing, electrochemistry, and materials science** with laboratory and pilot\-scale engineering. A key responsibility is turning experimental concepts into working systems: designing and building custom equipment, testing and commissioning it, and integrating it into automated and robotic laboratory workflows supported by a laboratory information management system (LIMS). We welcome candidates who bring strong technical foundations, practical engineering skills, and a willingness to tackle challenging experiments and unfamiliar problems. This position is based at our R\&D facility in Bellingham, WA, and offers opportunities to expand your expertise, take ownership of technical projects, and help advance new materials processing and metallization technologies. ### **Why join us?** * **Work on meaningful scientific and engineering challenges.** Contribute to cutting\-edge projects focused on critical materials processing, metallization, and alloying. * **Put advanced equipment to work.** Gain hands\-on access to a unique suite of analytical and materials characterization instruments, alongside laboratory automation and robotic platforms from **Hamilton, Chemspeed, Sirius Automation, ABB, and FESTO**. Connect detailed material analysis with thermal processing, electrochemistry, and automated experimentation to develop better processes. * **Keep learning and growing.** Expand your expertise across metallurgy, chemistry, materials science, electrochemistry, and automation through challenging experiments and collaborative research. Take on increasing responsibility and help shape new research directions. * **Enjoy flexibility and professional development.** Benefit from flexible work arrangements that accommodate laboratory and project needs, along with opportunities to develop your technical skills and advance your career. * **Make an impact in a growing team.** Bring your ideas, contribute to technical decisions, and see your work move from experimental concepts to functioning equipment and pilot\-scale demonstrations. * **Live and work between the mountains and the sea.** Bellingham, Washington, offers access to skiing at Mount Baker, sailing in the San Juan Islands, and hiking through Pacific Northwest forests. Enjoy a vibrant local community, cultural attractions, and the character of a smaller city, with Seattle and Vancouver, BC, within reach. ### **Our in\-house capabilities** Our Innovation Center brings process development, advanced characterization, and pilot testing together, including: * **Materials characterization:** SEM, TEM, AFM, XRD, XRF, particle\-size analysis, and rheology. * **Chemical and thermal analysis:** ICP\-MS/OES, atomic absorption (AA), LC\-MS, FTIR, Raman spectroscopy, and thermogravimetric analysis (TGA). * **Thermal and electrochemical processing:** Controlled\-atmosphere furnaces, potentiostats, galvanostats, impedance analysis, and electrochemical reactors. * **Laboratory and pilot equipment:** Reactors, pressure systems, milling, and powder preparation equipment. * **Automation and robotics:** Robotic sample handling, automated liquid and powder dosing, automated reaction platforms, instrumentation, and process monitoring. ### **What you will do** * Develop and optimize thermal, chemical, and electrochemical processes for metallization and materials conversion. * Design, build, modify, test, and commission custom laboratory and pilot systems, including reactors, electrochemical cells, thermal equipment, and experimental test rigs. * Select and integrate pumps, valves, tubing, heaters, sensors, controls, and data acquisition systems. * Develop automated and robotic workflows for sample preparation, dosing, experiments, and analytical testing. * Connect experimental and analytical workflows with LIMS for sample tracking, operating records, results management, and data traceability. * Plan and execute laboratory experiments and pilot trials, using process data and characterization results to improve recovery, purity, jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer, GTM
jobs.description: OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com. **Job Summary** --------------- OpenGov is seeking an AI Solutions Engineer to serve as a dedicated practitioner within the Applied AI team, focused on Sales/GTM use cases across the revenue organization — SDR outbound, AE pipeline and opportunity management, and CSM account management and renewals — along with the account/opportunity intelligence that feeds all three. This role sits at the intersection of seller workflows, revenue systems, and applied AI, and includes hands\-on GTM engineering: building the workflows, integrations, and automations across revenue systems that make sellers faster. It exists to systematically redesign how OpenGov's revenue organization runs its motion in an AI\-native world, from lead through cash and the renewals that follow. This is a technical role applied in a traditionally non\-technical space. You bring a sharp problem\-solving mind, comfort with modern AI tools, and the instinct to decompose a complex, manual seller workflow into its components — and then design something fundamentally better. You need the ability to think from first principles, build trust with sellers and RevOps before designing for them, and own the full lifecycle from problem discovery to solution adoption. You will build the agents and systems that turn raw go\-to\-market signal (procurement data, contract/vendor intelligence, account and contact records, call and email activity) into action sellers actually take — signal\-to\-sequence automation for SDR outbound, next\-best\-action and deal\-risk surfacing for AE opportunity management, and account\-health and renewal\-risk surfacing for CSMs. You will also serve as product owner for systems built entirely in house, and be the primary AI capability advisor for the revenue organization. This role operates within the Applied AI team's technical ecosystem. You will partner closely with a dedicated analytics/ops counterpart on the sales side, partner with AI and data engineers on complex builds, and work directly with sales leadership, RevOps, and SDR/AE/CSM teams for domain guidance and go\-to\-market context. Given the revenue\-centric focus of this work, this role requires a genuine interest in driving conversion across the funnel (such as contact\-to\-meeting rate, S1/S2 conversion, and win rate), along with deal\-cycle length and renewal outcomes. Pipeline management itself sits with sales leadership and RevOps, and you will work closely with them. You will not own KPI definitions or reporting, but you will apply the necessary rigor and ROI framing to make sure what gets built is actually moving those numbers. You will have access to data, ownership, and core responsibilities at a level comparable to senior sales leadership, and are expected to exercise that with corresponding discretion. **You Will…** ------------- * **Own the AI\-native signal\-to\-action layer for Sales**: design, build, and continuously improve the agents and automations that turn account/contact/product signal into qualified SDR sequences, AE opportunity actions, and CSM account and renewal actions, with clear human review and approval points before anything reaches a prospect or customer. * **Build for AE and CSM workflows specifically, not just top\-of\-funnel outbound**: deal\-risk and next\-best\-action surfacing for AEs managing opportunities through the pipeline, and account\-health, renewal\-risk, and expansion\-signal surfacing for CSMs managing customers through renewal — this role's scope is the revenue organization, not one segment of it. * **Serve as product owner for systems built entirely in house**: drive the roadmap, prioritization, and quality bar for the call\- and deal\-intelligence and other revenue systems the Applied AI team builds, in partnership with sales leadership and the RevOps/analytics counterpart. * **Design the human oversight for every agent you ship**: approval gates, escalation paths, and clear ownership boundaries so SDRs, AEs, and CSMs stay in control of what goes out under their name — an agent recommends and drafts, a human approves and sends. * **Build and run evaluation frameworks for agent behavi  tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar), and working fluency with SQL; able to extract insight from data and frame it clearly for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Self\-starter with high initiative: you see opportunities, propose solutions, and drive them forward without waiting to be told. This role will involve significant ambiguity, and the right person will find that energizing rather than paralyzing. * Exceptional written and verbal communication: you write clearly, you do not create information silos, and you know how to tailor your message to the audience in front of you. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Prior experience in sales/revenue operations, customer success operations, or a forward\-deployed/solutions\-architecture role. * Experience with Claude Code, the Claude Agent SDK, or building MCP servers. * Familiarity with AI governance concepts: prompt design, data access controls, audit trails, and responsible AI principles in sensitive\-data environments. * Experience building or deploying workflow automations or internal tools without engineering support. * Familiarity with Snowflake, Looker, or similar data platforms at a data analysis level (not data engineering). * Applied ML and experimentation background: A/B testing, propensity models, recommendations, or lead/account scoring. * Experience working in a fast\-moving, high\-growth SaaS environment where the org is actively evolving and priorities shift quickly. * Experience working at the intersection of Sales and Marketing, or Sales and RevOps — roles that required navigating cross\-functional data ownership and system permissions. * Prior exposure to public sector or B2G sales, or other environments with elevated data handling standards. **Compensation** ---------------- Chicago, IL: $150,000 \- $165,000 On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance. The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location. **Why OpenGov?** ================ **A Mission That Matters.** At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy. **Opportunity to Innovate** The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started. **A Team of Passionate, Driven People** This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune. **A Place to Make Your Mark** We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within. **Benefits That Work for You** Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including: * Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families * Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays * 401(k) with company match * Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions * Professional development and growth opportunities * A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches. Compensation Range: $150K \- $165K

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology, to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, and data they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.** As a **Senior AI/ML Engineer** within Optum Technology, you will design and deliver enterprise\-scale AI solutions, platforms, and automations that transform healthcare delivery and operations. In this role, you will build scalable ML models, optimize data pipelines, and integrate advanced artificial intelligence architectures into production environments with an emphasis on responsible AI use. Working alongside cross\-functional teams of data scientists, software engineers, and product leaders, you will evaluate emerging trends, streamline complex workflows, and deploy cutting\-edge technologies to solve high\-impact healthcare challenges. You will enjoy the flexibility to telecommute\* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. **Primary Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered solutions to address complex business challenges with an emphasis on responsible use of AI * Design, develop, and deploy scalable artificial intelligence and machine learning models into cloud\-based production environments * Use enterprise\-approved AI tools to streamline workflows, automate tasks, and drive continuous improvement * Evaluate emerging trends in artificial intelligence and machine learning to inform solution design and strategic innovation * Build, optimize, and maintain robust data pipelines and ML architectures for training, evaluation, and real\-time inference * Collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to translate healthcare business requirements into technical AI/ML architecture * Monitor, evaluate, and fine\-tune model performance, latency, and accuracy in production environments * Establish best practices for MLOps, including automated testing, model monitoring, version control, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) * Conduct code reviews, mentor technical team members, and drive engineering excellence across the team You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear directions on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in. **Required Qualifications:** * 8\+ years of overall Software engineering experience * 3\+ years of experience with a focus on designing, building, and deploying AI/ML models into enterprise production environments * 3\+ years of experience leveraging AI engineering tools and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit\-learn) to build automated solutions * 3\+ years of programming experience in Python and utilizing modern cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP) for machine learning development * 3\+ years of experience building and optimizing data pipelines and database architectures (e.g., SQL, Spark, Kafka * 2\+ years of experience with containerization, orchestration, and MLOps tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, Kubeflow, or Airflow) **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelors or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field * Experience with Generative AI frameworks, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures * Experience building AI solutions within healthcare, including working with healthcare data standards (e.g., FHIR, HL7\) and privacy/security guidelines * Demonstrated experience mentoring technical team members and evaluating emerging technology trends for enterprise integration * All Telecommuters will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy. Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far\-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $120,100 \- $214,500 annually based on full\-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. ***Application Deadline:*** *This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.* *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location, and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups, and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.* *UnitedHealth Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.* *UnitedHealth Group is a drug\-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.* \#RPO \#GREEN
