jobs.description: Santa Clara, California, United States of America Product Engineering Ref ID: JR\-024724 **Our Mission** At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place. **Who We Are** In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us! We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. **Job Summary** **Your Career** As a Principal Machine Learning Engineer, you will provide technical leadership in architecting and delivering next\-generation, AI\-driven cloud security solutions. In this role, you will drive scalable cloud security architecture through hands\-on system design and coding, build and fine\-tune advanced AI/ML, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Small Language Models (SLMs), oversee the full product lifecycle, and collaborate cross\-functionally to transform complex security telemetry into high\-reliability Security\-as\-a\-Service (SECaaS) offerings. **Your Impact** --------------- * **Architect Agentic Systems:** Lead the design and implementation of ML/GenAI\-powered agents featuring dynamic planning, multi\-step execution, self\-correction, and seamless multi\-agent and human\-in\-the\-loop collaboration. * **Model Development, Diagnosis \& Fine\-Tuning:** Build, evaluate, and fine\-tune both LLMs and SLMs, alongside multimodal architectures. Diagnose model regressions or sub\-par performance, pinpoint root causes (data distribution shift, alignment failures, loss anomalies), and implement targeted fine\-tuning (SFT, DPO/RLHF, PEFT/LoRA) to drive continuous quality recovery and improvement. * **GPU \& System Optimization:** Profile, debug, and optimize model training and inference on GPU clusters, addressing memory allocation bottlenecks (OOMs), distributed communication overhead, and compute utilization. * **Data Pipelines \& Telemetry Integration:** Architect scalable data preprocessing and feature extraction pipelines to feed real\-time endpoint telemetry into agentic and analytical workflows. * **Production Engineering \& Standards:** Drive end\-to\-end engineering from prototype to enterprise\-grade production, establishing best practices for prompt architecture, agent memory persistence, context window optimization, tool\-use execution, and safety guardrails. * **Technical Strategy:** Continuously evaluate state\-of\-the\-art agent frameworks, model serving engines, and accelerator architectures to inform long\-term technical roadmaps.Your **Qualifications** **Your Experience** * **Experience:** 7\+ years in professional software engineering, with a proven track record of deploying production\-grade ML, GenAI, or agentic architectures at enterprise scale. * **Languages \& Backend:** Advanced proficiency in Python (AI/ML development) paired with production\-level Go or Java experience for building distributed microservices. * **Data Pipeline Engineering:** Strong hands\-on capabilities building and scaling data pipelines. Proficient with **Apache Spark, core data tools, SQL**, BigQuery schema design, and Google Cloud infrastructure (Dataproc, GKE, and GCP SDKs). * **LLM/SLM Operations \& Fine\-Tuning:** Practical operational experience with both **LLMs and SLMs**. Deep expertise in diagnosing model performance issues and executing remedial fine\-tuning strategies (dataset curation, parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning, loss monitoring, alignment, and evaluation benchmarks). * **Hardware \& Accelerator Debugging:** Practical experience with **GPU profiling and debugging** (e.g., CUDA memory optimization, multi\-GPU synchronization, batch throughput tuning, and handling GPU compute crashes/stalls). * **Core ML Foundations:** Solid understanding of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector storage, prompt optimization, model evaluation metrics, and applied statistical modeling. * **Education:** BS or MS in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. ### **Preferred Qualifications (Bonus)** * **Domain Knowledge:** Background in cybersecurity, threat detection, or cloud security principles is a strong bonus. * **Networking:** Working knowledge of L3–L7 networking protocols, packet inspection, and network security topologies. * **Telemetry:** Experience handling high\-volume cybersecurity telemetry, endpoint detection data, or real\-time threat intelligence feeds. \#LI\-TD1 **Compensation Disclosure** The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non\-sales roles) or base salary \+ commission target (for sales/com\-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. $163,200\.00 \- $264,000\.00/yr **Our Commitment** We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. jobs.title: IT Business Systems Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra\-low\-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore. The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis. Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries. ### **About the Job** Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean's harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention. We're looking for a Business Systems Engineer to own the platforms our company runs on day to day and the connective tissue between them. Google Workspace, Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, and Slack are where work actually happens here. You'll own how they're configured, and how they talk to each other. This role is for someone who reaches for an API when the admin console runs out of road. A lot of the work is eliminating the manual handoffs between systems: the spreadsheet someone maintains by hand, the ticket someone copies into a second tool, the approval that lives in a DM. You'll find those and replace them with something that runs itself. You'll partner across Finance, People Ops, and Engineering to understand what they need, then build it. Our IAM Engineer owns the identity plane, so you'll work together on SSO and provisioning for the applications you administer. Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis. ### **Responsibilities** #### **Business Platform Administration** * Own Google Workspace administration: tenant configuration, organizational units, Drive and sharing governance, email routing and security, and rollout of new capabilities * Administer Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence, including projects, workflows, custom fields, forms, permission schemes, automation rules, and reporting * Own Slack workspace configuration: channel standards, app and integration approvals, retention, and Slack Connect governance * Maintain a clear administration model for each platform, including who can change what and how changes are reviewed #### **Integrations and Automation** * Design and build integrations between business systems using APIs, webhooks, and automation platforms * Write and maintain code that automates recurring work across SaaS tools, with version control, monitoring, and error handling * Replace manual processes and shadow spreadsheets with reliable, observable workflows * Own the reliability of the integrations you build, including alerting when they fail and runbooks for when they need help #### **Business Partnership** * Work with Finance, People Ops, Legal, and Engineering to translate process problems into system designs * Drive intake, requirements, and rollout for new business applications, including evaluation, pilot, and adoption * Build reporting and dashboards that give teams visibility into their own work * Document configurations and workflows so the next person can pick them up #### **SaaS Stack Health** * Maintain our SaaS application inventory, including ownership, license counts, and renewal dates * Right\-size licensing and surface underused spend * Partner with our IAM Engineer to bring applications under SSO and automated provisioning * Own the application layer of our compliance framework (NIST or equivalent), including access control, audit logging, and data retention ### **Required Qualifications** * Experience administering business platforms such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Atlassian products, or Slack at an organization of meaningful size * Experience writing code against SaaS APIs to automate work the admin console couldn't do * Experience designing and maintaining integrations between business systems using REST APIs, webhooks, or an integration platform * Ability to work directly with non\-technical stakeholders, understand the underlying process problem, and propose a system that solves it * Ability to write clear documentation for both administrators and end users ### **Desired Qualifications** * Atlassian experience: Jira workflow and permission scheme design, JSM request types and queues, and Confluence space administration * Google Workspace administration experience, including Drive governance, Vault, and security settings * Scripting and development skills (Python, JavaScript, or Google Apps Script) with source control and testing practices * Experience with SaaS lifecycle management: evaluation, implementation, renewal, and license optimization * Familiarity with SSO and SCIM from the application administrator's side * Experience supporting a security or compliance framework (NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or equivalent) The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed. ### **Additional Requirements** * Available for occasional off\-hours work to support platform migrations and integration cutovers that have to land outside business hours * Travel to the Portland office quarterly if working remotely * Intermittently able to work longer hours to support critical needs. While we expect a lot of each other, we also offer a high degree of autonomy and work\-life balance, including flexible PTO and flexible working hours. ### **Compensation and Benefits** If hired for this full\-time role, you will receive: * Cash compensation of $120,000 \- $180,000\. * Equity in the company. We're all owners and if we're successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation. * A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including: + Flexible paid time off + Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold\-level PPO plan for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long\-term financial support if you become disabled) + Ability to contribute to tax\-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA * Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed). ### **Location** This is ideally an on\-site position, based at our offices, lab, and shop inPortland, Oregon. **We will consider exceptional remote candidates who can commit to being on\-site in Portland, Oregon at least one week per quarter**.

jobs.description: ### **About the Company** We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. We're looking for an IAM Engineer to own the identity plane at Panthalassa. Identity is the control point for everything we do: who gets access to what, on which device, from where, and for how long. You'll build that system and the automation behind it. This is a high\-ownership individual contributor role. You'll administer Microsoft Entra ID and Google Workspace identity, design Conditional Access and context\-aware policy, automate joiner/mover/leaver, and bring every SaaS application in our stack under SSO and automated provisioning. You'll also help govern the identities that aren't people: service accounts, OAuth grants, and workload credentials. We have an established zero trust roadmap and a security framework to comply with, and your job is to turn both into enforceable technical controls and explain the reasoning well enough that the rest of the company comes along with you. Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis. ### **Responsibilities** #### **Identity Infrastructure** * Administer Microsoft Entra ID, including user lifecycle, group management, dynamic membership rules, and role assignment. * Design and maintain Conditional Access policy, tying device compliance posture, identity signals, risk, and location to resource access. * Own authentication standards: MFA, phishing\-resistant methods, passwordless rollout, and legacy auth retirement. * Partner with our Endpoint Engineer so access policy and device posture stay in sync. #### **Access Automation and Lifecycle** * Automate joiner, mover, and leaver so access is granted and revoked from a source of truth rather than a ticket. * Manage SSO integrations and application provisioning via SAML and SCIM across our SaaS stack. * Build and run access review and recertification cycles that produce evidence auditors accept. * Implement least privilege for privileged roles, including just\-in\-time elevation and break\-glass procedures. #### **Non\-Human Identity and Governance** * Govern service accounts, OAuth grants, and API credentials: naming conventions, ownership, scope review, and rotation. * Establish where secrets live and how they are issued, stored, and retired. * Maintain a defensible inventory of who and what can reach our systems. #### **Security and Compliance** * Advance our zero trust roadmap and translate policy into enforceable technical controls. * Own the access control domain of our compliance framework (NIST or equivalent), including documentation and evidence. * Partner with information security leadership on access control policy, identity threat detection, and incident response involving compromised accounts. ### **Required Qualifications** * Experience administering identity and access in a modern IdP, including user lifecycle, groups, and conditional or context\-aware access. * Experience implementing SSO and provisioning integrations (SAML, SCIM) across a SaaS stack. * Automation experience: scripting or API work against identity and SaaS platforms rather than console\-only administration. * Ability to write clear documentation and turn written policy into enforceable technical controls. * Ability to explain the reasoning behind an access decision to a non\-technical audience and get buy\-in. ### **Desired Qualifications** * Experience owning an IdP at a growing technology company. * Familiarity with zero trust architecture and how it translates into identity controls. * Experience with identity governance and administration: access reviews, entitlement management, and privileged access. * Experience governing non\-human identities, service accounts, and OAuth scopes. * Experience supporting or implementing a security or compliance framework (NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or equivalent). * Experience with identity threat detection and response, or investigating account compromise. The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed. ### **Additional Requirements** * Available for occasional off\-hours work to support identity migrations, tenant changes, and access cutovers that have to land outside business hours. * Participate in incident response when accounts or credentials are involved, including outside business hours. * Travel to the Portland office quarterly if working remotely. * Intermittently able to work longer hours to support critical needs. While we expect a lot of each other, we also offer a high degree of autonomy and work\-life balance, including flexible PTO and flexible working hours. ### **Compensation and Benefits** If hired for this full\-time role, you will receive: * Cash compensation of $120,000 \- $180,000\. * Equity in the company. We're all owners and if we're successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation. * A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including: + Flexible paid time off + Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold\-level PPO plan for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long\-term financial support if you become disabled) + Ability to contribute to tax\-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA * Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed). ### **Location** This is ideally an on\-site position, based at our offices, lab, and shop inPortland, Oregon. **We will consider exceptional remote candidates who can commit to being on\-site in Portland, Oregon at least one week per quarter.**

work, including advice on client AI use, complies with PLEXIS security and AI policies, HIPAA data\-handling requirements, and each client's own data governance. * Manages priorities across multiple jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Manufacturing Test
jobs.description: **About Positron AI** Positron AI is building next\-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low\-latency, high\-throughput large language model inference. Chips built for the training era keep running into two walls at inference time: memory bandwidth and chip\-to\-chip networking. We designed our architecture to break through both. Our first\-generation Atlas systems are already in production on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Asimov, our first custom ASIC, takes that architecture to silicon. In simulations, Asimov delivers several times more tokens per dollar and tokens per watt than leading GPUs, at a fraction of the power. Paired in our Titan system, Asimov is built to serve models beyond 16 trillion parameters. In September 2026, we raised $875 million at a $5 billion valuation. NEA led the round, joined by Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, and others, to bring Asimov and Titan to market. Our team includes engineers from Groq, Lambda, NVIDIA, Meta, F5, and many other industry leaders. **Role Overview** ----------------- As a Senior Software Engineer on our Manufacturing Test team, you will build the reliable test software that verifies the quality of Positron hardware, catches defects before systems ship, and produces diagnostics that engineers can act on. You will own tests from initial development through production deployment, partnering closely with hardware, firmware, and manufacturing teams to improve test coverage, repeatability, and failure isolation. This is a hands\-on senior role for an engineer who writes production Go, understands systems down to the hardware, and uses agentic coding tools to move fast without compromising rigor. This role is based in\-office at our Spokane Valley, WA location. Candidates must be able to work on\-site as required. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Test Development in Go*** Design, build, and maintain production\-quality manufacturing tests in Go with clearly defined pass/fail criteria, actionable diagnostics, and thorough documentation. * Develop hardware tests and diagnostics across PCIe/AER, CPU, memory, I²C, SPI, PRBS, NICs, BMC/IPMI/Redfish, and drive I/O. * Build system\-level functional, stress, reliability, and performance tests for Positron platforms. **Test Strategy and Validation*** Translate platform requirements and failure modes into prioritized coverage plans with measurable pass/fail criteria, balancing defect detection, runtime, and repeatability. * Validate test effectiveness against known\-good hardware and representative failures, and maintain automated regression coverage as tests evolve. **Failure Analysis and Cross\-Functional Partnership*** Investigate ambiguous failures and isolate root causes across hardware, firmware, and operating system boundaries. * Partner with hardware, firmware, and manufacturing teams to close coverage gaps, and clearly communicate risks and tradeoffs across teams. **Agentic Development*** Direct coding agents through well\-scoped tasks to accelerate implementation, debugging, and test development, while retaining full accountability for design, correctness, code review, and hardware validation. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 5\+ years demonstrated experience designing, shipping, debugging, and maintaining production\-quality Go software, including concurrency, error handling, automated testing, and maintainable interfaces. * Experience with FPGA, AI, Inference HW test. * A strong understanding of computer architecture, including CPUs, memory, PCIe, storage, networking, and the interactions among hardware, firmware, and operating systems. * Hands\-on experience writing hardware tests and isolating failures across multiple domains such as PCIe/AER, CPU, I²C, SPI, memory, PRBS, NICs, BMC/IPMI/Redfish, and drive I/O. * Proven ability to turn platform requirements and failure modes into prioritized coverage, measurable pass/fail criteria, and validation plans. * Practical skill directing coding agents through well\-scoped tasks, providing relevant context, critically reviewing generated changes, and verifying behavior through software tests and hardware validation. * Senior\-level engineering ownership, with the ability to independently drive test development and technical decisions and to communicate coverage gaps and tradeoffs across teams. * Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or similar equivalent additional years of experience **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * A track record of delivering and supporting hardware tests at contract manufacturers, including deployment, station qualification, documentation, and remote troubleshooting. * Familiarity with analyzing manufacturing test data to improve coverage, reduce false failures, and shorten debugging time. * Experience building CI/CD pipelines, automated regression infrastructure, and test release management processes. ### **Leveling \& Scope** While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth\-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- Success in this role means delivering production\-ready hardware tests in Go that carry clearly defined pass/fail criteria, actionable diagnostics, automated regression coverage, and solid documentation, with their effectiveness proven against both known\-good hardware and representative failures. It also means using agentic coding to accelerate implementation, debugging, and test development while remaining fully accountable for design, correctness, review, and hardware validation. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- * Own the test software that stands between a new class of AI inference hardware and production, with direct influence on the quality of every system Positron ships. * Work across the full stack, from PCIe and BMC to system\-level stress testing, alongside hardware, firmware, and manufacturing engineers bringing Asimov and Titan to market. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- The base salary range for this role is $200,000 – $250,000\. Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits. At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future.**Health and wellness*** Fully company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents * Company\-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more * Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available **Time off and flexibility*** Unlimited paid time off; we encourage everyone to truly unplug and recharge * 13 paid company holidays * Remote\-first culture with a company\-provided computer and home office setup **Compensation and future*** Competitive salary and equity * 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one **Visa Support** ---------------- This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H\-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates. **Equal Opportunity Employer.** If you're excited about the role but don't meet every bullet, we'd still love to hear from you.

jobs.title: System Administrator
jobs.description: **JOB TITLE:** System Administrator **DEPARTMENT:** Office \- IT **LOCATION:** Dublin, TX **PAY:** $60,000 \- $75,000/yr **BENEFITS:** Benefits include a full health insurance policy that is 100% covered by Prime, a 50% matching 401(k) package, and a $25,000 life insurance policy. Comprehensive dental, vision and supplemental life insurance options are also available. PTO is available after 6 months. 7 paid holidays. **SUMMARY:** Our System Administrator reports to the CIO and runs the day\-to\-day operation of Prime’s IT environment across all locations, including end\-user devices, Microsoft 365, networking, phones, servers, and backups. Working with our Senior Systems Engineer, they take over systems once they are built and are responsible for keeping them maintained, monitored, secure, and documented. They also handle escalated support issues and cover the help desk when needed. This is a hands\-on role on a small team, so the right person is comfortable working independently and owning their work from start to finish. **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Serve as the escalation point for support issues and provide tier 1 help desk coverage as needed; troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, printer, and connectivity issues in person, by phone, and remotely. * Own the device lifecycle: set up, image, deploy, and retire computers, laptops, mobile devices, and peripherals for new hires, role changes, and departures. * Administer user accounts, groups, licenses, and permissions in Microsoft 365 and the company’s directory, collaboration, and file\-sharing services. * Maintain the IT asset inventory system, keeping device assignments, serial numbers, and warranty information current. * Administer and maintain the network across company locations, including firewalls, switches, and wireless access points; diagnose and resolve connectivity issues. * Administer the company VoIP phone system, including extensions, call routing, provisioning desk phones, and resolving call issues. * Maintain server and backup infrastructure, including patching and updates, verifying backups and restores, reviewing logs, and performing routine maintenance. * Enforce security best practices such as patching, endpoint protection, multi\-factor authentication, and least\-privilege access; investigate and respond to security alerts and suspicious activity. * Monitor alerts and system health across all sites and resolve issues before they affect users. * Take over new systems from the Senior Systems Engineer once built, and work with vendors on support cases and service issues. * Write and maintain clear documentation, runbooks, and checklists for systems, configurations, and procedures. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience. * 2–5 years of hands\-on experience in systems administration, IT administration, or desktop support. * Working knowledge of desktop and server operating systems, cloud productivity suites, and networking (IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, Wi\-Fi). * Familiarity with command\-line tools or scripting is a plus. * Industry certifications in IT support, networking, or security are a plus. * Strong verbal communication skills and a patient, friendly approach when helping non\-technical employees. * Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and keep thorough documentation. * Valid driver’s license and ability to travel occasionally between company locations; ability to lift up to 50 lbs. for equipment setup. **COMPETENCIES:** * **Adaptability** \- Adapts to changes in the work environment; Manages competing demands; Changes approach or method to best fit the situation; Able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events. * **Analytical** \- Synthesizes complex or diverse information; Collects and researches data; Uses intuition and experience to complement data; Designs workflows and procedures. * **Attendance/Punctuality** \- Is consistently at work and on time; Ensures work responsibilities are covered when absent; Arrives at meetings and appointments on time. * **Dependability** \- Follows instructions, responds to management direction; Takes responsibility for own actions; Keeps commitments; Is available for after\-hours support or maintenance when necessary; Completes tasks on time or notifies appropriate person with an alternate plan. * **Ethics** \- Treats people with respect; Keeps commitments; Inspires the trust of others; Works with integrity and ethically; Upholds organizational values. * **Initiative** \- Volunteers readily; Undertakes self\-development activities; Seeks increased responsibilities; Takes independent actions and calculated risks; Looks for and takes advantage of opportunities; Asks for and offers help when needed. * **Communication** \- Explains technical issues clearly to non\-technical employees; Listens and gets clarification; Responds well to questions; Writes clear, accurate documentation and procedures. * **Problem Solving** \- Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics. * **Quality** \- Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality. * **Teamwork** \- Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed. * **Technical Skills** \- Assesses own strengths and weaknesses; Pursues training and development opportunities; Strives to continuously build knowledge and skills; Shares expertise with others. *The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or physical requirements. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.* *Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (GenAI, AWS)
jobs.description: **At Provectus**, you don’t prototype in a sandbox and hand a client a slide deck. You embed inside a bank, an insurer, or a health system, learn the work, and ship a Claude \+ AWS system into their real, regulated production. Then you watch the business number move. We’re an **Anthropic** and **AWS Partner** with 150\+ certified architects. That means the newest models, real budgets, and problems that matter, without the layers, politics, and long wait for impact of a firm with a hundred thousand people. 350\+ builders, 100\+ customers in production, led by our founders since 2010, offices across North America, LATAM, and EMEA ### **Why Provectus?** * **Frontier access. Anthropic Preferred Partner:** newest Claude models, real budgets, real problems. * **Real tasks (not scope), real deployment.** You go where the operating problem is and ship production code to real users, not slide decks that sit in a drive. * **Embedded, not engaged.** You are part of the customer’s team and inside their process, not a vendor running a project alongside it. Embedded is not staff augmentation. * **Autonomous**. You own the work from framing through to production, visible to clients and founders. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket. * **Your experience stays portable.** Every engagement is a new problem, often in a new industry, so your skills compound instead of narrowing to one product. No legacy maintenance grind, not a single stack. * **Craft \& growth.** Build beside senior FDEs on a Claude certified team, with a real platform (talks, OSS) to grow your name. * **We give you a stage:** Claude certification, conference talks, open source contributions, published work under your own name. ### **What you’ll do:** * Spend the first weeks of each engagement in the operator’s seat, learning the constraints from the inside, then rebuild the function from first principles alongside the client and a Forward Deployed Executive. You are the one who builds it * Be part of the customer’s team, inside their process; work on real tasks, not scoped deliverables, and own the method autonomously * You won’t start from zero. Provectus builds industry Blueprints, working systems that have already shipped for a customer in your industry. Your engagement starts from that baseline, and what you learn in the field goes back into it * Deliver across Cowork Activation, Agentic SDLC, and Blueprint Activations in Financial Services and Healthcare * Help shape how leading enterprises adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment; help build the tooling and frameworks of a growing AI delivery practice ### **What we look for:** * Typically 7\+ years building software, a substantial share of it writing production code you were accountable for. You are hands on today and intend to stay that way * Genuinely willing to spend time understanding someone else’s job before writing code; demonstrated ability to become conversant in an unfamiliar business function quickly * Shipped GenAI/LLM systems to production, not demos, not notebooks. You’ve handled the parts that get hard after the prototype works * You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a nondeterministic system, and you can explain what you measured and why * Strong engineering fundamentals. Dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack * Cloud native delivery on AWS (GCP/Azure a plus), including the operational reality of a system someone else inherits * Presales experience. Credible with senior stakeholders: you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO without losing either room * Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job * Hands on experience with Claude, Claude Code, and Cowork (skills, workflows, MCP, integrations, connectors, custom harnesses) **Nice to have:** * Containers and orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS) and CI/CD in production * IaC depth: AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform * Open source contributions or public writing on applied AI ### **What We Offer:** * Full time * On site visits to client’s facilities and our office in NYC once a week * Unlimited Vacation policy * Generous health, vision, and dental insurance * 401(k) matching plan * Base salary $180k to $250k \+ bonuses; OTE up to $300k. The salary range is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, and alignment with market data * No Visa sponsorship ### **We’re real:** * A person reads your application. We filter out AI generated and fraudulent submissions automatically. Every application that clears that filter is read by someone on our team * We may ask for a quick ID verification. Fraudulent applications are common, and this protects real candidates * You’ll meet the people you’d work with. We host AI engineering events in New York and San Francisco. We’d be happy to talk in person. Your interviews are with Pavel Borobov, Solutions Architect, and Stepan Pushkarev, Cofounder \& CEO ### **How we hire:** * Recruitment interview. * Tech interview with our FDE (30 min). * A live engineering building session (1\.5 hours). We hand you a business function and the constraints. You have to understand the job and rebuild it — then say what you’d build and how you’d know it worked. ***Use AI the way you normally would; we expect AI\-generated code. What we look at is how you used AI, the judgment behind your choices, and what you researched beyond what any LLM already knows.*** * Soft skills interview. * Offer discussion. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition & People Partner (AI Engineering, Product, GTM), New York / New Jersey
jobs.description: ### **About the Role:** The problem you'd be solving We build AI systems that enterprises run their business on. Production systems inside banks, insurers, and health systems, where our engineers embed with the client, learn the work, and own the outcome. We call them Forward Deployed Engineers and Forward Deployed Executives. These people hold design conversations with a Chief Data Officer on Tuesday and ship to production next Monday. We are hiring a People \& Talent Partner to help us scale our FDE/FDX, Product, and GTM teams. Five open reqs at a time, none of them generic. We would rather you run five properly than twenty badly. Beyond filling roles, you will own the talent community strategy around Provectus, and you will build the people\-operations presence for our US team locally — be the person our US colleagues come to first. Location: Hybrid, New York: 2\-3 days onsite. Type: Full\-time (W2\). ### **What You'll Do:** **Recruiting:** * Full\-cycle hiring across the US for Forward Deployed Engineers (software, AI/ML, architects, leads), Forward Deployed Executives, Product Owners, and Business Development Managers. Intake to offer: * Partnership with the hiring managers. You'll run calibration with them and bring market data when a scorecard doesn't match what exists. * Architect and execute Provectus's talent community strategy in the US. Meetups, workshops, hackathons, university programs, and the AI/ML communities. You don't need to have run events before. You need to want to help with that, and there's a budget and support from marketing when you do. * US hiring strategy. Talent market intelligence, compensation benchmarking, and how we position Provectus against the companies competing for the same engineers. **People operations for the US team.** You'll be the on\-the\-ground people partner for our US\-based colleagues, working with the Head of People Operations: * Onboarding of US hires. * First point of contact for US employees on benefits, time off, policies, and day\-to\-day people questions. * Support for the performance review cycle for US\-based staff: scheduling, collecting feedback, tracking outcomes. * Team engagement and onsite days — the rhythm that makes a hybrid New York team feel like a team. **What's the split between Recruiting and HR?** 70/30### **What You'll Bring:** * 4\+ years of full\-cycle recruiting experience in a fast\-paced technical environment, ideally at an AI, cloud, or consulting firm * Proven track record of sourcing and hiring senior technical profiles — AI/ML engineers, software engineers, architects, or consulting leaders * Demonstrates personal AI adoption — uses AI tools as part of their recruiting workflow, not just aware of them * Exposure to HR generalist or people\-operations work — onboarding, benefits, employee relations — or a clear appetite to build it. You don't need to have been an HRBP. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable partnering with C\-level and senior technical leadership * Highly organized, self\-directed, and comfortable with ambiguity in a distributed, global team * Commitment to Provectus's core values: Obsession, Ownership, Transparency, and Partnership * Based in the New York / New Jersey area and able to be onsite \[2\-3] days a week **Nice to have:** * Experience building talent community: events, meetups, professional networks, or university programs * Familiarity with US benefits administration, onboarding, and experience with an HRIS. **Where this goes:** This is a growing US function. The person who does this well takes on more of the community mandate, more senior searches, a deeper people\-partner role as the US team grows, and a path toward owning the US talent function. We'll talk about that trajectory. ### **What We Offer:** * Direct impact on Provectus's growth in the US market with direct visibility to leadership. * Access to the Provectus Learning Hub, Claude Code certification support * Collaborative culture that rewards ownership, curiosity, and continuous learning * Full\-time W2 model. * Base $150k\- 170k. Final offer reflects experience, skills, and market data. * Health, vision, dental, disability, and life insurance; 401(k) plan; unlimited vacation. ### **About Provectus:** Provectus is an AWS Premier Partner and an Anthropic Strategic Partner working at the front edge of applied AI. We help enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable outcomes through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory work. We focus on Financial Services \& Insurance and Healthcare \& Life Sciences, with offices across North America, LATAM, and EMEA.### **Hiring Process:** * 30\-45\-minute call with the Head of Talent Acquisition * 30\-minute call with the Head of People Operations * On\-site meeting with the CEO We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

The Integration \& Automation Engineer is responsible for the design, configuration, integration, and reliable operation of the plant's utility control systems — including PLC, DCS, SCADA/FMCS, HMI, field instrumentation, and industrial networks — that connect electrical, mechanical, and process utility equipment into a single, monitored and controlled system in a 24/7 critical manufacturing environment. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Control System Operation \& Maintenance** * Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot PLC, DCS, SCADA/FMCS, and HMI systems serving plant utilities (power distribution, chillers, compressed air, exhaust, UPW/wastewater, and bulk gas/chemical supply). * Manage control system backups, program revision control, firmware/software updates, licenses, and spare hardware. * Perform control loop checks, instrument calibration, and tuning of flow, pressure, temperature, level, and analyzer loops. **System Integration \& Communication** * Integrate package PLCs, power meters, switchgear, VFDs/MCCs, and third\-party equipment into FMCS/SCADA using Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC DA/UA, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, BACnet, and serial (RS\-485/RS\-232\) protocols. * Develop and maintain I/O lists, point/tag mapping, alarm lists, and interface specifications; resolve communication and data quality issues between systems. * Build and maintain HMI/SCADA graphics, alarms, trends, and historian data (e.g., OSIsoft/AVEVA PI) for operations and engineering use. **Industrial Network \& OT Cybersecurity** * Maintain the OT network architecture (switches, fiber, remote I/O, gateways) and its segregation from the IT network. * Implement OT cybersecurity practices, including access control, system hardening, patch management, and remote access procedures, in coordination with the IT team. **Safety \& Protection Systems** * Maintain interlocks, emergency shutdown logic, and safety\-related control functions; support review of safety instrumented functions and proof testing where applicable. * Support interfaces between the control system and fire alarm, gas detection, and toxic gas monitoring systems. **Troubleshooting \& Reliability** * Serve as first\-line technical responder for control system failures, communication losses, and nuisance trips; lead root cause analysis and corrective action reports. * Participate in the on\-call rotation for after\-hours control and automation emergencies. **Projects \& Expansion** * Support plant capacity expansion and modification projects: develop control philosophy and functional design specifications, prepare RFQs and technical bid evaluations, review vendor submittals, and attend FAT/SAT. * Oversee control system installation, loop checks, and commissioning (Level 3–5\) through turnover; coordinate with EPC/controls contractors, system integrators, and equipment vendors. **Documentation \& Technical Support** * Maintain system architecture drawings, P\&IDs, loop drawings, control narratives, network diagrams, and as\-built documentation. * Provide technical guidance and training to automation and instrumentation technicians and operators. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Control/Instrumentation, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in configuration, integration, commissioning, or maintenance of PLC, DCS, and/or SCADA systems in industrial, utility, or process plant environments. * Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols (Modbus, OPC, Ethernet\-based fieldbuses) and industrial networking. * Ability to read and interpret P\&IDs, loop diagrams, control narratives, one\-line diagrams, and wiring diagrams. * Familiarity with NEC, NFPA 70E, and OSHA electrical safety requirements. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel. * Ability to communicate effectively in English with contractors, vendors, and plant personnel. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * **Experience integrating multi\-vendor control systems (e.g., Allen\-Bradley/Rockwell, Siemens, Yokogawa, Emerson, Honeywell) into a plant\-wide SCADA/FMCS or historian platform.** * Experience in semiconductor, high\-purity chemical, solar, battery, or other mission\-critical manufacturing facilities. * Experience with safety instrumented systems (SIS/ESD) and fire \& gas systems; TÜV Functional Safety Engineer (IEC 61511/61508\) certification. * Experience with OT cybersecurity standards and programs (e.g., ISA/IEC 62443\). * Electrical system knowledge, including MCCs, VFDs, switchgear, UPS, and power monitoring. * Project management experience, including scope, schedule, budget, and contract management with EPC contractors and vendors. * Network certifications (e.g., CCNA) or equivalent industrial networking training. * OSHA 10/30 certification; NFPA 70E qualified person training. **Working Conditions** ---------------------- * Work in a 24/7 manufacturing facility, including control rooms, electrical rooms, utility buildings, and outdoor areas. * Participation in on\-call rotation and occasional after\-hours, weekend, or shutdown work. * Required to wear PPE, including arc\-rated clothing, as specified by task. * Ability to climb ladders, work in confined or elevated spaces, and lift up to 50 lbs. *Hanwha Q CELLS provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics.*

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Are you looking to power the next leap in the exciting world of advanced electronics?Do you want to help solve problems that drive success in the rapidly evolving technology and connectivity landscape? Then bring your problem\-solving, passion, and creativity to help us power the next leap in electronics. AtQnity, we’re more than a global leader in materials and solutions for advanced electronics and high\-tech industries – we’re a tight\-knit team that is motivated by new possibilities, and always up for a challenge. All our dedicated teams contribute to making cutting\-edge technology possible. We value forward\-thinking challengers, boundary\-pushers, and diverse perspectives across all our departments, because we know we play a critical role in the world enabling faster progress for all. Learn how you can start or jumpstart your career with us. Senior AI Engineer Qnity is accepting applications for a full\-timeSenior AI Engineer position based at one of Qnity’s main campuses inWilmington, Delaware, USA. For engineers who want to take generative AI beyond experimentation and into daily production use, this is an exciting opportunity to join a growing team that plays a vital and dynamic role in the company. Qnity is a market leader in specialty materials for electronic devices and microchip fabrication. In this role, the Senior AI Engineer will collaborate with data scientists, operations scientists, and Digital and IT teams engaged in a variety of manufacturing and business activities, building the agentic AI and enterprise retrieval capabilities these teams depend on. Generative AI, agent orchestration, and enterprise search are becoming core to business operations, creating opportunities to contribute across: * Enterprise agentic AI platform architecture * Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) over proprietary technical and business content * Multi\-agent automation for business and manufacturing workflows * Secure, permission\-aware enterprise data access * Production deployment, evaluation, observability, and AI cost optimization A strong candidate will bring modern AI engineering expertise in LLM application design, retrieval and ranking, agent orchestration, prompt engineering, evaluation, and machine learning. The role requires strong Python skills to prepare and index data, build and serve models and agents, and create clear documentation and demonstrations. The Senior AI Engineer will also plan delivery, lead technical work, communicate with business stakeholders, integrate with data engineering and software teams, deploy production solutions, and coach the broader community. Key Responsibilities * Partner with business stakeholders to define use cases, scope, and success criteria, and translate business problems into AI, machine learning, or computer vision solutions. * Lead end\-to\-end AI delivery, including architecture, technical direction, code quality, deployment, operations, reliability, performance, and cost. * Architect and operate the enterprise agentic AI platform on Azure AI Foundry, optimizing models, orchestration, retrieval, evaluation, latency, scale, and cost. * Design enterprise RAG over SharePoint and Microsoft 365 content using Microsoft Graph, permission\-aware ingestion, embeddings, metadata, re\-ranking, and access\-controlled search. * Build Copilot Studio agents, custom connectors, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams agents, MCP servers, and function\-calling tools for governed enterprise actions. * Design multi\-agent patterns, including orchestrator\-worker delegation, sequential and concurrent execution, handoff, collaboration, state management, and memory. * Develop and evaluate AI applications for knowledge discovery, workflow automation, quality improvement, process monitoring, defect detection, and operational efficiency. * Collaborate with data engineering, software, and digital teams to integrate enterprise data, build scalable pipelines, and deliver production solutions through CI/CD. * Set enterprise AI engineering standards, reusable architecture patterns, and design\-review practices that reduce production risk. * Communicate results, coach engineers and data scientists, and drive adoption through responsible AI, user feedback, and continuous improvement. Required Skills\& Education * Bachelor’s degree or higher in data science, computer science, engineering, or a related technical field. * 1\+ years of experience building and deploying production AI and machine learning systems. * Strong Python development skills, with SQL/NoSQL experience. Java or R experience is a plus. * Hands\-on Azure AI experience, including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Agent Service, Prompt Flow, evaluation, embeddings, and content safety. * Advanced RAG and search skills, including Azure AI Search, hybrid/vector retrieval, semantic ranker, chunking, metadata filtering, re\-ranking, and document\-level security trimming. * Experience with Microsoft Graph, SharePoint Online, Microsoft 365 content, Entra ID app registrations, delegated/application permissions, and ACL\-based access control. * Copilot and agent extensibility experience with Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams agents, MCP servers, custom connectors, function\-calling tools, Adaptive Cards, Graph connectors, and governed enterprise integrations. * Agent orchestration experience with Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, LangChain/LangGraph, planner\-executor patterns, ReAct loops, tool calling, and guardrails. * Applied ML, NLP, and computer vision foundation, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, transformers, deep learning, object detection, and image segmentation. * Production AI engineering experience with LLMOps/MLOps, evaluation, regression testing, observability, tracing, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, Azure Functions, AKS/Container Apps, API Management, Key Vault, Application Insights, and Azure Monitor. * Working knowledge of enterprise AI security and governance, including permission trimming, data residency, Purview sensitivity labels, DLP, responsible AI, prompt\-injection defenses, and cost controls. * Strong technical leadership, architecture review, mentoring, stakeholder communication, and delivery ownership skills. Preferred Experience * Experience in manufacturing, semiconductor, specialty materials, or operational technology environments. Living the Qnity ValuesAt Qnity, success is measured not only bywhat we achieve, but also byhow we achieve it. * Customer: Partner with stakeholders to understand needs, solve business challenges, and deliver meaningful outcomes. * Innovation: Continuously improve processes, technologies, and ways of working. * Speed: Act with urgency, focus, and precision to move work forward and deliver results. * People: Build trusted relationships, collaborate across teams, and inspire positive change. Join ourTalent Community to stay connected with us! Qnity is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability or any other protected class. If you need a reasonable accommodation to search or apply for a position, please visit our Accessibility Page for Contact Information. Qnity offers a comprehensive pay and benefits package. To learn more visit theCompensation and Benefits page. We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to enhance our recruitment process.

jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. **Job Area:** ------------- Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Machine Learning Researcher **General Summary:** Qualcomm AI Research is seeking world\-class researchers to help push the boundaries of artificial intelligence and machine learning. Our team pioneers new algorithms, models, and systems that advance the state of the art while delivering exceptional performance with unprecedented power, memory, and computational efficiency. Our multidisciplinary team brings together expertise across algorithms, software, hardware, and systems. We pursue fundamental and applied research, from foundational theories and novel learning algorithms to efficient AI systems deployed on resource\-constrained devices. Working closely with Qualcomm's business and engineering teams, we translate research breakthroughs into technologies deployed worldwide across mobile, compute, automotive, robotics, cloud, XR, and IoT platforms, while publishing at leading AI conferences. Our team has demonstrated world\-first research breakthroughs and proof\-of\-concepts across model efficiency, representation learning, perception and understanding, generative and foundation models, reasoning and agentic intelligence, and embodied and physical AI. Our research contributions have earned numerous best paper awards, major research competition wins, and top rankings on AI and computer vision benchmarks. We also translate these breakthroughs into highly optimized AI models, end\-to\-end workflows, and developer tools for Qualcomm platforms, making many innovations accessible to all. Explore our research and innovations: * Research Breakthroughs and Demonstrations * Qualcomm AI Research Publications and Innovations Qualcomm AI Hub: Optimized Models and Workflows * **Role Responsibilities:** Research interns will contribute to fundamental and applied research in artificial intelligence and machine learning, developing novel algorithms, models, and systems that advance the state of the art. jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Embedded Sensor Systems & Physical AI
jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. **Job Area:** ------------- Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> ASICS Engineering **General Summary:** We are seeking a **Staff Engineer, Embedded Sensor Systems \& Physical AI** to develop next\-generation sensing technologies for Robotics, XR, mobile, \& IEIoT,I applications. This is a **hands\-on sensor systems engineering role** at the intersection of sensor hardware, embedded electronics, firmware, signal processing, characterization, and system integration. The ideal candidate can take a sensing concept from early evaluation through prototype development, characterization, embedded integration, and system demonstration. You will work with technologies such as **tactile, force, pressure, proximity, motion, environmental, and multimodal sensing** , integrating sensors with embedded compute platforms and intelligent perception/control systems. You will collaborate across robotics, XR, AI/ML, silicon, embedded software, and systems teams on applications including **dexterous manipulation, tactile perception, force control, HMI, multimodal perception, and contextual awareness** . We value **technical depth, hands\-on experimentation, system thinking, and the ability to turn emerging sensor technologies into robust working prototypes** . **Key Responsibilities** * **Lead the architecture, development, and validation of advanced sensor systems** for robotics, XR, mobile, IoT, and Physical AI applications. * **Design and build embedded sensing platforms** for sensor bring\-up, data acquisition, real\-time processing, characterization, control, and system validation. * **Develop sensor characterization and calibration methodologies** , including automated test infrastructure and performance metrics for noise, sensitivity, accuracy, latency, bandwidth, power, reliability, drift, and robustness. Create or partner for hardware prototypes and evaluation systems, including sensor boards, embedded platforms, sensor fixtures, test setups, and data collection infrastructure. * **Develop and debug hardware, firmware, and low\-level software** spanning sensors, analog/digital interfaces, MCUs/SoCs/DSPs/FPGAs, communication interfaces, and embedded processing. * **Architect and evaluate multimodal sensing and sensor\-fusion solutions** combining modalities such as tactile, force, proximity, motion, vision, audio, and environmental sensing. * **Collaborate with robotics, controls, AI/ML, silicon, software, and systems teams** to integrate sensing with perception, actuation, manipulation, HMI, and intelligent interaction. * **Provide technical leadership for emerging sensing technologies** , working with internal teams, suppliers, research partners, and universities to evaluate technologies, build prototypes, define roadmaps, and generate IP. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, or related field and 4\+ years of ASIC design, verification, validation, integration, or related work experience. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer, AI Enablement** RB Global is building the team that makes agentic software development standard, governed, and measurable across the company. We want every engineer to be able to delegate work to an agent and trust the result, with the right standards, guardrails, and visibility built into the path itself. This new team exists to make that the default: composing what already exists wherever it's good enough, and building only what doesn't. It's engineering excellence applied specifically to how we build software with AI. We're hiring the founding engineers for this team. You'll help shape the team's scope, standards, and first deliverables from day one, not inherit someone else's roadmap. * Help build secure, governed ways for agents to reach internal tools and data, with the scoping, credentials, and audit trails that make that access trustworthy. * Help build and run the containerized environments agents work in, where things like isolation, reproducibility, and model/cost choices are actually controlled. * Help turn the team's engineering standards and conventions into something tools and agents can actually consume and follow, not just documentation that drifts out of date. * Contribute to establishing the baselines and metrics the team doesn't have yet, so claims about speed, quality, and cost are backed by numbers. * Work with CI/CD, security, and platform teams to plug agent workflows into tools the company already uses, rather than reinventing them. * Help review and harden what the team ships with the same rigor you'd apply to any system other engineers depend on: tests, documentation, and a clear plan for who supports it. * Share your perspective with teammates on what the team takes on, and when to adopt an existing tool versus build something new. * Work with the team's technical product owner and stakeholders to understand priorities and turn ideas into delivered work. * Work closely with the other engineers on the team to reason through ambiguous problems together. We want your questions, ideas, and pushback, not just completed tasks. **Requirements** * Solid professional software engineering experience at a senior level (5\+ years of professional experience), with a record of delivering reliable work and speaking up to improve how the team approaches it. * Familiarity with internal developer platforms, "paved road" tooling, or developer\-enablement work, and an interest in making other engineers more effective. * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, including quality gates defined as code. * Experience with Kubernetes or comparable container orchestration, and comfort supporting services from build through production operation. * Working knowledge of observability, such as structured logging, tracing, and metrics/dashboards (e.g., Datadog, OpenTelemetry, or similar), and using it to answer "is this actually working?" * Comfort working in Python; we care more about your ability to reason across a stack and pick up what's needed than mastery of any one language. * Curiosity and a genuine desire to learn: this space is moving fast, the right answers aren't settled yet, and the best candidates will enjoy figuring them out rather than expecting a playbook. This is essential for the role. * A habit of contributing to the discussion: you ask questions, offer ideas, and share your view, rather than waiting to be handed a task. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade\-offs clearly to teammates, other engineering teams, and stakeholders who weren't in the room when the decision was made. * Comfort working through ambiguous or evolving problems with teammates, since much of this team's early work won't have a settled playbook to follow. **Nice To Have** * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, agentic coding tools), and even better, experience building platforms, tooling, or guardrails around them. * Experience building AI tooling, personal or professional, and a natural enjoyment of experimenting with new approaches. * Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar tool\-access and governance patterns. RB Global (NYSE: RBA) RB Global (NYSE: RBA) (TSX: RBA) is a leading, omnichannel marketplace that provides value\-added insights, services and transaction solutions for buyers and sellers of commercial assets and vehicles worldwide. Through its auction sites in 13 countries and digital platform, RB Global serves customers in more than 170 countries across a variety of asset classes, including automotive, commercial transportation, construction, government surplus, lifting and material handling, energy, mining and agriculture. The company’s marketplace brands include Ritchie Bros., the world’s largest auctioneer of commercial assets and vehicles offering online bidding, and IAA, a leading global digital marketplace connecting vehicle buyers and sellers. RB Global’s portfolio of brands also includes Rouse Services, which provides a complete end\-to\-end asset management, data\-driven intelligence and performance benchmarking system; SmartEquip, an innovative technology platform that supports customers’ management of the equipment lifecycle and integrates parts procurement with both OEMs and dealers; Xcira, a leader in live simulcast auction technologies; and Veritread, an online marketplace for heavy haul transport. RB Global full\-time employees are offered medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurances. jobs.title: Software Certification Engineer
jobs.description: At REGENT, we’re on a mission to revolutionize regional transportation between coastal cities. We're not just building vehicles, we're creating a new category of transportation: the Seaglider. These groundbreaking wing\-in\-ground\-effect craft travel just above the water’s surface, combining the speed of an airplane with the low operating costs of a boat. Capable of 180 miles at 180 mph on today's battery tech (and up to 400 miles with next\-gen batteries), Seagliders will unlock fast, affordable, and sustainable coastal transit for passengers and cargo \- connecting cities, islands, and communities like never before. Backed by leading investors and powered by a team of passionate, forward\-thinking engineers, builders, and operators, we’re now scaling from a breakthrough prototype to full production \- and building the team to make it happen. **Role Overview** ================= REGENT is hiring a Software Certification Engineer to hold engineering approval authority for Viceroy's software and airborne electronic hardware (AEH), and to help guide REGENT and its suppliers through a certification process built on RTCA DO\-178C but tailored for Seaglider certification with the U.S. Coast Guard (USCG) and a classification society such as Lloyd's Register (LR). You'll review and approve software and AEH compliance artifacts, both REGENT's own and those produced by key suppliers like motor, battery, and actuator vendors, act as an internal software quality assurance auditor, and help facilitate external software process audits from regulators. This is a hands\-on, high\-trust role for someone who already has software FAA Designated Engineering Representative (DER) experience, or an equivalent, and wants to put it to work on a new, all\-electric aircraft program early in its certification life. **What You'll Do** ================== * **Develop and approve compliance artifacts.** Help develop and review software and AEH certification data, and approve findings as REGENT's software certification lead on the program. * **Liaise with certifying and classification authorities.** Serve as a primary point of contact with USCG and Lloyd's Register on software and AEH compliance, with the FAA available in a supporting role to USCG. * **Guide certification strategy.** Help tailor REGENT's DO\-178C\-like process for Seaglider certification and establish methods of compliance for software and AEH. * **Oversee supplier artifacts.** Work with key suppliers, including motor, battery, and actuator vendors, to help them produce software and AEH certification artifacts acceptable to USCG and LR. * **Audit internal process adherence.** Act as REGENT's internal software quality assurance auditor, confirming the software team follows its defined development and verification processes. * **Facilitate external audits.** Help prepare for and facilitate software process audits from USCG, LR, and the FAA (under direction of USCG). * **Maintain the compliance record.** Keep an audit\-ready record of findings, methods of compliance, and supporting data, for REGENT and supplier artifacts alike. * **Build the practice.** Help REGENT establish a durable, in\-house software and AEH certification capability as Viceroy scales toward entry into service. **What We're Looking For** ========================== * Software Designated Engineering Representative (DER), or an equivalent experience, ideally covering airborne electronic hardware (AEH) as well. * Experience in software or AEH certification, including direct experience with RTCA DO\-178C (and ideally DO\-254\). * Experience approving certification artifacts and representing an engineering organization directly with a certifying or classification authority. * Experience overseeing supplier or subcontractor software/AEH design assurance. * Experience with internal software process audits and/or facilitating external regulatory or classification\-society audits. * Working knowledge of SAE ARP4754A/ARP4761 and the means\-of\-compliance process. * Comfort working across engineering teams, suppliers, and multiple certifying and classification authorities, without formal authority over any of them. **Who We're Looking For** ========================= * **Trusted regulatory voice.** You take delegated approval authority seriously and communicate clearly with regulators, engineers, suppliers, and leadership alike. * **Solutions\-oriented.** When a supplier's or engineering team's artifacts don't yet meet a compliance requirement, you help find a path to yes. * **Builder.** You want to help stand up a new certification practice, not just operate inside an established one. * **Cross\-functional connector.** You're comfortable being the link between REGENT's engineering teams, outside suppliers, and certifying and classification authorities. * **Adaptable \& agile.** You adapt quickly to changing priorities in a fast\-paced startup environment. **What We Offer** ================= * **Competitive compensation** including a robust equity incentive plan to reward your contributions to our success. * Comprehensive **health, dental, and vision insurance**, we cover **100%** of your premiums (including dependents!). * **401(k)** with company matching, so you can plan for the future. * Generous **flexible time off**, paid parental leave, and company\-wide holiday breaks. * **Relocation packages** available for those moving to join our team. * Daily, **free catered lunches**. * Learning \& professional development opportunities with the chance to make a direct impact on the company's growth and success. **If you’re ready to take on an exciting challenge, grow with us, and make a lasting impact, we want to hear from you.** Even if you don’t meet every requirement, but you see yourself contributing to our mission, we encourage you to apply! We value diverse skillsets and experiences and believe in the potential of passionate individuals to make a big impact. **Equal Opportunity Employer** REGENT is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.
