jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Full time \| Remote\-friendly, NYC and New Orleans \| Reports to the CTO** ### **What is Rima** Rima's mission is to improve population health by giving people technology to make navigating their employer sponsored health plans easy. We see a world where it is possible to reduce the economic burden on employees and employers without sacrificing quality of care. This is both a moral imperative and a business opportunity. Rima is building an agentic navigation platform for self insured health plans to tackle the root cause underlying rising healthcare costs. We are empowering the individuals on which the entire system depends. We’re a small, fast\-moving team based in NYC and New Orleans. We are all in. ### **The Role** We're looking for a senior engineer to join the Platform team. Platform owns the core of Rima: the member experience, member management, the agent harness, the channels members reach it through, and the infrastructure underneath it all. A parent texts our agent at 9pm. Their son has a fever and the pediatrician is closed. Where should they go tonight, and what will it cost? Guiding them well depends on his coverage as a dependent, the family's deductible, and which urgent care and telehealth options their plan includes. It has to come together in seconds, from protected health data, and be right every time. That's the problem the Platform team exists to solve. At a larger company, each system you'll own would have its own team. Here it's yours: the architecture, the trade\-offs, and the results. You'll know these systems better than anyone and help decide where they go next. ### **Minimum qualifications** * You've built production software for 4\+ years, or built more in less time. We are impressed by results, not years and logos. * You've shipped complex, user\-facing systems end to end that you designed, from data model to API to UI. * You understand software design deeply. You model domains carefully, draw clean boundaries, plan for how things fail, and change systems without breaking what depends on them. * You've spent at least a year shipping production code mainly through coding agents, and you've built the tooling that keeps their output correct: rules, skills, tests, and evals. * You've built on regulated or sensitive data, with access control, audit trails, and least privilege designed in from the start. * You're an expert in TypeScript. * You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and you can take a trade\-off from discussion to decision with an engineer, a designer, or a customer. ### **Nice to have** Bonus if you've: * Built LLM\-powered product features: agent tool design, context engineering, evals, guardrails, and trace interpretation. * Worked on multi\-tenant SaaS: tenancy, white\-labeling, and SSO (OIDC, SAML). * Used durable execution or workflow engines, such as Temporal, or built event\-driven systems. * Shipped across web, iOS, Android, browser extensions, and internal admin tooling. * Worked in healthcare, benefits, insurance, or payroll, including FHIR, EDI, or HL7\. * Built or maintained HIPAA\- or SOC 2\-compliant systems. ### **What you'll do** **Member experience and member management** * Build the features members expect from their health plan: insurance cards, claims, accumulators, dependents, and provider search. * Model benefits and entitlements precisely enough that a member reading the app and an agent answering a question reach the same correct answer. * Build member and company management for admins: onboarding, benefits configuration, and usage analytics. * Build internal admin tooling so our team can configure and support customers without an engineer. * Ship across web, iOS, Android, and our browser extension. * Work out requirements and trade\-offs with product and design before build. Talk to members and admins to see how the product actually gets used. **Agents and channels** * Build the features and data the member agent depends on, such as agent tools, entitlement data, and plan data, so it answers from what each member actually has. You'll work closely with the engineers who build the agent harness. * Build the channels the agent reaches members through, including web, mobile, SMS, Slack, Teams, and MCP clients, so it behaves the same in each one. * Add evals and tracing to the features you ship, so we know an answer is wrong before a member does. **Platform infrastructure and observability** * Own parts of our AWS infrastructure, CI/CD, and the pipeline from dev to production. * Strengthen observability: structured logs, metrics, traces, alerting, and incident response. * Treat security as architecture: PII minimization, envelope encryption with key rotation, least\-privilege access, purpose\-of\-use audit trails, and break\-glass workflows. **Developer tooling and practice** * Improve our developer tooling, including agent rules and skills, linting, CLI, and automated tests, so every engineer and agent ships faster and more safely. * Make good practice the default. When you find a better way to build, turn it into a rule, skill, or check so the whole team and every agent picks it up. * Bring consequential trade\-offs to the team early, with a recommendation. * Lead incident response for the systems you own. Our stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Vite, Hono, PostgreSQL, Temporal, Capacitor (web, iOS, Android), AWS with Terraform, Sentry, and Amplitude. ### **What success looks like in your first 90 days** * You own two or three platform systems. You know them better than anyone and are the first call when something goes wrong. * You've shipped at least one member\-facing feature end to end, from requirements through production monitoring. * You've closed one gap in observability, CI, or our developer tooling that makes the whole team faster. ### **How we work** * **Love and excellence.** We strive to win at the highest level and hold an extremely high bar, without losing the humanity that makes us who we are. * **High ownership.** You own problems end to end. No hand\-offs, no "not my problem." * **Crisp communication.** We say what we mean, raise problems early, and keep decisions easy to find. * **Fast iteration.** We ship in small batches, learn from members, and improve quickly. * **Results over process.** We care about what ships and how well it works, not how many meetings you attended. ### **Why work at Rima** * **Hard problems.** Health plans are complex, the data is regulated, and agents are capable, but new. You'll work where all three meet. * **Early in a category being reinvented.** Benefits navigation is being rebuilt around agents that reach members wherever they are. We're early, and you'll help shape what it becomes. * **Push agentic development forward.** We treat building software with agents as a system to engineer, and you'll help design it. * **Real impact, fast.** Our agents serve tens of thousands of members, and what you ship reaches them in days. * **Close to users.** You'll hear directly from the members and admins using what you built, not through layers of tickets. * **A team that pushes the tools.** Everyone here builds at the edge of what agents can do and shares what works. * **Competitive comp and benefits.** Base salary range $125,000\-$175,000, plus an equity package, flexible PTO, health insurance, dental, vision and more. Compensation Range: $125K \- $175K

You model domains carefully, draw clean boundaries, plan for how things fail, and change systems without breaking what depends on them. * You've spent at least a year shipping production code mainly through coding agents, and you've built the tooling that keeps their output correct: rules, skills, tests, and evals. * You've built on regulated or sensitive data, with access control, audit trails, and least privilege designed in from the start. * You're an expert in TypeScript. * You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and you can take a trade\-off from discussion to decision with an engineer, a designer, or a customer. ### **Nice to have** **Bonus if you've:** * Built LLM\-powered product features: agent tool design, context engineering, evals, guardrails, and trace interpretation. * Worked on multi\-tenant SaaS: tenancy, white\-labeling, and SSO (OIDC, SAML). * Used durable execution or workflow engines, such as Temporal, or built event\-driven systems. * Shipped across web, iOS, Android, browser extensions, and internal admin tooling. * Worked in healthcare, benefits, insurance, or payroll, including FHIR, EDI, or HL7\. * Built or maintained HIPAA\- or SOC 2\-compliant systems. ### **What you'll do** **Member experience and member management** * Build the features members expect from their health plan: insurance cards, claims, accumulators, dependents, and provider search. * Model benefits and entitlements precisely enough that a member reading the app and an agent answering a question reach the same correct answer. * Build member and company management for admins: onboarding, benefits configuration, and usage analytics. * Build internal admin tooling so our team can configure and support customers without an engineer. * Ship across web, iOS, Android, and our browser extension. * Work out requirements and trade\-offs with product and design before build. Talk to members and admins to see how the product actually gets used. **Agents and channels** * Build the features and data the member agent depends on, such as agent tools, entitlement data, and plan data, so it answers from what each member actually has. You'll work closely with the engineers who build the agent harness. * Build the channels the agent reaches members through, including web, mobile, SMS, Slack, Teams, and MCP clients, so it behaves the same in each one. * Add evals and tracing to the features you ship, so we know an answer is wrong before a member does. **Platform infrastructure and observability** * Own parts of our AWS infrastructure, CI/CD, and the pipeline from dev to production. * Strengthen observability: structured logs, metrics, traces, alerting, and incident response. * Treat security as architecture: PII minimization, envelope encryption with key rotation, least\-privilege access, purpose\-of\-use audit trails, and break\-glass workflows. **Developer tooling and practice** * Improve our developer tooling, including agent rules and skills, linting, CLI, and automated tests, so every engineer and agent ships faster and more safely. * Make good practice the default. When you find a better way to build, turn it into a rule, skill, or check so the whole team and every agent picks it up. * Bring consequential trade\-offs to the team early, with a recommendation. * Lead incident response for the systems you own. Our stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Vite, Hono, PostgreSQL, Temporal, Capacitor (web, iOS, Android), AWS with Terraform, Sentry, and Amplitude. ### **What success looks like in your first 90 days** * You own two or three platform systems. You know them better than anyone and are the first call when something goes wrong. * You've shipped at least one member\-facing feature end to end, from requirements through production monitoring. * You've closed one gap in observability, CI, or our developer tooling that makes the whole team faster. ### **How we work** * **Love and excellence.** We strive to win at the highest level and hold an extremely high bar, without losing the humanity that makes us who we are. * **High ownership.** You own problems end to end. No hand\-offs, no "not my problem." * **Crisp communication.** We say what we mean, raise problems early, and keep decisions easy to find. * **Fast iteration.** We ship in small batches, learn from members, and improve quickly. * **Results over process.** We care about what ships and how well it works, not how many meetings you attended. ### **Why work at Rima** * **Hard problems.** Health plans are complex, the data is regulated, and agents are capable, but new. You'll work where all three meet. * **Early in a category being reinvented.** Benefits navigation is being rebuilt around agents that reach members wherever they are. We're early, and you'll help shape what it becomes. * **Push agentic development forward.** We treat building software with agents as a system to engineer, and you'll help design it. * **Real impact, fast.** Our agents serve tens of thousands of members, and what you ship reaches them in days. * **Close to users.** You'll hear directly from the members and admins using what you built, not through layers of tickets. * **A team that pushes the tools.** Everyone here builds at the edge of what agents can do and shares what works. * **Competitive comp and benefits.** Base salary range $175,000\-$200,000, plus an equity package, flexible PTO, health insurance, dental, vision and more. Compensation Range: $175K \- $200K

Escalate consequential decisions to the CPO with a recommendation. **Talk to the customer directly** * Meet weekly with the customer's operations team, including on site on Long Island, to observe payroll, enrollment, and reconciliation workflows firsthand. * Walk the customer through the roadmap and trade\-offs, and communicate changes to scope, timing, or risk early. **Write requirements engineering can build from** * Write specs covering the user, business rules, edge cases, failure handling, and acceptance criteria before work reaches engineering. * Resolve unclear requests before they become engineering work. Check feasibility, sequencing and risk with the engineering team. * Break work into pieces that ship within a Monday\-to\-Friday sprint. Keep the spec current as decisions change. * Use coding agents to prototype an automation and test your assumptions before you write the spec. **Own product acceptance, release readiness, and rollout** * Test features with the customer's operati nds, and check that the new workflow works in practice. * Write the release notes, SOPs, and training material the customer's operations team needs. **Turn requests into structured product input** * Triage bugs, support requests and asks from the forward\-deployed team and the customer. Record the problem, the current workaround, how often it happens and the impact, not just the fix someone asked for. * Find the patterns behind repeat problems across employer clients and payroll providers. **Measure whether it worked** * Decide what to measure before a feature ships, and work with engineering on the instrumentation in Sentry and Amplitude. * Check after release whether the feature changed the KPI it was tied to. Use the results to decide what to build next. **What you won't own** * Pricing, contracts or commercial terms. * Day\-to\-day account management and support, which stay with the forward\-deployed team. * Engineering execution, technical quality, automated testing, deployment, and monitoring, which stay with the engineering team. ### **What success looks like in your first 90 days** * Document the customer's payroll, enrollment, reconciliation, and reporting workflows, including the automations, workarounds, and failure points. * Publish a proposed 6–12 month roadmap with the engineering team. Tie each item to a customer problem and KPI, and review priorities and trade\-offs with the customer and CPO. * Take at least one existing automation through requirements, customer acceptance, and production release, working with engineering on monitoring and failure handling. * Establish a recurring customer report showing automation activity, failures, and available evidence of time saved or errors prevented. Identify gaps where measurement is not yet available. ### **How we work** * **Love and excellence.** We strive to win at the highest level and hold an extremely high bar, without losing the humanity that makes us who we are. * **High ownership.** You own problems end to end. No hand\-offs, no "not my problem." * **Crisp communication.** We say what we mean, raise problems early, and keep decisions easy to find. * **Fast iteration.** We ship in small batches, learn from members, and improve quickly. * **Results over process.** We care about what ships and how well it works, not how many meetings you attended. * **Our tools.** Claude Code, Cursor, Grok Bot, Codex, Conductor, Notion, Figma, Storybook, GitHub, Slack, Google Workspace, Wispr Flow, Intercom, and 1Password. * **Our stack.** TypeScript, Next.js, Hono, PostgreSQL, Temporal, WXT, AWS with Terraform, Flagsmith, Sentry, and Amplitude. ### **Why work at Rima** * **Hard problems.** Payroll and benefits operations are complex, the data is regulated, and automation has to be right every pay period. You'll work where all three meet. * **Early in a category being reinvented.** Benefits navigation is being rebuilt around agents that reach members wherever they are. We're early, and you'll help shape what it becomes. * **Push agentic development forward.** We treat building software with agents as a system to engineer, and you'll help design it. * **Real impact, fast.** Our agents serve tens of thousands of members, and what you ship reaches them in days. * **Close to users.** You'll work directly with the operations team using what you built, not through layers of tickets. * **Learn from how the team uses agents.** The team shares what works—and what doesn’t—when building with agents. * **Competitive comp and benefits.** Base salary range $165,000\-$185,000, plus an equity package, flexible PTO, health insurance, dental, vision and more. ### **Travel** Expect on\-site visits to the customer's operations team on Long Island about once a week, roughly 5 days per month, increasing to up to 10 during rollouts or critical periods. jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: RahrBSG is looking for a Network Engineer in Shakopee, Minnesota. The Network Engineer designs, deploys, maintains, and supports secure, reliable network infrastructure, with a primary focus on production Microsoft Azure networking environments. The role independently handles moderately complex network configurations, implementations, and troubleshooting within established architecture, security standards, and change\-management practices, seeking guidance on complex or unfamiliar issues. Working with infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, and application teams, the Network Engineer supports reliable network services that enable the organization’s technology and business objectives. **WE ARE PROUD TO OFFER:** * Competitive Starting Pay between $100,000 \- $120,000 annually * Annual Bonus * Medical benefits with coverage paid for at 90% * Dental and Vision Programs * Generous Annual 401(k) Company Contribution of 15% * Employee Assistance Program * Paid Life Insurance * Short Term Disability * Long Term Disability * Tuition Reimbursement * Generous PTO * Sick Time * 12 Paid Company Holidays * Parental Leave * Career Growth and Progression Paths **ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Network Design and Engineering** * Design and implement Azure virtual networks, subnets, IP address plans, peering, route tables, and hub\-and\-spoke or Virtual WAN topologies. * Configure and support Azure load balancing and traffic management services, including application gateways, web application firewalls, and global traffic distribution. * Design and implement name resolution for hybrid environments, including Azure DNS, private DNS zones, and conditional forwarding with on\-premises DNS. * Support the technical design and implementation of moderately complex network solutions, including evaluating requirements, identifying appropriate solutions, developing configurations, coordinating implementation, and validating results. * Build and support hybrid connectivity between on\-premises sites and Azure, including site\-to\-site VPN, point\-to\-site VPN, and dedicated private circuits, with routing and failover design. * Design and manage Azure networking components, including Virtual Networks (VNets), subnets, Network Security Groups (NSGs), route tables, Azure Firewall, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, private endpoints, DNS, and load\-balancing technologies. * Design and support network connectivity between Azure environments, corporate locations, data centers, and third\-party services. * Apply network segmentation, routing, resiliency, and security principles to ensure solutions meet business and technical requirements. * Participate in network architecture discussions and provide technical recommendations within the assigned area of responsibility. **Network Deployment and Administration** * Configure and maintain routers, switches, firewalls, wireless infrastructure, VPN technologies, and related network services. * Implement network changes, upgrades, expansions, and migrations with appropriate testing, documentation, and change controls. * Manage IP addressing, routing, DNS, DHCP, network segmentation, and connectivity configurations. * Maintain network configurations and technical documentation, including network diagrams, configuration standards, and operational procedures. * Support hybrid networking technologies connecting cloud and on\-premises infrastructure. **Monitoring, Troubleshooting, and Support** * Monitor and troubleshoot network availability, performance, capacity, and connectivity using Azure Monitor, Network Watcher, Log Analytics, flow logs, and other network management and diagnostic tools. * Independently diagnose and resolve moderately complex network incidents involving routing, connectivity, latency, DNS, firewall policies, VPNs, and cloud infrastructure. * Perform root\-cause analysis for recurring or significant network issues and implement corrective actions. * Provide escalation\-level technical support for network\-related incidents and service disruptions. * Participate in scheduled maintenance activities and an on\-call rotation as required to support production systems. **Security and Reliability** * Implement network security controls in partnership with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams. * Implement and manage Azure network security controls, including network security groups, application security groups, Azure Firewall, DDoS protection, service endpoints, and Private Link/private endpoints, in accordance with established security standards. * Apply identity and access controls to Azure network resources, including role\-based access control and integration with Microsoft Entra ID, in partnership with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams. * Support network resiliency, redundancy, disaster recovery, and business continuity requirements. * Identify network vulnerabilities, configuration risks, and opportunities to improve reliability, security, and performance. * Ensure network changes follo ciency. * Develop or improve automation for repeatable network configuration and deployment activities using tools such as PowerShell, Azure CLI, Bicep, or Terraform. * Work collaboratively with cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, application, ERP, and service desk teams to resolve technical issues and implement solutions. * Provide technical guidance to team members and contribute knowledge through documentation and knowledge sharing. * Maintain current knowledge of Azure networking capabilities, network security practices, and relevant technologies. **MINIMUM EDUCATION \& WORK REQUIREMENTS:** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant technical experience. * Minimum of 4 years of professional experience supporting and engineering enterprise network environments. * Hands\-on experience designing, deploying, and supporting Microsoft Azure networking in a production environment. * Experience supporting hybrid cloud and on\-premises network environments. * Experience implementing moderately complex to complex network solutions. * Preferred Qualifications * Microsoft Azure networking or infrastructure certification, such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, Azure Network Engineer, Azure Solutions Architect, or Azure Security Engineer. * Relevant networking certification, such as Cisco CCNA or equivalent experience. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:** * Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, subnetting, routing, switching, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VPNs, and firewall technologies. * Working knowledge of routing protocols and concepts, including BGP and dynamic routing. * Strong understanding of Microsoft Azure networking, including VNets, VNet peering, NSGs, User Defined Routes, Azure Firewall, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, Private Link/private endpoints, DNS, and load balancing. * Ability to translate technical and business requirements into network designs and implementation plans. * Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex network connectivity, routing, security, and performance issues. * Understanding of network security concepts, segmentation, least\-privilege access, and cloud networking security practices. * Experience with network monitoring, logging, and diagnostic tools. * Working knowledge of infrastructure\-as\-code and automation technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, PowerShell, or Azure CLI. * Ability to create and maintain network diagrams, configuration documentation, implementation plans, and operational procedures. * Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical issues to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Ability to manage multiple technical priorities and drive assigned network projects through implementation. jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Backend, Vendor Management
jobs.description: **About Ramp** ============== Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7\.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. **About the Role** ================== Businesses need a clear, reliable way to work with their vendors, from collecting information during onboarding to keeping vendor records accurate as they purchase and pay. Vendors need a straightforward way to provide details and stay connected with the businesses they serve. Ramp’s Vendor Management \& Portal team builds the systems behind those experiences. We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to make vendor information easier to collect, connect, and use across Ramp. You’ll work on services that support vendor profiles, onboarding requests, and the vendor portal, where identity, permissions, and data accuracy matter. You’ll own meaningful projects from design through launch and partner with product, design, and other engineering teams to make these workflows dependable for both businesses and vendors. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Design and build backend services and APIs for vendor profiles, onboarding, and portal workflows. * Improve how vendor records and portal accounts are matched and connected, reducing duplicate work and making shared information more reliable. * Build workflows for collecting and updating vendor information, including payment and tax details, with clear permissions and accurate data handling. * Make vendor data available consistently across the products that depend on it, including procurement and bill pay. * Own projects from problem definition and technical design through launch, monitoring, and iteration. * Raise the quality of the team’s systems through thoughtful design reviews, code reviews, and mentorship. **What You’ll Need** -------------------- * Experience designing, building, and operating production backend systems, including APIs, data models, and asynchronous workflows. * Strong judgment about data integrity, access controls, reliability, and the tradeoffs involved in evolving existing systems. * A track record of independently leading complex engineering projects from design to production. * Product sense and curiosity about how businesses and vendors actually use the workflows you build. * Clear communication and a collaborative approach to working across engineering, product, and design. **Nice to Haves** ----------------- * Experience with vendor management, procurement, accounts payable, or other business finance workflows. * Experience with identity matching, deduplication, or sharing data safely across accounts and products. * Experience improving operational visibility and reliability in systems that handle sensitive business information. **Benefits available to all full\-time Ramp employees (Global)** ---------------------------------------------------------------- * Flexible PTO * Centralized home\-office equipment ordering * Health and wellness stipend * Budget for intra\-office travel * Weekly coffee stipend **United States** ----------------- * 100% medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents * One Medical annual membership * 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp * Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year) * Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay * Pet insurance * In\-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more * Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed) **Canada** ---------- * Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life * Life, AD\&D, and disability coverage * Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime) * Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP \+ DPSP) * Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay * Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health **United Kingdom** ------------------ * Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite * Virtual GP and at\-home care via eMed x Livi * Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option * Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay **Referral Instructions** ------------------------- If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf. **Other notices** ----------------- Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. *Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @**Ramp.com* *email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.* Ramp Applicant Privacy Notice Compensation Range: $204K \- $280K

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: Location: Remote (US or Canada). Employment Type: Full\-time **About the role** ------------------ We're hiring a Product Engineer who can go from a customer call to a shipped feature without an engineering lead or a product manager in the middle. Reacher is an AI\-powered TikTok Shop affiliate platform used by thousands of brands. You'll talk to customers, decide what to build, and ship it yourself across our Pro software, Reacher Plus automation, and the Creator app. You'll report to Hari, our Head of Engineering, and you'll work with a lot of autonomy. This role is for someone with strong product sense who likes talking to users and writing the code. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Join customer calls, figure out the real problem, and ship a feature that solves it * Own work end to end across backend, frontend, and, when needed, the Creator app * Build and improve automation and AI\-assisted workflows that run our products * Write clean, reliable code in our stack and keep what you ship working in production * Work directly with customers, design, and product when a second opinion helps, without waiting on a handoff **What you bring** ------------------ * Strong product sense and comfort talking to customers * You can go from a customer call to a shipped feature without an engineering lead or product manager * Solid full\-stack experience. Our stack is Python (FastAPI, Django, Peewee), React with the Vercel AI SDK, and React Native/Expo with TypeScript * Experience with the Anthropic SDK, Playwright, or similar tools for AI features and automation * Comfort working fast in a startup and doing the work yourself **Nice to have** ---------------- * Familiarity with TikTok Shop, social commerce, or creator marketing * Experience shipping AI agents or production LLM features * You've been an early engineer at a startup and owned a product area end to end

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Real Estate)
jobs.description: Overview: **Why this role** Real assets are among the largest asset classes in the world and among the least well served by software. Cherre already has the data layer that makes AI agents viable in this industry, which almost nobody else does. You would be among the first people turning that into something clients use every day, in a function you help define. Whether that means going deeper technically or eventually leading engagements is a choice you make later, not today. What the work actually looks like The future of real assets is agentic. Our clients feel this shift coming, but many struggle moving from pilot into production. That gap is the job: * A fund with 40 operating partners, each sending financials on a different chart of accounts. Agents build the mapping, maintain it as partners change their own books, and onboard the next partner as the business grows, without an analyst starting over every time. * An asset management team that answers the same portfolio questions every month by hand, out of four systems, into a deck. * An owner who wants to ask a plain\-English question about their portfolio and get an answer that is correct, from an agent that knows when it does not know. The interesting problems are rarely the model. They are entity resolution, messy source systems, workflows that exist only in someone's head, and the gap between an impressive demo and something a controller will sign off on. You will be hands on. You will also be the person in the room when a client explains their use case for the first time, and the person who decides what gets built to meet their objectives. Done is an agent reliable enough for production, handed off to whoever will run it, while you move on to their next problem. Responsibilities: **What you will do** * Embed with client teams. Map their data, decompose their processes, and define and prioritize the use cases worth building, including the parts of the workflow nobody documents. Translate those priorities into agentic solutions that create value for the business. * Architect and build. Design the approach, then build it: agent workflows, tool and data integrations, evaluation harnesses, and the plumbing connecting it to Cherre's platform. Business process becomes orchestration logic: triggers, tools, guardrails, and human checkpoints. * Own delivery end to end. From scoping through production and handoff to the teams who support it. Ship early, put it in front of real users, find out where it is wrong, and fix it. * Instrument everything you ship. Build for auditability, version control, and cost predictability. These clients operate under real financial and regulatory scrutiny, and "the agent decided" is not an acceptable answer. * Build for the second deployment while delivering the first. Decide what is worth making reusable, build it so the next client gets there faster, and feed recurring patterns back to product and engineering as templates and accelerators. * Deliver what was agreed. New use cases surface constantly. The good ones are the next engagement, not this week's extra work. * Help build the machine. As one of the first FDEs here, you will document how you work and help turn it into a process other engineers can run. How you work becomes how the function works. Qualifications: **What you bring** We care more about what you have done than how long you have been doing it. The experience range above is a guide, not a filter. * A record of shipping production systems inside someone else's environment, under someone else's constraints. You can walk us through one that broke, how you found out, and what you changed. * Strong hands\-on engineering, and you still want to write code. We are flexible on stack; Python, SQL, APIs, and comfort in messy data environments go a long way. * You have built with LLMs well beyond a prototype, and you have opinions about what is hard: evaluation, non\-determinism, context, tool design, and knowing when an agent is the wrong answer. * Judgment about where automation belongs and where a human stays in the loop. * Comfort sitting with business operators and turning how they describe their work into system design. You can hold both conversations in the same meeting: the technical tradeoff with their engineer, and the business outcome with their executive. * Fluency in real assets or financial operations: fund reporting, asset management, valuations, deal pipelines, investor reporting. You can follow a client conversation without a translator. * You work well when requirements arrive as a conversation instead of a ticket, and you know how to turn the first into the second. * 30% domestic travel **Bonus points** * Prior forward\-deployed, solutions architecture, or consulting\-adjacent engineering experience. * Experience with agentic orchestration and development tooling such as Claude Code, n8n, LangGraph, or Temporal. * Background in enterprise SaaS or data infrastructure serving regulated industries. * Early\-stage or 0 to 1 experience where you built the process as well as the product. ***SALARY AND BENEFITS*** RealPage provides a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefit plan that includes:* Health, dental, and vision insurance. * Retirement savings plan with company match. * Paid time off and holidays. * Professional development opportunities. * Performance\-based bonus based on position. Compensation may vary depending on your location, qualifications including job\-related education, training, experience, licensure, and certification, that could result at a level outside of these ranges. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance. Equal Opportunity Employer: RealPage Company is an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Pay Range: USD $129,400\.00 \- USD $220,400\.00 /Yr.

problem\-solving skills. * Clear communication skills and experience collaborating across teams. **Nice to Have:** * Familiarity with frameworks for building real\-time voice and multimodal Parental Bonding Benefit Program * Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO): We believe time to rest and recharge is essential. That's why we offer a generous and flexible PTO policy. Full\-time employees accrue 20 days of PTO for a full calendar year annually, with an increase to 25 days after five years of service. **Who We Are:** Red Ventures is a global portfolio of high\-growth companies — spanning several U.S. businesses,a joint venture in the health services industry,and strategic investments in Europe. jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Overview** We are seeking a dynamic and highly skilled Network Engineer to join our innovative IT team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining complex network infrastructure to ensure optimal performance, security, and reliability across our organization. You will play a critical role in supporting our IT systems, troubleshooting network issues, and deploying cutting\-edge solutions that enhance our connectivity and data security. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work with a broad range of network technologies and contribute to the seamless operation of our enterprise network environment. **Responsibilities** * Design, configure, and optimize network infrastructure including LAN (Local Area Network), WAN (Wide Area Network), VPN (Virtual Private Network), MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching), and SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) protocols. * Manage and support network hardware such as Cisco routers, switches, ASA firewalls, Meraki devices, Juniper equipment, and other networking equipment. * Implement and maintain network security measures including Cisco ISE (Identity Services Engine), PKI (Public Key Infrastructure), firewalls, IDS (Intrusion Detection Systems), VPNs, encryption protocols, and cloud security solutions like AWS. * Troubleshoot complex network issues related to equipment failures, configuration errors, or connectivity problems using tools such as SolarWinds, PRTG, Splunk, and SolarWinds. * Perform regular vulnerability assessments and ensure high availability through load balancing, redundancy strategies, and high\-availability configurations in data centers or cloud environments. * Configure and support network protocols including TCP/IP, DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol), DNS (Domain Name System), BGP (Border Gateway Protocol), EIGRP (Enhanced Interior Gateway Routing Protocol), OSPF (Open Shortest Path First), and MPLS. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams on system design projects involving virtualization platforms like VMware vSphere or Hyper\-V; support operating systems including Windows Server, Linux distributions such as Ubuntu or CentOS; and utilize scripting languages like Bash or PowerShell for automation. * Maintain comprehensive documentation of network configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps; ensure compliance with security policies and standards. **Experience** * Proven experience in computer networking with a strong understanding of network architecture design and implementation across enterprise environments. * Hands\-on expertise with Cisco networking hardware including routers, switches, ASA firewalls; familiarity with Meraki cloud\-managed devices is preferred. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex network hardware issues and perform system administration tasks in diverse operating systems such as Windows Server, Linux (Ubuntu/CentOS/Red Hat), Solaris or BSD variants. * Experience managing VPN configurations including IPsec VPNs for secure remote access; knowledge of SFTP/FTP/SSH protocols is essential. * Skilled in using network management tools like SolarWinds or PRTG for monitoring network health; experience with vulnerability assessment tools like Splunk is advantageous. * Strong understanding of network security principles including SSO (Single Sign\-On), LDAP integration, GPO (Group Policy Objects), encryption techniques, load balancing strategies, and high availability architectures. * Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or openSUSE virtualization environments; experience supporting telecommunication systems and data center operations is a plus. Join us to be part of a forward\-thinking team dedicated to building resilient networks that empower our organization’s growth! Pay: From $25\.00 per hour Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Autonomy Evaluation & Metrics Platform
jobs.description: Rivian’s Autonomy Eval Infrastructure team builds the software that helps engineers understand and improve the ML models behind our driving systems and gives release teams evidence they can trust. Within Autonomy’s AI Platform organization, we connect model development with evaluation workflows, metrics, triage and visualization across simulation and real\-world vehicle data. As a senior metrics\-platform engineer, you will design, build and operate a substantial part of the platform that makes autonomy evaluation consistent and reproducible. Working directly with Perception, Planning and Systems engineers, you will connect model experiments to reliable metrics and help turn insights about model behavior, failure modes and generalization into improvements in models and data. This is a hands\-on software engineering role. You will own projects through design, implementation, rollout and operation, make practical system\-design trade\-offs, and mentor teammates. As an early member of a newly formed team, you will help establish the engineering practices and interfaces that make the platform useful across Autonomy. * Own the design and delivery of a metrics\-platform area, such as the metric registry, computation services or comparison and reporting APIs, in partnership with the team’s technical lead. * Design versioned metric definitions and data models for inputs, aggregation, slicing and results. Preserve provenance linking official evaluation runs to code, model, dataset and scenario versions. * Build distributed computation and storage paths with idempotent execution, incremental processing and controlled backfills. Make informed trade\-offs across throughput, latency, cost and reproducibility. * Build comparison tools that expose coverage, sample sizes, uncertainty and changes in evaluation inputs. Help users distinguish model regressions from data, simulator or infrastructure failures. * Partner with model developers to design evaluation experiments, inspect predictions and analyze failure patterns. Use the findings to guide model and data improvements, and build reusable evaluation harnesses that shorten the iteration cycle. * Integrate metrics and regression checks into replay and closed\-loop evaluation workflows and CI. Partner with domain owners on metric semantics and thresholds, and with Systems on evidence for release decisions. * Deliver self\-service APIs and scorecards backed by consistent definitions and results. measure improvements in turnaround time, correctness and cost. * Write and review production code, lead design reviews for your projects, mentor engineers, and collaborate across Palo Alto, London and Belgrade to deliver software that users adopt. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience and impact, including ownership of production backend or data\-intensive systems. * Hands\-on experience building software for autonomy or robotics, with direct exposure to evaluation, simulation, perception, planning or validation workflows. * Strong Python programming skills, with the ability to write, test, profile and debug maintainable production software. * Practical SQL skills, with AI coding tools expected to support writing and refining queries; customer success in a hybrid role * Strong communication skills and comfort presenting to both technical and business stakeholders * Bias toward scaling yourself through process, tooling, and collaboration * Curious and customer\-obsessed: you’re always learning and looking for ways to delight users * Be located in or willing to relocate to New York **Benefits** ------------ * Competitive pay with considerable equity upside * Medical, dental, and vision, including 100% company\-paid plans for you and eligible dependents * Company\-paid life \& AD\&D, plus short\- and long\-term disability * 401(k) with automatic enrollment * Unlimited PTO, plus paid sick leave, company holidays, and bereavement * Up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave at 100% pay (birth, adoption, or foster) * Wellness stipend: $375/quarter * Learning stipend: up to $2,000/year * Internet \& cell phone stipend: $25/month * Mental health support, virtual care, and care navigation * Fertility \& family\-building support, plus backup care membership * Pre\-tax commuter benefits (transit \& parking) * SF HQ: daily catered breakfast \& lunch, meal allowances, and rideshare support when commuting This role is for someone early in their career, joining a team that works AI\-first. You’ll help build the agent\-driven tooling and process we use to create reusable Rally supply chains that solve common customer use cases, and push how much of that work AI agents can take on. You’ll work with senior engineers, take well\-defined pieces of work from design to production, and grow toward owning part of that system yourself. ### **What You’ll Work On** * Build and maintain python backend services with guidance from senior engineers * Help build the agent\-driven tooling, pipelines, and checks we use to create reusable Rally supply chains * Work with AI coding agents every day, and help the team find where agents can take on more of the work and where a person still needs to decide * Write and optimize database queries and REST APIs * Establish trust in your work with effective development\-loop tests * Take part in code reviews, and ask questions to learn the codebase and the technologies behind it * Work with customers and customer\-facing teams to understand the use cases behind your work * Take part in design discussions, and apply the feedback you get on your own designs ### **What Success Looks Like** * **First 90 days.** You’ve shipped production changes with guidance, use AI agents as a normal part of how you deliver, can find your way around the code you work in, and take part in code reviews. * **First year.** You own part of the tooling we use to create reusable supply chains, deliver changes from design to production with little guidance, and have helped change how the team uses AI to ship. ### **What You’ll Bring** * Curiosity about new systems and technologies, and the habit of reading the docs and code before asking, then asking good questions * Clear, accurate communication about your work, and honesty about what you don’t know yet * Some experience building backend software in a mainstream server\-side language, from work, internships, or your own projects. We mostly use Python, but value being able to read and understand many languages over fluency in any one. If your strongest language is something else, you should be able to read Python and understand it thoroughly. * A working understanding of REST APIs and relational databases * Experience writing automated tests for your own code * Hands\-on experience building software with AI coding agents, interest in pushing how far they can go, and the habit of checking what they produce ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with FastAPI, Flask, SQLAlchemy, or PostgreSQL * Experience with Docker and containerized deployments * Experience with a mainstream cloud platform, such as AWS, GCP, or Azure * Exposure to distributed systems or data pipelines * Familiarity with professional media formats, such as codecs, container formats, and metadata, and how media supply chains use them If you don’t meet every point above, we’d still like to hear from you. ### **How We Work** * **We’re small and distributed.** Most of our collaboration happens over Slack and Zoom, across time zones. You’ll own what you build, and you’ll work closely with people outside your immediate team. * **Engineers stay close to customers.** You’ll hear directly from the people using what you build. When something goes wrong in production, the team that owns the code helps fix it. * **We dig for root causes.** When something breaks, we find out why instead of patching the symptom and moving on. * **We ship, then refine.** We work in short sprints and improve things over time instead of waiting for a perfect first version. ### **How We Use AI** AI coding agents are part of how we work every day, and we invest in getting good at using them. We’re also careful with them, because customers run their content operations on Rally. We’re tracking industry trends and innovations, but using our day\-to\-day experiences to separate signal from noise. Our engineers are still responsible for the code they ship. We still expect them to explain and defend its architecture and intent, even as more is built with an agent’s help. We judge work by its quality, not its quantity. This role is not a fit for someone who would rather not use AI tools, or who is used to shipping generated changes they couldn’t explain. It probably is a fit for someone who knows where these tools go wrong and how to achieve quality with speed. ### **Logistics** * This is a remote role, open to candidates across the United States * Occasional travel may be required, but is not core to this role * Interview process: introductory call, AI proficiency interview, team technical interview, interview project, interview project presentation, and founders interview ### **Compensation and Benefits** *Salary range $90,000 to $145,000* *Salary range represents the expected range for this position and is based on a number of factors, including location, and* *will* *vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges are US\-applicable only.* ### **You Should Be Interested in SDVI Because:** * You are looking for your next big challenge * You are looking for a company that welcomes your talent virtually * You want teammates you can learn from, and who will learn from you * You want to be part of a team that respects individuals and their work * You consider the big picture and your contribution to it SDVI offers a comprehensive benefits package including competitive salary, medical, vision, dental, 401(k) match, and stock options in a stimulating and rewarding distributed work environment. SDVI is committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusivity in our workforce. We maintain a courteous work environment that recognizes the dignity and worth of each employee. SDVI respects the individual needs of employees and is an equal\-opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Layout Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** We are seeking an experienced Plant Layout / AutoCAD Engineer to develop, integrate, and maintain comprehensive 2D plant layouts for automotive manufacturing operations. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross\-functional launch teams, suppliers, and build crews to ensure spatial accuracy, resolve design interferences, and support seamless facility installations from planning through pilot builds. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain overall 2D plant layouts using AutoCAD in alignment with production flow and facility constraints. * Integrate supplier and contractor drawings—including tooling, tool rails, platforms, and other assembly aids—into master plant layouts. * Create custom AutoCAD blocks (such as carriers, tooling, tool presentations, and aisles), evaluate spatial interferences, and provide design resolutions. * Release weekly layout updates to the core product launch team. * Perform on\-site field checks to identify existing monuments and verify layout accuracy against physical facility conditions. * Provide detailed build and installation drawings to the installation and build teams. * Participate in pilot builds and process validation to verify layout accuracy and resolve design\-related issues on the floor. * Adhere strictly to all customer CAD standards, including file naming conventions, layer structures, and Xrefs. * Upload, organize, and maintain all layout files within Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC). **Qualifications** * At least 5 years of experience in automotive manufacturing with strong proficiency in AutoCAD. * Demonstrated experience creating and maintaining standardized AutoCAD block libraries. * Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify spatial interferences and verify designs via physical field checks. **Preferred Skills** * Knowledge of converting 2D layouts to 3D using AutoCAD Product Design \& Manufacturing Collection (PDMC) tools. * Experience rendering and reviewing 3D facility models in Navisworks.

jobs.title: Hybrid South Carolina Cloud Engineer – Managed IT Services (5544)
jobs.description: We are looking for a skilled **Cloud Engineer** to join our State and Local Platforms and Data Managed Services team. As a core member of our operations group, you will work across multiple client environments, implementing, maintaining, and supporting cloud infrastructure and services. You'll collaborate internal teams and clients to ensure the reliability, security, and performance of cloud\-based systems, following industry standards and meeting service\-level agreements (SLAs). This is a hybrid position that may require periodic travel to customer facilities. Candidate must be within commuting distance of Columbia, SC. **Essential Duties:** * Deploy, configure, and provide day\-to\-day operational support for client cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP, and/or hybrid). * Implement and maintain cloud resources, including compute, storage, networking, and security components for multiple clients. * Support cloud migrations, new implementations, system upgrades, and integrations, working closely with project teams and client contacts. * Automate routine operational tasks using Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, ARM, CloudFormation) and scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash). * Monitor system health, performance, cost, and security alerts across client environments, proactively resolving issues and escalating as needed. * Respond to incidents and service requests per contractual SLAs, providing detailed troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and resolution documentation. * Enforce client\-specific security requirements, access controls, and backup/recovery procedures in accordance with compliance standards and best practices. * Maintain detailed environment documentation, change logs, and knowledge base articles for all assigned clients. * Collaborate with Service Desk and NOC teams to deliver excellent, consistent support for all managed cloud services customers. * Stay current with new cloud services, features, and best practices; contribute to service improvements and process optimization. * Participate in an on\-call rotation for after\-hours support as required. **Required Skills \& Experience** * Associate's or Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field; or equivalent work experience. * 3\+ years hands\-on experience supporting, maintaining, or operating cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), ideally in a managed services or MSP environment. * Strong understanding of core cloud services (compute, storage, networking, identity, security, backup/recovery). * Experience with configuration, monitoring, automation, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, ARM, CloudFormation, etc.). * Proficient in scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python). * Familiarity with service management tools (e.g., ServiceNow, ConnectWise), ticketing systems, and ITIL practices. * Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills. * Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage time while supporting multiple clients and projects. **Desired Skills \& Experience** * Industry certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP) are a strong plus. * Familiarity with Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), TIC 3\.0, and security controls * Exposure to AI/ML tooling within AWS or Azure (e.g., Bedrock, SageMaker, Comprehend, Lex, Azure OpenAI) * Experience with containers (Docker, Kubernetes), DevOps, and automation tools is desirable. * Knowledge of regulatory compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA, SOC 2\) is advantageous. \# LI\-SA1 At SMX®, we are a team of technical and domain experts dedicated to enabling your mission. From priority national security initiatives for the DoD to highly assured and compliant solutions for healthcare, we understand that digital transformation is key to your future success. We share your vision for the future and strive to accelerate your impact on the world. We bring both cutting edge technology and an expansive view of what's possible to every engagement. Our delivery model and unique approaches harness our deep technical and domain knowledge, providing forward\-looking insights and practical solutions to power secure mission acceleration. SMX is an Equal Opportunity employer including disabilities and veterans. Selected applicant may be subject to a background investigation and/or education verification. jobs.description: SONIFI Health isn’t just building interactive patient technology, we’re helping healthcare organizations improve care and create better experiences. Our team is passionate about solving real healthcare challenges, reinforcing our belief that healthcare is hospitality, and supporting what patients, clinicians, and families need most in care settings. We’re looking for a Software Engineer who is ready to independently deliver high quality software solutions, contribute across the product development lifecycle, and continue expanding their technical expertise. This role offers the opportunity to build and improve technology that directly supports patient engagement, hospital operations, and the healthcare experience. **What you’ll do:** Reporting to the Director of Software Engineering, this role contributes across the full product development lifecycle, including requirements definition, design, development, testing, debugging, and deployment. Success in this role requires a solid technical foundation, sound engineering judgment, and a commitment to building reliable, maintainable software. * Analyze, design, develop, test, debug, and document software applications with minimal assistance, delivering well\-defined features and technical solutions * Build new product capabilities, enhance existing applications, and resolve defects requirements, assess technical feasibility, estimate development effort, and support successful delivery * Write clean, maintainable, and testable code, including unit tests that address expected functionality, edge cases, errors, performance, reliability, and security considerations * Apply systematic debugging and problem\-solving approaches to diagnose complex issues, identify technical This is a hands\-on technical role embedded in the GTM organization, focused on execution and delivery. You'll ship reliable automations and workflows that sellers and GTM teams can trust, and partner effectively on well\-defined problems to improve productivity and operational effectiveness. This role reports to the Senior Director of GTM Engineering \& AI Enablement. You'll work under the direction of GTM \& Engineering Leadership, with opportunities to grow your scope over time as you demonstrate strong execution and increasing ownership. Key Responsibilities: * Build and maintain automated workflows using tools like n8n, Clay, and Claude Code, with a focus on shipping reliable automations that sellers can trust * Contribute to data models, ETL pipelines, and enrichment workflows that support outbound targeting, account scoring, and growth initiatives * Help support the integration layer across Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, Snowflake, and Clay — the data infrastructure that GTM agents and automated workflows depend on for reliable signal ingestion, enrichment, and execution * Partner with Sales, RevOps, Enterprise AI Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success on scoped requests, translating clear requirements into working solutions * Spot manual or repetitive work inside existing processes and propose simpler, more automated approaches * Develop components of AI\-powered agents and workflows that automate research, prospecting, and operational tasks, with senior engineers guiding architecture * Grow into a technical contributor the GTM organization relies on, building the range to eventually own larger problems end\-to\-end Required Qualifications: * 5\+ years of experience in GTM engineering, revenue operations, data analysis, marketing operations, sales operations, or a similar technical role within a SaaS or subscription\-based business * Proficiency in Python and SQL * Experience building automated workflows using tools like Zapier, n8n, or similar platforms * Working knowledge of data modeling and ETL/ELT concepts; familiarity with Snowflake, Power BI, or Databricks is a plus * Working knowledge of Salesforce, including data concepts and supporting integrations across GTM systems * Understanding of GTM business processes, including pipeline creation, seller execution, and marketing\-to\-sales handoffs * Ability to partner cross\-functionally on defined problems and deliver solutions that drive measurable outcomes Preferred Experience: * Experience with data enrichment platforms like Clay or ZoomInfo * Familiarity with AI/LLM tooling (Claude, OpenAI, AI agents) and how to apply them to GTM workflows * Exposure to sales engagement platforms (Outreach, 6Sense) and revenue intelligence tools (Gong) * Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent combination of education and experience Location: Remote \- Ontario, Canada or US What We Offer: At SPS Commerce, we are committed to ensuring that each employee's compensation reflects their unique experiences, performance, and skills in their role. The salary range for this role considers several factors, including education, relevant skills, work history, certifications, location, and more. The annual salary range for this role is $100,300 – $130,000 CAD OR $97,380 \- 123,00K USD \+ Equity. Final compensation will be determined based on the factors outlined above and may fall anywhere within the applicable range. SPS Commerce offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' health, well\-being, and financial security. Benefits are country\-specific and aligned with local laws and market practices. \#LI\-TB1 **Commitment to our Employees:** ================================ At SPS we power connections that drive the world of commerce forward, and our success depends on making strong decisions, fostering innovation, delivering unparalleled customer solutions, and driving outstanding business performance. We achieve this by creating an environment where every employee feels a true sense of belonging. jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **THE COMPANY:** STACK INFRASTRUCTURE (STACK) provides digital infrastructure to scale the world’s most innovative companies. We are an award\-winning industry leader in building, owning, and operating highly efficient, cost\-effective wholesale, colocation, and cloud data centers. Each of our national facilities meets or exceeds the highest industry standards in all operational categories of availability, security, connectivity, and physical resilience. STACK offers the scale and geographic reach that rapidly growing hyperscale and enterprise companies need. The world runs on data. Data runs on STACK. **THE POSITION:** STACK is seeking a Controls Engineer to join our Technical Operations team and play a pivotal role in supporting the construction, operation, and maintenance of BMS and EPMS systems at our new data center facilities in New Mexico. The Controls Engineer will work directly with site operations, engineering, construction, commissioning teams, vendors, and internal technical stakeholders to ensure reliable, scalable, and secure controls performance across a large, mission\-critical campus. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Develop a comprehensive understanding of mechanical, electrical, controls, and monitoring architectures, including chilled water plant controls, plant operation, electrical distribution monitoring, and campus\-level system integration. * Support the implementation, commissioning, operation, and optimization of PLC\-based controls systems across mission\-critical mechanical and electrical infrastructure. * Maintain and troubleshoot Ignition front\-end systems, including screens, tags, alarms, historian functions, user interfaces, integrations, and reporting. * Support MQTT\-based data movement and system integration and related edge or enterprise messaging infrastructure. * Work with databases supporting controls, monitoring, alarming, reporting, analytics, and operational data workflows. * Partner with site operations teams to troubleshoot controls\-related events, perform root cause analysis, and support corrective actions for building automation, PLC, SCADA, and EPMS\-related systems. * Support integration and validation of power quality meters, including devices configured for continuous waveform monitoring, event capture, power quality analysis, and electrical system diagnostics. * Collaborate with commissioning agents, contractors, vendors, and internal engineering teams to verify system performance, sequence execution, alarm behavior, trend collection, data integrity, and turnover documentation. * Support site operations by reviewing control logic, plant staging, pumping sequences, valve control, temperature control, differential pressure strategies, and system performance. * Assist with operational readiness, site acceptance testing, integrated systems testing, and turnover of controls and monitoring systems from construction to operations. * Ensure proper metering, trending, and data collection to support operational reporting, energy efficiency, reliability tracking, and long\-term optimization. * Partner with IT, cybersecurity, network, and monitoring teams to support secure and reliable connectivity for OT systems, PLCs, SCADA servers, MQTT brokers, databases, and field devices. * Provide technical support and training to site personnel on controls system functionality, alarm response, data interpretation, and troubleshooting procedures. * Support standards development and continuous improvement efforts for controls architecture, PLC programming practices, Ignition development, data modeling, alarm management, and documentation. **THE DETAILS:** * Location: Santa Teresa, New Mexico; On\-site * Compensation: $160,000 \- $195,000 annually with 10% bonus potential * Benefits: Healthcare, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, Paid Leave Programs * Travel: Up to 15% domestically * Must be eligible to work in the United States * Must pass comprehensive background screening **MUST\-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Controls, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience with building automation, industrial controls, SCADA, PLCs, EPMS, or mission\-critical facility control systems. * Hands\-on experience with Allen\-Bradley PLCs, including PLC logic review, troubleshooting, field validation, and integration with supervisory systems. * Experience with Ignition SCADA, including tag structures, alarm configuration, graphics, historian functions, scripting, reporting, and system integration. * Strong understanding of mechanical systems, especially chilled water systems, chiller plants, pumping systems, heat rejection, and hydronic loops. * Familiarity with electrical monitoring systems, power quality meters, and EPMS concepts in mission\-critical environments. * Experience with industrial communication protocols and integration methods, including some combination of EtherNet/IP, Modbus TCP, BACnet, SNMP, MQTT, and OPC UA. * Ability to troubleshoot complex controls issues involving PLCs, SCADA, network connectivity, field devices, sensors, actuators, meters, and databases. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical issues to engineering, construction, operations, vendors, and non\-technical stakeholders. * Must be comfortable working in a high\-stress, fast\-paced mission\-critical environment with shifting priorities. * Must be willing to support off\-hours troubleshooting, maintenance windows, emergency response, and critical operational events as needed. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Experience supporting hyperscale, semiconductor, industrial, utility, or other large\-scale mission\-critical campuses. * Ignition certification or advanced Ignition development experience. * Experience with enterprise MQTT broker platforms. * Experience with SEL power quality meters and relays. * Working knowledge of SQL databases, preferably PostgreSQL, for data collection, reporting, analytics, and controls system integration. * Understanding of OT cybersecurity concepts, network segmentation, authentication, certificate management, and secure access practices. **Compensation Range:** $133,000\.00 \- $154,000\.00**THIS MIGHT BE RIGHT FOR YOU IF:** * You are a strong communicator, you are persuasive and clear, blending analytics with experience in decision\-making. * You do not get flustered easily. You can juggle multiple priorities while balancing urgent requests with shifting timelines and deliverables. * You are a team builder. You take the time to understand and develop the strengths of your resources while formulating long\-term plans for the growth and success of the team. * You are naturally curious and driven toward continual improvement. While you celebrate your successes, you take time to review and analyze campaigns for future learning. **WHY STACK?** * We offer a competitive compensation package with strong benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401K program, flexible spending accounts – even a cell phone subsidy. * We foster a culture of appreciation, including peer\-to\-peer recognition and rewards programs. * Fun is part of our DNA, with events, game nights, happy hours, and barbecues. * We’re growing – this is a great time to join and make an impact! *STACK is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, national origin, mental or physical disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law* ***Note to external agencies****: We are not accepting any blind submissions or resumes/cvs from recruitment agencies. Any candidates sent to STACK Infrastructure, Inc. will not be accepted or considered as a submission without a signed agreement in place. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of STACK Infrastructure, Inc.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** -------------------- The Senior Software Engineer will be responsible for the design, documentation, development, and testing of new and existing Software solutions within the Digital Workflow Solutions Business Unit. You will also be responsible for analyzing product/system\-level requirements and translating them into software requirements, as well as the deployment and delivery of specific software features and functionality. You will work with cross\-functional teams to deliver new features, ensure application performance, and mentor junior engineers. SPM Workflow Solution and Surgical Asset Tracking Software \| STERIS * You will be developing software solutions that are part of the STERIS product offering. Contributes to cross functional project planning, development, and analysis of product requirements, and proposed solutions. * Refine and refactor the software design based on the system architecture and new product requirements. * Designs, documents, implements, and maintains efficient, reusable, secure, and reliable software code according to corporate and department standards and procedures for new and sustaining engineering projects, maintaining code quality, organization, and automation. * Creates software development process documentation, including requirements, design and interface specifications and verification documentation. * Develops time and effort estimates for features and functions. * Develops and performs unit, integration, and/or system testing of applications as
