jobs.title: Senior Identity System Engineer
jobs.description: **Careers With Purpose** **Sanford Health, the largest rural health system in the United States, is dedicated to transforming the health care experience and providing access to world\-class health care in America’s heartland.** **Facility:** Bismarck Business Center **Location:** Bismarck, ND **Address:** 3451 N 14th St, Bismarck, ND 58503, USA **Shift:** 8 Hours \- Day Shifts **Job Schedule:** Full time **Weekly Hours:** 40\.00 **Salary Range:** $40\.00 \- $66\.00 **Pay Info:** Pay starts at $40 and increases according to years of applicable experience. **Job Summary** The Senior Identity Systems Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and securing enterprise identity and access management infrastructure that enables reliable authentication, authorization, and access management across hybrid environments. Engineers in this family ensure that users, systems, and applications are authenticated, authorized, and protected in alignment with security standards, regulatory requirements, and business needs. The Senior Identity Systems Engineer is an advanced technical role responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise identity infrastructure across on\-premises and cloud environments. This position leads the architecture of domain topologies, forest structures, and global replication, while ensuring hybrid identity solutions provide seamless sign\-in experiences across platforms. The engineer drives the adoption of modern authentication protocols such as Kerberos, OAuth, OpenID Connect, and SAML, and leads initiatives around just\-in\-time access, privileged session monitoring, and automated access governance. Responsibilities include integrating systems through API calls (REST, SOAP, JSON), managing enterprise PKI and certificate lifecycles, enforcing security baselines via Group Policy, and ensuring compliance with regulatory frameworks such as SOX, HIPAA, and GDPR. In addition to technical execution, the Senior Identity Systems Engineer plays a mentoring role, guiding junior engineers in best practices and fostering team knowledge growth. With a focus on innovation and automation, this role ensures that the organization's identity services remain secure, resilient, and aligned with modern zero trust principles and evolving business needs. This role requires deep technical expertise in Active Directory, Entra ID, authentication protocols, Identity Governance Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM) and PKI with a strong focus on information security, compliance, strong problem\-solving skills, a security\-first mindset, and least\-privilege enforcement. The Senior Identity Systems Engineer ensures the organization's identity platforms are resilient, scalable, and secure to support business operations and protect sensitive data. The Senior Identity Systems Engineer will work closely with cross\-functional IT, application, and security teams to ensure alignment with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. **Qualifications** Bachelor’s degree required, in lieu of education, leadership may consider an Associate’s Degree plus 3 years of applicable experience in computer science or related field. Minimum of 3\-4 years applicable work experience required. Including but not limited to: * Supporting Active Directory, Domain Services, Hybrid Identities, \& Entra ID * Implementing SSO/MFA workflows using SAML 2\.0 and/or OIDC * Maintaining Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) * Supporting Identity Lifecycle \& Access Governance workflows and technical integrations * Implementation of information security standards and procedures including HIPAA and PCI Security Certifications (CISSP, CISA, CISM, Security\+, CEH, etc.) are highly desired. **Benefits** Sanford offers an attractive benefits package for qualifying full\-time and part\-time employees. Depending on eligibility, a variety of benefits include health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, life insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, work/life balance benefits, and a generous time off package to maintain a healthy home\-work balance. For more information about Total Rewards, visit https://sanfordcareers.com/benefits . Sanford is an EEO/AA Employer M/F/Disability/Vet. learner.** You get oriented in unfamiliar codebases, ask focused questions, and turn direction into working software without needing every step spelled out. * **Focused on outcomes.** You understand jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: We're looking for an AI Engineer to help build the next generation of AI models behind our diagnostic platform. You'll work on modern, large\-scale machine learning for health, turning large, messy, real\-world datasets into models that carry real clinical signal. You'll join a team of AI engineers who care about doing this the right way. We're looking for someone who brings current knowledge of the field, whether from graduate research or hands\-on work, and who pushes the team to approach problems from a modern AI perspective. We want someone who understands why methods work, not someone who can only run a tutorial notebook on an off\-the\-shelf model. Together you'll assemble and curate large datasets, train and evaluate models, and show whether they carry real clinical signal. Learning goes both ways here. You'll work alongside experienced AI engineers who review your code and talk through your results, and we expect you to teach them what's new. The work is hands\-on from week one. Over time you'll own larger pieces of the pipeline, from data to deployed model. ### **Responsibilities** * Train and evaluate modern deep learning models on large datasets, including self\-supervised approaches and fine\-tuning of large pretrained models. * Build and maintain the data pipelines that feed them: collecting, cleaning, deduplicating, and versioning large video datasets. * Develop ways to learn from noisy or limited labels, and measure how much real signal the models carry. * Run experiments carefully: track runs, make results reproducible, and write up what you found, including negative results. * Design evaluations that reflect real\-world use, and show clearly where offline metrics and product performance diverge. * Support our existing computer vision work as models move toward production. * Write clean, tested, well\-documented Python that teammates can pick up and reuse. * Take part in code review and technical discussions, and explain your results to both technical and non\-technical colleagues. * Stay on top of current AI research. Reproduce promising methods, propose experiments, and teach the team what you learn. * Pitch in on whatever the team needs. We're small, and everyone does a bit of everything. ### **About Senseye** Senseye is a NeuroTechnology company based in Austin, TX, on the cusp of revolutionizing mental health. We're developing the world's first objective mental health diagnostics platform, measuring cognitive activity through the eye using mobile devices. Our initial diagnostic for PTSD is entering clinical trials, with additional indications for anxiety and depression to follow. We're a team of scientists, engineers, and clinicians building technology that could redefine how mental health is understood and treated. **Requirements** * Master's degree or PhD in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent experience showing comparable machine learning skills, such as several years of applied ML work or substantial published or open\-source work. * Recent graduates are welcome. Up to about 3 years of hands\-on ML experience, including graduate research, a thesis, internships, and industry work, is a plus. * Solid Python and experience with at least one deep learning framework. * A working grasp of ML fundamentals: training and validation, overfitting, evaluation metrics, and why a good test score isn't the same as a working product. * Hands\-on experience with modern deep learning beyond off\-the\-shelf use. You've trained or substantially adapted models yourself and can explain your design choices and the tradeoffs. * Comfort with Git, the command line, and working on a shared codebase. * Clear writing and communication. You can explain a result or a plot simply and say what you're unsure of. * Curiosity and the habit of digging in when something looks off, in the data or in your own code. ### **Extra Points** None of these are required. * Hands\-on experience with self\-supervised, contrastive, or masked\-modeling methods. * Experience with large\-scale training: multi\-GPU runs or experiment tracking such as Weights \& Biases. * Experience with video, time\-series, or sensor data. * Experience with noisy\-label learning or semi\-supervised methods. * A paper, open\-source contribution, or substantial personal project you can show us. * Exposure to healthcare, medical device software, or other regulated settings. **Benefits** * Flexible schedule and flexible paid time off * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Short\- and long\-term disability and life insurance * 401(k) * Continuing education opportunities * Health and Wellness stipend * Fully stocked kitchen and a flexible hybrid environment * The freedom and trust to shape your role as we design, build, and ship our products

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** SmartRent (NYSE: SMRT) is revolutionizing how people live and work with the industry's only end\-to\-end platform designed for the rental housing industry. By uniting purpose\-built software, integrated hardware and full implementation and support in one ecosystem, we help owners and operators simplify operations, cut costs and deliver exceptional resident experiences. Recognized by Deloitte, HousingWire and the PropTech Breakthrough Awards, SmartRent is shaping the future of property technology and redefining what it means to make rental housing smarter. **Job Description** As a Data Engineer at SmartRent, you will build the pipelines that turn SmartRent's device telemetry, operational and enterprise data into trusted, governed assets. You'll build and deploy production\-grade data pipelines in Databricks by partnering closely with Data Science, Product, and functional stakeholders to curate disparate data sources into actionable assets. Reporting to the Director of Data Engineering, part of our new transformational Enterprise Data and AI organization, you will use your hands\-on experience to mature our Databricks Lakehouse to increasingly become the nexus of data\-driven insight across SmartRent. **Responsibilities** * Build and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines for high\-volume device telemetry and operational data. * Design curated data models across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers in Unity Catalog that serve data science, ML, and AI workloads. * Deploy and promote pipelines using Databricks Asset Bundles, in partnership with DevOps. * Contribute to platform standards for governance, cost, and performance with the Director of Data and DevOps. * Build and maintain datasets that support agentic AI workloads, including curating unstructured data, leveraging vector\- and search\-based data stores. * Drive the maturity of our data quality framework, including data sensitivity classification and access controls as part of the end\-to\-end pipeline creation process. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; or equivalent professional experience. * 5\+ years in data engineering, including production work with core and emerging features in Databricks. * Demonstrated experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow (Declarative Pipelines and Jobs), Lakebase, Asset Bundles. * Experience ingesting and modeling high\-volume IoT, telemetry, or event\-stream data. * Advanced Python and SQL skills * Familiarity with relevant data structures such as CSV, JSON, Parquet and Delta. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with a demonstrated ability to present technical concepts to non\-technical audiences. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience enabling self\-service data access in Databricks using features such as AI/BI Dashboards and Genie. * Experience in proptech, real estate technology, IoT, or SaaS platform environments. * Databricks Associate or Professional Certifications for data engineering. * Familiarity with Git\-based version control and Terraform. ### **We Put Our Employees First** We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your well\-being and future. For our US employees, this includes medical, dental, vision, and life insurance with low deductibles and 75–100% employer contributions. We also provide flexible and generous PTO (because we know how important work\-life balance is), a competitive 401(k) with employer contributions, paid parental leave, discounted insurance plans for pets and legal services and an employee stock purchase plan to help you invest in your future. ### **You'll fit right in if you:** * Do the hard work and go out of your way to deliver excellence * Own outcomes and learn from your mistakes * Are a collaborative and supportive team player—win or lose, you lift others up * Value authenticity, diverse perspectives, and inclusion in the workplace * Have a passion for smart tech and the real estate industry Privacy Policy

This role manages internal staff and security service providers, oversees incident response and vulnerability management, and translates security strategy and approved designs into effective operational plans, controls, and measurable results.**Essential Functions:** * Leads, coaches, and develops the Information Security Operations team; assign priorities, manage performance, and exposure management activities, including security testing, third\-party security reviews, risk\-based remediation, exception tracking, and control validation; drives measurable process improvements and escalates material unresolved risks. * Manages Information Security Operations capabilities, including technologies and services, ensuring clear accountability, performance measures, service expectations, and roadmaps. * Evaluates security products and services based on protection, business value, reliability, integration, staff efficiency, and total cost. * Develops operating procedures, incident playbooks, performance measures, and concise reporting on risks, service levels, corrective actions, and outcomes. * Oversees cybersecurity budgets, projects, contracts, licensing, vendors, and service\-level commitments; coordinates with Risk, Compliance, Audit, Legal, and other stakeholders. * Evaluates emerging risks, including AI\-enabled threats, and uses threat intelligence, automation, and AI\-assisted capabilities to improve SJI’s defensive capabilities and operational effectiveness. * Supports compliance with applicable cybersecurity regulatory requirements, including TSA Security Directives, NJ BPU requirements, and evolving requirements affecting SJI’s utility and renewable operations. **SCADA and Operational Security** ---------------------------------- * Provide operational cybersecurity leadership for SJI’s SCADA systems and utility and renewable operations. * Partner with operations leaders, engineers, and technology teams to understand operational constraints, prioritize risk, and implement improvements without compromising safety or reliability. * Oversee the operational effectiveness of asset visibility, network monitoring, endpoint protection, secure access, identity and privileged access, vulnerability management, and incident readiness. * Maintain clear escalation paths, response playbooks, support expectations, and readiness exercises for cyber events affecting SCADA and other operational environments. **Capability and Service Leadership** ------------------------------------- * Define ownership, service expectations, operating procedures, performance measures, and roadmaps for Information Security Operations services. * Evaluate security products and services based on the protection they provide, business value, reliability, usability, integration, staff efficiency, and total cost. * Work with IT, operations, and business partners to understand priorities, plan the work, reduce unnecessary handoffs, and support safe and reliable operations. * Use automation and AI\-assisted tools where they can improve response time, consistency, and staff capacity, while maintaining appropriate review and oversight. **Governance, Financial and Partner Management** ------------------------------------------------ * Plan and manage operating and project budgets, forecasts, contracts, licensing, renewals, staffing, and external service requirements. * Manage vendors and managed security providers against documented service levels, deliverables, costs, issues, and improvement plans; hold partners accountable for results. * Lead operational security projects and ensure scope, ownership, milestones, risks, decisions, and outcomes are documented and actively managed. * Partner with Legal, Procurement, Risk, Compliance, Audit, Human Resources, and business stakeholders on incidents, contracts, regulatory obligations, audit support, and security governance. * Maintain policies, standards, procedures, knowledge resources, inventories, records, and operational documentation that support repeatable and auditable execution. **Required Skills:** * Experience supporting corporate IT and OT environments; utility, energy, critical infrastructure, SCADA, or industrial control system experience strongly preferred. * Knowledge of NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2\.0, incident response, network and identity security, cloud monitoring, and modern security operations tools (e.g., SIEM/XDR, SOAR, EDR, NDR). * Experience managing cybersecurity budgets, projects, vendors, contracts, and service\-level agreements; strong communication, judgment, collaboration, and operational leadership skills. **Qualifications** **Required Background:** * Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience, or; * Master’s degree with 4 years of relevant experience. * In addition, a minimum of 3 years of leadership experience is required * Equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of degree. **Explore the Possibilities** South Jersey Industries employs a diverse range of talent – from construction contractors to environmental specialists. jobs.title: Protection & Control Applications Engineer/Analyst (BHM)
jobs.description: **WORK LOCATION, SCHEDULE, \& TRAVEL** * This position will be based out of Birmingham, AL. * Hybrid work schedule (both in\-office and telecommute); currently four (4\) days in\-office and one (1\) day telecommute. * Relocation assistance may be provided if the successful candidate does not currently live within a reasonable commuting distance. This position will require some travel (day and overnight, up to 25%) and the ability to work successfully in a remote/virtual environment with access to internet service. * **POSITION SUMMARY** If you're passionate about being at the forefront of innovation in the electric utility industry, this is the perfect moment to join us! With an accelerated growth in power demands and AI technologies reshaping our field, our teams are designing dependable transmission and distribution protection systems to maintain the highest level of reliability our customers expect. We're embracing the latest advancements in protective relaying systems, setting the stage for a new era of the electric grid. If you’re excited about helping build tomorrow’s energy infrastructure, we invite you to explore this opportunity and become part of our dynamic team! This position will perform protective relay calculations and coordination studies for Southern Company's transmission and distribution systems. This engineer will also perform engineering design and technical services for the specification, application and analysis of protective relaying and control systems. The selected candidate(s) will provide technical expertise and support for design, construction, planning, marketing and customers regarding protection and control of Southern Company's transmission and distribution facilities. Additional responsibilities include developing and maintaining impedance models from equipment manufacturer data and transmission line designs using Gridscale X (CAPE) for Southern Company's transmission system. This includes performing system impact studies in support of transmission system interconnection requests. **POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES** * Design protective relay \& control schemes and develop protective relay settings to protect and monitor the performance of electric power system facilities (transmission lines, distribution lines, and substation equipment). * Provide power system and protection engineering consulting services and technical assistance to other functional areas. * Investigate root cause of abnormal power system operations. * Review transmission system operations with emphasis on microprocessor relay event analysis. * Some travel for site visits, meetings, conferences, and training may be required. * Develop and maintain impedance models from equipment manufacturer data and transmission line designs using Gridscale X (CAPE). * Perform short\-circuit studies for transmission and substation projects, including breaker duty, equipment ratings, and system strength assessments. * Perform interconnection studies to assess the impact of renewable energy integration (inverter\-based resources) and traditional generation on short\-circuit levels and provide breaker duty impacts. * Participate in an on\-call rotation to provide remote support to field and operations customers in the event of abnormal/emergency system conditions. ***Opportunities provided by this position:*** * Learning how a power system/utility operates and how substations are designed and built. * Attending a variety of classes to aid in professional development. Many of these classes are designed for new engineers to help them improve their skills and knowledge to be successful. Working for a large electric utility that offers many opportunities for advancement. * ***Selected candidate will have the chance to:*** * Work with technologies that range from the older electromechanical relays to modern microprocessor relays. * Support operations and design functions to maintain a reliable, safe, and secure power system. * Develop protection schemes and providing relay settings for protecting the power system from short circuits and other abnormal conditions that might cause damage or interfere with the effective operation of the system. * Handle multiple projects simultaneously, requiring the ability to set priorities and use effective time management and organizational skills. * Develop power system models including transmission lines, transformers, inverter\-based resources (IBR), and generators. **POSITION QUALIFICATIONS** ***Education:*** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Engineering Technology is preferred + Electrical emphasis/discipline is highly preferred Professional Engineer (P.E.) License or Engineer\-in\-Training Certificate or ability to obtain in 12 months is highly desirable * ***Experience:*** * Experience performing protective relay calculations and coordination studies is a plus. * Experience working with APA (Advanced Protection Assessment), ASPEN, EDSA, ETAP or other related power system simulation software ngineering, and/or substation control design engineering is a plus. * Knowledge of NERC compliance requirements for the Bulk Electric System (BES) is a plus. * For less experienced engineers, electrical engineering courses that will be helpful in this position will include Power System Analysis, Protective Relaying, Control Systems, Electric Machine Theory, and Symmetrical Components. ***Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities:*** * Knowledge of electrical and power system theory * Understanding of substation protection \& operation control schemes Strong computer, data analysis, time management \& excellent communication skills (oral, presentation \& written) * ***Behavioral Attributes:*** * Model **Our Values** : *Safety First, Intentional Inclusion, Act with Integrity, and Superior Performance* * Conduct all activities with a focus on providing value to our customers. * Take personal responsibility for their projects and customer issues. * Follow through on all aspects of assignments to ensure a quality product and increased value is delivered to our customers. * Exhibit and promote a positive, "can do" attitude. * Commitment as a team member to building and maintaining an inclusive work environment. * Must place strong emphasis on Operational Excellence (mistake free designs). Must understand and practice Human Performance concepts. * **BENEFITS** * Competitive Pay * Excellent benefits packages which includes: + Medical and dental coverage + Defined Pension/Cash Balance Benefit Plan + Performance\-sharing plan + 401(k) plan with a generous company match + Bonus opportunities Tuition Reimbursement + ***\*\*\*Please submit an updated resume with your application\*\*\**** **About Southern Company** Southern Company (NYSE: SO ) is a leading energy provider serving 9 million customers across the Southeast and beyond through its family of companies. Providing clean, safe, reliable and affordable energy with excellent service is our mission. The company has electric operating companies in three states, natural gas distribution companies in four states, a competitive generation company, a leading distributed energy solutions provider with national capabilities, a fiber optics network and telecommunications services. Through an industry\-leading commitment to innovation, resilience and sustainability, we are taking action to meet customers' and communities' needs while advancing our goal of net\-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050\. Our uncompromising values ensure we put the needs of those we serve at the center of everything we do and are the key to our sustained success. We are transforming energy into economic, environmental and social progress for tomorrow. Our corporate culture has been recognized by a variety of organizations, earning the company awards and recognitions that reflect Our Values and dedication to service. To learn more, visit www.southerncompany.com . Southern Company invests in the well\-being of its employees and their families through a comprehensive total rewards strategy that includes competitive base salary, annual incentive awards for eligible employees and health, welfare and retirement benefits designed to support physical, financial, and emotional/social well\-being. This position may also be eligible for additional compensation, such as an incentive program, with the amount of any bonus/awards subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan(s). A summary of the benefits offered for this position can be found here https://seo.nlx.org/southernco/pdf/SOCO\-Benefits.pdf . Additional and specific details about total compensation and beneﬁts will also be provided during the hiring process. Southern Company is an equal opportunity employer where an applicant's qualifications are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Overview of Responsibilities: * Provide operational support for the IT infrastructure production environment. * Serve as a subject matter expert in servers, operating systems and IT support related systems to ensure end user success. * Respond to escalated issues, conducts troubleshooting/research and reports on workarounds and resolutions per ITIL\-management best practices. * Drives systems/technology migrations and implementations. * Responsible for delivery of IT metrics across all systems (i.e.: monitoring, patch management, malware control, etc.). * Policy and procedure enforcement under the best practices established within the IT Department. * A Systems Engineer IV works with their counterparts to troubleshoot advanced infrastructure and application issues. * A Systems Engineer IV performs advanced installation, configuration, administration and tuning of many infrastructure systems and applications (see skills below). * A Systems Engineer IV serves in an jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Global Markets
jobs.description: ### **About Staffbase** We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first **AI\-native Employee Experience Platform**. Our **industry\-leading and award\-winning agentic AI communications channels** \- intranet, employee app and email solutions \- create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees. Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550\+ employees supports 1,500\+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience. We are proud to be a **Unicorn** company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we're shaping the future of workplace communication. This is a hands\-on technical role within Staffbase Build, responsible for turning specific enterprise customer needs into reliable, scalable extensions of the Staffbase platform, using its extensibility capabilities (widgets, plugins, integrations, and other platform objects). The role owns assigned customer solutions end\-to\-end, defining the use case with stakeholders, building and testing across the stack, deploying it, and validating it with users. The aim is to drive adoption and stickiness of the platform, not to create one\-off, standalone customer solutions. The role acts as a bridge, helping customers do what they and the platform can't do alone yet, and feeds what's learned back into shared standards and the product roadmap. This is a hybrid role. Core in\-office days in our Minneapolis office are Tuesdays\-Thursdays, and it is expected that folks will be in the office a minimum of 2 day per week during core days. The role reports into the regional Build Leader. **What you'll be doing** **Solution Delivery** * Owning the technical design, implementation, testing, and release of assigned custom solutions end\-to\-end * Building across the stack (customer\-facing UI, backend services, and integrations with Staffbase and third\-party APIs) **Customer \& Stakeholder Collaboration** * Partnering with customers, consultants and internal teams, e.g. Sales, to define and detail use cases before development. Supporting pre\-sales in a technical advisory capacity, primarily during requirements discovery: join customer and Sales conversations to clarify needs, assess technical feasibility, and help scope custom solutions * Validating shipped solutions with users and gathering feedback afterward * Supporting customers in building basic solutions themselves using Staffbase\-provided platform tools where appropriate, rather than defaulting to a fully bespoke build **Platform\-First Engineering** * Keeping up to date with new and evolving platform capabilities (new extensibility primitives, APIs, and platform objects) so solutions are built using the latest native capabilities rather than defaulting to more bespoke patterns * Applying the company's architectural, security, and compliance standards so solutions remain supportable **Pattern Capture \& Product Feedback** * Identifying reusable patterns and components arising from customer engagements; documenting and contributing them to a shared Build asset catalogue * Surfacing recurring, validated customer needs for consideration in the product roadmap **Craft \& Team Contribution** * Maintaining a strong quality bar (testing, code reviews, healthy CI/CD practices). * Participating in the Build on\-call rotation to support shipped customer solutions, in line with the applicable regional on\-call policy. * Helping bring structure and engineering standards to the team, and mentor less experienced engineers **What you need to be successful** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, building and running production systems * Customer\-facing technical experience (forward\-deployed, solutions engineering, consulting) * Strong React, TypeScript/JavaScript and experience in either Go, Java, Kotlin or Node.js on the backend * Deep experience designing and integrating REST APIs and third\-party systems, as well as testing, assessing and integrating APIs of third\-party systems * Ability to explain technical trade\-offs to non\-technical audiences * Experience mentoring or guiding less\-experienced developers, and a knack for bringing structure to how a team works * Comfort working directly with stakeholders — you can translate business needs into technical solutions and validate them afterwards * A strong focus on quality, clean code, testing, and continuous learning * A self\-starter who works well both independently and as part of a team * You understand and appreciate diversity and inclusivity in the workplace **What you'll get** * *Competitive Compensation \-* we offer attractive salary packages including LTIP (unit\-based Long Term Incentive Plan) * *Flexibility \-* we offer flexible working time models and the option of hybrid work, and support this with a yearly flex work allowance of $1608 * *Recharge* \- with 31 vacation days annually (incl. one floating holiday), plus pro rata fully paid Fridays off during August * *Support \-* we're offering a 401(k) plan with company match and health plans, including dental \& vision as well as competitive Paid Parental Leave to support new parents * *Volunteer Day \-* you'll get one day off per year for supporting a social project In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles that will be performed in Minnesota. Actual salaries will vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Staffbase's total compensation package for employees. Pay Range: $130,000 \- $175,000 base salary per year. Other rewards may include commissions and program\-specific awards. In addition, Staffbase provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, equity, paid parental leave, an employee growth budget, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, wellness days, paid holidays and paid time off (PTO).

jobs.title: AI QA Automation Engineer, AVP - State Street Investment Management
jobs.description: **Role Summary** ================ We are looking for an AI Quality Engineer to modernize and accelerate software quality engineering through AI\-assisted testing and intelligent automation. The ideal candidate will bring strong hands\-on QA automation experience and demonstrated expertise in Playwright, GitHub Copilot, and Tricentis Tosca, including Tosca AI capabilities. The engineer will use AI\-assisted development and automation techniques to improve test generation, automation development, execution, maintenance, defect analysis, and overall QA productivity. This role will also support the development and adoption of reusable AI\-powered QA agents and automation frameworks across multiple application teams. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **AI\-Assisted Quality Engineering** ------------------------------------ * Use GitHub Copilot to accelerate the development of automated test cases, utilities, test data solutions, API tests, and QA frameworks. * Apply Generative AI to requirements analysis, test scenario identification, test case generation, automation generation, and defect analysis. * Develop reusable prompts, instructions, skills, and engineering patterns that improve the consistency and accuracy of AI\-generated QA assets. * Evaluate AI\-generated tests for accuracy, stability, coverage, maintainability, and security rather than accepting generated output without engineering validation. * Contribute to the development and enhancement of AI QA agents for requirements analysis, test design, automation generation, traceability, and defect triage. **Playwright Automation Engineering** ------------------------------------- * Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks using Playwright. Hands\-on Playwright experience is mandatory for this role. * Build and maintain Playwright tests for modern web applications using JavaScript or TypeScript. * Develop reusable fixtures, page objects, utilities, reporting, test data, and environment configuration to support enterprise\-scale automation. * Implement reliable cross\-browser, API, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing with Playwright. * Integrate Playwright automation into GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or equivalent CI/CD and Continuous Testing pipelines. * Analyze failed automation and determine whether failures are caused by application defects, test data, environment, or automation issues. **Tricentis Tosca \& Tosca AI** ------------------------------- * Design, develop, and maintain automated tests using Tricentis Tosca. * Apply Tosca AI\-assisted capabilities to increase automation productivity and improve test maintenance. * Build reusable Tosca components and automation assets that can be shared across applications. * Support GUI, API, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing. * Integrate Tosca automation into CI/CD and Continuous Testing pipelines. **QA Transformation \& Adoption** --------------------------------- * Partner with application QA and development teams to identify opportunities for AI\-assisted testing and automation. * Help application teams adopt Playwright, GitHub Copilot, Tosca, and AI QA capabilities. * Build reusable examples, templates, prompts, standards, and best practices. * Conduct demonstrations, knowledge\-sharing sessions, and technical enablement for QA engineers. * Measure improvements in automation coverage, development effort, execution time, maintenance effort, and defect detection. **Required Skills and Qualifications** ====================================== * 5\+ years of experience in Quality Engineering or QA Automation. * **Mandatory:** Strong hands\-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining automated tests and frameworks using Playwright. * Strong JavaScript or TypeScript experience for Playwright automation development. * Strong hands\-on experience with GitHub Copilot. * Strong experience with Tricentis Tosca. * Experience applying Generative AI or large language models (LLMs) to software testing or engineering workflows. * Strong understanding of test automation architecture, functional and regression testing, API testing, UI/web automation, test data management, CI/CD, Continuous Testing, defect analysis, and debugging. * Programming or scripting experience with Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or C\#. * Experience with Git/GitHub and modern development workflows. **Preferred Skills** ==================== * Tosca API and enterprise application automation. * GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps. * Jira and Xray. * AI agent development or agentic workflows. * Prompt engineering and reusable AI instruction or skill development. * Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) and enterprise knowledge\-base integration. * Requirements\-to\-test traceability. * AI\-generated automation validation and governance. * Performance or data testing experience. **Salary Range:** $80,000 \- $140,000 Annual The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ. *Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long\-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid\-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance\-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.* *For a full overview, visit* *https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home* *.* **About State Street** ====================== Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law. Discover more information on jobs at StateStreet.com/careers Read our CEO Statement **Job Application Disclosure:** It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. jobs.description: ### **Information Technology Services \- ITS** #### **State of Idaho Opportunity** **Applications will be accepted through 4:59 PM MST on the posting end date.** **About Information Technology Services** Information Technology Services is a team of dedicated professionals providing core technology and cybersecurity services to agencies across the state of Idaho. Our work enables state employees to deliver essential services to Idaho’s citizens. We invite you to join our team and help strengthen the technology services that support state government. **Summary:** Build software that helps Idaho state agencies serve the people who depend on them. The Office of Information Technology Services (ITS) is seeking an IT Software Engineer IV onsite at our Boise, Idaho Chinden Campus to help strengthen and modernize the applications that support public services across the state. In this hands\-on senior engineering role, you will work alongside developers designing, building, and delivering secure, reliable applications. You will contribute production code, solve challenging integration problems, and help modernize established systems while preserving the essential services they provide. Working with agency partners and technical teams, you will translate business needs into practical solutions that improve services and support the responsible use of state resources. As part of the senior engineering team, you will share technical leadership responsibilities, with assignments and priorities coordinated by the development manager. You will help other developers succeed through collaborative problem\-solving, code reviews, and mentoring. Your experience and judgment will guide architectural decisions and improvements in testing, security, and deployment practices. This position offers the opportunity to stay closely involved in software development while shaping the technical direction of applications with a lasting public service impact. **Please note:** Successful candidates will be required to pass multiple, comprehensive fingerprint\-based background checks specific to the agencies ITS supports. **Example of duties:** * Leads the architecture, development, and modernization of complex enterprise applications, including assessing legacy systems, evaluating alternatives, and planning migrations that preserve essential business functions * Serves on the senior engineering team, providing technical leadership for agency software portfolios and collaborating with development teams to resolve complex design, integration, and maintenance challenges within established enterprise standards * Works directly within development teams to design, write, test, and deliver secure production code, implement reusable components and complex integrations * Designs secure, reliable, and maintainable applications through appropriate architectural patterns, access controls, data protection, and consideration of system dependencies * Establishes and applies engineering standards through architecture reviews, code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration and deployment practices * Mentors junior staff and guides engineering teams through technical decisions, process improvement, troubleshooting, onboarding, and adoption of new development practices * Provides recommendations for investment in new products and technology solutions, supported by appropriate ROI, total cost of ownership, and/or cost benefit analysis **Minimum Qualifications:** Considerable knowledge of: * Data architecture, software architecture, development and testing practices * Multiple programming languages and software development tool suites Experience: * Providing technical leadership on teams developing large software projects * Creating, interpreting and documenting user requirements * Testing and deploying production systems * Managing complex, enterprise/ interdependent systems Supporting organizational transitions to new architectures, new development processes, performing cost/benefit analysis, analyzing buy vs build alternatives and strategic planning * **Preferred Qualifications:** * Seven or more years of hands\-on software engineering experience delivering complex enterprise applications, including legacy modernization and systems integration, with advanced proficiency in one or more technologies such as Microsoft .NET, C\#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, or Angular. * Five or more years applying and improving secure architecture and engineering practices, including code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines, using platforms such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Enterprise. * Three or more years providing senior technical leadership within software development teams while contributing production code, guiding architectural decisions, mentoring developers, and evaluating technical alternatives through cost, benefit, and risk analysis. * Experience applying AI\-assisted development tools within engineering teams and evaluating generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability. **Benefits:** This position is eligible for the state benefits package, including: * Excellent low\-cost medical, dental, and vision insurance * Generous vacation and sick leave accrual beginning as soon as you start * Eligibility for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program (PSLF) * Paid parental leave * Eleven paid holidays a year * Participation in one of the nation's best state retirement systems: PERSI * Multiple retirement plans * Life insurance * Wellness programs; ongoing training opportunities; and more https://dhr.idaho.gov/StateEmployees/Benefits.html **EEO/ADA/Veteran:** The State of Idaho is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and prohibit discrimination against qualified individuals based on their status as protected veterans or individuals with disabilities and prohibit discrimination against all individuals based on their race, color, religion, political affiliation or belief, sex, national origin, genetics, or any other status protected under applicable federal, state, or local laws. The State of Idaho is committed to access and reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities, auxiliary aids and services are available upon request. If you require an accommodation at any step in our recruitment process, you are encouraged to contact (208\) 334\-2263 (TTY/TTD: 711\), or email ada.coordinator@dhr.idaho.gov. Preference may be given to veterans who qualify under state and federal laws and regulations.

jobs.description: **Job Posting Title** Site Reliability Engineer **Agency** 090 OFFICE OF MANAGEMENT AND ENTERPRISE SERV **Supervisory Organization** IS\-CS **Job Posting End Date** Refer to the date listed at the top of this posting, if available. Continuous if date is blank. Note: Applications will be accepted until 11:59 PM on the day prior to the posting end date above. **Estimated Appointment End Date (Continuous if Blank)** **Full/Part\-Time** Full time **Job Type** Regular **Compensation** Job Details: Full\-time 40\-hour work weeks. Supports the Information Services Division. Salary is up to $110,000 based on education and experience. Position reports onsite in Oklahoma City. Sponsorship: At this time, we cannot offer sponsorship now or in the future. **Job Description** **As a Site Reliability Engineer with OMES you will enjoy:** * Generous leave including 15 days of vacation, 15 days of sick leave and 11 paid holidays annually. * A comprehensive Benefit Package with a generous benefit allowance to offset the cost of insurance premiums for employees and their eligible dependents. **Job Details** * Full\-time 40\-hour work weeks * Supports the Information Services Division * Salary is up to $110,000 based on education and experience * Position reports onsite in Oklahoma City * Sponsorship: At this time, we cannot offer sponsorship now or in the future. **Responsibilities** Incident Escalation \& Remediation (approx. 40%) * Serve as the first technical escalation point for P1/P2 incidents affecting infrastructure, cloud, and application environments. * Lead hands\-on troubleshooting across Windows and Linux servers, virtualization, Azure and hybrid cloud, networking (DNS, load balancing, firewalls), storage, databases, and application middleware. * Act as technical lead within the incident command structure, advising the Incident Commander on impact, options, and risk of remediation actions. * Engage and coordinate subject\-matter experts from network, security, database, application, vendor, and agency teams; drive cross\-domain remediation to closure. * Execute and document emergency changes in accordance with change management and audit requirements. Observability Partnership (approx. 15%) * Collaborate with Observability engineers to define service\-level indicators (SLIs), dashboards, and actionable alerts across Zabbix, Grafana, Azure Monitor, and Datadog. * Identify telemetry gaps surfaced during incidents and drive instrumentation improvements. * Reduce alert noise and false positives; tune thresholds to reflect true user and service impact. Reliability Engineering \& Problem Management (approx. 25%) * Lead blameless post\-incident reviews; produce root cause analyses with corrective and preventive actions tracked to completion. * Define and maintain service\-level objectives (SLOs) and error budgets with service owners and agency stakeholders. * Perform capacity planning, performance analysis, and resilience testing, including disaster recovery and failover validation. * Identify single points of failure and architectural risks; recommend and implement remediation. Automation \& Toil Reduction (approx. 15%) * Develop automated remediation, self\-healing routines, and runbooks using PowerShell, Python, Bash, and infrastructure\-as\-code tooling (Terraform, Ansible, ARM/Bicep). * Measure and reduce operational toil; target a sustained ratio of engineering work to reactive work. * Contribute reliability guardrails to CI/CD pipelines in partnership with DevSecOps. Governance, Security \& Compliance (approx. 5%) * Ensure remediation activities comply with NIST SP 800\-53 controls, CJIS Security Policy, IRS Publication 1075, HIPAA, and state security standards as applicable. * Preserve evidence and audit trails for incidents with security, privacy, or regulatory implications; coordinate with the security operations team and Operational Risk \& Controls. * Support internal and external audits by providing incident, change, and availability documentation. **Physical Demands and Work Environment** * This position works in a comfortable office setting with a computer and telephone for a large percentage of the workday. * This position requires long periods, up to eight hours per day, of sitting and working at a desk. The noise level in the work environment is usually mild. * Participation in a rotating on\-call schedule, including occasional after\-hours, weekend, and holiday response for critical incidents. * Work supports essential public services; may be designated essential personnel during declared emergencies or continuity\-of\-operations events. * Occasional travel to state data centers or agency sites. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field; equivalent professional experience may substitute year\-for\-year. * 5\+ years in infrastructure, systems, or application operations, including 2\+ years in an SRE, production engineering, or senior escalation role. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex, multi\-layer incidents in enterprise or hybrid cloud environments under time pressure. * Strong working knowledge of Windows Server, Linux, virtualization (VMware/Hyper\-V), Microsoft Azure, and core networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, load balancing, firewalls). * Hands\-on experience with at least two observability platforms (e.g., Zabbix, Grafana, Azure Monitor, Datadog, Splunk). * Scripting proficiency in PowerShell and/or Python; working knowledge of infrastructure as code. * Working understanding of ITIL incident, problem, and change practices. * Ability to pass fingerprint\-based background checks and meet CJIS and IRS 1075 personnel security requirements. **Preference will be given to candidates who possess** * Experience in state, local, or federal government IT, or another regulated industry (insurance, financial services, healthcare). * Experience defining and operating SLOs and error budgets for production services. * Familiarity with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes/AKS) and with APM and distributed tracing. * Experience with ServiceNow ITSM and incident command frameworks. * Certifications such as Azure Administrator/Solutions Architect, AWS SysOps, CKA, ITIL 4, or Security\+. * Experience working within agile delivery (Kanban, Agile Release Train / PI planning). **About** **OMES** The Office of Management and Enterprise Services provides excellent service, expert guidance and continuous improvement in support of our partners’ goals. We are a highly qualified workforce committed to serve those who serve Oklahomans and make government run in the most efficient, innovative manner possible. **OMES is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities may be provided upon request.** **Equal Opportunity Employment** The State of Oklahoma is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of genetic information, race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, or disability. Current active State of Oklahoma employees must apply for open positions internally through the Workday Jobs Hub . jobs.description: **Description** --------------- **GENERAL SERVICE** **JOB ANNOUNCEMENT** IT Application Development Senior/Specialist $99,300 \- $133,608 annually **Closes November 29,2026** The Washington State Office of Superintendent of Public Instruction (OSPI) seeks to fill an IT Application Development Senior/Specialist. This full\-time permanent position is based in Olympia, Washington. This position may be eligible for partial to near full\-time telework. Telework is a combination of in\-building and off\-site days. We encourage interested candidates to visit the OSPI website to gain insight into our agency. **About OSPI and our initiatives** OSPI is the primary agency charged with overseeing public K–12 education in Washington state. Working with the state's 295 public school districts and 7 state\-tribal education compact schools, OSPI allocates funding and provides tools, resources, and technical assistance so every student in Washington is provided a high\-quality public education. At OSPI, we recognize that our employees are the key to the success of the agency. We are committed to our work but value the balance with our personal lives. We demonstrate our commitment to employees by providing an environment that stimulates professional growth and values them for their expertise. OSPI is a great place to work and has several initiatives to help create a great working environment, including: * We support a healthy work/life balance by offering flexible/alternative work schedules and mobile and telework options. (Depending on job duties and work location.) * We have an Infant at Work Program that is based on long\-term values of newborns and infant\-parent bonding. Eligible employees who are new parents or legal guardians can bring their infant (six weeks to six months) when returning to work. (Depending on job duties and work location.) * We value and are actively involved in promoting diversity, equity and inclusion within OSPI by way of cross\-divisional, collaborative committee. The focus of the committee includes employee engagement and education; reinforcing OSPI values; and maximizing the value of diversity and identifying strategies for inclusion. **Vision, Mission, and Values** Vision: All students prepared for post\-secondary pathways, careers, and civic engagement. Mission: Transform K\-12 education to a system that is centered on closing opportunity gaps and is characterized by high expectations for all students and educators. We achieve this by developing equity\-based policies and supports that empower educators, families, and communities. Values: Ensuring Equity, Collaboration and Service, Achieving Excellence through Continuous Improvement, Focus on the Whole Child **Equity** Each student, family, and community possesses strengths and cultural knowledge that benefits their peers, educators, and schools. Ensuring educational equity: * Goes beyond equality; it requires education leaders to examine the ways current policies and practices result in disparate outcomes for our students of color, students living in poverty, students receiving special education and English Learner services, students who identify as LGBTQ\+, and highly mobile student populations. * Requires education leaders to develop an understanding of historical contexts; engage students, families, and community representatives as partners in decision\-making; and actively dismantle systemic barriers, replacing them with policies and practices that ensure all students have access to the instruction and support they need to succeed in our schools. **Position Overview** The objective of this senior\-level position is to independently design, develop, maintain, sustain and modernize the Child Nutrition Services application suite and related data transfer systems. The position applies advanced application development, architecture, data integration, security, and troubleshooting expertise to support accurate and timely service delivery and financial support for Child Nutrition Services applications. The systems enable Child Nutrition Services to: * Administer 9 U.S. Department of Agriculture Child Nutrition Programs * Collect and approve a program application from program operators * Pay claims for reimbursement for meals served. * Account for state and federal dollars paid to program operators over multiple overlapping state and federal fiscal years. * Collect data for state and federal reporting efforts. * Determine eligibility for local level program participants. * Manage food inventory and food ordering. * Washington Integrated Nutrition System (WINS): an application and claiming system for USDA Child Nutrition Programs. Child Nutrition Services administers seven programs in WINS and each of these programs pays reimbursement for meals served each month of the year. Additionally, WINS has a custom payment option to distribute other payment types like federal and state equipment grants. WINS supports claims for reimbursement totaling $55 r level professional experience in some or all of the following technologies: * T\-SQL Query Language for database development. * Azure DevOps and GIT source code management * Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) * Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) or other ETL processes * Authentication and Authorization technologies. i.e. Entra ID * ASP.NET MVC * XML \& XSLT * Webforms * Windows Services * Web Services / SOA Messaging services * Writing and executing Unit Tests and other Software Testing Methodologies. * Source control management, tracking, reviews, and troubleshooting. * DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments * Application troubleshooting, debugging, and performance analysis * Unit testing, integration testing, automated testing, and quality assurance methodologies * IIS administration and web application hosting Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise applications * Professional experience in some or all of the following business processes: * Lean principles and continuous process improvement * Data Warehousing * ITIL, DevOps, Agile * Project Management * Requirements gathering, business analysis, and stakeholder engagement * Production support, incident management, and root cause analysis * Change management and release management processes * Technical documentation and knowledge transfer **Compensation** The annual compensation for the position is $99,300 \- $130,344per year and depends upon experience, educational background and qualifications. Geographic differentials may be applied based on work location of successful candidate. Washington State offers a generous benefit package including health, dental and life insurance, retirement and an optional deferred compensation program. Please visit Health Care Authority for information regarding health benefits and the Department of Retirement Systems for retirement plan information. This position serves at the pleasure of the Superintendent, and is Civil Service Exempt. This position is not represented by a bargaining unit. **Application Process** Those interested in this position must apply through Careers.wa.gov. jobs.title: Transportation Engineer 3
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- **About WSDOT** The Washington State Department of Transportation (WSDOT) is a multimodal agency with a global reputation for excellence. Our dedicated workforce plans, designs, builds, and operates an integrated transportation system that safely and efficiently moves people and goods throughout the state. In addition to maintaining over 20,000 lane miles of state highway and 4,100 bridges, WSDOT leads an award\-winning Active Transportation Plan, manages the world's longest floating bridge, and operates the largest ferry system in the nation! **The Opportunity** WSDOT is currently seeking a skilled Transportation Engineer 3 in Union Gap, WA, to support work zone safety operations throughout the South Central Region. In this role, you will serve as the region’s primary resource for temporary traffic control, ensuring work zones meet state and federal safety standards while helping reduce congestion and crashes. You will provide technical guidance on traffic control designs, construction staging, and work zone strategies; coordinate with construction, maintenance, utilities, and local agency partners; and help resolve work zone safety concerns. You will also assist with developing and reviewing traffic control plans, evaluating temporary and permanent signing and pavement markings, conducting field reviews, and maintaining work zone traffic control records. Your expertise will help keep highway projects moving safely and efficiently while protecting workers and the traveling public. **What to Expect** Among the varied range of responsibilities held within this role, the Transportation Engineer 3 will: * Conduct field reviews of construction work zones to evaluate temporary traffic control (TTC) setups, identify safety concerns, and ensure compliance with approved traffic control plans and applicable standards. * Provide independent technical guidance and engineering recommendations to construction offices on complex traffic control challenges, work zone safety strategies, and traffic management. * Review and evaluate traffic control plans, detours, construction staging plans, and proposed revisions, providing technical comments and recommendations to address traffic impacts and improve safety. * Coordinate with construction, maintenance, utilities, local agencies, Washington State Patrol, and WSDOT staff to ensure consistent work zone practices and safe traffic operations. * Inspect work zone traffic control devices, including signs, pavement markings, cones, barriers, message boards, and flagger stations, to verify proper placement, visibility, and compliance with approved plans. * Evaluate real\-world traffic conditions, including congestion, traffic flow, pedestrian and cyclist safety, detour routes, and potential hazards, and recommend adjustments to improve work zone operations. * Maintain and oversee accurate work zone event records in the statewide database, monitor potential conflicts, and provide guidance and training to staff on database use and reporting requirements. * Support the development of emergency temporary traffic control plans and strategies to address unexpected events and changing roadway conditions. * Scope, develop and implement Low Cost Enhancement projects across the region. **Qualifications** To be considered for this opportunity, the following competencies are required: * **Engineering Knowledge:** Demonstrated experience applying engineering principles, methods, and practices to project management in transportation or construction environments. This includes expertise in design development, construction techniques, and/or contract administration. * **Project Analysis \& Delivery:** Ability to evaluate project plans and documentation to ensure compliance with standards and regulations and provide engineering expertise to support successful project design and construction. * **Regulatory \& Policy Interpretation and Application:** Demonstrated ability to interpret and communicate applicable laws, rules, standards, policies, and procedures, including FHWA and MUTCD standards, and agency guidelines, and apply them to project delivery. * **Technical \& Digital Proficiency:** Advanced skills in operating Windows\-based systems and engineering software, including MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, SharePoint, Outlook), MS Teams, computer\-aided engineering applications, cloud\-based platforms, and system databases for project tracking and information management. * **Communication Skills:** Advanced skills in professional communication, specifically in communicating technical information effectively and professionally to a diverse audience, including those with non\-technical backgrounds, virtually, by phone, and in person. * **License and Certification:** Possession of a valid driver's license and ability to operate state\-owned vehicles for travel to and between project sites in support of field duties and essential job functions. Certification as a Traffic design and analysis, temporary traffic control, and roadway safety. * **Work Zone Traffic Control and Safety:** Knowledge and experience interpreting and applying traffic control regulations, standards, and guidelines to evaluate work zone conditions, identify safety concerns, analyze traffic impacts, and recommend effective solutions. **Important Notes** * This recruitment may also be used to fill additional positions per business needs. * This position offers flexible/hybrid remote work options. * In addition to base salary, employees may be entitled to other forms of compensation depending on the type, duties, or location of the position. For union\-represented positions, more information on other forms of compensation can be found in the applicable Collective Bargaining Agreements. Information on other compensation types for non\-represented positions can be found in Chapter 357\-28 of the Washington Administrative Code. * WSDOT does not use the E\-Verify system, therefore we are not eligible to extend STEM Optional Practical Training (OPT). For more information, please visit www.uscis.gov **Why WSDOT** * Work\-Life Balance – We offer flexible work schedules that allow you time for your life outside of this excellent opportunity. * Paid Leave – In addition to 12 paid holidays, full\-time employees mayearn up to 25 paid vacation days per year! * Tuition Assistance – Permanent employees have several options for assistance with education expenses, including tuition reimbursement programs, government discounts at participating colleges throughout the state, and eligibility for federal student loan forgiveness. * Plan For Your Future – WSDOT offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes a variety of healthcare options. Employees also have a choice of state retirement programs, and much more. Go to State Benefits for more information. **How to Apply** Applications for this recruitment will be accepted electronically. Your relevant experience may be evaluated to determine salary. Therefore, it is very important that the “Work Experience” portion of the application be completed in as much detail as possible. In order to be considered for this opportunity, please include the following with your online application: * An attached Resume outlining (in reverse chronological order) your experience to date. * An attached Cover Letter that further explains your qualifications and indicates why you believe you are a viable candidate for this role. * Contact details for a minimum of three (3\) individuals who can attest to your work performance, technical skills, and job\-related competencies. This information can be entered in the “References” section of the online application; does not require an additional attachment. **Please click the "APPLY" button to proceed.** Note that you will be prompted to either sign in or create an account. This step is required in order to submit an application to this opportunity. *WSDOT is an equal opportunity employer. We value the importance of creating an environment in which all employees can feel respected, included, and empowered to bring unique ideas to the agency. Our diversity and inclusion efforts include embracing different cultures, backgrounds and viewpoints while fostering growth and advancement in the workplace. All persons, regardless of race, ethnicity, age, veteran status, sexual orientation, and/ or gender identity, are encouraged to apply. Persons with disabilities needing assistance in the application process, or those needing this job announcement in an alternative format may contact the recruiter listed.* *WSDOT does not use the E\-Verify system, therefore we are not eligible to extend STEM Optional Practical Training (OPT). For more information, please visit* *www.uscis.gov* **Contact Us** For inquiries about this posting, you may contact the assigned Recruiter at amanda.strebeck@wsdot.wa.gov . Please be sure to reference Transportation Engineer 3 \#51353 in the subject line.

The problems are hard, the data is structured and verifiable, and what you build will be used by engineering teams building the chips that run the world. ### **What You'll Be Doing** * Lead the adaptation of foundation models to specialized engineering domains like hardware description languages, RTL design, and EDA workflows, using supervised fine\-tuning, LoRA/PEFT, and synthetic data data sources like CSV, JSON, Parquet, and SQL, with sandboxed execution and privacy\-preserving designs * Own the evaluation strategy for LLM and agent systems, building automated frameworks with LLM\-as\-judge pipelines, domain\-specific benchmarks, pass@k metrics, and regression suites that gate model releases * Develop production ML monitoring to detect feature drift, data drift, and performance degradation, using statistical tests like Kolmogorov\-Smirnov, Wasserstein distance, and Jensen\-Shannon divergence combined with feature importance * Build scalable pipelines for dataset construction, distributed multi\-GPU training on NVIDIA A100/H100 clusters, checkpoint evaluation, and experiment tracking using PyTorch, Hugging Face, DeepSpeed, and FSDP * Set standards for experimental rigor across the team, including strong baselines, controlled ablations, reproducibility, error analysis, and honest reporting of negative results, and translate outcomes into publications, patents, and production\-ready designs ### **The Impact You Will Have** * Define the technical direction for domain\-specific LLMs that generate verifiable hardware code, improving the productivity of engineering teams designing complex semiconductor systems * Enable reasoning\-enhanced models that solve multi\-step planning and coding tasks with measurably higher correctness, reducing iteration cycles for engineers working in EDA workflows * Deliver enterprise analytics agents that operate autonomously over heterogeneous structured data, automating analysis and reporting tasks that today require manual effort * Build evaluation frameworks that become the standard for how the team measures quality, gates releases, and maintains trust in production AI systems * Detect and remediate production ML drift before it impacts users, ensuring models remain reliable and accurate as data distributions shift over time * Grow the technical capability of the team through mentorship, design reviews, and by setting the example for what rigorous, reproducible AI research looks like in practice * Represent Synopsys AI research externally through publications and invention disclosures that advance the state of the art in domain\-specific AI systems ### **What You'll Need** * PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience in applied AI research and production ML systems * 8\+ years of hands\-on experience building and shipping machine learning systems, with at least 3 years focused on LLMs, post\-training, or agentic AI * Deep expertise in PyTorch, Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, TRL, Datasets, Accelerate), and distributed training frameworks like DeepSpeed or FSDP * Strong foundation in supervised fine\-tuning, parameter\-efficient methods, preference optimization, and reasoning\-enhancement techniques including search\-based inference and reward modeling * Proven ability to design and implement rigorous evaluation frameworks, including automated benchmarks, LLM\-as\-judge pipelines, and statistical validation of model improvements * Experience building production ML monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines using statistical methods and data\-quality tools * Track record of translating research into production systems, with evidence through publications, patents, or shipped products that demonstrate both depth and engineering discipline ### **Who You Are** * You do not trust a result until you have measured it three ways, ablated the components, and understood why it works, not just that it works * You can explain a complex tradeoff between model quality, inference cost, and latency to a VP in two sentences without losing the nuance, and you can defend your without losing context or momentum * You push back when an evaluation is too weak, a baseline is missing, or a launch plan does not account for how the model will actually fail in production * You learn new technical domains quickly, whether that means understanding RTL simulation well enough to integrate it into a training loop or picking up a new statistical test to improve drift detection
