jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: 1\. Senior Software Engineer The individual assigned to this role shall meet the following minimum requirements: Minimum of a masters degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline such as environmental science, mathematics, or physics; or a bachelors degree in a related discipline with 10 years of relevant experience. Minimum of 5 years of experience in computational modeling, software development, and software documentation, including legacy software and systems. Statement of Work The Offeror shall provide National Technology and Engineering Solutions of Sandia (NTESS) with virtual scientific computing support to sustain the Carlsbad, New Mexico site. The Offeror shall provide at least one Subject Matter Expert (SME) with expertise in computer science methods and strong written communication skills to support an existing computational framework. Support shall include sustainment, modernization, performance optimization, HPC readiness, and transition support for evolving three\-dimensional modeling capabilities. Work shall include software development, analysis, refactoring, verification and validation, documentation, performance improvement, platform portability, workflow reproducibility, and migration readiness for Linux\-based computing environments, and shall be performed in compliance with Nuclear Quality Assurance (NQA\-1\) requirements. The Offeror shall confirm its ability to meet these requirements in response to this BOW posting. Note: Additional information regarding the SME is provided in the Key Personnel Overview section of this BOW posting. Note: No lower\-tier subcontractors shall be utilized in the performance of this work. **Mandatory Requirements Part 1** The Offerors personnel assigned under this subcontract shall be United States citizens. The Offeror shall indicate its ability to meet this requirement in its response to this BOW posting. **Mandatory Requirements Part 1** The Offeror shall demonstrate that the proposed personnel identified in the Key Personnel Overview section has supported at least one project within the five years preceding the closing date of this posting that involved computational modeling and software development performed in a regulated, safety\-critical, or other high\-consequence computational environment. To demonstrate compliance, the Offeror shall provide the following information for each project submitted: Project Title Period of Performance Description of the relevant statement of work performed. **Mandatory Requirements Part 1** The Offeror shall provide a resume for the proposed Key Personnel that clearly demonstrates the following qualifications: 1\. Experience programming in mixed\-language scientific software environments, including: Fortran Python C and/or C\+\+ 2\. Experience working in GNU/Linux or equivalent Linux\-based development environments and associated build, compilation, and debugging toolchains. 3\. Experience with high\-performance computing (HPC) systems. 4\. Experience using HPC job schedulers, such as Slurm or equivalent workload management systems. 5\. Experience with Bash shell scripting or equivalent Unix/Linux shell scripting. 6\. Demonstrated ability to adapt to and work effectively with a broad set of conceptual, process, and numerical models, as evidenced by prior project experience. The resume must address each qualification in a manner that allows NTESS to confirm whether the proposed personnel does or does not meet the requirement. If the Offeror seeks consideration of equivalent experience, the Offeror shall submit all requested information identified above, together with a description demonstrating the comparability of the experience, for NTESS review and approval. Note: No lower\-tier subcontractors shall be utilized in the performance of this work. **Mandatory Requirements Part 2** The Offeror shall demonstrate that the proposed personnel has experience in the following technical areas. The resume and project examples provided must contain sufficient detail to allow NTESS to make a clear Yes/No determination for each area. 1\. Computational Modeling and Scientific Software Support Experience in computational modeling, software development, software documentation, and sustaining legacy scientific software in regulated, high\-consequence, or equivalent mission\-critical environments. Define has the environment is mission critical. 2\. Code Standards and Data Handling Experience applying software code standards or equivalent software quality practices; conducting software testing; and working with scientific or technical data formats, storage structures, and data\-processing workflows. 3\. Debugging and Performance Analysis Proficiency with debugging, profiling, performance\-analysis, or equivalent tools and methods used in scientific, technical computing, or HPC software environments. 4\. Legacy Code Modernization Experience improving the portability, efficiency, maintainability, stability, or related quality attributes of legacy scientific codes. 5\. Documentation Enhancements Ability to create or update source code documentation, including Doxygen or equivalent automated documentation approaches, for both existing and newly developed code to improve clarity, traceability, and maintainability. 6\. Technical Debt Identification Experience identifying and documenting technical debt, fragile or high\-risk code areas, and maintainability concerns within software components. 7\. Version Control and Reproducible Builds Knowledge of version\-control concepts and workflows, such as Git or equivalent systems, and practices supporting reproducible or repeatable builds. 8\. Performance Benchmarking Experience conducting performance benchmarking, scalability assessments, load\-characterization studies, or equivalent performance evaluations for scientific or computational software. To demonstrate compliance with the technical areas above, the Offeror shall submit project examples with relevant work performed within the five years preceding the closing date of this posting. For each project, the Offeror shall provide: Project title Period of performance Description of the work performed, including specific tasks, responsibilities, or deliverables demonstrating relevant experience A single project may be used to demonstrate experience in multiple technical areas; the Offeror is not required to provide one project per area if one project substantively addresses more than one requirement. If the Offeror seeks consideration of equivalent experience, the Offeror shall submit all requested information identified above, together with a description demonstrating the comparability of the experience, for NTESS review and approval.

jobs.description: The Principal Product Manager, Clinical Data Analytics, will play a pivotal role in shaping Tendo’s data\-driven solutions by translating clinical and financial\-focused activities into actionable insights that support patients, providers, and health systems. This individual will help define product strategy and functional requirements for analytics offerings, leveraging deep expertise with healthcare coding systems (ICD\-10, DRG, CPT) and payer/provider data workflows. Specifically, this role will help define data requirements and business logic to: * Measure provider\-level clinical quality from claims data. * Analyze the relationship between quality, price, and market share for health procedures. * Identify missing comorbidities from EHR patient records. This role requires a strong balance of technical acumen, healthcare domain knowledge, and product management experience. This person will work closely with engineering, clinical informatics, and customer\-facing teams to deliver data solutions that improve decision\-making, enhance operational efficiency, and support Tendo’s marketplace growth. Under Tendo’s AI\-First R\&D model, this role operates as a Product Engineer with domain strength, owning features end\-to\-end from discovery through release, with AI as the first author at every stage. **About Tendo** Make an impact—join our team! We’re a fast\-growing, mission\-driven company building a culture that enables teams and individuals to thrive. **Our team\-driven culture and rapid growth have earned us recognition as one of Forbes’ Top Startup Employers for 2024, 2025, and 2026\.** Led by an experienced and proven team, we live by our values and are always on the hunt for motivated people with diverse experiences and backgrounds to help us improve the care journey for patients, clinicians, and caregivers by creating software that provides seamless, intuitive, and user\-friendly experiences. If you like working with innovative technologies and want to be part of a growing team that will help transform the healthcare experience, we encourage you to apply today! **Job Location** San Francisco Bay Area, CA Tendo has hubs in San Francisco, CA; Salt Lake City, UT; Chicago, IL; Nashville, TN; and Philadelphia, PA. Candidates may be located in any one of our hub locations. ### **Responsibilities** * **Product Strategy \& Roadmap:** Help define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for clinical data analytics, aligning with company priorities, customer needs, and market opportunities. * **Healthcare Data Expertise:** Serve as a subject matter expert on EHR, claims, pricing, payment, and healthcare coding data to ensure accurate, compliant, and valuable use of clinical and financial information in products. * **Quality Measurement \& Methodology:** Define and maintain the business logic, measurement specifications, risk adjustment methodologies, scoring algorithms, and forecasting models that power Tendo’s quality analytics products, ensuring alignment with evolving CMS, commercial payer, and industry quality programs. * **Clinical Analytics Leadership:** Partner with quality measurement experts, clinical informatics, data science, and engineering teams to design methodologies that accurately measure provider performance, identify opportunities for quality improvement, and produce transparent and explainable analytics. * **Customer Engagement:** Collaborate with health systems, employers, payers, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, validate use cases, and ensure products deliver measurable value. * **Execution \& Delivery:** Own assigned features end\-to\-end, from opportunity statement through specification, design input, build, documentation, and release, advancing work through the four PLA gate reviews with no handoffs between stages. * **Analytics \& Insights:** Partner with data science and engineering to build tools that surface actionable insights for users, ensuring outputs are accurate, meaningful, accessible, and aligned with defined methodologies. * **Market \& Internal Collaboration:** Monitor industry trends, competitive offerings, and regulatory developments to inform product direction, and work closely with Sales, Customer Engagement, and Operations to support go\-to\-market, adoption, and customer satisfaction. * **AI\-Directed Delivery \& Knowledge Sharing:** Use AI as the first author for specifications, acceptance criteria, documentation, and analysis; critically evaluate and refine AI\-generated output, and contribute prompt patterns, quality examples, and design and decision standards to the shared team library. ### **Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, Data Science, Health Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * 7\+ years of product management experience in healthcare technology, healthcare analytics, data products, or a related field. * Deep expertise in U.S. healthcare quality measurement an ty measurement methodologies into scalable product requirements, analytics, AI\-driven insights, and decision\-support capabilities for healthcare organizations. * Strong working knowledge of healthcare coding systems, including ICD\-10, DRG, and CPT, as well as claims, payment, and payer/provider data workflows. * Experience working with healthcare data standards and interoperability technologies, including HL7, FHIR, EHR data models, provider directories, and clinical terminology standards such as LOINC, SNOMED CT, and RxNorm, strongly preferred. * Experience working with large, complex healthcare datasets and translating data into meaningful products, insights, or analytics. * Working familiarity with SQL, Python, relational data concepts, or similar technical tools and concepts. * Demonstrated ability to define product strategy, requirements, business logic, and roadmaps for complex data\-driven products. * Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical, clinical, and business teams. * Demonstrated ability to own product initiatives from discovery through delivery and post\-release learning. * Demonstrated fluency with AI tools as a first author, with the ability to direct, evaluate, and refine AI\-generated product specifications, documentation, and analysis using strong independent judgment. ### **Nice to Have** * Advanced degree (MBA, MPH, MS in Health Informatics, MS in Data Science, or related field). * Experience with SaaS platforms, digital health solutions, or healthcare marketplaces. * Experience developing products that support provider quality reporting, value\-based care, population health, care management, or healthcare transparency initiatives. * Experience with CMS quality programs, HRRP, HCC, Leapfrog, U.S. News, commercial quality scorecards, or other healthcare performance measurement frameworks. * Experience applying predictive analytics or machine learning to healthcare quality measurement, risk prediction, or forecasting. * Familiarity with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial claims data structures and reimbursement methodologies. * Familiarity with payer, provider, and employer data integration and reporting needs. * Understanding of value\-based care, reimbursement models, and healthcare economics. * Experience working with EHR systems and clinical informatics teams in a product capacity. **Base Salary Range** $157,250 \- $212,750 This salary range is offered with the understanding that final compensation is based on a number of factors including geography and experience. Tendo also offers an equity package, annual bonuses, and benefits. **Benefits** For full time employees, Tendo also offers full health benefits (medical, dental, and vision), flexible spending and health savings accounts, company paid life insurance, company paid short\-term and long\-term disability, company equity, voluntary benefits, 401(k), company paid holidays, flexible time off, and an employee wellness program (“Breathe”). *Tendo is an equal opportunity employer. Responsibilities** * Develop, maintain, and optimize infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) for repeatable and secure cloud deployments * Build, maintain, and refactor CI/CD pipelines to accelerate feature roles/policies for least\-privilege access in collaboration with security engineers + Improve visibility into cloud resource utilization and cost to support budget\-aware engineering decisions **Required Skills \& Qualifications** * **Core Technical Experience:** 3\-5 years of professional engineering experience in DevOps or Cloud Engineering, with a track record of identifying automation Kubernetes, Ansible, CloudFormation), with experience managing core cloud network topologies. * **CI/CD \& Automation Proficiency:** Solid experience with CI/CD systems (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD) and strong scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash) for automating routine tasks and reducing manual toil. * **Observability \& Reliability:** Hands\-on experience with industry\-standard observability tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Prometheus, Datadog, Grafana) to develop proactive alerts, metrics, and dashboards. * **Security \& Compliance:** Experience managing secrets and access using tools like AWS Secrets Manager, Vault, or SSM, with a strong understanding of cloud IAM roles and least\-privilege enforcement. * **Technical Communication \& Collaboration:** Clear communication of infrastructure requirements, risks, and opportunities, with a proven ability to partner effectively with developers and IT to support secure, reliable delivery pipelines. *Education* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, systems engineering, or a related technical field. **Benefits** At Tenet3, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both your personal and professional well\-being: * **Generous Paid Time Off**: Including PTO, sick days, and floating holidays to help you recharge. * **Comprehensive Health Coverage**: 100% paid medical, vision, and dental insurance for you and your family. * **HSA Contribution:** Company contribution to help offset costs of the health insurance deductibles. * **Retirement Plan**: 401(k) with company match * jobs.title: Junior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About The Brandit Agency** The Brandit Agency is a promotional products distributor, technology platform, and fulfillment company based in Vero Beach, Florida. We help brands get their logo into people’s hands: we run branded merchandise programs, custom online ordering portals, and in\-house fulfillment for companies across the country. Data drives everything we do, from client reporting and order operations to how we grow the business. **The Role** We’re looking for a Junior Data Engineer who loves working with data and wants to grow their career in data engineering. You’ll work primarily for The Brandit Agency, inside the Marketfuel platform, the technology that powers our ordering portals and client programs. You’ll spend your days writing SQL, building reports and dashboards in Metabase, and helping keep our data accurate and reliable. You’ll be based in our Vero Beach office and work closely with our sales, operations, fulfillment, and finance teams. You’ll also work alongside the Marketfuel platform team on data that touches the platform itself. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants hands\-on experience across the whole data stack. You’ll pick up new skills quickly and take on more ownership as you grow. **What You’ll Do** * Write and maintain SQL queries, views, and reports that answer business questions * Build and maintain dashboards, questions, and models in Metabase for internal teams and clients * Help build and maintain data pipelines that bring data from the Marketfuel platform, our business systems, and third\-party tools into our reporting environment * Create client\-facing reports for our portal and program clients: order activity, spend, inventory, and fulfillment * Work with our sales, operations, fulfillment, and finance teams to understand what they need and turn it into clear, reliable reports * Check data for accuracy, track down discrepancies, and help fix the source of the problem * Document data sources, table definitions, and report logic so others can understand and trust the data * Learn our data stack and take on more responsibility over time, including Metabase administration and pipeline ownership **What You Bring (Required)** * 1–2 years of experience in a data analyst, data engineering, BI, or similar role (internships and significant project work count) * Solid SQL skills: you’re comfortable writing queries with joins, aggregations, subqueries, and CTEs, and you want to keep getting better * Experience with Metabase or another BI/reporting tool (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) * Familiarity with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL * Strong attention to detail and a habit of double\-checking numbers before sharing them * Clear communication skills and comfort explaining data to non\-technical coworkers * Curiosity, a willingness to learn, and the ability to manage your own time * Ability to work on\-site at our Vero Beach, FL office **Nice to Have** * E\-commerce data experience: orders, SKUs, product catalogs, inventory, fulfillment and shipping, or customer metrics * Hands\-on experience with Metabase specifically * Basic Python for scripting or data cleanup * Exposure to building or maintaining data pipelines (ETL/ELT) or working with APIs * Experience in B2B ordering, promotional products, or fulfillment environments * A degree in computer science, information systems, statistics, business analytics, or a related field **What We Offer** * $55,000 annual salary * Full company benefits package * Hands\-on experience across the whole data stack, with room to grow * Real ownership and visibility on a small, fast\-moving team *The Brandit Agency is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.* Pay: From $55,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AI Solutions Analyst Lead
jobs.description: **The Mosaic Company (NYSE: MOS)** is the world’s leading integrated producer of concentrated phosphate and potash—two of the three most important nutrients in agriculture. We employ more than 13,000 people in six countries to serve farmers all over the world. Our Headquarters is in Lithia, Florida with operations throughout North America (U.S./Canada) and South America. **At Mosaic We Help the World Grow the Food it Needs \- Apply today and join our team!** The AI Solution Lead Analyst is a senior, hands\-on leader in Mosaic's AI Office who guides a team in turning high\-value business problems into adopted, governed AI solutions with measurable business value across Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Commercial and Corporate functions. Working with data scientists, AI/ML engineers, product owners and business process owners, this role leads the technical execution and ensures high\-quality delivery of generative AI, computer vision, machine learning and optimization solutions built on Mosaic's enterprise AI platform. The role combines hands\-on development support with leadership in applying architectural standards, enforcing code quality, promoting responsible AI and engineering best practices, and developing team members. **Team\-Level AI Solution Delivery \& Technical Leadership** * Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of AI solutions, from discovery and data readiness through prototype, production and adoption, ensuring alignment with architecture standards and business requirements. * Guide the design, build, configuration and testing of AI solutions, including generative AI agents, machine learning, computer vision and optimization models, on Mosaic's Microsoft Azure–based enterprise AI platform. * Partner with data and analytics teams to ensure trusted, AI\-ready data from enterprise systems and to translate model outputs into business\-ready insights. * Ensure consistent application of coding standards, design patterns, and responsible AI and security practices to deliver scalable, maintainable and secure solutions. * Actively support developers and analysts by resolving technical blockers and providing guidance on implementation strategies. * Conduct code and solution reviews and define evaluation approaches to ensure AI solutions meet quality, performance and cost targets. * Champion test automation, continuous integration, and continuous delivery (CI/CD) within the team. * Track adoption and business value of delivered AI products and ensure technical debt is identified and addressed proactively. * Promote a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement, staying current on emerging AI capabilities and sharing knowledge across the AI Office. **Agile Collaboration** * Participate in and help facilitate Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, stand\-ups, and retrospectives. * Work closely with the Product Owner and Global Process Owners/business SMEs to understand requirements, map as\-is and to\-be workflows, define success criteria and KPIs, and ensure technical feasibility. * Coordinate with other Tech Leads and Architects to align on cross\-team dependencies and shared components. * Collaborate with IT partners (architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure) and external technology partners (e.g., Microsoft) to lead solution reviews, governance approvals and production readiness. **People Leadership:** * Lead, Business, Information Systems or related area * Bachelor's degree preferred * 7\+ years of experience working with information technologies and systems analysis. * Strong knowledge of business processes, and how data and software applications support those processes. * Proven ability to assess business needs and translate them into relevant solutions. * Strong understanding and knowledge of 365 Copilot preferred * Experience with APIs and data integration with enterprise systems such as SAP preferred **What's in it for you:** * A competitive base salary \+ bonus incentives * 11 paid jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **About Thea Energy:** Thea Energy is leveraging recent breakthroughs in stellarator physics and engineering to create a faster and simpler approach to commercializing fusion energy. The company is reinventing the stellarator using computer\-controlled arrays of planar coils thereby replacing the intricate, complex modular magnets required in all other stellarator architectures. Thea Energy is on a mission to create a limitless source of zero emission energy for a sustainable future. **Position Overview:** Thea Energy is seeking a dynamic and accomplished Manufacturing Engineering Manager to lead and grow our manufacturing team to build high\-temperature superconducting (HTS) magnets as well as other critical systems for our stellarator device. You will establish operational excellence and drive development of custom processes, equipment, and project workflows to enable rapid iteration and learning. You will guide the transition of novel planar coil designs from prototype R\&D into high\-yield production, in addition to owning team resourcing, capital project budgets, and facility commissioning. ### **Key Responsibilities:** * Manage and grow a high\-performing team of manufacturing engineers by developing talent, allocating resources, and planning out team growth and hiring. * Define and execute the operational roadmap for manufacturing, especially for HTS magnets, including process development, facility layout, coil winding equipment and automation. * Partner with cross\-functional teams to establish seamless design for manufacturability and proactive preparation of * Oversee budgets, schedules, and engineering execution for major capital equipment programs, tooling, and commissioning. * Direct the implementation and optimization of manufacturing enterprise system (MES) workflows, inventory control, and manufacturing BOM architectures. * Lead high\-level technical partnerships with critical suppliers, equipment builders, and machine integrators to guarantee quality, schedule, and cost targets. * Develop and own department KPIs, operating budgets, and project timelines, as well as report progress, risks, and mitigations to executive leadership. * Champion the deployment of Process and Quality Engineering standards, including standard work instructions, and root\-cause corrective action (RCCA) protocols. ### **Experience \& Skillsets:** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering with 10\+ years of progressive manufacturing engineering experience, including 3\+ years in a direct engineering management or leadership role. * Demonstrated success recruiting, structuring, and leading technical engineering teams through aggressive hardware development and factory ramp\-up milestones. * Strong technical foundation in complex electro\-mechanical hardware assembly, especially in continuous web handling, reel\-to\-reel automation, or precision coil winding in applications like lithium batteries, motors, or superconducting magnets. * Experience with precision processes including soldering, welding, adhesive bonding and potting, automation equipment design, heavy structures and rigging, cryogenics, high voltage systems, and fragile electrical/magnetic materials. * Deep familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma principles, GD\&T (ASME Y14\.5\), MES components (PLM, ERP, MRP), and ISO9001 or similar quality systems * Track record of success in fusion energy, aerospace, superconducting systems, medical devices, robotics, or high\-reliability advanced manufacturing sectors. * Exceptional interpersonal and cross\-functional communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical hurdles into actionable operational strategies. * Ability to occasionally lift objects up to 50 lbs. ### **Company Benefits:** * Salary Range: $160,000 – $190,000\+ * Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision) * Employee equity stock options * 20 days PTO It’s not necessary to meet all of the skillsets outlined above. Please feel free to send us a note and tell us why you would still be a great fit for this role or Thea Energy. **Diversity and Inclusion:**Thea Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a company of diverse backgrounds. By creating a diverse environment, we will bring new ideas and approaches to solving some of the world’s hardest (and most important) problems. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, family or marital status, age, disability, veteran’s status, or other characteristic protected by applicable laws and regulations. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description: Seattle Regular R\&D Job ID: A211080 to this job Responsibilities The TikTok U.S. Data Security (USDS) team is responsible for the security, integrity, and compliance of TikTok data in the United States. The Data Platform Team builds reliable and cost\-efficient infrastructure, self\-service tools, and data products that help business and engineering teams work effectively. We are looking for a Software Engineer to grow their backend engineering skills while contributing to AI\-powered internal products. You will work on clearly scoped projects with guidance from experienced engineers, learn the team’s systems and development practices, and gradually take ownership of production\-ready components. Responsibilities \- Implement, test, and maintain well\-scoped backend services, APIs, and internal platform components with guidance from experienced engineers. \- Contribute to AI\-powered product capabilities such as data services, workflow automation, model integrations, and internal tools by following established designs and engineering practices. \- Work with engineers, data scientists, and business partners to understand requirements, clarify edge cases, and deliver practical solutions. \- Write clear, maintainable code and participate in code reviews, design discussions, testing, deployment, and production support. \- Learn the team’s architecture, development processes, and operational standards, and apply feedback to improve technical judgment and execution. \- Take increasing ownership of small features or components, communicate progress and blockers early, and deliver work within agreed scope and timelines. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications \- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, completed recently or expected before the start date. \- Programming foundations: Proficiency in at least one backend programming language such as Python, Go, Java, or Node.js, demonstrated through coursework, internships, research, or personal projects. \- Computer science fundamentals: Understanding of data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented or functional programming, and basic software design principles. \- Backend fundamentals: Familiarity with APIs, databases, testing, version control, and common client\-server concepts. \- Learning and collaboration: Ability to learn unfamiliar systems, ask clear questions, incorporate feedback, and work effectively with teammates. Preferred Qualifications \- AI Systems Exposure: Coursework, internship, research, or project experience using LLM APIs, RAG pipelines, model\-serving tools, or agentic workflows; interest in learning how to build reliable and safe AI\-powered systems. \- System Design Foundations: Understanding of modular design, API design, testing, and maintainable code, with the ability to discuss basic trade\-offs and apply feedback from experienced engineers. \- Collaboration and Growth: Strong communication and teamwork skills, curiosity about user needs, and the ability to take ownership of well\-scoped tasks or small features with appropriate guidance. Job Information 【For Pay Transparency】Compensation Description (Annually) The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $100320 \- $177840 annually. Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units. Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure). The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice. For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates: Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: 1\. Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues; 2\. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and 3\. Exercising sound judgment. About USDS TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025\. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision\-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale. On\-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real\-time decision\-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in\-person schedule up to 5 days a week. Why Join Us Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy \- a mission we work towards every day. We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. Diversity \& Inclusion TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/USDS\-RA

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager — On-Premise Solutions (Kiosk, POS & Self-Service)
jobs.description: **Senior Technical Product Manager — On\-Premise Solutions (Kiosk, POS \& Self\-Service)** **(No Visa Transfers or Sponsorships Available)** **Location: Remote – East Coast Preferred** **About Tillster** Tillster, headquartered in the USA, is the global leader in digital ordering and customer engagement solutions. For over a decade we have developed revolutionary self\-service, ordering and payments solutions — for mobile, tablet, online, kiosk, call center, and more — creating personalized interactions based on consumer preferences, language, and currency. Our platform is compatible with 15\+ unique POS systems, representing over 90% coverage in multi\-unit restaurants. We offer one platform; one scalable, enterprise\-class solution — to create world\-class digital engagement solutions. Our mission and passion are one and the same: Empower restaurants and consumers to engage and transact anywhere, anytime, and from any device — one consumer at a time, one order at a time, billions of times over. In doing so, *together* we are transforming e\-commerce in restaurants and making the till grow for Tillster and our customers. **About the Role:** ***QSR \& Restaurant Technology · Client\-Facing Product Owner*** We are seeking a highly skilled, client\-obsessed Technical Product Manager to join our dynamic and growing team. In this role you will act as the primary product owner and day\-to\-day technical point of contact for our customer(s), owning the relationship as well as the product. You will be responsible for the development and implementation of innovative on\-premise solutions — including but not limited to self\-service kiosks — that span both **hardware and software**, and you will serve as the trusted bridge between the customer, engineering, and design teams. You will hold responsibility for several of Tillster's key, high\-profile clients across Tillster globally. This is a highly visible role with regular exposure to senior leadership — both internally and with our clients — so polished executive communication and sound judgment are essential. This role requires a deep understanding of on\-premise and cloud restaurant technology — point of sale, payment, kiosk, and other on\-premise systems — combined with the ability to read and work directly from **technical API documentation**, and the communication skills to translate complex technical detail into clear, professional, **client\-facing documentation**. **Responsibilities** * **Client Partnership \& Product Ownership:** Serve as the primary product owner and day\-to\-day point of contact for the customer. Manage the client relationship end to end — setting expectations, aligning priorities, communicating trade\-offs and timelines, and building trust as the go\-to expert for their on\-premise product portfolio. Lead client meetings, demos, and working sessions. * **Requirements Gathering \& Prioritization:** Engage internal teams and both internal and global stakeholders to gather requirements and understand their needs and align with stakeholders on how success will be measured for each requirement. Translate these requirements into actionable product features and enhancements, aligning with leadership on prioritization and roadmap. * **Hardware \& Software Product Development:** Manage the end\-to\-end product development lifecycle, from concept to launch, across both hardware — such as self\-service kiosks, digital menu boards, Kitchen Display Systems, cash payment machines — and software. Work closely with cross\-functional teams including engineers, UI \& UX designers, and customer representatives to define product requirements, create wireframes and workflow diagrams, and ensure timely delivery of on\-premise solutions. * **API \& Technical Documentation Fluency:** Read, interpret, and work directly from technical API documentation to define integration requirements, validate feasibility, scope work with engineering, and answer customer technical questions. Comfortably navigate integration points across POS, payment, kiosk, and other on\-premise systems. * **Client\-Facing Documentation:** Author and maintain high\-quality client\-facing documentation — feature definitions, configuration guides, release notes, RFP responses, and how\-to materials. Communicate the value of features without unnecessary technical jargon and select and articulate the best features to meet each customer's needs. * **User Experience Optimization:** Continuously enhances the user experience of our on\-premise solutions by gathering feedback from stakeholders and collaborating with UI/UX designers and engineers to implement improvements that drive customer satisfaction and maximize user engagement. * **Technical Expertise:** Stay current with the latest advancements in on\-premise hardware and software technologies and leverage your technical knowledge to define requirements that further enhance our product offerings. * **Reporting:** Track and report on key success s** — on\-premise or cloud\-based. * **Defines and consumes APIs (required) —** able to define API specifications and to read and interpret technical API documentation to scope, validate, and communicate integration requirements, including documenting tool/product features and planning migrations between systems or platforms. * **Proven ability to write clear, professional client\-facing documentation — samples/portfolio required.** Shortlisted candidates will be asked to share 1–2 examples of documentation they authored (guides, feature definitions, release notes, or similar). * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. * **Senior\-level Technical Product Manager (5\+ years) —** proven experience in a similar role, preferably in restaurant technology, point of sale, payment systems, or on\-premise / self\-service technology. * **Highly analytical and data\-driven —** makes decisions from data, drives continuous improvement, and applies rigorous problem\-solving with deep attention to detail. * **Communicating clearly with all stakeholders —** keeps internal and external stakeholders aligned on project status, priorities, and trade\-offs, and collaborates effectively across cross\-functional teams and customers. * **Familiarity with user experience design principles** and wireframing tools such as Figma. * Ability to travel as business needs demand. **Core skills \& technologies:** Senior Technical Product Manager · Technical Product Owner · on\-premise solutions · self\-service kiosks · self\-service ordering · digital ordering · POS / point of sale (on\-premise and cloud) · payment systems · Kitchen Display Systems (KDS) · digital menu boards · cash payment machines · API specification and system integrations (REST) · agentic / AI solutions · QSR (Quick Service Restaurant) · hospitality and restaurant technology · product roadmap · stakeholder management · cross\-functional leadership · data\-driven product management · bilingual (native Spanish / English) · LATAM · Mexico. **The Interview Process** 1\)Recruiter interview with a Talent Acquisition Specialist. 2\)Technical interview with the VP of Product (may include a review of your documentation samples). 3\)Final interview with our VP of Engineering, Kiosk. **Making a Difference in the Tillster Way** Our mission is to empower restaurants and consumers globally, by empowering, supporting, and nurturing the people who are part of the global Tillster team. We want to ensure all employees feel respected, confident, and engaged. Creating an inclusive working environment is of the utmost importance to us. To make this a reality, Tillster is dedicated to embracing diversity in all forms and is proudly an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, family/parental status, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other protected status. **Pay and Benefits (United States)** * Compensation yearly rate is $145,000k \- $170,000k DOE * Meal allowance for each day worked, available through a meal card. * Home/Office allowance reimbursement per calendar month, pro\-rated based on employment start date. * **Health insurance:** Tillster pays the premium for employee private health insurance. Employees have the option to add their spouse/dependents at the employee's cost. * **Holidays:** Up to 20 federal and local/municipal holidays in accordance with applicable Mexican Labour laws, dependent on your employment start date. * **Vacation:** Up to 22 days of vacation every holiday year, pro\-rated based on employment start date. * **Education, Learning \& Development:** We offer Udemy Learning courses and ongoing learning and development opportunities. **Tillster is proudly an Equal Opportunity Employer** **No Visa Sponsorship** **Principals only — no Agencies or calls please** Compensation Range: $145K \- $170K

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer II
jobs.description: ### **About Torus** Torus is headquartered in Utah and is expanding manufacturing at our 545,000\-square\-foot facility in Salt Lake City called GigaOne. **We are** **the world’s first mesh energy infrastructure, uniting communities through resilient, sustainable, and intelligent power.** We design, engineer, manufacture, install, and support our systems end\-to\-end, standing behind them throughout their lifecycle. Torus systems help reduce costs, lower emissions, and protect facilities from outages, while strengthening the security and reliability of the broader utility grid. Torus is committed to American manufacturing, engineering excellence, and building energy systems that last. Torus has raised over $267 million from investors like Magnetar, Mercado, ICONIQ and Origin Ventures. The investments are helping to accelerate deployment of modular power plants across utilities, data centers, and industrial sectors. This investor confidence reflects the strength of our team, technology as well as the scale of the problem we are solving. At Torus, you will be part of something larger than a single product or technology. Your work will help build energy infrastructure that supports and strengthens our electrical grid, critical systems, industry, and communities for decades to come. We value accountability, collaboration, and clear thinking. We are looking for people who want to solve hard problems and build things that matter. #### **About the Role** At Torus, we're building the world's first mesh energy infrastructure — systems that protect communities, reduce costs, and strengthen the grid for decades to come. Nova Pulse, our Battery Energy Storage System, is at the heart of that mission. As a **Mechanical Engineer**, you'll design, validate, and bring to life the sub\-systems that make resilient energy storage possible. This role sits at a critical handoff, where great engineering becomes great manufacturing. And your work will directly shape how quickly and reliably we scale. We *Value Speed and Quality Equally* here; moving fast matters, but so does building it right the first time. You'll need to *Think About Systems and Data Holistically*, understanding how your design decisions ripple across the full product lifecycle, from concept through production. If you're someone who finds energy in solving hard mechanical problems and takes ownership from the first sketch to the final spec, this role was built for you. #### **Key Responsibilities** * Design, document, and test sub\-systems of Torus Pulse (Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) Chemical Battery) and/or Torus Spin (Flywheel Energy Storage System Mechanical Battery). * Ensure smooth transition from Design to Manufacturing. * Support DFM/DFA initiatives in collaboration with manufacturing and suppliers. * Support lifecycle development from concept through testing and production. * Solve technical problems to achieve product specifications. * Create, manage, and document critical product specifications. * Work closely with the internal engineering team and external engineering experts. * Ensure compliance with relevant codes, industry standards, and safety requirements. * Other duties as assigned. #### **Required Experience** * Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field * 2\-5 years experience in mechanical engineering * Hands\-on experience with prototyping, testing, and design validation in a regulated industry * Strong background in Solidworks, PDM, and CAD administration * A passion and proven track record of designing mechanical structures * Demonstrates a proactive and action\-oriented approach to problem solving * Strong organizational skills with a disciplined approach to your workflow management #### **Preferred Experience** * Structural design to include steel tube, steel sheet, weldments, machined components, electrical components * Experience includes a focus on energy storage, batteries, or power systems * Familiarity with industry standards such as UL 9540, ISO 26262, or ASME codes ### **Additional Details** **Background Check** All candidates are subject to a background check. **Location \+ Travel** The role is onsite based at our GigaOne warehouse in Salt Lake City (air\-conditioned) with some remote work. May require occasional onsite work at our South Salt Lake HQ Warehouse and/or Springville R\&D Warehouse (air\-conditioned and non air\-conditioned). **Schedule** Full\-Time, Salaried **Compensation** $80,000\-120,000 (Note: We have the flexibility to hire at different levels, which may impact the corresponding pay range.) **Work Authorization** Applicants must already have the legal authorization to work in the US without requiring any employer sponsorship. **Physical Requirements** * Must have the ability to safely lift and move objects weighing up to 50 lbs. * Must be capable of standing, bending, and executing repetitive tasks for prolonged periods of time. * Ability to read, identify, observe and recognize details, color\-coding and fine print at close range on associated engineering drawings. * Ability to don personal protective equipment to include, but not limited to, respiratory protective equipment with proper seal, coveralls, ear protection, gloves, eye protection \& safety helmet. * Ability to observe, detect and respond to audible and visual machine malfunction warnings. * Ability to communicate information so others can understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations. * Must report to work reliably and with the ability to use full and unimpaired skills and judgment to safely execute your job. * Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking English required. ### **Our Perks \& Benefits** Benefits eligibility is based on employment status. Financial * Employee Rewards Package including equity * 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan * Torus paid life and AD\&D Insurance with options to purchase additional coverage * Voluntary short\- and long\-term disability insurance Health \& Wellness * Health Benefits Package: Choice between traditional PPO or HSA\-eligible medical plans with Torus covering 50% of medical premiums; Dental insurance; and Vision insurance * Plan participants have access to telehealth services, mental health support and coaching, and exclusive discounts on brands, dining, entertainment, and more. Time Off * Unlimited discretionary PTO * 10 paid company holidays * Waiting period\-free 100% paid parental leave Culture \& Community * Regular company\-wide offsites to showcase our progress and learnings. A time to step back, think strategically, and work on the business together. * Team members receive Torus branded gear * Peer Recognition Program * Fully stocked break rooms with free snacks and drinks. Because great work deserves great fuel. Torus is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. Torus participates in E\-Verify. Once you accept a job offer, we will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from your Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization. *\#li\-lw \#li\-onsite*

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **TransCore (TRN), a subsidiary of ST Engineering, is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to join our growing Smart Mobility Ecosystems team and help shape the architecture and technical direction of our next generation of mobility solutions.** **Location:** Atlanta **About the Role:** Passionate about the Smart Cities space? Interested in solving problems with how people move? Perhaps this is the role for you! TransCore is seeking an experienced, hands\-on Principal Software Engineer to help build the Smart Mobility Platform, the shared foundation for our Smart Mobility products with the intent to rethink how users move, providing innovative, user\-friendly solutions to their day\-to\-day lives, reaching millions of users across the globe. This "zero to one" role is pivotal in building an entirely new product \& ecosystem from scratch. You’ll serve as the platform subject matter expert for Smart Mobility engineering leadership and work closely with the full engineering group to shape technical direction, developing a high\-quality, data\-informed system to meet customer needs, support user growth \& critical journeys, while unlocking new mobility use cases and verticals. TransCore is uniquely positioned to have a huge impact in advancing smart cities \& mobility and this role is uniquely positioned to achieve this vision. Join TransCore as we shape the future of smart cities and transportation tech. **This is an individual contributor role.** You will not have direct reports. We are looking for a deep technical practitioner who leads through expertise, influence, and good engineering practice, with room to grow into a more senior technical or people\-leadership role over time. **Key Responsibilities:** Be the hands\-on technical authority for the Smart Mobility Platform and its expansion into a multi\-modal mobility ecosystem. Requires deep expertise in cloud\-native architecture, microservices, payment systems, and modern engineering practice. * **Platform Subject Matter Expertise:** Serve as the platform SME for Smart Mobility engineering leadership. Assess current engineering capabilities and architecture, and advise on the technology direction and standards we adopt going forward. * **Hands\-on Design \& Implementation:** Design, prototype, and implement cloud\-native, microservices\-based architectures, focusing on payment integration (PCI DSS), auto integrations, and API\-first design to enable multi\-vertical use cases as well as great end user experiences. Apply user\-first thinking to determine other features or capabilities to build into the UI and ensure the architecture can support. * **Scalability \& Performance:** Ensure high\-performance, scalable systems for high\-volume, real\-time data processing. * **Security \& Compliance:** Maintain system security and compliance with relevant regulations (PCI DSS, GDPR, etc.). * **Cross\-Team Collaboration:** Work closely with product, platform, and application engineering teams to align designs, resolve cross\-cutting technical issues, and keep teams on a consistent path. * **Engineering Practices \& Mentorship**: Set and promote good practices (design reviews, code reviews, testing, observability, secure delivery), and mentor engineers across teams. **Key Skills \& Experience:** * Expertise in cloud\-native architecture (AWS, Azure, GCP), microservices, and event\-driven systems; experience with high\-volume, real\-time data processing. * Proficiency in API design (RESTful/GraphQL) with experience showcasing applications across broad sets of use cases. * Strong working knowledge of modern engineering and DevOps practices, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability. * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including sustained experience as a technical lead across multiple teams or systems. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field. * Typically requires 14\+ years of combined relevant software engineering experience and advanced education, including sustained experience as a technical lead across multiple teams or systems. * Proven track record of technically leading “zero to one” initiatives, especially in tech\-heavy, regulated industries like transportation or infrastructure. * Strong communication skills and a proven ability to influence and coordinate across teams without formal authority. * Currently working as a hands\-on individual contributor. Candidates whose recent roles have been primarily people management should note this role writes and reviews code and designs. **Preferred qualifications and experience:** * Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science * Application of AI capabilities to improve workflow or deliver organizational efficiencies. * Knowledge of tolling, parking, or transportation technologies is a plus. * Experience working in cross\-functional environments with a focus on platform SDK development. **Physical Demands/Work Environment** While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be seated for extended periods of time. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. * TransCore complies with federal and state disability laws and provides reasonable accommodation for employees with disabilities. Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** As a Quality Engineer at Transcendia, you will serve as a key change agent supporting manufacturing operations across our manufacturing campus that incorporates three buildings. This is a highly visible, hands\-on role that requires a self\-motivated professional who can work independently, make sound decisions, and drive quality improvements in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment. You will actively partner with Operations, Engineering, and Production teams to identify and solve complex quality and process challenges, reduce operational risk, and ensure the reliability of custom\-engineered materials used in critical applications. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, a proactive approach, and the ability to balance strategic quality initiatives with day\-to\-day manufacturing support. **Key Responsibilities** * Provide routine on\-site support across Hebron manufacturing facilities, requiring frequent movement between locations to support quality and operational needs. * Conduct hands\-on inspections, testing, sample collection, investigations, and audits within production environments. * Act as SQF Practitioner, overseeing food safety programs, HACCP activities, internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions, employee training, and SQF certification activities. * Manage the site's MS Access Quality Database, including system maintenance, user access control, specification setup, inspection data management, reporting, troubleshooting, and database enhancements. * Serve as the site validation lead, coordinating cross\-functional IQ/OQ/PQ activities, reviewing validation data, resolving deviations, and ensuring a state of continuous compliance and audit readiness. * Apply data\-driven problem\-solving methodologies to identify root causes, develop effective corrective actions, and prevent recurrence of quality issues. * Independently prioritize workload and manage multiple projects while maintaining a strong sense of ownership and accountability for results. * Work closely with manufacturing and engineering to develop, implement, maintain and improve quality standards and methods to ensure product quality within manufacturing operations. * Collaborate with and mentor cross\-functional team members through the root\-cause analysis process, continuous improvement process, and supporting a culture of quality. * Lead investigations in response to quality nonconformances and manage timely corrective and preventive actions in alignment with quality system requirements. * Analyze quality data and key performance indicators, identify trends, and initiate actions to address emerging product or process risks. * Plan and execute test method validations. * Participate in internal and external audits. **Qualifications** **Education \& Experience** * Experience working in a manufacturing environment requiring regular interaction with production personnel and processes. * Experience utilizing statistical analysis and problem\-solving tools such as Minitab, DOE, SPC, Pareto analysis, capability studies, and root cause methodologies. * Experience with electronic document management systems, SharePoint, or similar collaboration platforms. * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Science, or a related technical field * Minimum 2 years of experience in quality or engineering within a regulated industry

jobs.title: AI Product & Automation Specialist
jobs.description: TriMark Digital is seeking an AI Product \& Automation Specialist to help build AI\-powered tools, agents and workflows that improve how our team works and expand the solutions we offer clients. This role will turn business challenges into practical applications, from internal assistants and process automations to prototypes for new products and services. The ideal candidate is a curious, resourceful builder who actively explores AI and has already used it to create something useful. You enjoy figuring out how things work, connecting tools and improving an idea through experimentation and feedback. This is an early\-career opportunity focused on initiative, problem\-solving and demonstrated ability. A traditional web development background is not required. Your experience may come from internships, coursework, personal projects or independent learning. **RESPONSIBILITIES** AI Product \& Agent Development * Build AI\-powered tools, agents and applications that address internal and client needs. * Translate ideas and business requirements into working prototypes. * Use AI\-assisted development tools, agent builders and no\-code or low\-code platforms to create functional solutions. * Refine prototypes based on feedback and collaborate with developers when projects require additional technical support. Workflow Automation \& Integration * Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive tasks and improve how information moves between teams and systems. * Build workflows that connect tools, organize information and support marketing, sales and agency operations. * Explore APIs and integrations to extend functionality and connect existing platforms. * Troubleshoot issues and maintain automations as needs evolve. Research \& Experimentation * Explore emerging AI tools and evaluate their potential for specific business applications. * Test different approaches and recommend tools based on usefulness, reliability and ease of adoption. * Share findings and demonstrate practical applications to the broader team. * Contribute ideas for new AI\-powered products and services. Testing \& Continuous Improvement * Test tools for accuracy, usability and reliability before broader use. * Identify errors, limitations and situations that require human review. * Gather user feedback and improve functionality over time. * Document how tools work, how to use them and what their limitations are. Collaboration \& Business Application * Work with strategists, creatives, developers and other team members to understand challenges and define useful solutions. * Explain technical concepts clearly to colleagues with varying levels of AI experience. * Help teams adopt new tools and incorporate them into their daily work. * Connect projects to clear objectives, such as saving time, improving the customer experience or supporting sales and marketing. **REQUIREMENTS** * Hands\-on experience using AI to build agents, applications, automations or other functional tools. * Examples of completed or working projects that demonstrate initiative and problem\-solving. Personal projects, coursework and independent experiments are welcome. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted development, agent\-building or workflow automation platforms, with a willingness to learn new tools. * An interest in APIs, integrations and how systems exchange information. * Ability to research, troubleshoot and work through unfamiliar challenges. * Strong attention to detail and a willingness to test and question AI\-generated outputs. * Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate across disciplines. * Strong organizational skills and follow\-through, including documenting and improving what you build. * An interest in applying AI to marketing, customer experiences and business operations. * A computer science degree or traditional web development background is not required. Familiarity with reading or adapting code is helpful. **When applying, please include two or three examples of something you’ve built using AI.** Links, short demonstrations or project walkthroughs are welcome. Tell us what problem you were solving, which tools you used, what you personally contributed and what you learned.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - .NET
jobs.description: Tyler Technologies’ Maryland Enterprise is seeking candidates for a Senior .NET Software Engineer. The selected candidate will be part of a strong development team and they will be responsible for translating complex business requirements into functional web\-based applications throughout all stages of the SDLC. The Developer will create and support large\-scale/complex applications by gathering requirements, designing, maintaining, developing, testing, and deploying applications with security, efficiency, maintainability, and usability in mind. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * Build and ship high\-quality customer\-facing web applications. * Maintain and improve a distributed cloud platform running on AWS. * Develop and containerize .NET applications deployed to AWS. * Provide direct mentorship to junior engineers on the team. * Collaborate with other engineers, engineering management, designers, and project managers to design and architect solutions. **Qualifications:** ------------------- * We would love to talk to you if you… * Care about scalable, robust, well\-tested code. * Consider yourself a full stack engineer, willing to work in any part of the stack required for the task. For a senior level role, we need you to have at least 4 years of experience. * Have significant frontend experience (HTML, CSS, and JavaScript). We are currently using Vue, React and bootstrap. * Develop secure .NET C\# containerized applications running in AWS. * Demonstrate experience in owning all aspects of a system lifecycle, from proper design, testing, deployment, metrics, monitoring, and maintenance. * Enable other engineers’ success both through your code contributions and through direct mentorship. * Have experience working with database technologies including relational databases MS\-SQL and NoSQL stores. Bonus points for experience with technologies like Elasticsearch/AWS. * Have experience with converting .NET Framework to .NET containerized apps. Development of Java applications is a plus. * Are comfortable working in a heterogeneous development environment where you’ll be working with multiple development languages and technologies. * Solve the problem, not the symptoms. * Have strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills. * Enjoy working closely with the business, infrastructure support and development teams.

The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer \- Data Infrastructure, Mobility Simulation and Planning** **About the role and team** How can Uber plan pricing and incentives to meet financial goals while keeping its marketplace healthy and growing? That’s the challenge our Mobility Simulation and Planning (MSP) organization tackles within Marketplace. MSP builds forecasting, simulation, and optimization products that help Operations teams translate financial targets into pricing and incentive policies across hundreds of cities. Our planning product, Planner, brings these capabilities together to generate actionable price plans. Supporting this work requires dependable data, scalable model training and simulation, and reliable workflows for generating and deploying plans. The **MSP Infra team** builds the data and computing foundations that make these capabilities possible. We partner with engineers and scientists to turn complex data and modeling workflows into reliable, scalable, reusable infrastructure. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a strong infrastructure background and a focus on data\-intensive systems. You’ll build and evolve feature stores, distributed data pipelines, and self\-service tooling that support forecasting, simulation, optimization, and financial measurement. Your work will help teams move from new data and modeling ideas to dependable production workflows. The challenges go beyond moving data from one place to another. How do we keep model inputs fresh and consistent as upstream sources evolve? How do we efficiently rebuild historical features for simulation and backtesting? How do we make complex data operations safe and self\-service? You’ll solve these problems through hands\-on engineering, cross\-team collaboration, and end\-to\-end ownership of production systems. **What you’ll do** * **Build scalable data infrastructure:** Design and evolve shared feature stores and distributed processing pipelines that support model training, inference, backtesting, simulation, and planning. * **Make data trustworthy:** Develop automated validation, monitoring, and alerting to detect freshness, completeness, and correctness issues before they affect downstream consumers. * **Improve data lifecycle operations:** Build efficient capabilities for incremental processing, historical backfills, schema evolution, data versioning, and recovery from failed or incorrect writes. * **Enable self\-service:** Create reusable frameworks, APIs, and developer tooling that help engineers and scientists onboard features, investigate issues, and operate workflows with less manual support. * **Optimize performance and cost:** Identify bottlenecks in data processing, storage, and orchestration, and improve throughput, resource efficiency, and reliability. * **Drive technical projects end to end:** Translate ambiguous requirements into designs, lead implementation and rollout, and own production health through on\-call, incident response, and long\-term improvements. * **Collaborate and mentor:** Partner with modeling, financial\-data, and shared\-platform teams to establish consistent data foundations; guide engineers through thoughtful design reviews, code reviews, and technical mentorship. **Basic Qualifications** * 6\+ years of professional experience in software engineering, data infrastructure, or a related technical role. * Strong programming skills in Python, Java, Scala, Go, or a comparable language. * Experience designing, building, and operating large\-scale data pipelines or distributed data\-processing systems. * Strong SQL skills and experience with data modeling, storage systems, and query\-performance optimization. * Experience delivering technical projects from design through production rollout and ongoing operations. * Ability to communicate technical tradeoffs and collaborate across engineering and data science teams. * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Apache Spark or comparable distributed data\-processing frameworks. * Experience with Apache Hudi or similar data lake technologies supporting incremental updates, schema evolution, and versioned datasets. * Experience building feature stores or data infrastructure for machine learning, forecasting, optimization, or simulation. * Experience developing reusable data\-quality frameworks, observability systems, or tools for tracing and reconciling data across sources. * Familiarity with workflow orchestration and distributed computing frameworks such as Ray. * Experience building self\-service platforms or automation that reduces operational overhead for engineers and scientists. * A track record of measurable improvements in data reliability, processing performance, infrastructure cost, or developer productivity. You will own the end\-to\-end architecture, build pipelines, systems, and models, and scale a cross\-disciplinary team of engine developers, game developers, and machine learning engineers. The work spans market forecasting, outcome prediction, multimodal content understanding, evaluation, and agentic systems. **What you'll be doing** ------------------------ ### **Technical Excellence** * Work on our Game Intelligence ML platform, from data ingestion, semantic layer and feature stores through model registry, evaluation and serving. * Make the calls that keep every model output reproducible and auditable: versioned data snapshots, model and prompt versions, and cost tracked per decision. * Define, lead, and spearhead engineering practices for the agentic era, including agentic development workflows and evaluation methodologies. * Partner with different functional teams and disciplines to translate expert human judgment into training signals. Shape the roadmap with the product team. ### **Modeling** * Build predictors of commercial outcomes for games such as user acquisition cost, lifetime value and return on ad spend from large, noisy, multi\-source signals. * Build forecasting models over market signals that detect emerging demand and estimate when a window opens, peaks and closes. * Deliver every prediction as a calibrated range with stated confidence, and own the ranking and portfolio logic that turns predictions into recommendations within a budget. ### **Experimentation and agentic systems** * Design online experimentation with guardrails, safe exploration and clear human decision points. * Build evaluation harnesses for LLM\-based agents, including automated playtesting and multimodal assessment of generated content. * Orchestrate frontier\-model agents in production with strict data boundaries and cost control. ### **Calibration and measurement** * Own the feedback loop that scores predictions against realized outcomes and corrects bias, coverage and signal weighting over time. * Make the system report its own error in plain language so that creators and internal stakeholders can trust it. **What we're cost, lifetime value, return on ad spend, retention or comparable outcomes. * Strong grounding in probabilistic prediction and calibration: quantile or interval prediction, coverage, bias correction and backtesting of forecasts. * Experience building LLM\-based agent systems in production: orchestration, evaluation harnesses, prompt and model versioning, and cost control. * Comfort building in a zero\-to\-one environment. **You might also have** ----------------------- * Experience in mobile game user acquisition, LiveOps or monetization, on the studio or publisher side. * Experience with
