jobs.description: **Get Set for Cumberlands!** Join our team of student\-focused individuals working together in order to encourage intellectual and spiritual growth, leadership and service. **CURRENT STUDENT or EMPLOYEE?** Please log into Workday and use the Career Tile to find and apply to jobs from our internal career sites. Senior AI Platform Engineer ENTERPRISE AI INFRASTRUCTURE \& LLM OPERATIONS **Department:** Information Technology \| **Employment Type:** Full\-Time \| **Location:** Remote, with occasional travel to main campus (Williamsburg, KY) as needed **Help Us Build What’s Next in AI** At the University of the Cumberlands, we’re building a new enterprise AI environment that brings powerful, locally hosted AI technologies to students, faculty, and staff. We’re looking for a Senior AI Platform Engineer who enjoys building from the ground up, tackling challenging engineering problems, and shaping how AI works in higher education. You’ll help design, deploy, and grow an on\-premises environment powered by NVIDIA GPU infrastructure and NVIDIA AI Enterprise, supporting large language models (LLMs), high\-performance inference, and secure APIs. You’ll partner with infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, and our emerging AI Lab to turn ambitious ideas into dependable services. **What You’ll Do** * **Build the foundation.** Design, deploy, and manage on\-premises and hybrid AI infrastructure, including NVIDIA GPU environments and NVIDIA AI Enterprise. * **Bring models to life.** Deploy, optimize, and maintain locally hosted LLMs and inference services using NVIDIA NIM, vLLM, Ollama, or comparable tools. * **Make AI accessible.** Build secure APIs and services connecting approved AI capabilities to University applications and users. * **Keep things running.** Monitor performance, optimize GPU resources, troubleshoot issues, and maintain security, reliability, and scalability. * **Automate and improve.** Use Linux, containers, scripting, and platform engineering practices to streamline operations. * **Collaborate and shape what’s next.** Partner across IT and the AI Lab, evaluate emerging technologies, and influence platform architecture. **What You’ll Bring** * Significant professional experience in platform engineering, DevOps, systems engineering, or enterprise infrastructure, including demonstrated responsibility for deploying and supporting production AI/ML environments. * Hands\-on experience deploying or administering NVIDIA GPU\-based AI infrastructure, NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NVIDIA NIM, or comparable AI/ML and enterprise inference platforms. * Strong Linux, networking, containers, and modern infrastructure knowledge. * Scripting and automation experience with Python, Bash, or similar tools. * Familiarity with APIs, authentication, security, and monitoring; strong troubleshooting and collaboration skills. * Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field or equivalent professional experience. **Even Better If You Have** * Direct experience with NVIDIA AI Enterprise and NVIDIA NIM; CUDA or GPU performance optimization. * Experience with vLLM, Ollama, Hugging Face, Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, or CI/CD. * Knowledge of MLOps/LLMOps, vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG). * Experience with enterprise API gateways, hybrid cloud, higher education, or research computing. **Why This Role Is Different** * **Build from the beginning.** Help establish a new AI platform and shape its long\-term direction. * **Work with powerful technology.** Get hands\-on with NVIDIA GPU computing, enterprise AI software, and open\-weight language models. * **Make an impact.** Support teaching, learning, research, and institutional innovation. * **Have a voice.** Help choose tools, set technical standards, and improve the platform as it grows. **Let’s Build Something Great** We’re looking for an experienced engineer who brings deep technical expertise, strong problem\-solving skills, and a proven ability to design, deploy, and manage enterprise AI infrastructure. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Supply
jobs.description: Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an **Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform** that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper\-targeted segmentation, AI\-powered recommendations, real\-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million\+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first\-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real\-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. **This is a unique moment to join Vibe.** With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance\-driven future for the channel. **Your team** ------------- You will join the Supply team, which owns Vibe's inventory: the publishers we partner with, the deals we run, and the catalog of apps, channels and shows our advertisers care about. Shows are the reason people turn on their TV. Advertisers don't just want impressions: they want to show up next to the right shows, live sports and premium channels. Supply brings that content to Vibe through direct publisher partnerships, curated deals and sponsorships. It makes it easy to find, understand and buy, through real\-time bidding, or any technology the publisher uses. Premium publishers care as much about which ads run on their shows as about who buys them, and great creatives are what earn us access. The team brings together partnerships, operations, and product. You will work closely with the DSP team, which runs the bidding infrastructure, and the Performance team, which decides how to value each opportunity, as well as with publisher partners directly. **Your mission** ---------------- As a Senior Software Engineer on Supply, you will build the systems that let Vibe grow, operate, and trust its inventory. You will turn publisher partnerships into live, healthy supply, and give the business and our partners the tools to manage it at scale. **What you will do** -------------------- **Publisher integrations** * Build and improve publisher integrations end\-to\-end, from onboarding a new partner to supporting new ad formats and sponsorship offers. * Implement measurement requirements with publishers and the DSP team (e.g. UID2, publisher IDs) so the bidder sees richer inventory. * Own integration health: detect broken or degraded supply before it costs us spend. **Deals \& catalog** * Build the services behind deal setup, catalog management, and price configuration, in partnership with DSP on the deal API. * Automate the routine work of the Supply team (new deals, stale\-supply cleanup, troubleshooting) so it scales with the number of partners, and with Vibe. * Enrich the catalog with content data (shows, genres, live events, channels) so advertisers can find what they are looking for, and even enjoy looking for it. **Supply tooling \& publisher platform** * Build real\-time monitoring, alerting, and analytics on supply volume, quality, and spend. * Build publisher\-facing features: reporting, insights, and self\-serve catalog tools. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 5\+ years of experience as a software engineer building and operating backend systems in production. * Strong programming skills (Go, Python and/or Rust), with real engineering discipline: testing, code review, CI/CD, maintainable design. * Hands\-on with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex or similar) in your day\-to\-day engineering workflow. * Experience integrating with external partners' systems and APIs, and owning those integrations when they break. * Comfortable owning services from code to production: cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), Kubernetes, and the observability to know your systems are healthy. * Product sense: you like talking to the people who use what you build, and you turn ambiguous business needs into concrete deliverables. * Excellent communication in English, with internal teams and with partners' technical contacts. * Pragmatism over purity: a bias toward shipping value. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience in AdTech or programmatic: OpenRTB, SSPs, PMP / PG deals, VAST. * Knowledge of the CTV ecosystem (publishers, apps, FAST channels). * Experience with identity solutions (UID2 or similar). * Experience building partner\-facing or B2B dashboards and reporting. **Our Values** -------------- At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions. You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort. This is a high\-performance environment with high\-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast. If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you. **What We Offer** The base pay range for this role in Paris is €90,000 – €125,000\. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates. The base pay range for this role in New York is $140,000 – $200,000\. We will support relocation to New York for great candidates. At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here’s how we back that up: * Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals. * Hybrid flexibility — We’re in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week! * Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan. * Meal vouchers — Via Swile. * Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip. * Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide. **Our Interview Process** We respect your time. Here’s exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting. * Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes. We’ll share more context on the role and team, and learn more about your background and what you’re looking for. * Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes. Meet with the person you’d work with directly and dive deeper into your experience, product background, and approach to the role. * Technical Discussion — 90 minutes. A deeper conversation covering product thinking, measurement methodology, data reasoning, and a use case relevant to the role. * Bar Raiser Interview — 30 minutes. Meet with a senior leader at Vibe for a final conversation and an opportunity to ask any remaining questions. * Offer — We move quickly once we’ve made a decision. We don’t let good decisions sit. **Equal Opportunity** Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know. **Referral Instructions** Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (Platform)
jobs.description: **Teaching AI Drug Discovery** ------------------------------ The next great drugs won't be discovered. They'll be designed. But AI can't design biology it has never seen, and the data to teach it barely exists yet. Valen Labs is building the engine that generates it. We are a biological data company. We've orchestrated novel technology and ambitious lab machinery into an autonomous biofactory that designs, builds, and characterizes molecules at a scale and speed the field has never had. Best in class machines, best in class data. We work with frontier AI labs to train their biology models, and we build the benchmarks that measure how well AI can actually do science, from a single binding assay to running an entire lab. Everything we produce is structured, high\-fidelity data, built for machine learning and generated faster than anywhere else. We're backed by top Silicon Valley investors, including funds linked with Peter Thiel, and we're based in San Francisco. **About this Role** ------------------- Every molecule Valen makes and every assay we run has to land somewhere clean, queryable, and ready for a model to learn from. That system is the platform, and you own it. As a Member of Technical Staff on Platform, you build Valen's internal system of record and LIMS from the ground up. You model our samples, assays, and experimental metadata, you build the data pipelines that carry results from the bench to analysis to the model, and you make sure every data point is tracked, trustworthy, and structured for machine learning. You're one of our first engineering hires, so you own the whole stack rather than inherit someone else's. What you'll own: * Build Valen's LIMS and scientific system of record from zero, replacing off\-the\-shelf tooling that doesn't fit our science * Model samples, assays, and experimental metadata so every result is tracked and queryable * Build clean, reliable data pipelines from the bench through analysis and into model training * Migrate our existing lab data and workflows onto the system you build * Work in the lab, five days a week, next to the scientists who use what you ship **Requirements** ---------------- * Strong software and data engineering; you build real systems, not just scripts * One of two paths: you've built a LIMS or sample\-tracking system from scratch at a biotech, or you're an excellent engineer with a biology or wet\-lab background ready to build one for the first time * Comfort owning data modeling, pipelines, and the tracking and analysis layer end to end * A high bar, whether from a rigorous technical program, a strong TechBio or lab\-software startup, or teams like Benchling or Ginkgo Bioworks * Familiarity with protein expression or antibody characterization workflows is a plus * Early\-career and hungry is welcome; a strong track record matters more than years on paper * San Francisco based, fully onsite **Benefits** ------------ * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Meaningful early\-stage equity * Unlimited PTO We work hard, and we're honest about that. The pace is high and the problems are hard. What you get in return is work that genuinely matters, real ownership, and a small team that holds a high bar and ships fast. This is a place to do the best work of your career.

jobs.title: ETL Tester with AI Experience
jobs.description: Job Description **Job Title:** ETL Tester with AI Experience **Location:** Irving, Texas (Hybrid 3 days' work from office) **Experience:** 10\+ Years **Skills:** ETL, SQL, Azure Databricks, Agentic AI Testing, Web Testing, Data Automation Tools We are looking for a senior QA professional skilled in ETL, SQL, Azure Databricks, agentic AI evaluation, web testing, and test automation tools. The ideal candidate will drive data integrity, compliance, and scalable validation strategies. Roles and Responsibilities Agentic AI Testing and Evaluation * Test AI agents that generate extraction queries and transformation logic, along with the workbench through which humans review and approve their outputs. * Validate agent\-generated metadata executed by the client's existing data platform. * Understand and validate the redesigned data processing workflow across raw ingestion, consolidated transformation, and domain\-refined layers. Test Strategy and Reconciliation * Own the test strategy and reconciliation methodology. * Define equivalence standards, identifying what must match exactly, what may vary within tolerance, and at which layer each applies. * Design source\-to\-target validation across the redesigned data processing workflow. * Establish risk\-based prioritization, as the schedule does not permit exhaustive coverage of hundreds of tables. * Author the test strategy and test plan for review with the client in Phase 2\. Agent Evaluation * Build and maintain a golden reference set using existing production extracts, validated with the Epic SME. * Maintain strict separation between evaluation data and data used to develop or tune the agents. * Establish the evaluation harness in MLflow, including scoring runs, versioning, and candidate comparison. * Define and report key metrics, including mapping precision and recall, override rate, confidence calibration, run\-to\-run consistency, escalation correctness, and cost per case. * Operate the regression gate to ensure no prompt, skill, or model change is promoted without passing evaluation. * Identify and characterize agent failures, including hallucinated tables, incorrect column selection, omission of required fields, and incorrectly selected join grain. Automated Regression Testing * Own the automated regression harness. * Automate comparison of new\-path outputs against current production extracts. * Validate row counts, aggregate reconciliation, field\-level comparisons, data types, precision, null and duplicate profiling, and referential integrity. * Establish repeatable execution so every agent revision can be revalidated efficiently. Data Security and Control Testing * Design control\-critical test suites for member, health\-system, and facility isolation. * Validate facility mapping changes and ensure one member cannot access another member's data. * Perform contract\-scope validation. * Verify that generated queries comply with data\-sharing restrictions at facility, column, and product levels. * Validate acquisition costs by confirming optimized queries access fewer source tables than the baseline and that facility consolidation works as expected. Team Leadership and Reporting * Directly lead two QA engineers. * Establish testing standards, review test coverage, and manage defect classification. * Confirm downstream compatibility across Databricks, SQL Server, and Vertica. * Produce evidence packs suitable for client executive review. * Defend testing methodology, sample sizes, and statistical findings when required. Educational Qualifications * Engineering degree BE, ME, BTech, MTech, BSc, or MSc. * Technical certifications in multiple technologies are desirable. Mandatory Skills * 10\+ years of experience in data and ETL testing, including test strategy ownership on at least one large migration or re\-platforming program. * Proven experience in reconciliation and equivalence testing, demonstrating that rebuilt pipelines produce outputs equivalent to legacy systems. * Expert\-level SQL skills, including independently writing complex analytical validation queries against unfamiliar schemas. * Experience with Azure Databricks and PySpark for large\-volume data validation. * Python programming for test automation and test harness development. * Experience with data quality and test automation frameworks such as Great Expectations, dbt tests, pytest, or equivalent. * Experience in test strategy development, coverage models, risk\-based prioritization, entry and exit criteria, and defect classification. * Multi\-platform validation experience across at least two of Databricks, SQL Server, Vertica, or comparable platforms. * Experience testing PHI\-scoped healthcare data, including de\-identified or synthetic test data. * Defect management and reporting using Azure Boards. * Team leadership experience, including setting testing standards and reviewing team members' test coverage. * Strong communication skills and the ability to present and defend quality findings to senior stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications * Experience evaluating LLM or GenAI systems using MLflow, LangSmith, Weights \& Biases, or equivalent tools. * Experience with LLM\-as\-judge design and understanding its limitations and failure modes. * Applied statistics, including sampling design, confidence intervals, significance testing, and calibration measurement. * Epic EHR data experience. * Experience with Caboodle or Clarity. * Knowledge of clinical coding systems such as ICD, CPT, SNOMED, and LOINC. * Experience with multi\-tenant data isolation testing. * Experience testing code\-generation or SQL\-generation systems. * Previous experience presenting test evidence directly to client executives. Software Design and Best Practices * Apply software design principles such as SOLID and Domain\-Driven Design. * Understand software code patterns and best practices. * Maintain up\-to\-date technical skills and industry knowledge.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Agentic Engineering
jobs.description: Position Summary: Vista Equity Partners is seeking a Consultant, Deployment Strategist to help execute agentic engineering transformations at Vista portfolio companies. The role supports Vista’s Agentic Engineering Factory framework, which helps portfolio companies adopt agentic AI across the software development lifecycle, with measurable gains in engineering throughput, quality, and cost. This role sits on the Product \& Technology Value Creation team and owns day\-to\-day engagement execution. The Deployment Strategist works inside portfolio company engineering and product organizations to turn a broad goal, such as shipping faster at lower cost with AI tooling, into a scoped, sequenced, and measured program. They keep that program on track across portfolio company leadership, Vista engagement leads, tool vendors, and delivery partners, and they write what they learn back into Vista’s playbooks, templates, and measurement standards. The Deployment Strategist works as a pair with the team’s Senior Forward Deployed Engineers. The Senior Forward Deployed Engineers own the technical build: repository and environment readiness, agent and harness configuration, and hands\-on work with portfolio company engineers. The Deployment Strategist owns everything around that build: scoping, stakeholder alignment, measurement, program management, and adoption. Together they cover an engagement from the first discovery conversation through measured results. The role requires analytical rigor, technical fluency, and the ability to work credibly with CTOs, CPOs, CFOs, and engineers. It is an operating role, not a pure advisory one: the Deployment Strategist is accountable for whether the work gets delivered, adopted, and measured. This role is for an immediate start. Responsibilities: * Own day\-to\-day execution of agentic engineering engagements at assigned portfolio companies, from discovery and scope definition through build, rollout, measurement, and handoff. * Lead discovery, including data requests, current\-state SDLC and product development interviews, and use case workshops, to identify where engineering work stalls and where AI tooling can have the highest impact. * Translate pain points into scoped use cases with defined success criteria, baselines, owners, and phase\-gate requirements. * Partner with the Senior Forward Deployed Engineers to turn scoped use cases into build requirements, sequence technical work against business priorities, and keep engineers and stakeholders aligned on what is being built and why. * Define and maintain engagement measurement, including metric definitions with explicit calculation logic, baselines, control groups, and efficiency models. Ensure reporting separates adoption from outcomes and holds up under scrutiny from portfolio company finance and engineering leaders. * Run the program cadence: maintain the tracker as the system of record, manage milestones, risks, blockers, and decisions, and produce weekly status updates and steering committee and executive materials. * Work with portfolio company engineers and product leaders to pilot and roll out agentic development tooling. Prototype, script, and analyze data directly where it moves the work forward. * Coordinate across Vista, portfolio company teams, tool vendors, and external delivery partners. Hold partners to agreed scope, acceptance criteria, and handoff plans. * Support change management and enablement, including sequencing of communications, training, and adoption checkpoints, so that the tooling is used in daily work. * Support evaluation of AI engineering platforms and harnesses against each portfolio company’s technical, security, and organizational constraints. * Surface decisions, tradeoffs, and data discrepancies early, and escalate to Vista and portfolio company leadership with a clear recommendation. * Capture lessons from each engagement and contribute to reusable playbooks, phase\-gate templates, data request lists, and diagnostic kits for use across the Vista portfolio. **What Could Be Next:** This role gives you direct exposure to several portfolio companies at different stages of AI adoption, and to the executives who make the decisions. You see what works and what fails across different codebases, team structures, and tool choices. That experience prepares you to lead engagements and a broader portfolio, take on an operating role at a portfolio company, or move into forward deployed, product, strategy, or investing roles focused on software and AI. Qualifications: * 2 to 5 years of experience in consulting, product management, technical program management, implementation, or operating roles, preferably in software or technology. * Demonstrated ownership of a complex, multi\-stakeholder program with ambiguous requirements, where you were accountable for delivery and not only for advice. * Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle, including source control, CI/CD, issue tracking, and engineering productivity metrics such as cycle time and deployment frequency. * Hands\-on use of AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. * Strong quantitative skills, including building and pressure\-testing metrics and models and stating their assumptions and limits clearly. * Ability to communicate clearly with both product management / engineering teams and senior executives, in writing and in person. * Comfort with open\-ended problems, low ego, and a focus on outcomes over credit. * Experience with developer productivity measurement, change management, agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph), system integrators, or private equity operating environments is preferred. * Willingness to travel up to 50%. The annualized base pay range for this role is expected to be between $140,000 \- $165,000\. Actual base pay could vary based on factors including but not limited to experience, subject matter expertise, geographic location where work will be performed and the applicant’s skill set. The base pay is just one component of the total compensation package for employees. Other components may include an annual cash bonus and a comprehensive benefits package. Company Overview: Vista is a preeminent technology investor, specializing in enterprise AI and software, with over $100 billion in AUM. For over 25 years and across every technology cycle, Vista has been pioneering new approaches to software investing, delivering consistent and compelling results at scale. Today, we're applying that expertise to help harness the transformative potential of AI to redefine how work gets done. Further information is available at vistaequitypartners.com. Follow Vista on LinkedIn, @Vista Equity Partners, and on YouTube.

approaches. * Establish and promote common definitions for key risk, customer, account, transaction, and performance measures to improve consistency across analytics and decisioning. * Identify opportunities to improve the availability, usability, quality, and scalability of data used by risk and data science teams. * Act as a bridge between data consumers and data engineering teams, helping prioritize and communicate data requirements and technical needs. ### **Data Pipeline Optimization** * Partner closely with data engineering teams to design, optimize, and improve pipelines supporting risk analytics, modeling, and strategy. * Identify bottlenecks, redundancies, data quality issues, and opportunities to improve the efficiency and reliability of existing data pipelines. * Help jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: AutoStore™ holds a simple yet powerful vision: to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. Founded in Norway, we've grown into a global technology company. AutoStore uses advanced software to automate and orchestrate order fulfillment. Our goal is to ensure orders arrive faster than ever, with minimal environmental impact. That’s how we help brands exceed customer expectations. We have more than 1600 systems in nearly 60 countries, and we grow continuously as a community of employees, partners, customers, suppliers, and connected technologies. Automation should make life easier, and by listening carefully to our community, we innovate to meet the industry’s most complex needs. With AutoStore™, brands gain speed, efficiency, improved workplaces, and much more floor space. **The Role:** As a Mechanical Engineer at AutoStore, you will help develop the next generation of automated storage and retrieval systems that power warehouses around the world. You will contribute to the design, analysis, prototyping, testing, and production launch of innovative electromechanical products used in our robots, grids, bins, charging systems, and other emerging technologies. You will apply engineering fundamentals, simulation tools, and hands\-on product development experience to solve challenging technical problems and deliver reliable, manufacturable solutions. Working as part of the New Product Development Innovation Team in Atlanta, you will collaborate with mechanical, electrical, controls, software, manufacturing, and test engineers throughout the product development lifecycle. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who enjoys taking ownership of technical problems, learning from experienced engineers, and contributing directly to products deployed in more than 1,600 AutoStore systems worldwide. **Key Tasks and Responsibilities:** * Design mechanical components, assemblies, and mechanisms using 3D CAD tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, or NX. * Perform engineering analyses including hand calculations, finite element analysis (FEA), tolerance analysis, and design trade studies to support product development decisions. * Develop concepts and detailed designs for robotic and electromechanical systems, balancing performance, cost, manufacturability, and reliability. * Build, evaluate, and refine prototypes through iterative testing and analysis. * Support laboratory testing activities, analyze test results, and incorporate findings into design improvements. * Collaborate with electrical, controls, and software engineers to develop integrated system solutions. * Participate in design reviews and contribute to technical problem\-solving activities across projects. * Support supplier engagement activities including part reviews, manufacturability discussions, and technical issue resolution. * Assist with product validation activities and engineering documentation. * Apply Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFM/DFA) principles to improve product quality, reliability, and production efficiency. * Create and maintain engineering drawings, specifications, bills of material, and other development documentation. Support new product introduction activities through prototype, pilot, and production phases. * **Key Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. * 3 \+ years of experience developing mechanical or electromechanical products. * Proficiency with 3D CAD tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, NX, or similar platforms. * Experience performing engineering analysis using FEA tools such as Ansys, Simcenter, Abaqus, or equivalent software. * Familiarity with mechanical design fundamentals including materials, stress analysis, tolerance stack\-up analysis, and machine design. * Experience creating engineering drawings and applying GD\&T principles. * Understanding of design for manufacturability and assembly (DFM/DFA). * Experience supporting prototype builds, testing activities, and product validation efforts. * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot mechanical systems and identify root causes. * Ability to communicate effectively with cross\-functional teams. Demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a team environment. * **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience developing robotic systems, automation equipment, industrial machinery, or other electromechanical products. * Familiarity with dynamic analysis, kinematics, multibody simulation, or motion system design. * Hands\-on experience with motors, gearboxes, conveyors, lifting mechanisms, bearings, sensors, or other mechatronic components. * Experience with additive manufacturing, rapid prototyping, or laboratory test equipment. * Exposure to reliability testing, environmental testing, or failure analysis. * Experience using MATLAB, Python, or other engineering tools for data analysis and automation. * Familiarity with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems such as Teamcenter or Windchill. * Experience working with suppliers and contract manufacturers. Knowledge of warehouse automation, robotics, logistics systems, or material handling equipment. * **We Offer:** AutoStore believes in taking care of employees and is dedicated to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. Join us in our mission to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans * Health Savings Account (HSA) with a company contribution * Generous Paid Time Off including 12 holidays, paid exercise time, paid volunteer time, and paid parental leave plans for all new parents * Retirement 401(k) plan with employer match and discretionary profit sharing contribution * Educational assistance and professional development programs, including mentorship/coaching programs with external industry leaders Additional benefits include Group Life Insurance, Voluntary Additional Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance programs, and more! * AutoStore is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, pregnancy\-related conditions, and lactation), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. *AutoStore does not accept agency resumes or assistance for this role. Please do not forward resumes to our job's alias or AutoStore employees. AutoStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. This policy should be respected.*

If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. **Applying to Render** ---------------------- We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. **About the Role** ------------------ Render's mission is simple: eliminate the tedious work of building software by providing a cloud platform that just works. We're evolving from the go\-to platform for solo developers into the backbone for fast\-scaling teams. Our brand has to evolve with us. Developers already love Render for how it feels to use; now the brand needs to carry that same clarity and confidence everywhere else: on our site, in our campaigns, on a conference floor, and in every launch we put into the world. As Brand Designer, you'll be a core maker on the brand team. You'll take briefs and turn them into sharp, finished work across campaigns, launches, events, and everyday brand moments. You'll contribute ideas in concept development, own projects from first sketch to final files, and help keep the brand system consistent as it grows. You'll work closely with senior brand designers and creative leads, with plenty of room to take on bigger projects as you grow. What makes this work hard and interesting: developers are a famously skeptical audience. They can spot marketing gloss from a mile away, and they reward brands that are honest, specific, and a little bit delightful. Great brand work here has to earn attention from people who don't want to be sold to. That takes real craft and a good sense of what engineers find genuine. You'll join a design team that takes its craft seriously, with weekly critiques and deep collaboration with marketing, product, and engineering. You'll thrive here if you love making things, care deeply about the details, and want to grow your craft alongside people who will push you. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Create high\-craft graphic design across the brand.** Design key visuals, web and social assets, ads, presentations, print, and merch. Typography, layout, color, and composition are your everyday tools, and you'll bring care to every piece, no matter how small. * **Contribute to concept development.** Join brainstorms and creative explorations with a steady stream of ideas. You'll sketch directions, build out options, and help the team find the concept that best fits the brief, then refine it until it's ready to ship. * **Design and extend campaigns.** Working from a creative platform set with e explorations, and how your thinking moved the work forward. * **Campaign and launch work.** You've designed assets for campaigns or product launches across digital, social, and print, and you know how to keep an idea consistent across many formats. * **Some event or physical design experience.** You've designed for print production, signage, booths, or merch, and you understand what it takes to get files ready for the real world. * **Comfort working within a brand system.** You can work fluently inside an established identity and know when to stretch it thoughtfully. * **Curiosity about developers.** You don't need a technical background, but you're interested in how developers think and what kind of brand they trust. * **Ownership and reliability.** You manage your own projects, hit deadlines, and know when to ask for direction. You take feedback well and use it to make the work better. * **Clear, collaborative communication.** You can present your work, explain your choices, and work smoothly with marketing, product, and engineering partners. **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * **Animation and motion design.** You can add motion to brand work, such as animated social posts, logo stings, or simple launch videos. Experience with After Effects, Cavalry, Rive, or Lottie is a plus. * **Interactive design and experiences.** You've designed interactive web moments, microsites, or playful experiments that invite people to engage. * **Comfort near code.** Some familiarity with HTML, CSS, or prototyping tools that help you test interactive ideas. * **Experience at a developer tools or technical company.** * **Illustration or 3D skills** that expand what the brand can do in\-house. * **Curiosity about AI\-assisted design** and how new tools can speed up exploration. * **Side projects** that show your craft and point of view. FSAs and HSAs are available as well. * Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc. * Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy. * Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders. * Continuous learning benefits \& related support. *This position is generally not eligible for new visa**sponsorship.
